# 2020: current events archive

**Source-preservation edition.**

This chronological reference preserves 7,393 Wikipedia event assertions across 366 dates, including topic hierarchy, original citations and pinned revisions. SQLite is authoritative; this UTF-8 Markdown is its readable companion.

Source selection and wording are Wikipedia’s, and are not certified exhaustive, impartial or factually correct. Publication does not imply independent checking of every assertion. Original wording, errors and dated reporting figures remain visible. Editorial accounts are separately labeled and cited.

Database: [2020.sqlite](2020.sqlite). Edition SHA-256: `569cbe9afdb002cd0331d40c13dd2e630b5c6b30167367c11a2e2e15a09dc4c8`. Publication: `preservation-release-1.0`. Extraction/Markdown profile: `annual-series-1.0`. Date: 2026-10-21.

Original entries without attached citations: 8. These have separate editorial evidence. Full-event reviews complete: 4; partial: 4; without a full-event review: 7,385. Partial reviews leave unsupported details explicit.

Exact original daily files, Wikipedia payloads/metadata and prior extraction candidates are embedded losslessly, with hashes, an exact retirement manifest and Git checkpoint. Wikipedia attribution and CC BY-SA obligations remain applicable. Publisher URLs identify evidence; full publisher articles and images are not reproduced.

Template display uses explicit original arguments without calculated conversions, live expansion or inferred links. Unsupported template markup and source reliability tags remain visible. Orphan topics and malformed/unbulleted material are preserved with the handling notes below; no missing child or event is invented.

Commented-out source assertions remain labeled non-event material in the database and handling notes; they are excluded from ordinary event totals.

## January

### 2020-01-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1284116256](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20January%201&oldid=1284116256>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-01-01-0-1"></a>

Context: Attack on the United States embassy in Baghdad.

**Archived source account.** Supporters of Iraqi paramilitaries withdraw from the American embassy in Baghdad after being ordered to by the Popular Mobilization Forces, stating the "message has been heard".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-security-usa/iraqi-militias-start-withdrawing-from-u-s-embassy-idUSKBN1Z01N9?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-01-01-0-3"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present), Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** The Houthis release six Saudi prisoners as part of a United Nations-mediated deal struck last month. All six arrive in Riyadh later the same day.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-prisoners/six-saudi-prisoners-freed-by-yemens-houthis-return-home-idUSKBN1Z01T9?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-01-01-0-4"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present), Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** The secessionist Southern Transitional Council pulls out of committees working to implement a November agreement that would have placed them in the national cabinet and put their forces under government control. The council claims it was in response to an outbreak of violence in the Shabwah Governorate allegedly caused by their rival, the Al-Islah party.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security/yemens-southern-separatists-pull-out-of-riyadh-agreement-committees-idUSKBN1Z01ZE?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-01-01-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Taliban kills 23 security force members in three separate attacks in three different Afghani provinces.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/01/taliban-attacks-kill-20-afghan-security-forces-200101133724551.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-01-01-1-1"></a>

Context: 2019–20 Australian bushfire season.

**Archived source account.** An additional three deaths have been confirmed on the New South Wales South Coast while another man has been killed in Victoria's East Gippsland region.

Source citations (as archived): [News](<https://www.news.com.au/national/nsw-and-victorian-bushfires-wreak-havoc-and-destruction/live-coverage/fb3443775d5d2b365ba1c583046dc865>).

<a id="event-2020-01-01-1-3"></a>

Context: 2020 Jakarta floods.

**Archived source account.** At least 21 people are killed and over 19,000 displaced as flash floods hit the Indonesian capital of Jakarta.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-50969418>).

<a id="event-2020-01-01-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Coast Guard searches for five missing crew members after a fishing vessel sinks near Kodiak, Alaska. Two other crew members are rescued.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.ktuu.com/content/news/Coast-Guard-searching-for-5-people--566629771.html>).

<a id="event-2020-01-01-1-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** A fire at Krefeld Zoo, NRW, Germany, kills over 30 animals.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-50971250>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-01-01-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Palau becomes the first country in the world to ban sun cream that is harmful to corals and sea life. The ban comes into effect immediately after an announcement by President Thomas Remengesau Jr.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-50963080>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-01-01-3-1"></a>

Context: North Korea–United States relations, North Korea and weapons of mass destruction.

**Archived source account.** North Korean leader Kim Jong-un says his nation will be "developing a new strategic weapon" in the near future, after the United States misses a year-end deadline for a restart of denuclearization talks.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-usa/kim-says-north-korea-to-show-new-strategic-weapon-in-near-future-idUSKBN1YZ1DX?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-01-01-3-3"></a>

Context: China–Indonesia relations, Spratly Islands dispute.

**Archived source account.** The Indonesian Ministry of Foreign Affairs rejects an earlier statement by Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs spokesman Geng Shuang that China had territorial claims to the Spratly Islands as part of the Nine-Dash Line, stating it "\[has\] no legal basis and have never been recognized by the UNCLOS 1982". Indonesia had recalled its ambassador to China two days earlier after a Chinese coastguard vessel trespassed in its waters.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-indonesia-china-southchinasea/indonesia-rejects-chinas-claims-over-south-china-sea-idUSKBN1Z01RE?il=0>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-01-01-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 16 inmates are killed and five others injured in a riot that breaks out at a prison in Zacatecas, Mexico.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-50965785>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-01-01-5-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Guinea-Bissau presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Former Prime Minister of Guinea-Bissau Umaro Sissoco Embaló is declared the winner of the country's presidential elections. However, his direct rival Domingos Simões Pereira says he will challenge the results in court.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bissau-election/ex-guinea-bissau-pm-embalo-wins-presidency-opponent-disputes-vote-idUSKBN1Z01RA>).

<a id="event-2020-01-01-5-3"></a>

Context: Investigations involving Benjamin Netanyahu.

**Archived source account.** Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu announces he will seek immunity from his corruption cases. As the Knesset is currently deadlocked, they will likely not come to a decision until after the next election.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-politics-netanyahu/israels-netanyahu-says-he-will-seek-immunity-in-graft-cases-idUSKBN1Z020L?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-01-01-5-5"></a>

Context: Politics of Switzerland.

**Archived source account.** Simonetta Sommaruga is sworn in as President of the Swiss Confederation for second time.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua News Agency](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/europe/2020-01/01/c_138671825.htm>).

<a id="event-2020-01-01-5-7"></a>

Context: Politics of Austria.

**Archived source account.** Austria's left-wing Green Party agrees to form a coalition with the ruling right-wing People's Party. This will be the first time the Green Party is part of a ruling government in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-50969001>).

### 2020-01-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1284116449](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20January%202&oldid=1284116449>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-01-02-0-1"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Turkish Grand National Assembly votes 325–184 to send troops to help the internationally-recognized Government of National Accord in Libya.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/01/turkey-parliament-approves-military-deployment-libya-200102113511422.html>).

<a id="event-2020-01-02-0-3"></a>

Context: American-led intervention in Iraq (2014–2021), Iranian intervention in Iraq (2014–present), Aftermath of the Attack on the United States embassy in Baghdad.

**Archived source account.** A missile strike hits a convoy near Baghdad International Airport in Iraq, killing Iranian Major general Qasem Soleimani and Popular Mobilization Forces leader Abu Mahdi al-Muhandis.

Source citations (as archived): [TRT World](<https://www.trtworld.com/middle-east/top-iran-commander-qasem-soleimani-killed-in-baghdad-raid-iraqi-state-tv-32678>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-01-02-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Swedish Royal Court confirms that Princess Estelle of Sweden, second-in-line to the Swedish throne, is injured in a skiing accident in the Alps where the Crown Princess Family is on vacation.

Source citations (as archived): [Royal Central](<http://royalcentral.co.uk/europe/sweden/breaking-princess-estelle-of-sweden-injured-in-skiing-accident-135684/>).

<a id="event-2020-01-02-1-2"></a>

Context: 2020 New Taipei helicopter crash.

**Archived source account.** A UH-60 Black Hawk helicopter carrying 13 people crashes in New Taipei, Taiwan. Eight people are killed, including the Chief of the General Staff Shen Yi-ming, the head of the Republic of China Armed Forces.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/jan/02/taiwans-military-chief-missing-helicopter-crash>).

<a id="event-2020-01-02-1-4"></a>

Context: 2019–20 Australian bushfire season.

**Archived source account.** New South Wales Premier Gladys Berejiklian declares a state of emergency for seven days starting on January 3.

Source citations (as archived): [News](<https://www.news.com.au/technology/environment/nsw-premier-gladys-berejiklian-declares-state-of-emergency/news-story/8651cf93eb1fe85e3866221ed567a88c>).

<a id="event-2020-01-02-1-5"></a>

Context: 2019–20 Australian bushfire season.

**Archived source account.** An elderly woman dies of suffocation while leaving a Brisbane, Queensland-originated Qantas plane at Canberra Airport. Canberra's air quality had been reported as the worst in the world because of heavy smoke from the bushfires in New South Wales.

Source citations (as archived): [News](<https://www.news.com.au/travel/travel-updates/incidents/woman-dies-from-bushfire-smoke-in-canberra-after-exiting-qantas-plane/news-story/280f1c9bb729c5c4f3377f97936b5cda>).

<a id="event-2020-01-02-1-6"></a>

Context: 2019–20 Australian bushfire season.

**Archived source account.** A second person is confirmed dead in the East Gippsland region of Victoria as thousands of people are evacuated from Mallacoota by sea. State premier Daniel Andrews has declared a state of disaster in six government areas. 17 people remain missing.

Source citations (as archived): [News](<https://www.news.com.au/technology/environment/australian-troops-prepare-for-bushfire-emergency-evacuations-by-sea/live-coverage/cf3d149ec9bbb9b7eb808e663eec8a28>).

<a id="event-2020-01-02-1-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** A military plane crashes shortly after takeoff from an airport in Sudan's West Darfur, killing the 18 people on board.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-50978258>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-01-02-2-1"></a>

Context: China–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** China temporarily suspends plans to cross-link companies on the London and Shanghai Stock Exchange due to increased political tensions between the two nations, particularly Britain's stance on the Hong Kong protests.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-britain-ipos-exclusive/exclusive-china-halts-british-stock-link-over-political-tensions-sources-idUSKBN1Z108L>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-01-02-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Lebanese justice minister says he has received an arrest warrant from Interpol against former Chairman of Nissan, Carlos Ghosn, who escaped house arrest in Japan and fled to Lebanon days ago.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/lebanese-justice-minister-says-lebanon-has-received-an-interpol-issued-wanted-notice-for-nissans-ex-chair-carlos-ghosn/2020/01/02/5641ca3c-2d5c-11ea-bffe-020c88b3f120_story.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-01-02-4-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries.

**Archived source account.** Former Secretary of Housing and Urban Development Julian Castro drops out of the presidential race.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2020/01/02/774556481/julian-castro-drops-out-of-the-democratic-presidential-race>).

<a id="event-2020-01-02-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Italy's ruling Five Star Movement expels Senator Gianluigi Paragone from its ranks over disciplinary issues, shrinking the coalition's majority in the Senate to five.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-italy-politics-5star/italys-5-star-expels-senator-further-reducing-slim-government-majority-idUSKBN1Z10T0?il=0>).

### 2020-01-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1111955434](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20January%203&oldid=1111955434>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-01-03-0-1"></a>

Context: Iranian intervention in Iraq (2014–present), American-led intervention in Iraq (2014–2021), Aftermath of the Attack on the United States embassy in Baghdad, Assassination of Qasem Soleimani.

**Archived source account.** Popular Mobilization Forces spokesman Ahmed Al Asadi confirms the death of Quds Force Commander Qasem Soleimani in an airstrike, blaming Israel and the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [The Economic Times](<https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/defence/irans-major-general-qassem-soleimani-and-iraqs-muhandis-killed-in-air-strike-militia-spokesman/articleshow/73077547.cms>).

<a id="event-2020-01-03-0-2"></a>

Context: Iranian intervention in Iraq (2014–present), American-led intervention in Iraq (2014–2021), Aftermath of the Attack on the United States embassy in Baghdad, Assassination of Qasem Soleimani.

**Archived source account.** United States officials say "strikes have been carried out against two targets linked to Iran in Baghdad".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-security-usa-strike/strikes-against-two-targets-linked-to-iran-u-s-officials-idUSKBN1Z201Q>).

<a id="event-2020-01-03-0-3"></a>

Context: Iranian intervention in Iraq (2014–present), American-led intervention in Iraq (2014–2021), Aftermath of the Attack on the United States embassy in Baghdad, Assassination of Qasem Soleimani.

**Archived source account.** In response to the death of Qasem Soleimani, U.S. President Donald Trump tweets an image of an American flag. He later defends the airstrike, claiming Soleimani "was both hated and feared" in Iran and "should have been taken out many years ago."

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/homenews/administration/476610-trump-tweets-american-flag-amid-reports-of-strike-against-iranian>); [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/politics-news/trump-tweets-after-u-s-strike-iran-never-won-war-n1109906>).

<a id="event-2020-01-03-0-4"></a>

Context: Iranian intervention in Iraq (2014–present), American-led intervention in Iraq (2014–2021), Aftermath of the Attack on the United States embassy in Baghdad, Assassination of Qasem Soleimani.

**Archived source account.** The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps says Soleimani and Muhandis were "martyred" in an attack by U.S. helicopters. Anonymous security sources cited by AFP say the attack killed at least eight people. The Iraqi military says three rockets hit the airport and two cars exploded.

Source citations (as archived): [New Straits Times](<https://www.nst.com.my/world/world/2020/01/552980/update-8-killed-rocket-attack-baghdad-airport>).

<a id="event-2020-01-03-0-5"></a>

Context: Iranian intervention in Iraq (2014–present), American-led intervention in Iraq (2014–2021), Aftermath of the Attack on the United States embassy in Baghdad, Assassination of Qasem Soleimani.

**Archived source account.** The secretary of the Iranian Expediency Discernment Council, former Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps commander Mohsen Rezaee, tweets that "vigorous revenge against America" will be pursued following the assassination of Soleimani. Iranian state television cuts all broadcasts, replacing them with prayers for Soleimani.
