**Archived source account.** A stampede occurs during the funeral of Qasem Soleimani in his hometown of Kerman. Iranian state-affiliated media say at least 56 people are killed and 213 more are injured.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC News](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/iran-qassem-soleimani-us-kerman-1.5417178>).

<a id="event-2020-01-07-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A magnitude 6.4 earthquake strikes Puerto Rico, killing one and injuring nine others

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://nbcnews.com/news/latino/6-5-quake-strikes-puerto-rico-amid-heavy-seismic-activity-n1111666>).

<a id="event-2020-01-07-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** An avalanche at a ski resort in Kellogg, Idaho, United States, kills two people and injures five others.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2020/01/08/794589755/2-killed-5-injured-in-avalanche-at-idaho-ski-resort>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2020-01-07-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Neil Peart dies from glioblastoma, a form of brain cancer, in his home in Santa Monica, California. He had been diagnosed three years earlier but had kept details secret until his family officially announced his death on January 10, 2020.

Source citations (as archived): [Rolling Stone](<https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/neil-peart-rush-obituary-936221/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-01-07-3-1"></a>

Context: Iran–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Iran's Islamic Consultative Assembly formally designates the United States Department of Defense as a "terrorist organization" in response to the assassination of General Qasem Soleimani in a targeted killing in Baghdad, Iraq. Under the newly adopted bill, all United States Armed Forces personnel and Pentagon employees are "considered terrorists."

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua News Agency](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2020-01/07/c_138685013.htm>); [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/iran-designates-us-forces-terrorists-for-killing-general-12240474>).

<a id="event-2020-01-07-3-2"></a>

Context: Iran–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Germany announces a partial withdrawal of the Bundeswehr troops positioned in Iraq, citing security concerns.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/germany-to-partially-withdraw-troops-from-iraq/a-51909308>).

<a id="event-2020-01-07-3-3"></a>

Context: Iran–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Canada's Chief of the Defence Staff General Jonathan Vance announces that some of its military personnel in Iraq will be moved to neighboring Kuwait over safety reasons.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-security-canada/canada-says-some-troops-in-iraq-to-be-moved-temporarily-to-kuwait-for-safety-idUSKBN1Z622W>).

<a id="event-2020-01-07-3-4"></a>

Context: Iran–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Kosovo Police arrest Ikballe Berisha Huduti, the founder of a now defunct Islamic organization called Kur'ani, in Pristina following an order from the prosecution after she was accused of inciting terrorist acts for social media comments against the United States over the death of Qasem Soleimani.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-kosovo-iran-crime/kosovo-arrests-iran-supporter-over-comments-after-soleimanis-death-idUSKBN1Z62AH>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/reuters/2020/01/07/world/middleeast/07reuters-kosovo-iran-crime.html>).

<a id="event-2020-01-07-3-6"></a>

Context: North Korea–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** South Korean President Moon Jae-in says there is a "desperate need" for practical ways to improve ties with North Korea and says he is ready to meet repeatedly with Kim Jong-un in Pyongyang if necessary.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-southkorea-politics-moon/south-koreas-moon-cites-desperate-need-for-ways-to-improve-ties-with-north-idUSKBN1Z603B>).

<a id="event-2020-01-07-3-8"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Argentina, 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** The government of Argentina says it will not recognize Juan Guaidó as President of Venezuela, and instead as the leader of the opposition in the country, and revokes the credentials of Guaidó's representative in Argentina.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-argentina-venezuela-trotta-idUSKBN1Z62IM>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-01-07-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Japan issues an arrest warrant for former Nissan Chairman Carlos Ghosn's wife Carole for allegedly lying during testimony.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nissan-ghosn-statement/japan-issues-arrest-warrant-for-ghosns-wife-looks-for-ways-to-bring-him-back-idUSKBN1Z6057>).

<a id="event-2020-01-07-4-2"></a>

Context: January 2019 Lincoln Memorial confrontation.

**Archived source account.** CNN settles a defamation lawsuit for an undisclosed amount.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! News](<https://news.yahoo.com/cnn-settles-defamation-lawsuit-kentucky-031509289.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-01-07-5-1"></a>

Context: November 2019 Spanish general election.

**Archived source account.** After a year of political deadlock, incumbent Prime Minister of Spain Pedro Sánchez is sworn in thanks to the support of left-wing parties and regional nationalists. He will form the first coalition government in the democratic era, with Podemos and its leader Pablo Iglesias Turrión as Second Deputy Prime Minister.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-51019358>).

### 2020-01-08

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1111709508](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20January%208&oldid=1111709508>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-01-08-0-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Iranian attack on U.S. forces in Iraq.

**Archived source account.** Iran begins Operation Martyr Soleimani, launching ballistic missiles at several United States Armed Forces facilities in Iraq, including Al Asad Airbase.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/iran-launches-missiles-us-air-bases-iraq-us/story?id=68130625>).

<a id="event-2020-01-08-0-2"></a>

Context: 2020 Iranian attack on U.S. forces in Iraq.

**Archived source account.** Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps issues a statement warning regional countries not to allow the United States military to launch attacks on Iran from their territory or they "will be targeted".

Source citations (as archived): [Associated Press](<https://apnews.com/add7a702258b4419d796aa5f48e577fc>).

<a id="event-2020-01-08-0-3"></a>

Context: 2020 Iranian attack on U.S. forces in Iraq.

**Archived source account.** In response to Iranian missile attacks on U.S. forces, the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) bans all U.S. commercial flights from operating in airspace over Iraq, Iran, the Persian Gulf and the Gulf of Oman.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/Middle-East/FAA-bans-flights-over-Iraq-Iran-Gulf-of-Oman-after-Iranian-attack-613484>).

<a id="event-2020-01-08-0-4"></a>

Context: 2020 Iranian attack on U.S. forces in Iraq.

**Archived source account.** Due to heightened tensions, Japanese Prime Minister Shinzō Abe cancels his scheduled trips to Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Oman, and convenes a National Security Council meeting, likely to discuss Iran's attack on U.S. forces based in Iraq.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/reuters/2020/01/08/world/middleeast/07reuters-iraq-security-japan-abe.html>).

<a id="event-2020-01-08-0-5"></a>

Context: 2020 Iranian attack on U.S. forces in Iraq.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump announces new sanctions against Iran in response to the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2020/01/08/us-officials-warned-missile-launch-iraq-bases-troops/2842200001/>).

<a id="event-2020-01-08-0-7"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War.

**Archived source account.** An Al-Shabaab car bombing kills six people and injures 12 others at an army checkpoint near Somalia's parliament in Mogadishu.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg News](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-01-08/six-killed-in-car-bomb-attack-in-somalia-s-capital-police-say>).

<a id="event-2020-01-08-0-9"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A car bomb kills four Turkish soldiers when a vehicle explodes at a checkpoint during a road check in northeastern Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Arab News](<https://www.arabnews.com/node/1610276/middle-east>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2020-01-08-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Prince Harry and his wife Meghan announce their plan to "step back as 'senior' members" of the British royal family. Buckingham Palace says discussions on the intended new role are "at an early stage".

Source citations (as archived): [United Press International](<https://www.upi.com/Entertainment_News/2020/01/08/Prince-Harry-Meghan-Markle-step-back-from-royal-family/7241578509912/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-01-08-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tesla, Inc. reports a stock market capitalization of US$88 billion in response to strong performances in the third- and fourth-quarter, surpassing General Motors and Ford Motor Company to become the most valuable automobile company in North America.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-stocks-tesla/teslas-market-value-eclipses-gm-and-ford-combined-idUSKBN1Z72MU>); [Business Insider](<https://markets.businessinsider.com/news/stocks/tesla-stock-price-rally-most-valuable-us-car-maker-history-2020-1-1028804022>).

<a id="event-2020-01-08-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The heads of state of Turkey, Russia, Serbia and Bulgaria formally inaugurate the TurkStream gas pipelines.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-turkey-russia-pipeline/turkey-russia-launch-turkstream-pipeline-carrying-gas-to-europe-idUSKBN1Z71WP>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-01-08-3-1"></a>

Context: Ukraine International Airlines Flight 752.

**Archived source account.** A Boeing 737-800 crashes while taking off from Tehran Imam Khomeini International Airport, killing all 176 people on board. The incident, which took place amid the 2019–20 Persian Gulf crisis, is under investigation.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2020/01/07/794430621/jetliner-reportedly-carrying-180-people-crashes-near-tehran-airport>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-01-08-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Norway agrees to take in 600 refugees from Rwanda who were previously evacuated from Libyan detention camps. Rwanda last September signed an agreement with the United Nations to take in asylum seekers from Libya while their status was being processed, to cut down on human trafficking in the Mediterranean.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-libya-refugees-rwanda-norway/norway-to-take-600-libya-evacuees-from-rwanda-camp-idUSKBN1Z72IJ?il=0>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-01-08-5-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Sagamihara stabbings.

**Archived source account.** The trial of Satoshi Uematsu, a young Japanese man who admitted to stabbing 19 disabled people to death at a care center in 2016, begins. The rampage ranks among the country's worst mass killings. His lawyer is expected to enter a plea of not guilty on grounds of diminished capacity. Uematsu will be handed a sentence on March 16 and could receive the death penalty.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/trial-opens-in-japan-for-grisly-murder-of-19-at-disabled-home-12242124>).

<a id="event-2020-01-08-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** One person is shot dead and three seriously wounded in a shooting near Parliament Hill in Ottawa. Police believe the shooting was targeted.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-canada-shooting/gunfire-near-canadian-parliament-kills-one-wounds-three-idUSKBN1Z722C>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-01-08-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Kuwaitian state news agency KUNA says its official Twitter account was hacked after it spread a fake news report that the United States Army would withdraw from Camp Arifjan within three days.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/hacked-kuwait-govt-says-report-of-u-s-troop-withdrawal-is-incorrect-1.8373707>).

<a id="event-2020-01-08-6-2"></a>

Context: List of fast radio bursts.

**Archived source account.** Scientists announce through the journal Nature the discovery of a repeating fast radio burst known as FRB 180916 coming from a nearby spiral galaxy around 500 million light years from Earth. It is the second repeating FRB to have been localized.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/life-style/gadgets-and-tech/news/radio-signal-frb-galaxy-space-universe-fast-burst-a9273356.html>).

### 2020-01-09

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1111708234](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20January%209&oldid=1111708234>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-01-09-0-1"></a>

Context: Battle of Chinagodrar.

**Archived source account.** Islamist militants kill over 25 Nigerien soldiers in an attack on an army base in Tillabéri Region, Niger. 63 militants are also killed in the ensuing shootout.

Source citations (as archived): [The Punch](<https://punchng.com/63-terrorists-25-others-killed-in-niger-army-base-attack/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nigeria-security/suspected-islamists-kill-25-soldiers-in-niger-government-idUSKBN1Z82JN>).

<a id="event-2020-01-09-0-3"></a>

Context: Ukraine International Airlines Flight 752.

**Archived source account.** U.S., Canadian, British and Iraqi officials say they believe the plane crash near Tehran in which 176 were killed yesterday was likely caused accidentally by an Iranian anti-aircraft missile, while Iran says it was due to "mechanical failure".

Source citations (as archived): [Newsweek](<https://www.newsweek.com/iranians-shot-down-ukraine-flight-mistake-sources-1481313>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2020/01/09/794863678/we-will-surely-find-out-the-truth-questions-linger-about-jet-crash-in-iran>); [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-iran-crash-britain/johnson-says-there-is-evidence-ukrainian-plane-was-shot-down-by-iran-missile-idUKKBN1Z82LD?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-01-09-0-4"></a>

Context: Ukraine International Airlines Flight 752.

**Archived source account.** The New York Times releases a verified video obtained from an Iranian citizen showing the plane being struck by what appears to be a surface-to-air missile.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2020/01/09/video/iran-plane-missile.html>).

<a id="event-2020-01-09-0-5"></a>

Context: Ukraine International Airlines Flight 752.

**Archived source account.** In a news conference, Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau says it's "too early to draw definitive conclusions" that the downing of the plane was an "act of war". Trudeau also condemns Iran's attack on U.S. bases in Iraq.

Source citations (as archived): [National Post](<https://nationalpost.com/news/canada/champagne-asks-iran-to-let-canadian-officials-in-to-investigate-plane-crash>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-01-09-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bus crashes in Iran's Mazandaran Province, killing at least 20 passengers and injuring 24 others.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/01/reported-dead-bus-crash-iran-iranian-media-200109053940090.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-01-09-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Judge Ghassan Ouiedat, a Lebanese prosecutor, imposes a travel ban on former Chairman of Nissan Carlos Ghosn after he was summoned over an Interpol warrant issued by Japan seeking his arrest on financial misconduct charges.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nissan-ghosn-lebanon-questioning/lebanon-imposes-travel-ban-on-ex-nissan-boss-ghosn-judicial-source-idUSKBN1Z80ZC>).

<a id="event-2020-01-09-2-2"></a>

Context: Trial of Catalonia independence leaders.

**Archived source account.** The Spanish Supreme Court revokes the immunity of jailed Oriol Junqueras declared by the European Court of Justice in a sentence on 19 December. This happens after the board of European Parliament recognized the former Vice President of Catalonia as a MEP since 3 July and was elected president of the Greens–European Free Alliance parliamentary group.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2020/01/09/world/europe/ap-eu-spain-catalonia.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-01-09-3-1"></a>

Context: Brexit.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom House of Commons votes 330–231 to pass the Withdrawal Agreement Bill authorizing the country’s departure from the European Union at the end of the month.

Source citations (as archived): [Associated Press](<https://nbc25news.com/news/nation-world/lawmakers-approve-brexit-bill-uk-on-course-for-jan-31-exit>).

### 2020-01-10

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1366163684](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20January%2010&oldid=1366163684>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-01-10-0-1"></a>

Context: Ukraine International Airlines Flight 752.

**Archived source account.** After Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau suggests the plane was downed by an Iranian missile, Iranian authorities reject this theory. Iranian civil aviation chief says he is "certain" the plane was not hit by a missile, still asserting the cause was "mechanical failure".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-51062369>).

<a id="event-2020-01-10-0-3"></a>

Context: January 2020 Quetta bombing.

**Archived source account.** A bombing claimed by the Islamic State at a mosque in Quetta, Balochistan, Pakistan, kills at least 15 people and injures 18 others, three days after a motorcycle bombing in the city killed two.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2020/01/10/world/asia/pakistan-mosque-bombing-isis-taliban.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-01-10-1-1"></a>

Context: Iraq–United States relations, Iran–Iraq relations.

**Archived source account.** Iraqi cleric and Grand Ayatollah Ali al-Sistani condemns both the United States and Iran over the escalation of conflict in Iraq, saying it shows blatant disregard for Iraqi sovereignty and the suffering of the Iraqi people.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-security/iraqi-cleric-condemns-u-s-and-iran-as-fears-of-wider-conflict-persist-idUSKBN1Z80P5?il=0>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-01-10-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An 11-year-old student opens fire at his school in Torreón, Coahuila, Mexico, killing a teacher and wounding six others before committing suicide.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/jan/10/mexico-school-shooting-torreon>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-01-10-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019–20 Australian bushfire season.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people protest in Melbourne, Brisbane and Sydney, calling for the resignation or ouster of Prime Minister Scott Morrison, accusing him of negligence over the Australian bushfires.

Source citations (as archived): [News](<https://www.news.com.au/technology/environment/climate-change/major-rallies-held-in-australian-cities-calling-for-prime-minister-scott-morrison-to-be-sacked/news-story/54b61b35563536a0b8a8fade8580b57f>).

<a id="event-2020-01-10-3-3"></a>

Context: 2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries.

**Archived source account.** Author and self-help guru Marianne Williamson drops out of the U.S. presidential race.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2020/01/10/us/politics/marianne-williamson-drops-out.html>).

<a id="event-2020-01-10-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Tunisian Parliament votes 134 to 72 to reject a cabinet proposed by Prime Minister-designate Habib Jemli. President Kais Saied has 10 days to select someone else to build a new government.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-tunisia-politics/tunisian-parliament-rejects-government-coalition-building-must-restart-idUSKBN1Z92EW?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-01-10-3-6"></a>

Context: Death of Qaboos bin Said al Said.

**Archived source account.** Omani state television announces the death of the Sultan of Oman Qaboos bin Said al Said aged 79. At the time of his death he was the longest serving head of state in the Middle East and Arab world.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://news.trust.org//item/20200110233755-nw853/>).

<a id="event-2020-01-10-3-7"></a>

Context: Death of Qaboos bin Said al Said.

**Archived source account.** The high military council of Sultan of Oman's Armed Forces calls on the Omani royal family to convene to name a successor to the late sultan within three days. A three-day period of national mourning is declared.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/jan/11/sultan-of-oman-dies-state-media-announces>).

### 2020-01-11

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1366163603](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20January%2011&oldid=1366163603>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-01-11-0-1"></a>

Context: Ukraine International Airlines Flight 752, 2019–20 Iranian protests.

**Archived source account.** Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps admits it mistakenly shot down the Ukraine International Airlines plane as it took off from Tehran, killing all 176 aboard.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/iran-unintentionally-shot-ukrainian-jetliner-68209842>).

<a id="event-2020-01-11-0-2"></a>

Context: Ukraine International Airlines Flight 752, 2019–20 Iranian protests.

**Archived source account.** Vigils in Iran that were held for the victims subsequently turn into protests. According to Twitter videos, hundreds of protesters in Tehran call for the resignation of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://reuters.com/article/amp/idUSKBN1ZA0LZ>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/01/iranian-protesters-demand-khamenei-quit-downing-plane-200111171757858.html>).

<a id="event-2020-01-11-0-3"></a>

Context: Ukraine International Airlines Flight 752, 2019–20 Iranian protests.

**Archived source account.** The British ambassador to Iran, Robert Macaire, is arrested during anti-government protests, after attending a vigil and then, according to BBC, getting his hair cut. According to Tasnim News Agency he was arrested "on suspicion of organising, provoking and directing radical actions". U.K. Foreign Secretary Dominic Raab states the arrest is in "flagrant violation" of international law. More than an hour later, Macaire is released from custody.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/jan/11/british-ambassador-arrested-at-demonstration-in-tehran-reports>).

<a id="event-2020-01-11-0-5"></a>

Context: Libyan peace process.

**Archived source account.** German Chancellor Angela Merkel announces she will hold peace talks in Berlin to help end the Second Libyan Civil War. Both Russian President Vladimir Putin and Government of National Accord leader Fayez al-Sarraj express support for the peace initiative.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-germany-merkel-libya/german-chancellor-merkel-says-berlin-will-host-libya-peace-talks-idUSKBN1ZA0NG>).

<a id="event-2020-01-11-0-6"></a>

Context: Libyan peace process.

**Archived source account.** Forces loyal to Khalifa Haftar say they accept a ceasefire starting on 12 January, conditional on their rivals' acceptance.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-libya-security/libyan-forces-loyal-to-haftar-announces-conditional-ceasefire-spokesman-idUSKBN1ZA0WM>).

<a id="event-2020-01-11-0-8"></a>

Context: Iraqi protests (2019–present).

**Archived source account.** Hundreds walk the street in mourning after popular journalist Ahmad Abdessamad and his cameraman were killed by unidentified gunmen the night before.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20200111-hundreds-mourn-reporters-shot-dead-after-covering-iraq-protests>).

<a id="event-2020-01-11-0-10"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** Two United States troops are killed and another two troops injured by a roadside bomb. The Taliban later claim responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-blast/two-u-s-service-members-killed-in-afghanistan-nato-idUSKBN1ZA0KT>); [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/2-american-troops-killed-by-roadside-bomb-in-afghanistan-2020-01-11/>).

<a id="event-2020-01-11-0-12"></a>

Context: Battle of Chinagodrar.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the attack on Niger's armed forces on Thursday rises to over 89 Niger soldiers.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/reuters/2020/01/11/world/africa/11reuters-niger-security.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-01-11-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Winter Storm Isaiah brings widespread heavy snowfall and freezing rain to the midwestern and southern United States, killing at least 12 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Associated Press](<https://www.abc12.com/content/news/Recovery-begins-after-storms-that-kill-12-in-Midwest-South-566924641.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-01-11-2-1"></a>

Context: North Korea–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** After U.S. President Donald Trump sends birthday wishes to North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, North Korea state media says that "although Chairman Kim Jong-un has good personal feelings about President Trump, they are, in the true sense of the word, 'personal'", and that it is not enough to resume denuclearization talks. It further stated that the country would not be led on the basis of Kim's feelings.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-usa/north-korea-says-leaders-relations-not-enough-after-trump-sends-birthday-wishes-to-kim-idUSKCN1ZA082>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-51074956>).

<a id="event-2020-01-11-2-3"></a>

Context: United Kingdom–United States relations, Death of Harry Dunn.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. State Department rejects an extradition request from the Home Office for the unlawful killing of Harry Dunn, describing it as "highly inappropriate" and "establish\[ing\] an extraordinarily troubling precedent".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-northamptonshire-51075235>).

<a id="event-2020-01-11-2-5"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** More than a dozen Saudi military cadets are to be expelled from the United States, following a review by the Department of Defense in the aftermath of a shooting at Naval Air Station Pensacola last month by a Royal Saudi Air Force member.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/01/11/politics/saudi-servicemen-expelled-december-air-force-base-shooting/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-01-11-3-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Taiwanese presidential election, 2020 Taiwanese legislative election.

**Archived source account.** Taiwanese voters head to the polls to elect a president and a new session to the Legislative Yuan. Incumbent pro-independence President Tsai Ing-wen defeats anti-independence challenger Han Kuo-yu in a landslide victory by more than 20%.

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<https://www.scmp.com/news/china/politics/article/3045652/taiwan-votes-not-just-leader-way-forward-beijing>).

<a id="event-2020-01-11-3-2"></a>

Context: 2020 Taiwanese presidential election, 2020 Taiwanese legislative election.

**Archived source account.** The governing Democratic Progressive Party retains its majority in the Yuan, albeit with fewer seats. Most of the seats lost are taken by third parties instead of the KMT.

Source citations (as archived): [Taiwan News](<https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/en/news/3855186>).

<a id="event-2020-01-11-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Oman names Haitham bin Tariq al-Said as its new head of state after the death of Sultan Qaboos.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN International](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/01/11/middleeast/oman-sultan-qaboos-bin-said-death-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-01-11-3-5"></a>

Context: Politics of Northern Ireland, Executive of the 6th Northern Ireland Assembly.

**Archived source account.** Following a deal brokered by the British and Irish governments, the Northern Ireland Executive is restored with Democratic Unionist Party leader Arlene Foster as First Minister and Sinn Féin deputy leader Michelle O'Neill as deputy First Minister, ending three years of political deadlock. The previous government had collapsed in 2017 as the result of a renewable energy scandal involving Foster.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/2020/01/10/northern-ireland-parliament-at-stormont-to-return-after-three-years-of-deadlock>).

<a id="event-2020-01-11-3-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thousands of protestors march in Warsaw against a controversial law proposed by the Sejm that would allow the Polish government to discipline judges that question their reform policies. Critics say the law would undermine the independence of the judiciary, and risks Poland's membership in the European Union.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-poland-judiciary-toga-march/thousands-protest-against-polands-plan-to-discipline-judges-idUSKBN1ZA0PD>).

### 2020-01-12

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 944064972](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20January%2012&oldid=944064972>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-01-12-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four Iraqi soldiers are wounded when mortar shells strike Balad Air Base, 40 mi north of Baghdad, which houses U.S. military personnel. The mortars struck the runway inside the base.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-security-base/mortar-bombs-strike-iraqi-military-base-of-balad-four-wounded-military-sources-idUSKBN1ZB0I0?il=0>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-01-12-1-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Taal Volcano eruption.

**Archived source account.** The Taal Volcano in southern Luzon, Philippines, spews an ash plume that measures approximately 10to15 km. The Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology designates a "level 4" alert level, indicating "an imminent hazardous eruption".

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/jan/13/philippines-lava-gushes-from-taal-volcano-as-alert-level-raised>).

<a id="event-2020-01-12-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The government of the Canadian province of Ontario apologizes for issuing a false alert about an incident at a nuclear plant near Toronto and blames a training exercise mistake. Angry local mayors demand an inquiry, saying the emergency message about the ageing Pickering Nuclear Generating Station has caused unnecessary distress.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-canada-nuclear/canada-province-says-sorry-after-training-mistake-sparks-false-nuclear-alert-idUSKBN1ZB0C8?il=0>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-01-12-2-1"></a>

Context: Japan–Saudi Arabia relations.

**Archived source account.** Japanese PM Shinzō Abe arrives in Saudi Arabia in his first visit to the Middle East, where he expects to mediate between the United States and Iran amid heightening tensions.

Source citations (as archived): [The Japan Times](<https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2020/01/12/national/politics-diplomacy/abe-meets-saudi-king-salman-calls-cooperation-stabilize-middle-east-talks-foreign-minister/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-01-12-3-1"></a>

Context: Ukraine International Airlines Flight 752, 2019–20 Iranian protests.

**Archived source account.** Protests continue for a second day despite a large deployment of security forces.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/amp/world-middle-east-51081833>).

<a id="event-2020-01-12-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Gambia warns ousted leader Yahya Jammeh not to return to the country, saying his safety cannot be guaranteed if he returns without permission, a government spokesman says. A spokesman for Jammeh's party says he could arrive back at any time from exile in Equatorial Guinea.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-51082371>).

<a id="event-2020-01-12-3-4"></a>

Context: 2019 Malta political crisis.

**Archived source account.** Robert Abela wins the Partit Laburista leadership election, succeeding Joseph Muscat as Prime Minister after Muscat's resignation.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-51080574>); [CNN International](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/01/12/europe/malta-robert-abela-prime-minister-intl/index.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-01-12-4-1"></a>

Context: Chinese espionage in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Department of the Interior halts its civilian drone program indefinitely out of concerns that China manufactured the fleet via the SZ DJI Technology Company for espionage.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-drones/trump-to-halt-civilian-drone-program-over-china-tech-concerns-ft-idUSKBN1ZB0MU>).

### 2020-01-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 945269642](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20January%2013&oldid=945269642>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2020-01-13-0-1"></a>

Context: 92nd Academy Awards.

**Archived source account.** The nominees for this year’s Academy Awards are announced. Joker receives 11 nominations, including for Best Picture and Best Director, the most out of those nominated.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hollywood Reporter](<https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lists/oscar-nominations-2020-complete-list-nominees-updating-live-1267880>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-01-13-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Competition Commission of India launches an antitrust probe into Flipkart and the Indian subsidy of Amazon, alleging that they were promoting certain sellers at the expense of smaller merchants.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-india-antitrust-ecommerce/india-orders-antitrust-probe-against-amazon-walmarts-flipkart-idUSKBN1ZC1BO>).

<a id="event-2020-01-13-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Raphael Bostic, President of the Federal Reserve Bank in Atlanta, says in a speech that he, as a member of the Federal Reserve Board is inclined to keep interest rates at their present, very low, levels. Any evidence of overborrowing or volatility will have to be "systemic" for him to change his mind.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-fed-bostic/fed-on-hold-but-will-financial-risks-matter-idUSKBN1ZC21E>).

<a id="event-2020-01-13-1-3"></a>

Context: China–United States trade war.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Department of the Treasury de-lists China as a currency manipulator.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trade-china/u-s-treasury-removes-designation-of-china-as-currency-manipulator-idUSKBN1ZC2FV>).

<a id="event-2020-01-13-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Visa Inc. purchases financial technology firm Plaid for US$5.3 billion, after it and Mastercard each invested US$250 million into the company last year.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-plaid-m-a-visa/visa-to-buy-fintech-startup-plaid-in-5-3-billion-deal-idUSKBN1ZC2BF>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-01-13-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A sinkhole swallows a bus and several pedestrians on a busy street in Xining, China, killing six people and leaving 16 others injured. According to state media, the sinkhole stretches nearly 10m (32 feet) in diameter.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-china-51101683>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-01-13-3-1"></a>

Context: Libyan peace process.

**Archived source account.** Representatives of Libya's Government of National Accord (GNA) and General Khalifa Haftar's rival Libyan National Army (LNA) reach a ceasefire agreement after talks in Moscow between warring factions in Libya, also attended by Russian and Turkish officials. The preliminary agreement was signed by GNA head Fayez al-Sarraj, while Haftar plans to sign it the next day.

Source citations (as archived): [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/478151-lavrov-progress-ceasefire-talks/>).

<a id="event-2020-01-13-3-3"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabia–United States relations, aftermath of the Naval Air Station Pensacola shooting.

**Archived source account.** The United States expels 21 Royal Saudi Air Force cadets. Amid an investigation into the Saudi Arabian military following the attack on Naval Air Station Pensacola in Florida, the cadets were found to have jihadist material and child pornography on their phones. However, none of the cadets are believed to have assisted the gunman in the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-51095771>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-01-13-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Lahore High Court, in Punjab, Pakistan, says the death sentence verdict against former ruler Pervez Musharraf last month is unconstitutional, casting into doubt the legitimacy of the verdict.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pakistan-law-musharraf/pakistani-judges-rule-special-court-in-musharraf-case-was-unconstitutional-idUSKBN1ZC12E>).

<a id="event-2020-01-13-4-2"></a>

Context: Murder of Ján Kuciak.

**Archived source account.** A suspect accepts guilt for having killed the investigative journalist and his fiancée.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC News](<https://www.cbc.ca/amp/1.5424644>).

<a id="event-2020-01-13-4-4"></a>

Context: Crime in China.

**Archived source account.** After a standoff, police in Hohhot, Inner Mongolia shoot and kill a hostage taker who had taken three hostages with a homemade gun. The case comes less than a year after five were killed in a shooting in Inner Mongolia, and the case is under investigation.

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<https://www.scmp.com/news/china/society/article/3045826/chinese-police-free-three-hostages-after-killing-kidnapper-armed>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-01-13-5-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries.

**Archived source account.** New Jersey Senator Cory Booker drops out of the U.S. presidential race.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2020-election/cory-booker-drops-out-presidential-race-n1114426?cid=sm_npd_nn_tw_ma>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-01-13-6-1"></a>

Context: Presolar grains.

**Archived source account.** Analysis of a meteorite found in Australia in 1969 reveals stardust formed 5 to 7 billion years ago, older than Earth's 4.6 billion year-old sun, making the meteor and its stardust the oldest solid material ever discovered on Earth.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/technology/the-oldest-material-on-earth-has-been-found-in-a-meteorite/ar-BBYUQy4>).

<a id="event-2020-01-13-6-3"></a>

Context: Naval Air Station Pensacola shooting.

**Archived source account.** Apple says it is helping authorities in the Pensacola shooting investigation but refuses to unlock their phones.

Source citations (as archived): [BuzzFeed News](<https://www.buzzfeednews.com/article/scottlucas/william-barr-apple-request-unlock-iphones>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2020-01-13-7-1"></a>

Context: Houston Astros sign stealing scandal.

**Archived source account.** Houston Astros general manager Jeff Luhnow and manager A. J. Hinch are suspended by Major League Baseball for the entire 2020 season after the league concludes its investigation into the team's illegal use of technology to steal signs during the team's championship 2017 season. They are also fired by the organization.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<https://www.espn.com/mlb/story/_/id/28476780/astros-jeff-luhnow-aj-hinch-fired-sign-stealing>).

<a id="event-2020-01-13-7-3"></a>

Context: 2020 College Football Playoff National Championship.

**Archived source account.** In American football, LSU defeats Clemson to win the national championship.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/sports/lsu-smothers-clemson-42-25-seize-college-football-s-national-n1114896>).

### 2020-01-14

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1291353214](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20January%2014&oldid=1291353214>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-01-14-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Security forces block roads leading to intelligence buildings in Sudan as gunfire is heard in the capital Khartoum.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-sudan-security/gunfire-heard-in-sudanese-capital-witness-idUSKBN1ZD19F>).

<a id="event-2020-01-14-0-2"></a>

Context: Battle of Chinagodrar.

**Archived source account.** ISIL claims responsibility for the attack in Chinagodrar, Tillabéri Region, Niger, that killed at least 89 Nigerien soldiers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-niger-security/islamic-state-claims-responsibility-for-niger-army-base-attack-idUSKBN1ZD1ZZ>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-01-14-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom bans the use of credit cards to make bets both for online and offline gambling, including the purchase of lottery tickets. The only exception to the ban is the purchase of lottery tickets in face-to-face transactions. The Gambling Commission says the ban will come into effect on April 14.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/us-britain-gambling/britain-bans-using-credit-cards-to-gamble-idUKKBN1ZD0PF>).

<a id="event-2020-01-14-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** In India, economic slowdown has adversely impacted employment generation in the country, as nearly 1,600,000 fewer jobs are projected to be created in FY20 compared to 8,970,000 fresh jobs in FY19.

Source citations (as archived): [The Economic Times](<https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/economy/indicators/slowdown-may-hurt-job-creation-sbi/articleshow/73239579.cms>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-01-14-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 57 people are killed and others are missing after avalanches in Pakistan-controlled Kashmir over the last 24 hours, senior government officials say. In Indian-administered Kashmir, at least 10 are killed.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pakistan-disaster/at-least-67-killed-by-avalanches-in-pakistan-india-government-officials-idUSKBN1ZD0TU>).

<a id="event-2020-01-14-2-2"></a>

Context: Chemical Industries of Ethylene Oxide explosion.

**Archived source account.** An explosion at a chemical plant in Tarragona, Catalonia, Spain, kills two members of staff and another man 3 km away. Seven other people are injured.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-51113132>).

<a id="event-2020-01-14-2-4"></a>

Context: Delta Air Lines Flight 89.

**Archived source account.** At least 44 people, including twenty elementary school children, are injured after Delta Flight 89, bound for Shanghai, dumped jet fuel over Los Angeles before making an emergency landing at Los Angeles International Airport. None of the reported injuries required hospitalization.

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<https://time.com/5764959/jet-fuel-playground-children-los-angeles/>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2020/01/15/delta-dumps-fuel-expert-defends-pilots/4476137002/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-01-14-3-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Tonga.

**Archived source account.** Tonga pays an outstanding fee in order not to lose its voting rights at the United Nations General Assembly. Tonga was among seven countries suspended last week for not paying their assessed contributions.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/407297/tonga-pays-outstanding-un-fees-govt>).

<a id="event-2020-01-14-3-3"></a>

Context: Libyan peace process.

**Archived source account.** General Khalifa Haftar, head of the Libyan National Army (LNA), refuses to sign a ceasefire agreement after talks in Moscow brokered by Russia and Turkey yesterday with Government of National Accord leader Fayez al-Sarraj. He says that the deal "ignores many of the Libyan army's demands".

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/01/libya-haftar-leaves-moscow-signing-ceasefire-agreement-200114064637135.html>).

<a id="event-2020-01-14-3-5"></a>

Context: Indonesia–Thailand relations.

**Archived source account.** Thai Army Chief Apirat Kongsompong and his Indonesian counterpart Andika Perkasa sign an intelligence-sharing agreement aimed at combating the insurgency in Thailand’s southern provinces.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/thailand--indonesia-to-share-intelligence-to-combat-insurgents-12262750>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-01-14-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** After the conviction of serial rapist Reynhard Sinaga, Mohammad Idris, the mayor of Depok, West Java, Indonesia, says he plans to raid the local LGBT community and is condemned by human rights activists.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-indonesia-lgbt/indonesia-rights-body-condemns-lgbt-raids-ordered-by-mayor-after-uk-rape-case-idUSKBN1ZD0J6?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-01-14-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** American rapper Jay-Z and his philanthropic organization Team Roc file a federal lawsuit against Mississippi Department of Corrections commissioner Pelicia E. Hall and Mississippi State Penitentiary superintendent Marshal Turner over the abusive and neglectful treatment of their prisoners, which they claim has led to the deaths of at least three people.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/jay-z-goes-bat-mississippi-prisoners-files-federal-lawsuit-n1115616>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/entertainment-arts-51126128>).

#### Politics and Elections

<a id="event-2020-01-14-5-1"></a>

Context: Politics of Guatemala.

**Archived source account.** Alejandro Giammattei takes the oath of office as President of Guatemala for the next four years. Also 160 new members of Congress are installed for a new parliamentary period of four years.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-guatemala-politics-president/giammattei-sworn-in-as-guatemalan-president-after-delays-idUSKBN1ZE044>).

<a id="event-2020-01-14-5-3"></a>

Context: Politics of South Korea.

**Archived source account.** The National Assembly of South Korea elects and sworns in Chung Sye-kyun as Prime Minister, succeeding Lee Nak-yeon.

Source citations (as archived): [Yonhap News Agency](<https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20200113009151320>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-01-14-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Microsoft officially ends support for the Windows 7 operating system. Microsoft says its Windows 7 users can still use their computers, but warns they will be at "greater risk for viruses and malware".

Source citations (as archived): [CNN Business](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/01/13/tech/microsoft-windows-7-support/index.html>).

### 2020-01-15

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1322726722](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20January%2015&oldid=1322726722>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-01-15-0-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Sudanese Revolution.

**Archived source account.** The Sudanese Armed Forces says it has quelled a mutiny by soldiers loyal to ousted President Omar al-Bashir in the capital Khartoum. Former Director of the National Intelligence and Security Service Salah Gosh is accused of orchestrating the mutiny, which left two troops dead. His current whereabouts are unknown.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-51112518>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2020-01-15-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Vatican appoints Francesca Di Giovanni undersecretary for multilateral affairs in the Secretariat of State, the first woman to hold a management position in this office.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-51124478>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-01-15-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Winter Storm Jacob makes landfall over the Pacific Northwest, bringing high winds and up to 22 in of snow to the Olympic Peninsula and forcing widespread road closures and transport cancellations.

Source citations (as archived): [The Weather Channel](<https://weather.com/storms/winter/news/2020-01-12-mid-january-snow-ice-rain-storm-west-midwest-northeast>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-01-15-3-1"></a>

Context: Egypt–Turkey relations.

**Archived source account.** Turkey summons its chargé d'affaires to Egypt after accusing the Egyptian security forces of raiding the Cairo offices of the state-run Anadolu News Agency and arresting four of its employees.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-egypt-security/turkey-says-egyptian-security-forces-raid-news-agency-in-cairo-idUSKBN1ZE1U5?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-01-15-3-3"></a>

Context: Japan–North Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** North Korean state media condemn Japanese Prime Minister Shinzō Abe for his attempts to reform the pacifist Japanese constitution. The state media say that "in the event of a constitutional revision, which gives \[Japan's\] self-defense forces legitimacy, the Japanese reactionaries will have all the preconditions necessary to realize military aggression overseas".

Source citations (as archived): [United Press International](<https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2020/01/15/North-Korea-rails-against-Japan-plans-for-constitutional-amendment/6591579104508/>).

<a id="event-2020-01-15-3-5"></a>

Context: China–United States trade war.

**Archived source account.** In a meeting at the White House, U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese Vice Premier Liu He sign "Phase 1" of a new trade deal in which the U.S. will relax some of the tariffs imposed on Chinese imports while China agreed to buy more American products. Both sides also agree to not impose new tariffs.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2020/01/15/796305300/trump-to-sign-phase-one-china-trade-deal-but-most-tariffs-remain-in-place>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-01-15-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Russian government of Dmitry Medvedev's Second Cabinet resigns after President Vladimir Putin delivers the Presidential Address to the Federal Assembly, in which he proposed several amendments to the constitution. Putin accepts the resignation. Medvedev says the constitutional changes would "significantly change Russia's balance of power".

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/dmitry-medvedev-resign-russia-prime-minister-putin-quit-latest-a9284741.html>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-51120166>).

<a id="event-2020-01-15-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis nominates Council of State president Aikaterini Sakellaropoulou to be President of Greece. If approved, she will be the first female president in Greek history.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-greece-politics-president/greek-pm-taps-top-female-judge-as-countrys-president-idUSKBN1ZE2FE?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-01-15-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Virginia House of Delegates votes to ratify the Equal Rights Amendment decades after its deadline passed. As the amendment nonetheless now has enough states for it to be fully adopted, legal scholars are divided on whether this means the Constitution of the United States has been amended.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2020/01/15/796754345/virginia-ratifies-the-equal-rights-amendment-decades-after-deadline>).

### 2020-01-16

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1039160376](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20January%2016&oldid=1039160376>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-01-16-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The American-led coalition issues a statement saying that 11 U.S. service members were injured by the January 8, 2020 attack by Iran on U.S. forces in Iraq. The U.S. Department of Defense had initially assessed that there had been no injuries.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/01/16/politics/service-members-injured-iran-strike/index.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2020-01-16-1-1"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in South Korea.

**Archived source account.** In a landmark case, the South Korean military is set to decide on the first transgender soldier's possible discharge. The soldier underwent surgery overseas and is stationed in Gyeonggi Province. The case sparks a national debate on LGBT issues in the military, which punishes sex between two males with up to two years imprisonment.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-southkorea-military-transgender/south-korea-to-decide-on-first-transgender-soldier-amid-debate-idUSKBN1ZF1S0?il=0>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-01-16-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Senate votes 89–10 to pass the United States–Mexico–Canada Agreement. Once ratified by Canada, it will supersede the North America Free Trade Agreement.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trade-usmca/senate-passes-north-america-trade-deal-canada-still-to-approve-idUSKBN1ZF283?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-01-16-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Alphabet Inc., parent company of Google, becomes the fourth American company to hit a stock market capitalization of US$1 trillion.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-funds-google/which-company-just-hit-1-trillion-google-it-idUSKBN1ZF2SH>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-01-16-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Winter Storm Jacob continues to move eastwards across the northern United States, bringing up to 26 in of snowfall from Montana to Idaho and Utah and down into the Sierra Nevada of California.

Source citations (as archived): [The Weather Channel](<https://weather.com/storms/winter/news/2020-01-12-mid-january-snow-ice-rain-storm-west-midwest-northeast>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-01-16-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Guatemalan President Alejandro Giammattei cuts ties with the government of disputed Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro and closes Guatemala's embassy in Caracas.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-guatemala-politics-venezuela/guatemalas-new-president-cuts-ties-with-venezuela-as-promised-idUSKBN1ZF2SB?il=0>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-01-16-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** After his escape from Japan, Carlos Ghosn's Japanese lawyer Junichiro Hironaka and seven other members of his defense resign. Hironaka says Ghosn's escape was a "complete surprise".

Source citations (as archived): [CNN Business](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/01/16/business/carlos-ghosn-lawyer/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-01-16-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The bodies of seven people are found in a mass grave in the indigenous Ngäbe-Buglé region of Panama. Authorities believe a religious sect performed an exorcism on the victims. Police rescued 15 people who had suffered bodily injuries.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-51144629>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-01-16-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mikhail Mishustin is appointed as new Prime Minister of Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2020/01/16/world/europe/mikhail-mishustin.html>).

### 2020-01-17

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1141701880](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20January%2017&oldid=1141701880>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-01-17-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019–2021 Iraqi protests.

**Archived source account.** At least two people are killed and dozens injured after Iraqi security forces fire upon protesters at Sinak bridge in central Baghdad.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/01/iraq-security-forces-kill-protesters-baghdad-200117192553279.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-01-17-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Icelandic fishing company Samherji announces it will cease operations in Namibia. The company was embroiled in a bribery scandal there that resulted in the resignation of Namibian Fisheries Minister Bernhardt Esau and Justice Minister Sacky Shanghala, as well as the arrest of two employees of South African banking corporation Investec.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-namibia-samherji/icelands-samherji-exiting-namibia-following-bribery-scandal-idUSKBN1ZH0DF?il=0>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-01-17-2-1"></a>

Context: Winter Storm Jacob.

**Archived source account.** An avalanche at the Squaw Valley Ski Resort in northern California, host site of the 1960 Winter Olympics, kills one person and seriously injures another.

Source citations (as archived): [The Weather Channel](<https://weather.com/storms/winter/news/2020-01-12-mid-january-snow-ice-rain-storm-west-midwest-northeast>).

<a id="event-2020-01-17-2-2"></a>

Context: Winter Storm Jacob.

**Archived source account.** Widespread snowfall and freezing rain across the Midwest leads to travel disruption. At Kansas City International Airport, a Delta Air Lines Airbus A319 passenger jet slides off the taxiway in icy conditions, while rare snowfall was recorded on the Texas Panhandle.

Source citations (as archived): [WABC-TV](<https://abc7ny.com/travel/delta-plane-slides-off-runway-in-missouri/5858193/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-01-17-3-1"></a>

Context: Politics of Lesotho.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Tom Thabane announces his forthcoming resignation after an arrest warrant is issued for his current wife, first lady Maesiah Thabane, who is wanted in connection for the 2017 murder of Thabane's estranged wife, Lipolelo Thabane.

Source citations (as archived): [The Sowetan](<https://www.sowetanlive.co.za/news/africa/2020-01-20-lesotho-1st-ladys-rise-to-infamy/>).

<a id="event-2020-01-17-3-3"></a>

Context: Crime in China.

**Archived source account.** A man is sentenced to death for murdering a doctor in Beijing on New Year's Eve. The murder was the latest in a string of attacks on medical staff in China by angry relatives blaming them for the lack of medical resources and services.

Source citations (as archived): [AsiaOne](<https://www.asiaone.com/china/chinese-doctors-murder-overshadows-new-law-improve-public-health-care>).

<a id="event-2020-01-17-3-5"></a>

Context: Killing of the Haynie family.

**Archived source account.** A 16-year-old boy, identified as Colin Haynie, shoots his parents and three younger siblings in their home in Grantsville, Utah, killing all but his father, who then apprehended him at the scene. The familicide was the deadliest mass shooting in Utah in 13 years.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2020/01/22/colin-haynie-utah-teen-charged-killing-mother-siblings/4548072002/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-01-17-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Brazilian federal government secretary of culture, Roberto Alvim, is dismissed after the broadcast of a video where he announces a new national prize on culture. In the video, Alvim seems to paraphrase a speech by Joseph Goebbels, Nazi Germany's Reichsminister of Propaganda.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/jan/17/brazil-culture-minister-goebbels-roberto-alvim-nazi>).

<a id="event-2020-01-17-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian Prime Minister Oleksiy Honcharuk submits his resignation after an audio clip of him allegedly criticizing President Volodymyr Zelensky’s economic policies was leaked earlier this week. Zelensky subsequently announces that Honcharuk is allowed to keep his position.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ukraine-pm-resignation/ukraine-pm-offers-to-resign-after-tape-suggests-he-criticized-president-idUSKBN1ZG0RF>).

<a id="event-2020-01-17-4-3"></a>

Context: Ukraine International Airlines Flight 752 protests.

**Archived source account.** At a Friday sermon by Iranian Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei, his first in eight years, he defends the Revolutionary Guards’ accidental killing of passengers onboard Ukraine International Airlines Flight 752 and praises Operation Martyr Soleimani for giving a “slap on the face” to the United States. His sermon comes as public anger mounts against the government for their handling of Flight 752.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/01/ayatollah-khamenei-defends-revolutionary-guard-friday-sermon-200117105420440.html>).

<a id="event-2020-01-17-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Protesters squat an oil terminal in the eastern Libyan town of Zuwetina at the request of tribal leaders, who claim that the Government of National Accord is using oil revenue to pay for foreign fighters, a reference to Turkey's sending of troops and arms in support of the GNA. The protesters are swiftly condemned by the state-owned National Oil Corporation.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-libya-oil/eastern-libyan-protesters-enter-zueitina-oil-port-announce-its-closure-idUSKBN1ZG2B5?il=0>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Afghan presidential spokesman Sediq Sediqqi says that the government rejects the proposed "reduction in violence" by the Taliban as an "ambiguous term with no legal or military parameters". On Friday, the Taliban proposed a ten-day truce and to hold follow-up discussions with Afghan government officials.

**Archived source account.** Eighty military personnel are killed by ballistic missiles and drone strikes in an attack reportedly carried out by the Houthis against a military camp in the Yemeni city of Ma'rib, according to Saudi state TV. The Houthis have not claimed responsibility for the attack.

Context: Megxit.

**Archived source account.** Officials within Buckingham Palace announced that effective around Q2 2020, Prince Harry and his wife Meghan, Duchess of Sussex will retain, but will no longer publicly use, the style His/Her Royal Highness, and will no longer receive public funds for royal duties.

Context: Megxit.

**Archived source account.** The couple will keep their titles as Duke and Duchess of Sussex. While Prince Harry will lose all his military appointments, he will remain a prince.

<a id="event-2020-01-18-2-1"></a>

Context: Winter Storm Jacob.

**Archived source account.** A historic blizzard strikes Atlantic Canada, with St. John's in Newfoundland worst affected – over 30 in of snow fell during the day, breaking the city's all-time daily snowfall record. 21,000 homes are without power and one person is missing.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-01-19-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Philippines military announce that they have launched search and rescue operations for five Indonesian fishermen kidnapped by militants belonging to the ISIL-linked Abu Sayyaf group in Malaysian waters last week in Sabah.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-philippines-security/philippine-military-says-5-indonesians-kidnapped-by-abu-sayyaf-militants-idUSKBN1ZI0BZ>).

<a id="event-2020-01-19-1-1"></a>

Context: Storm Gloria.

**Archived source account.** The tenth named storm of the 2019–20 European windstorm season makes landfall in northern Spain, killing at least 13 people. Heavy rainfall leads to widespread flooding, while high winds and coastal storm surges cause further damage.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-51231064>).

<a id="event-2020-01-19-1-2"></a>

Context: Storm Gloria.

**Archived source account.** Several people have died from hypothermia after heavy snowfall and high winds combined to bring historic blizzards over higher ground of mainland Spain. Local meteorologists have described Gloria as the worst storm to impact the region in 38 years.

<a id="event-2020-01-19-2-1"></a>

India tightened imports from Malaysia last week in response to Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad's criticisms of the revocation of Jammu and Kashmir's special status and the Citizenship Amendment Act.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-india-malaysia/india-says-no-meeting-with-malaysia-in-davos-as-palm-row-simmers-idUSKBN1ZI0DW>).
