#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-01-21-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Gold Fields Ltd, a South African mining company, has hired an investment bank, RBC Capital Markets, to help it sell 30% of its gold project in northern Chile.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-goldfields-m-a-chile/gold-fields-hires-advisor-to-sell-stake-in-chilean-gold-project-sources-idUSKBN1ZK1YG>).

<a id="event-2020-01-21-1-2"></a>

Context: Boeing 737 MAX groundings.

**Archived source account.** After having announced it the previous month, Boeing temporarily stops production of the new 737 MAX planes. Already produced ones will remain grounded an additional month until June or July.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/01/21/business/boeing-737-max-production-halt/index.html>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2020/01/21/798312515/boeing-737-max-may-stay-grounded-into-summer>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-01-21-2-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States, COVID-19 pandemic in Washington (state).

**Archived source account.** The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention announces the first U.S. case of novel coronavirus in Snohomish County, Washington.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/health/2020/01/21/coronavirus-us-case/>).

<a id="event-2020-01-21-2-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Taiwan.

**Archived source account.** The Centers for Disease Control for Taiwan announces that the first case of novel coronavirus was identified at Taoyuan International Airport.

Source citations (as archived): [The Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/taiwan-virus-case-highlights-chinese-efforts-to-exclude-taipei-from-world-health-organization-11579634031>).

<a id="event-2020-01-21-2-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** North Korea reportedly bans foreign tourists and closes the China–North Korea border to prevent the spread of the new coronavirus.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/01/north-korea-bans-foreign-tourists-china-virus-tour-agency-200122042416138.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-01-21-3-1"></a>

Context: Ukraine–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine demands the United Kingdom's National Counter Terrorism Policing Network remove the country's Tryzub coat of arms from a guide on hate symbols associated with white supremacy and Neo-Nazism. Counter Terrorism Policing says the coat of arms was included due to its use by National Action, a proscribed far-right terror group.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/blogs-trending-51174898>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-01-21-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two judicial sources announce that the trial of seven Cameroonian soldiers has begun for the killing of two women and two children in July 2018, in a case that sparked international outcry. Six of the soldiers admit to the charges, but say they were given the order to open fire.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-cameroon-security/cameroonian-soldiers-go-on-trial-over-shooting-of-women-and-children-idUSKBN1ZK197>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-01-21-5-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Labour Party leadership election.

**Archived source account.** Birmingham Yardley MP Jess Phillips drops out of the UK Labour Party leadership race.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-51195059>).

<a id="event-2020-01-21-5-3"></a>

Context: 2019–20 Lebanese protests.

**Archived source account.** Lebanon forms a new government with former American University of Beirut professor Hassan Diab as its Prime Minister, ending a three-month deadlock. Protestors subsequently march on Parliament to protest the new government.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/01/lebanon-announces-formation-government-200121200947113.html>).

<a id="event-2020-01-21-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The 2020 United States census begins, with Census Bureau director Steven Dillingham visiting Toksook Bay, Alaska, to meet with indigenous leaders and distribute census materials to residents.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-51200808>).

### 2020-01-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1131738611](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20January%2022&oldid=1131738611>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-01-22-0-1"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Mitiga International Airport, the only functioning airport in Libya's capital Tripoli, closes and a flight from Tunisia is diverted after forces loyal to Khalifa Haftar fire rockets toward the airport.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-libya-security/tripoli-airport-closes-again-after-rocket-fire-idUSKBN1ZL1O6>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-01-22-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Elliott Management, a prominent hedge fund, has sold all its shares in the Hyundai Motor Group of South Korea. It had long quarreled with Hyundai's management, demanding more generous dividend pay-outs. Their departure from the shareholder ranks is likely welcomed by Hyundai executives.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-hyundai-motor-elliott/activist-hedge-fund-elliott-sells-stakes-in-hyundai-motor-companies-paper-idUSKBN1ZL1DW>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-01-22-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police in the Solomon Islands launch search operations to find nine people from a capsized boat near Isabel Province. Five men, two women and two children were on board.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/407867/search-for-9-missing-in-solomons-after-boat-capsized>).

<a id="event-2020-01-22-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A small plane crashes shortly after takeoff from Corona Municipal Airport in California, killing all four on board.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/01/22/us/corona-plane-crash-california/index.html>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-01-22-3-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Mainland China.

**Archived source account.** Chinese authorities quarantine the entire city of Wuhan to prevent the further spread of the novel coronavirus as the death toll rises to 17. Nobody in the city will be able to leave starting from 10 a.m. local time on January 23, and all public transport in the city is suspended.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/jan/22/coronavirus-china-measures-rein-spread-mutate-disease-death-toll>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-01-22-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** UN special rapporteurs Agnès Callamard and David Kaye demand an investigation into claims made by The Guardian yesterday that Saudi Crown Prince Mohammad bin Salman ordered the 2018 hacking of Amazon CEO Jeff Bezos's phone. The hack was allegedly done months before the assassination of Jamal Khashoggi, who was employed at Bezos's newspaper The Washington Post and was a fierce critic of the Saudi government. The Saudi Foreign Ministry dismisses the allegations as "absurd".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-people-bezos-saudi/u-n-experts-demand-probe-into-alleged-saudi-hack-of-amazon-boss-bezos-idUSKBN1ZL0C9?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-01-22-4-2"></a>

Context: Libyan peace process.

**Archived source account.** Algeria announces it will host a meeting with foreign ministers from six North and sub-Saharan African nations, all of whom share a border with Libya, following the Berlin peace summit to help strengthen support for a tentative peace deal to end the Second Libyan Civil War.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/01/algeria-host-african-foreign-ministers-libya-conflict-200122154359602.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-01-22-5-1"></a>

Context: List of mass shootings in the United States in 2020.

**Archived source account.** Eight people are shot, one fatally, following a dispute outside a McDonald's in downtown Seattle, Washington.

Source citations (as archived): [The Seattle Times](<https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/crime/police-responding-to-shooting-near-4th-avenue-and-pine-street-reports-of-multiple-victims/>).

<a id="event-2020-01-22-5-3"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in South Korea.

**Archived source account.** A South Korean transgender soldier says she will sue the armed forces after it discharged her. The soldier, Byun Hui-su, says she will take her claim "until the end, to the Supreme Court".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-southkorea-military-lgbt/i-will-continue-to-fight-south-koreas-first-transgender-soldier-vows-to-oppose-dismissal-idUSKBN1ZL0QN>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-01-22-6-1"></a>

Context: Impeachment trial of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** The United States Senate hears opening statements in the impeachment trial of Donald Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/impeachment-trial-live-updates/2020/01/22/3beb411e-3d05-11ea-8872-5df698785a4e_story.html>); [The Washington Post](<http://dpaste.com/0S15GPE.txt>); [The Washington Post](<https://archive.ph/OmFzZ>).

<a id="event-2020-01-22-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Paraguayan President Mario Abdo Benítez is confirmed to have dengue fever amid a nationwide pandemic.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-paraguay-health-dengue/paraguays-president-abdo-contracts-dengue-fever-amid-outbreak-idUSKBN1ZL1U3>).

<a id="event-2020-01-22-6-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Italian Foreign Minister Luigi Di Maio resigns as leader of the ruling Five Star Movement, as polls show the party losing support ahead of a regional election in Emilia-Romagna next Sunday.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-51214954>).

<a id="event-2020-01-22-6-5"></a>

Context: Brexit.

**Archived source account.** The European Union Withdrawal Agreement Bill passes the House of Lords and is now awaiting royal assent to become law, finalizing the United Kingdom's withdrawal from the European Union on 31 January 2020.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-51210602>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-01-22-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Seattle metropolitan area becomes the first place in the United States to allow vote by smartphone, which they authorized for a board of supervisors election in King County, Washington on February 11.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2020/01/22/798126153/exclusive-seattle-area-voters-to-vote-by-smartphone-in-1st-for-u-s-elections>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2020-01-22-8-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The NFL's Oakland Raiders officially relocate to Las Vegas, and are now known as the Las Vegas Raiders.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Insider](<https://www.businessinsider.com/the-raiders-have-moved-to-las-vegas-2020-1>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/nfl/raiders/2020/01/22/oakland-raiders-nfl-renamed-las-vegas-raiders/4548435002/?amp;amp>).

### 2020-01-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1322740411](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20January%2023&oldid=1322740411>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-01-23-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War and Northwestern Syria offensive (December 2019–March 2020).

**Archived source account.** The Russian Ministry of Defence says that hundreds of rebels stormed Syrian Army positions in Idlib Governorate, the ensuing fighting left 50 rebels dead and 90 wounded while government forces reported 40 dead and 80 wounded. A military source cited by Syrian state news agency SANA says the Jabhat al-Nusra terrorists used various weapons such as car bombs, under an "intensive fire cover".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/middle-east/2020/01/23/Up-to-40-Syrian-Soldiers-killed-80-wounded-in-Idlib-attack-IFAX-.html>); [SANA](<https://sana.sy/en/?p=183197>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-51221225>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2020-01-23-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists advances the Doomsday Clock to 100 seconds before midnight, citing the threats to human survival posed by nuclear proliferation, climate change and "cyber-based disinformation." This is the closest to midnight that the clock has been since the project began in 1947.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-51213185>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-01-23-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Malaysian agriculture giant FGV Holdings Berhad announces it will increase its sugar imports from India from 88,000 tonnes to 133,000 in an attempt to resolve the palm oil trade dispute between the two nations.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-india-malaysia-exclusive/exclusive-malaysia-to-buy-more-indian-sugar-to-resolve-palm-oil-spat-sources-idUSKBN1ZM0E8>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-01-23-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019–20 Australian bushfire season.

**Archived source account.** A C-130 water bomber crashes in southern New South Wales, Australia, while helping control a bushfire. Three American firefighters are killed.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2020-01-23/nsw-rfs-air-tanker-crashes-near-numeralla-bushfire/11893554>).

<a id="event-2020-01-23-3-3"></a>

Context: 2020 Villa El Salvador explosion.

**Archived source account.** 34 people are killed and 28 others are injured after a truck transporting liquefied petroleum gas caused a gas leak that triggered an explosion in Villa El Salvador, Lima metropolitan area, Peru.

Source citations (as archived): [RPP News](<https://rpp.pe/lima/actualidad/ves-imagenes-de-la-explosion-de-un-camion-cisterna-en-villa-el-salvador-fotos-noticia-1241259>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-01-23-4-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the new coronavirus rises to 25 and 830 confirmed cases in China as four more Chinese cities, Huanggang, Ezhou, Chibi and Zhijiang are to be placed under quarantine. The total number of people under quarantine is now over 20 million people.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-china-51230011>); [Business Insider](<https://www.businessinsider.com/china-wuhan-coronavirus-quarantine-extended-cities-cut-off-2020-1?r=US&amp;IR=T>).

<a id="event-2020-01-23-4-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore.

**Archived source account.** Singapore confirms its first case of new coronavirus, a 66-year-old Chinese man from Wuhan who was travelling with his family.

Source citations (as archived): [Channel NewsAsia](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/singapore/wuhan-virus-pneumonia-singapore-confirms-first-case-12312860>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-01-23-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Heads of state and dignitaries from around the world attend the fifth World Holocaust Forum at Yad Vashem in Jerusalem to commemorate the 75th anniversary of the liberation of the Auschwitz extermination camp and to address the resurgence of antisemitism worldwide.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/world-leaders-convene-in-jerusalem-to-remember-holocaust-and-counter-anti-semitism/2020/01/23/e82fa964-3d56-11ea-afe2-090eb37b60b1_story.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-01-23-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The International Court of Justice orders Myanmar to protect the Rohingya population from atrocities. The Gambia had brought a lawsuit before the court over charges of genocide.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-rohingya-world-court/world-court-orders-myanmar-to-protect-rohingya-from-acts-of-genocide-idUSKBN1ZM00H>).

<a id="event-2020-01-23-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A judicial source close to former Nissan chairman Carlos Ghosn says that Lebanon and Japan will have 40 days to decide whether he will be extradited back to Japan or stand trial in Lebanon.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/middle-east/2020/01/23/Lebanon-Japan-have-40-days-to-agree-on-fate-of-ex-Nissan-boss-Ghosn.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-01-23-7-1"></a>

Context: Brexit.

**Archived source account.** The European Union (Withdrawal Agreement) Act 2020 is given royal assent in the United Kingdom, formally making the bill law.

Source citations (as archived): [Vox](<https://www.vox.com/world/2020/1/23/21070594/brexit-royal-assent-january-31-uk-eu-trade>).

### 2020-01-24

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1131738760](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20January%2024&oldid=1131738760>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-01-24-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019–2021 Iraqi protests, American-led intervention in Iraq (2014–2021).

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of thousands march in Baghdad to protest the presence of the United States in Iraq.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://amp.cnn.com/cnn/2020/01/24/middleeast/iraq-protests-us-troops-intl/index.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-01-24-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Indonesia agrees to increase its imports of buffalo meat, automobiles, and sugar from India in exchange for an increase in imports of Indonesian-produced palm oil, amid a growing trade dispute between India and Malaysia.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of India](<https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/indonesia-may-ease-auto-solar-imports/articleshow/73569439.cms>); [Yahoo\! Finance](<https://finance.yahoo.com/news/exclusive-indonesia-increase-imports-india-113106563.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-01-24-2-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Houston explosion.

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed and 18 injured in a warehouse explosion in Houston, Texas, United States.

Source citations (as archived): [Associated Press](<https://www.abc12.com/content/news/Explosion-at-Houston-building-shakes-city-scatters-debris--567259021.html>).

<a id="event-2020-01-24-2-3"></a>

Context: 2020 Elazığ earthquake.

**Archived source account.** 41 people were killed and more than 1,600 were injured in an earthquake centered near Elazığ in Eastern Anatolia.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-51256908>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-01-24-3-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Mainland China, Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on The Walt Disney Company.

**Archived source account.** Shanghai Disney Resort temporarily closes ahead of the Lunar New Year "in response to the prevention and control of the disease outbreak."

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/news/world/723443/shanghai-disneyland-closes-over-china-ncov-concerns/story/>).

<a id="event-2020-01-24-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Cook Islands Ministry of Health issues an edict mandating that all expatriate workers receive MMR vaccines, or risk losing their permits.

Source citations (as archived): [Cook Islands News](<http://www.cookislandsnews.com/national/health/item/75674-it-s-only-fair-overseas-workers-must-prove-they-are-vaccinated>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-01-24-4-1"></a>

Context: Iran–Saudi Arabia relations.

**Archived source account.** Responding to Iranian Foreign Minister Javad Zarif's comments that Iran is "open to dialogue with its neighbors", Saudi Arabia's Adel al-Jubeir blames Iran for recent tensions in the Middle East and for attacks on ships and oil facilities; which Iran denies.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2020/01/24/saudi-foreign-minister-iran-has-to-change-its-behavior-and-policies.html>).

<a id="event-2020-01-24-4-3"></a>

Context: Censorship in Singapore, Malaysia–Singapore relations.

**Archived source account.** Malaysian human rights advocacy group Lawyers for Liberty sues Singaporean Home Minister K. Shanmugam in Malaysian High Court after his office invoked the country's anti-fake news law to censor the group's criticisms of the death penalty there. The plaintiff argues that the move represents "an attempt by Singapore to encroach upon, stifle or crack down on freedom of speech in Malaysia".

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/politics/article/3047550/malaysian-watchdog-accused-singapore-brutal-execution-methods>).

<a id="event-2020-01-24-4-5"></a>

Context: Morocco–Spain relations.

**Archived source account.** The foreign ministries of Spain and Morocco announce they will hold talks to resolve a dispute over territorial water rights in the North Atlantic, caused by the Moroccan parliament passing two laws that extended its claims to the coast of Western Sahara earlier this week. Spain expressed concerns that these laws would encroach on its claims near the Canary Islands.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-morocco-spain/morocco-spain-to-hold-talks-about-overlapping-territorial-waters-idUSKBN1ZN2EQ>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-01-24-5-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Rot am See shooting.

**Archived source account.** Six people are killed and two others wounded when a man opens fire on his family members in Rot am See, Baden-Württemberg, Germany. The mass shooter's parents are among the dead.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/injured-probable-deaths-shooting-germany-police/story?id=68502982>).

<a id="event-2020-01-24-5-3"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Mauritania.

**Archived source account.** Police detain a gay couple in Nouakchott after a video purportedly of them marrying in a secret location emerges, in what is considered to be the first major prosecution of its kind in recent years. The attendees in the video were also detained.

Source citations (as archived): [North African Post](<http://northafricapost.com/37280-mauritania-gay-couple-arrested-in-nouakchott-after-marriage.html>).

### 2020-01-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1131738806](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20January%2025&oldid=1131738806>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-01-25-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two women, one of them pregnant, are killed and seven others are injured when artillery hits a Rohingya village in Rakhine State. The locals blame Myanmar's armed forces. The armed forces deny responsibility and blame the Arakan Army, and say the artillery hit the village amid ethnic clashes.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-rohingya/two-rohingya-women-killed-as-myanmar-army-shells-village-mp-idUSKBN1ZO08H>).

<a id="event-2020-01-25-0-2"></a>

Context: 2019–2021 Iraqi protests.

**Archived source account.** Iraqi security forces raid a protest site in Baghdad and try to remove protesters in southern cities, firing tear gas and live bullets, killing four and wounding dozens more. The raid comes after Muqtada al-Sadr ordered his followers to withdraw.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-protests/iraqi-security-forces-raid-protest-camps-4-killed-after-sadr-supporters-withdraw-idUSKBN1ZO0AN?il=0>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-01-25-1-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** General Secretary of the Communist Party of China Xi Jinping holds a special Party Politburo meeting where he says that the country faces a "grave situation" as he warns the virus is "accelerating its speed".

Source citations (as archived): [People's Daily](<http://en.people.cn/n3/2020/0125/c90000-9651799.html>).

<a id="event-2020-01-25-1-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** The United States orders the evacuation of the Consulate General of the United States, Wuhan employees and U.S. citizens in the city.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2020/01/25/world/asia/china-coronavirus.html#link-3db7b2fe>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-01-25-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Boeing 777X completes its first test flight near Seattle, Washington, United States, after two delayed attempts.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/travel/article/boeing-777x-9-first-flight/index.html>).

### 2020-01-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1368196337](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20January%2026&oldid=1368196337>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-01-26-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Afghan forces launch ground and air operations against the Taliban, killing 51 of them in nine provinces of the country. Afghanistan's Ministry of Defense say that the military conducted thirteen ground offensives and twelve airstrikes. In the northern province of Balkh, local officials say that three women and four children were killed.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-attacks-surge/afghan-forces-launch-air-ground-attacks-on-taliban-killing-51-idUSKBN1ZP0EG>).

<a id="event-2020-01-26-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Northwestern Syria offensive (December 2019–March 2020).

**Archived source account.** Syrian government forces retake several cities in the Idlib Province area, amid a push from Syrian President Bashar al-Assad to recapture the last rebel strongholds.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security/syrian-government-forces-capture-towns-in-advance-on-rebel-held-idlib-idUSKBN1ZP0FC>).

Context: 2019–20 Lebanese protests.

**Archived source account.** The Lebanese government votes 49–13, with eight abstentions and the rest boycotting, to pass the government budget in the midst of escalating protests. The budget projects a deficit of six percent, with no new taxes and most of the cuts going to the state utility company Électricité du Liban. Economists criticize the bill for failing to address the issues that caused the protests.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/ajimpact/lebanon-passes-budget-critics-call-useless-piece-paper-200127190315527.html>).

### 2020-01-28

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu unveil a peace plan developed by the Trump administration for three years. The plan recognizes Israeli sovereignty over major settlement blocs in the occupied West Bank, as well as the annexation of the Jordan Valley, in exchange for a freeze on new Israeli settlements in certain areas for four years. Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas dismisses the plan as "nonsense", while Israeli opposition leader Benny Gantz casts his support for the plan.

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-01-31-2-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** President Donald Trump announces a close of travel from China of non U.S. citizens or residents in response to the growing Coronavirus cases in Wuhan.

Source citations (as archived): [Trump White House Archives](<https://trumpwhitehouse.archives.gov/presidential-actions/proclamation-suspension-entry-immigrants-nonimmigrants-persons-pose-risk-transmitting-2019-novel-coronavirus/>).

<a id="event-2020-01-31-2-3"></a>

<a id="event-2020-01-31-2-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** The Department of Health and Human Services declares the coronavirus a public health emergency in the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2020/01/31/white-house-to-hold-briefing-on-coronavirus-friday-afternoon.html>).

<a id="event-2020-01-31-2-6"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [El Mundo](<https://www.elmundo.es/salud/2020/01/31/5e3463effdddfffa7a8b45ac.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-01-31-3-1"></a>

Context: Brexit.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom formally withdraws from the European Union at 23:00 GMT.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-51194363>).

<a id="event-2020-01-31-3-2"></a>

Context: Brexit.

**Archived source account.** Subsequently, the Department for Exiting the European Union and the Secretary of State for Exiting the European Union cabinet position are abolished with immediate effect upon leaving the EU.

Source citations (as archived): [inews](<https://inews.co.uk/news/politics/brexit/brexit-secretary-steve-barclay-exits-cabinet-boris-johnson-shutters-department-1382444>).

<a id="event-2020-01-31-3-4"></a>

Context: Tanzania–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. bans Tanzanian official Paul Makonda from entering the U.S. for his announcement about a crackdown on Tanzanian homosexuals in Dar es Salaam in 2018, among other accusations.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-tanzania-sanctions/u-s-bans-tanzanian-official-who-launched-anti-gay-crackdown-idUSKBN1ZU2W9>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-01-31-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Farrukhabad, Uttar Pradesh, India, a man is shot and killed by police after taking more than 20 children as hostages for more than 10 hours. Angry locals later beat the hostage-taker's widow to death. It is unknown whether she was involved in her husband's plan.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-51320991>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-01-31-5-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries.

**Archived source account.** Former U.S. Representative John Delaney drops out of the U.S. presidential race.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<https://www.latimes.com/politics/story/2020-01-31/john-delaney-2020-candidates-ends-bid>).


## February

### 2020-02-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1278342411](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20February%201&oldid=1278342411>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-02-01-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Suspected Islamist militants kill at least 62 civilians in a series of massacres in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo as killings of civilians intensify. The country's armed forces launch counter-offensives against insurgents of the Allied Democratic Forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-congo-violence/militants-kill-dozens-in-east-congo-as-attacks-on-civilians-intensify-idUSKBN1ZV3OS>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-02-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** 400–500 people are left stranded at the Sasquatch Mountain Resort in British Columbia, Canada, after the road to the resort was damaged from landslides caused by heavy rain. Train service between Vancouver and Seattle was also suspended until Monday due to mudslides.

Source citations (as archived): [CTV News](<https://bc.ctvnews.ca/landslide-washouts-strand-500-people-on-sasquatch-mountain-ski-hill-1.4793567>); [CTV News²](<https://bc.ctvnews.ca/mudslide-means-passenger-trains-between-vancouver-and-seattle-won-t-resume-until-monday-1.4793612>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-02-01-2-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** Kiribati becomes the latest country in the Pacific to block Chinese travelers by placing all visa applications from China on hold and ordering all those coming from countries with confirmed cases of the virus to self-quarantine.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio NZ International](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/408618/coronavirus-kiribati-blocks-chinese-travellers>).

<a id="event-2020-02-01-2-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** Apple Inc. announces it will close all of its stores and offices in China until February 9 due to the pandemic.

Source citations (as archived): [Gizmodo](<https://gizmodo.com/apple-is-closing-all-of-its-stores-and-corporate-office-1841410459>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-02-01-3-1"></a>

Context: Trump peace plan.

**Archived source account.** The Palestinian National Authority cuts all ties with the United States and Israel, including those relating to security, after rejecting a peace plan presented by U.S. President Donald Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palestinians-security/palestinian-authority-cuts-ties-with-israel-and-u-s-idUSKBN1ZV3PO>).

<a id="event-2020-02-01-3-3"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of the Maldives.

**Archived source account.** The Maldives returns to the Commonwealth of Nations as a republic in the Commonwealth of Nations.

Source citations (as archived): [The Commonwealth](<https://thecommonwealth.org/media/news/maldives-becomes-54th-member-commonwealth-family>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-02-01-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A court in Egypt sentences a former special forces officer and 36 others to the death penalty after being convicted on charges of terrorism, court officials say.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-egypt-security/egypt-sentences-officer-turned-militant-and-36-others-to-death-idUSKBN1ZV3IW>).

<a id="event-2020-02-01-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police in South Africa launch a manhunt for the killers of nine illegal miners who were stoned to death in western Johannesburg. All nine killed were from Lesotho.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-51341567>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-02-01-5-1"></a>

Context: 2019–2021 Iraqi protests.

**Archived source account.** Former Communications Minister Mohammed Tawfiq Allawi is appointed Prime Minister of Iraq by President Barham Salih. Protestors reject his appointment, seeing him as part of the establishment.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/02/iraq-president-appoints-mohammed-allawi-pm-state-tv-200201150554113.html>).

### 2020-02-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1241388385](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20February%202&oldid=1241388385>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-02-02-0-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Streatham stabbing.

**Archived source account.** Three people are injured after a man attacked people with a machete in Streatham High Road, London, United Kingdom. The attacker is shot dead by police. The incident is declared as terrorism-related.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-london-51349664>).

<a id="event-2020-02-02-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war, Northwestern Syria offensive (December 2019–March 2020), Turkish involvement in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** More than 200 Turkish Armed Forces vehicles cross the Syria–Turkey border into rebel-held Idlib Governorate in an effort to halt the Syrian Army advance on the city of Saraqib.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/turkish-military-convoy-crosses-into-rebel-held-nw-syria/2020/02/02/17651c30-45d8-11ea-91ab-ce439aa5c7c1_story.html>); [Al Masdar News](<https://www.almasdarnews.com/article/turkish-military-attempts-to-block-syrian-armys-path-to-saraqib/>).

**Archived source account.** Punxsutawney Phil doesn't cast a shadow and predicts an early spring.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<https://www.foxnews.com/us/groundhog-day-2020-punxsutawney-phil-prediction-forecast-winter-spring-weather>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-02-02-2-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines.

**Archived source account.** The first coronavirus death outside China is reported in the Philippines. The victim was a Chinese tourist, also infected with Streptococcus pneumoniae and influenza B, who recently arrived in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN Philippines](<https://cnnphilippines.com/news/2020/2/2/novel-coronavirus-cases-death-Philippines.html>).

<a id="event-2020-02-02-2-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** New Zealand closes its borders to all foreign visitors from China and bolsters screenings at its airports in response to the pandemic. The travel ban will be in place for at least fourteen days.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/feb/03/coronavirus-outbreak-new-zealand-bans-foreign-travellers-from-china>).

#### International relations

Context: Iran–Saudi Arabia relations.

**Archived source account.** According to Iranian Foreign Ministry, Saudi Arabia has blocked Iran from an Organization of Islamic Cooperation meeting in Jeddah after Saudi authorities refuse to issue visas to Iranian officials.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-saudi-oic-meeting/saudi-arabia-blocks-iran-from-islamic-groupings-meeting-tehran-idUSKBN1ZW0OP?il=0>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-02-02-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A female attacker stabs four people in Ghent, East Flanders, Belgium in different locations. The victims were injured, two of whom in critical conditions. The suspect is shot and wounded by Belgian police.

Source citations (as archived): [The Brussels Times](<https://www.brusselstimes.com/belgium/93371/woman-in-ghent-stabbing-attack-will-be-charged-with-attempted-murder/>).

<a id="event-2020-02-02-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Japan sends a destroyer to the Gulf of Oman amid heightening tensions in the region. The government says it is prepared to authorize the use of force to protect Japanese interests if needed.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-iran-japan/japanese-warship-departs-for-gulf-to-patrol-oil-lifeline-idUSKBN1ZW02D>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2020-02-02-6-1"></a>

Context: 2019 NFL season.

**Archived source account.** In American football, the Kansas City Chiefs defeat the San Francisco 49ers 31–20 to win Super Bowl LIV, the team's first Super Bowl win since 1970.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<https://www.espn.com/nfl/recap?gameId=401131047>).

### 2020-02-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1131739311](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20February%203&oldid=1131739311>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-02-03-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war, Northwestern Syria offensive (December 2019–March 2020), Turkish involvement in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Syrian Army shelling kills Turkish military personnel in Idlib Governorate, prompting retaliation by Turkish forces. A pro-opposition war monitor says the Turkish retaliation killed 13 Syrian soldiers, which Syria denies. The Russian Ministry of Defence says Turkey moved troops "inside the de-escalation zone \[...\] without notifying the Russian side". Turkish President Erdoğan says the Syrian shelling killed five Turkish soldiers and three civilian personnel, with nine others injured, and that the Russians "need to stand aside".

Source citations (as archived): [AP News](<https://apnews.com/3d67f5af98809d06e47600ea3568c8be>); [SANA](<https://sana.sy/en/?p=184182>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2020/02/03/802221255/turkey-syria-trade-deadly-strikes-as-russia-watches-uneasily>).

<a id="event-2020-02-03-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A gendarme is stabbed and wounded in Metz, Grand Est, France, by a soldier who shouted Islamic extremist slogans and declared that he is an Islamic State member. He was shot and wounded.

Source citations (as archived): [Le Figaro](<https://www.lefigaro.fr/actualite-france/attaque-de-la-gendarmerie-de-dieuze-le-parquet-de-metz-n-exclut-pas-un-acte-terroriste-20200203>).

<a id="event-2020-02-03-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Gunmen open fire in an amusement arcade in Uruapan, Mexico, killing at least nine people, including three children. Police say the gunmen were searching for specific targets but then opened fire indiscriminately on customers.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/feb/04/video-arcade-attack-mexico-michoacan>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-02-03-1-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** The global Cruise Lines International Association bans trips to mainland China and says that it "will deny boarding to any individual, whether guest or crew, who has travelled from or through mainland China within the previous 14 days".

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya English](<https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/world/2020/02/03/Cruise-ships-to-ban-recent-China-visitors-Global-industry-body.html>).

<a id="event-2020-02-03-1-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** Thailand announces the possible discovery of a "cure" for the coronavirus after a confirmed coronavirus patient tested negative for the virus 48 hours after being given an "anti-HIV" drug.

Source citations (as archived): [Filipino Times](<https://filipinotimes.net/news/2020/02/03/thai-cures-novel-coronavirus-patient-cocktail-hiv-flu-drugs/>); [Daily Sabah](<https://www.dailysabah.com/health/2020/02/02/thailand-cures-coronavirus-with-anti-hiv-drug-cocktail-in-48-hours>); [IB Times](<https://www.ibtimes.sg/thailand-may-have-found-cure-wuhan-coronavirus-hiv-influenza-drug-cocktail-cures-chinese-womam-38757>).

<a id="event-2020-02-03-1-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** Huoshenshan Hospital, opening after ten days of construction, admits the first patients of the pandemic.

Source citations (as archived): [SCMP](<https://yp.scmp.com/news/china/article/115508/coronavirus-outbreak-built-10-days-chinas-virus-hospital-takes-first>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/8e978ecbb3b1dd125221b627d35e8edc>).

<a id="event-2020-02-03-1-5"></a>

Context: HIV/AIDS research.

**Archived source account.** The United States National Institutes of Health stops its trial of an experimental HIV vaccine (HVTN 702) amidst poor results. The trial involved more than 5,000 people in South Africa.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/health-51361955>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-02-03-2-1"></a>

Context: Post-Brexit, United Kingdom–European Union relations.

**Archived source account.** European Union negotiator Michel Barnier says a future trade deal is possible only if the United Kingdom "abides by EU standards". British Prime Minister Boris Johnson says the UK would not be bound by EU rules in any post-Brexit agreement.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/e-u-u-k-set-out-conflicting-red-lines-post-n1128536>).

<a id="event-2020-02-03-2-3"></a>

Context: Israel–Uganda relations.

**Archived source account.** Ugandan President Yoweri Museveni says he is "studying" the possibility of opening an embassy in Jerusalem as Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu promises to open an embassy in Uganda if such a move takes place.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-uganda/israeli-pm-hopes-uganda-will-open-embassy-in-jerusalem-in-near-future-idUSKBN1ZX1Y6?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-02-03-2-5"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Greek police on the island of Lesbos fire tear gas to disperse migrants and refugees protesting about conditions in the camps and the slow pace of processing asylum requests.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-europe-migrants-greece-lesbos/greek-police-fire-teargas-at-protesting-migrants-refugees-on-lesbos-idUSKBN1ZX1QW>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-02-03-3-1"></a>

Context: List of mass shootings in the United States in 2020.

**Archived source account.** A mass shooting on a Greyhound bus headed from Los Angeles to San Francisco leaves one dead and five wounded; the motive remains unknown.

<a id="event-2020-02-03-3-2"></a>

Context: List of mass shootings in the United States in 2020.

**Archived source account.** A shooting at a dormitory at Texas A&amp;M University–Commerce, leaves two dead and one wounded.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.com/news/2020/02/03/2-dead-in-shooting-at-university-residence-hall-in-texas-110547>); [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/2-dead-shooting-incident-texas-m-commerce-residence-hall-n1129021>).

<a id="event-2020-02-03-4-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2019 Malawian general election.

**Archived source account.** The Constitutional Court of Malawi annuls the result of the country's last general election due to various irregularities. New elections are being scheduled to be held within 150 days.

Eleven Democratic Party candidates will challenge for 49 delegates, while incumbent President Donald Trump will face two Republican challengers for 40 delegates, regarding the 2020 United States presidential election

Context: 2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries, 2020 Republican Party presidential primaries.

**Archived source account.** Significant irregularities in the Democratic Party process are reported with an app being blamed for widespread confusion and delayed results.

Context: Impeachment trial of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** Closing statements are delivered before the United States Senate.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/live/2020/trump-impeachment-trial-vote-02-03?smid=tw-nytimes&amp;smtyp=cur#the-trial-resumes-but-with-little-of-the-intensity-and-drama-that-gripped-the-capitol-last-week>).

Context: Impeachment trial of Donald Trump.

### 2020-02-04

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1152520332](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20February%204&oldid=1152520332>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-02-04-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war, Northwestern Syria offensive (December 2019–March 2020), Turkish involvement in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan says Turkey will not allow Syria's military to gain more ground in the rebel-held Idlib Governorate, as the Syrian Army captures several more villages near the city of Saraqib. Turkish officials say intermittent clashes between Turkish and Syrian troops have continued since Monday.

<a id="event-2020-02-04-1-0"></a>

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-02-04-2-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in China / COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China.

**Archived source account.** Chinese Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Hua Chunying reports the death toll has surpassed 400 with over 20,000 people infected, and requests the United States "not to overreact".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-health-usa-aid/china-says-u-s-should-not-overreact-on-coronavirus-outbreak-idUSKBN1ZY03N>).

The victim was a 34-year-old Hongkonger who had recently travelled to Wuhan, the center of the pandemic. The Hospital Authority said the victim suffered from "preexisting health conditions", but did not give details.

<a id="event-2020-02-04-3-1"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/feb/04/lesotho-first-lady-to-be-charged-with-murder>).

<a id="event-2020-02-04-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Gunmen kill 9 people, including 3 children, in a video arcade in Uruapan, Mexico.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://6abc.com/5903440/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-02-04-4-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries, 2020 Republican Party presidential primaries.

**Archived source account.** Donald Trump receives overwhelming support in the Iowa Republican caucuses while the results of the Iowa Democratic caucuses are delayed because of problems with the use of a mobile app for reporting.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/politics/live-news/iowa-caucuses-live-results-coverage-2020/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-02-04-4-3"></a>

Context: 2020 State of the Union Address.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump delivers his third State of the Union Address to the 116th United States Congress in the chamber of the House of Representatives. It was Trump's fourth and final speech to a joint session of the United States Congress.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/02/04/politics/state-of-the-union-2020-donald-trump/index.html>).

### 2020-02-05

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1081810240](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20February%205&oldid=1081810240>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-02-05-0-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Van avalanches.

**Archived source account.** Avalanches in Van Province, eastern Turkey, kill at least 38 people, leaving more trapped.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-51384440>).

<a id="event-2020-02-05-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Winter Storm Kade brings heavy snowfall to much of the United States, with 14 inches of snow recorded as far south as Texas. Dozens of car accidents are reported in Oklahoma City as a result of difficult driving conditions due to the storm.

Source citations (as archived): [Weather.com](<https://weather.com/storms/winter/news/2020-02-02-winter-storm-west-rockies-plains-midwest-northeast-early-february>).

<a id="event-2020-02-05-0-4"></a>

Context: Pegasus Airlines Flight 2193.

**Archived source account.** A plane crashes after overrunning the runway at Sabiha Gökçen International Airport, Istanbul, Turkey, killing 3 people and injuring 155 others.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-51384667>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-02-05-1-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** Around 3,700 people aboard a cruise ship named Diamond Princess are quarantined after ten passengers test positive for the illness at the port of Yokohama, Japan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-health-japan/ten-passengers-on-cruise-liner-docked-in-japan-test-positive-for-coronavirus-idUSKBN1ZY2YE>).

<a id="event-2020-02-05-1-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** A baby is diagnosed with the virus 30 hours after birth, in the first recorded case of the virus in a newborn.

Source citations (as archived): [New Straits Times](<https://www.nst.com.my/world/world/2020/02/562896/baby-tests-positive-china-virus-just-30-hours-after-birth>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-02-05-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mexico establishes diplomatic relations with the Central African Republic, resulting in Mexico having diplomatic relations with all African states.

Source citations (as archived): [Government of Mexico](<https://www.gob.mx/sre/prensa/mexico-establishes-diplomatic-relations-with-the-central-african-republic?idiom=en>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-02-05-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom's Department for Digital, Culture, Media and Sport begins a public consultation on decriminalizing the failure to pay the television licence fee. Currently, failure to pay the fee while using a television can result in fines and imprisonment.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/entertainment-arts-51373372>).

<a id="event-2020-02-05-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Bayard Rustin, a black and gay African American civil rights activist who worked with Martin Luther King Jr., is posthumously pardoned by California Governor Gavin Newsom for anti-gay charges.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/feature/nbc-out/bayard-rustin-gay-civil-rights-icon-pardoned-california-governor-anti-n1130501>).

<a id="event-2020-02-05-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Denmark jails three men for potentially spying for Saudi Arabia.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/denmark-jails-men-suspected-spying-saudi-arabia-68769753?cid=clicksource_4380645_11_heads_posts_headlines_hed>).

<a id="event-2020-02-05-3-4"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Nigeria.

**Archived source account.** A court in Nigeria grants 47 men another delay in their trial over homosexuality and public displays of affection with members of the same sex. Judge Rilwan Aikawa says it is the last accepted delay at the Lagos court. The men face up to 10-year imprisonment if convicted in a closely watched trial.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nigeria-lgbt/court-case-of-47-nigerian-men-charged-under-homosexuality-law-delayed-again-idUSKBN1ZZ2HJ?il=0>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-02-05-4-1"></a>

Context: Impeachment trial of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** The United States Senate votes on whether to acquit U.S. President Donald Trump. By a vote of 52–48 almost entirely along party lines, the Republican-majority Senate acquits Trump on the first article of impeachment, abuse of power, and acquits him on the second charge, obstruction of Congress, in a separate 53–47 vote. Utah Senator Mitt Romney casts the sole Republican guilty vote, against party lines, on the first article.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2020/02/05/us/politics/trump-acquitted-impeachment.html>).

<a id="event-2020-02-05-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Romanian minority government led by Ludovic Orban is toppled by a vote of no confidence. The event could lead to an early election.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/romanias-centrist-government-collapses-after-no-confidence-vote/a-52269157>).

### 2020-02-06

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1118623038](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20February%206&oldid=1118623038>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-02-06-0-1"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Two Palestinians are killed and seven others are wounded by Israeli soldiers in the occupied West Bank. In a separate incident, twelve Israeli soldiers are injured in a car-ramming attack by a Palestinian in Jerusalem, while a police officer was shot and wounded in another attack in the city. Airstrikes in the Gaza Strip also occurred.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-51397355>).

<a id="event-2020-02-06-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war, Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Israeli warplanes fire missiles near Damascus, Syria. A pro-opposition war monitor says army positions and Iran-backed militias are targeted, killing 12 fighters. Syria says eight fighters are wounded and Israel intends to "save the armed terrorist organisations which have been collapsing in Idlib and western Aleppo Governorate in front of the strikes of the Syrian Army".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-51397357>).

<a id="event-2020-02-06-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war, Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Army's Tiger Forces with Russian air support enters and takes control of the city of Saraqib, and the nearby town of Sarmin, after rebel forces withdrew from the area.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/more-turkish-reinforcements-in-syria-russian-troops-killed/2020/02/06/92fa57b0-48d1-11ea-8a1f-de1597be6cbc_story.html>); [Anadolu Agency](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/syria-assad-regime-captures-key-city-in-idlib/1726913>).

<a id="event-2020-02-06-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Australian and two Chinese citizens, one of whom was a tourist, are stabbed and injured by ISIL sympathisers in Hulhumalé, Maldives. The attackers are arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/feb/06/maldives-stabbing-australian-and-two-chinese-injured-in-attack-claimed-by-isis-sympathisers>).

<a id="event-2020-02-06-0-7"></a>

Context: Brexit Day bomb plot.

**Archived source account.** The PSNI announce they foiled a plot, allegedly by the dissident republican CIRA, to detonate a truck bomb in the United Kingdom on the day Brexit occurred.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-northern-ireland-51401435>).

<a id="event-2020-02-06-0-9"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** A U.S. civil contractor is kidnapped by the Taliban in eastern Afghanistan's Khost Province. A Taliban leader who declined to be named tells Reuters they had kidnapped an American in Khost but did not provide further details.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-taliban-kidnapping/u-s-citizen-kidnapped-in-east-afghanistan-media-reports-idUSKBN2002C4>).

<a id="event-2020-02-06-0-11"></a>

Context: Yemeni Crisis (2011–present).

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump announces that the United States military has killed al-Qaeda in the Arabian Peninsula (AQAP) leader Qasim al-Raymi in a drone strike in Yemen.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-51409581>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-02-06-1-1"></a>

Context: Winter Storm Kade.

**Archived source account.** Several tornadoes are reported across the southern United States as Winter Storm Kade continues to cross the country, with more than 200 reports of damaging winds across Mississippi, Alabama and North Carolina.

Source citations (as archived): [Weather.com](<https://weather.com/storms/winter/news/2020-02-02-winter-storm-west-rockies-plains-midwest-northeast-early-february>).

<a id="event-2020-02-06-1-2"></a>

Context: Winter Storm Kade.

**Archived source account.** Heavy rainfall causes severe flooding in southern states, particularly western South Carolina and western Virginia, where several flash flood emergencies have been declared.

Source citations (as archived): [Weather.com](<https://weather.com/storms/winter/news/2020-02-02-winter-storm-west-rockies-plains-midwest-northeast-early-february>).

<a id="event-2020-02-06-1-4"></a>

Context: Livraga derailment.

**Archived source account.** A train crash in Livraga, Lombardy, Italy, kills 2 people and injures all the other 31 on board.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/milan-train-crash-death-toll-injured-lodi-italy-a9320456.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-02-06-2-1"></a>

Context: United States–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** Venezuelan security forces move six American Citgo executives from house arrest to El Helicoide prison in Caracas, prompting condemnation from the United States. The move comes shortly after Venezuelan opposition leader Juan Guaidó met with U.S. President Donald Trump at the White House.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics-usa-citgo/u-s-condemns-detention-of-citgo-executives-in-venezuela-hints-at-sanctions-on-russia-idUSKBN2002WD>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-02-06-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune pardons a further 6,000 prisoners after doing the same to another 3,000 two days ago. The mass pardons this week follow an offer of dialogue with the protesters, the release of detainees arrested at demonstrations, the formation of a committee to amend the constitution and meetings with opposition figures.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-algeria-pardon/algerian-leader-pardons-more-than-6000-prisoners-in-conciliatory-gesture-idUSKBN2001OX>).

<a id="event-2020-02-06-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A man is charged with raping a five-year-old girl inside of the United States embassy in New Delhi. The high-security mansion in the Indian capital is one of the most secure in Delhi, with multiple layers of manned and electronic security.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/feb/06/man-charged-rape-girl-5-us-embassy-complex-delhi>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-02-06-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Minister-President of the central German state of Thuringia, Thomas Kemmerich, resigns under national pressure after his controversial election to the position with the help of the far-right party Alternative for Germany.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-51399445>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-02-06-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Christina Koch returns to Earth from the International Space Station after a continuous 328 days in space, longer than any woman in history.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/technology/astronaut-christina-koch-lands-back-on-earth-after-a-record-breaking-328-days-in-space/ar-BBZGO30?OCID=ansmsnnews11>).

### 2020-02-07

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1200604163](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20February%207&oldid=1200604163>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-02-07-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Credit Suisse CEO Tidjane Thiam resigns after a spying scandal.

Context: Batterygate.

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-02-07-1-1"></a>

Context: Winter Storm Kade.

**Archived source account.** High winds, gusting up to 90 miles per hour, strike New England as Winter Storm Kade intensifies upon its exit into the Atlantic Ocean.

Source citations (as archived): [Weather.com](<https://weather.com/storms/winter/news/2020-02-02-winter-storm-west-rockies-plains-midwest-northeast-early-february>).

<a id="event-2020-02-07-1-2"></a>

Context: Winter Storm Kade.

**Archived source account.** Heavy snowfall blankets much of the north-eastern United States. More than 1 foot of snowfall is reported widely, with up to 2 feet recorded in parts of Maine and Vermont.

Source citations (as archived): [Weather.com](<https://weather.com/storms/winter/news/2020-02-02-winter-storm-west-rockies-plains-midwest-northeast-early-february>).

<a id="event-2020-02-07-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Five people are killed in a plane crash in Western Alaska, United States.

<a id="event-2020-02-07-2-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Mainland China.

**Archived source account.** General Secretary of the Communist Party of China Xi Jinping declares "people's war" on the coronavirus pandemic.

Source citations (as archived): [The National](<https://www.thenational.ae/world/asia/coronavirus-china-declares-people-s-war-on-outbreak-1.975219>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-health/china-wages-peoples-war-on-coronavirus-as-cruises-companies-hit-idUSKBN20003J>).

<a id="event-2020-02-07-2-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Mainland China.

**Archived source account.** Li Wenliang, the doctor who tried to issue the first warnings about the pandemic, dies after contracting the virus.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-51403795>).

<a id="event-2020-02-07-2-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Italy.

**Archived source account.** Italy confirms that an Italian man has contracted the virus, after he visited his girlfriend in Wuhan.

Source citations (as archived): [Il Messaggero](<https://www.ilmessaggero.it/italia/coronavirus_diretta_italia_italiano_contagiato_quarantena_cecchignola_chi_e_ultime_notizie-5034364.html>).

<a id="event-2020-02-07-2-6"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** Royal Caribbean Cruises bans China, Hong Kong or Macau passport holders from boarding its ships amid concerns over the pandemic.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-health-royal-caribbean/royal-caribbean-bans-china-hong-kong-macau-passport-holders-from-ships-on-coronavirus-fears-idUSKBN2012I5>).

<a id="event-2020-02-07-2-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Esperanza Base on the Antarctic Peninsula reaches a temperature of 18.3 C, the hottest on record for continental Antarctica.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/feb/07/antarctica-logs-hottest-temperature-on-record-with-a-reading-of-183c>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/weather/2020/02/07/antarctica-just-hit-65-degrees-its-warmest-temperature-ever-recorded>).

<a id="event-2020-02-07-2-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** It is reported January 2020 was the warmest January ever on record in Europe.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/weather/2020/02/03/warmth-is-really-unheard-much-eastern-europe-including-helsinki-moscow-saw-warmest-january-record>); [Time](<https://time.com/5779142/global-temperatures-warmest-january>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-02-07-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Russia repatriates 26 Russian children from a Syrian refugee camp.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/russia-repatriates-26-children-syrian-refugee-camp-68820291?cid=clicksource_4380645_2_heads_hero_live_headlines_hed>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-02-07-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Manish Shah, a general practitioner in the United Kingdom, is given three life sentences at the Old Bailey for 90 sexual assaults on 24 of his female patients.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-london-51415001>).

<a id="event-2020-02-07-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Patrick Crusius, accused of perpetrating the 2019 El Paso shooting, is charged with 90 counts of federal hate crimes. Under the new charges, he could face the death penalty.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-51413425>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-02-07-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump fires National Security Council advisor Lt. Col. Alexander Vindman and E.U. ambassador Gordon Sondland, who both testified as witnesses at the impeachment inquiry into him. Vindman's twin brother, Lt. Col. Yevgeny Vindman, an Army JAG officer also part of the National Security Council staff, is also fired.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2020/02/07/us/politics/alexander-vindman-gordon-sondland-fired.html>); [Politico](<https://www.politico.com/news/2020/02/07/donald-trump-pressure-impeachment-witness-alexander-vindman-111997>).

<a id="event-2020-02-07-5-2"></a>

Context: 2020 Republican Party presidential primaries.

**Archived source account.** Former Illinois representative Joe Walsh suspends his presidential campaign, following his poor performance in the Iowa caucuses.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/homenews/campaign/481979-joe-walsh-ends-primary-challenge-to-trump>).

### 2020-02-08

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087455573](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20February%208&oldid=1087455573>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-02-08-0-1"></a>

Context: Nakhon Ratchasima shootings.

**Archived source account.** A soldier opens fire in a military camp and a shopping center in Nakhon Ratchasima, Thailand, killing 29 people and injuring 58 others before being shot dead by police the next day. It is considered the deadliest mass shooting in the country's history.

Source citations (as archived): [Bangkok Post](<https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/1853334/17-killed-as-soldier-opens-fire-in-korat>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2020/02/08/thailand-soldier-terminal-21-mall-shooting-rampage-korat/4700184002/>).

<a id="event-2020-02-08-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least ten people have been killed and dozens have been injured in ethnic clashes in Kazakhstan between Kazakhs and Dungans. About 30 houses and 15 commercial properties were destroyed during the clash.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-51425938>).

<a id="event-2020-02-08-0-4"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** A shootout during joint exercises with U.S. and Afghan soldiers in Nangarhar Province leaves between four and six Americans, and six Afghans dead. It is unknown if the Taliban or rogue Afghan forces were responsible.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-afghanistan/american-afghan-soldiers-killed-in-shootout-in-afghanistan-ny-times-idUSKBN2020Q9>).

<a id="event-2020-02-08-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Argentine Vice President Cristina Fernández de Kirchner declares that the government will not pay back its US$57 billion debt to the International Monetary Fund until the country exits its recession.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-cuba-argentina/argentina-wont-repay-imf-debt-till-recession-over-vp-fernandez-say-idUSKBN20302R?il=0>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-02-08-2-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** Two people – one Japanese and one American – die from coronavirus in Wuhan. They are the first foreigners (excluding Hong Kong and Macau) to die from it.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/coronavirus-updates-u-s-japanese-citizens-die-wuhan-global-deaths-n1132951>).

<a id="event-2020-02-08-3-1"></a>

Context: Syria–Turkey relations.

**Archived source account.** Iranian Foreign Minister Mohammad Javad Zarif offers to mediate between Syria and Turkey over escalating conflicts between the two nations following the recent offensive in the Idlib Governorate.

Context: 2020 Irish general election.

**Archived source account.** Citizens of Ireland head to the polls in the country's latest general election.
