<a id="event-2020-02-08-4-2"></a>

Context: 2020 Irish general election.

**Archived source account.** Exit polls show the republican Sinn Féin, the ruling Fine Gael, and main opposition party Fianna Fáil in a virtual tie.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/feb/08/ireland-general-eleciton-sinn-fein-surge-to-22-in-exit-poll>).

### 2020-02-09

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1081811146](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20February%209&oldid=1081811146>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2020-02-09-0-1"></a>

Context: 92nd Academy Awards.

**Archived source account.** At this year's Oscars, South Korean film Parasite wins the most awards, including Best Picture and Best International Film. It becomes the first foreign-language film to win Best Picture.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hollywood Reporter](<https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lists/oscar-winners-2020-updating-live-full-list-1275973/item/director-1275980>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-02-09-1-1"></a>

Context: Storm Ciara.

**Archived source account.** Winds gusting up to 100 miles per hour have been recorded over much of the United Kingdom and Ireland, causing widespread damage and disruption.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-51433870>).

<a id="event-2020-02-09-1-2"></a>

Context: Storm Ciara.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of homes and businesses have been flooded across northern England after Storm Ciara brought sustained heavy rainfall to the region. Worst affected were the Calder Valley settlements of Todmorden, Hebden Bridge and Mytholmroyd in Yorkshire.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-51433870>).

<a id="event-2020-02-09-1-3"></a>

Context: Storm Ciara.

**Archived source account.** A man in Hampshire was killed when a tree fell onto his car on the A33 road as a result of high winds.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-51439152>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-02-09-2-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** The death toll of the coronavirus outbreak surpasses the death toll of the 2002–2004 SARS outbreak, at 910 deaths.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/feb/09/coronavirus-global-death-toll-overtakes-sars-epidemic>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/02/china-virus-death-toll-surges-800-infections-mount-200209003721741.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-02-09-3-1"></a>

Context: Cross-Strait relations.

**Archived source account.** Taiwan scrambles its air force to intercept Chinese jets after they circled the island during a combat drill. The drill is denounced by the Taiwanese Defense Ministry as a violation of its sovereignty.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-taiwan-china-defence/taiwan-scrambles-armed-jets-as-chinese-air-force-flies-around-island-idUSKBN2030AE>).

<a id="event-2020-02-09-3-3"></a>

Context: Israel–Palestine relations.

**Archived source account.** Israel blocks all Palestinian export of agricultural products from the occupied West Bank following Palestinian limitations on imports of Israeli cattle.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/02/israel-blocks-palestinian-agricultural-exports-jordan-200209104227779.html>); [Haaretz](<https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-to-bar-palestinians-from-exporting-produce-via-jordan-as-trade-war-escalates-1.8506459>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-02-09-4-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Azerbaijani parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** Azerbaijan holds a snap election after President Ilham Aliyev dissolved the National Assembly last December. The opposition accuses Aliyev of limiting their ability to campaign, and calls for boycotts against the election.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-azerbaijan-election/azeri-president-moves-to-modernize-parliament-with-snap-election-idUSKBN2020S9>); [France24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20200209-azerbaijan-holds-elections-decried-as-sham-by-opposition>).

<a id="event-2020-02-09-4-3"></a>

Context: 2020 Cameroonian parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** After having been postponed twice, parliamentary elections are held in Cameroon. The ongoing Anglophone Crisis overshadows the process, with supporters of Ambazonia calling for a boycott of the election.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/cameroon-elections-a-vote-marked-by-violence-and-abstention/a-52304640>).

<a id="event-2020-02-09-4-5"></a>

Context: 2020 Irish general election.

**Archived source account.** Counting of the first preference votes show Sinn Féin leading with 24.1% of the vote, ahead of ruling party Fine Gael and main opposition party Fianna Fáil, each with 22.1%. Sinn Féin leader Mary Lou McDonald claims victory, declaring that Ireland "is no longer a two-party system", and hopes to form a coalition government.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/feb/09/sinn-fein-to-try-to-form-ruling-coalition-after-irish-election-success>).

<a id="event-2020-02-09-4-7"></a>

Context: 2020 Swiss referendums, LGBT rights in Switzerland.

**Archived source account.** Swiss voters head to the polls to vote on a proposal to mandate quotas for affordable housing in new residential development projects, and whether to criminalize discrimination on the basis of sexual orientation.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-51370820>); [Irish Times](<https://www.irishtimes.com/news/world/europe/switzerland-is-putting-its-housing-crisis-to-a-referendum-1.4155510>).

<a id="event-2020-02-09-4-8"></a>

Context: 2020 Swiss referendums, LGBT rights in Switzerland.

**Archived source account.** The proposal to mandate quotas is rejected, the proposal to criminalize discrimination on the basis of sexual orientation passes.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-51370820>).

<a id="event-2020-02-09-4-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** President of El Salvador Nayib Bukele breaks into the Legislative Assembly with the Army and occupies the chair of the Speaker to demand the approval of a financial measure which couldn't pass earlier as there was no quorum. In a public release, the Presidency department calls for calm after a "demand of insurrection". The opposition accuses the president and the army of intimidation and a "self-coup".

Source citations (as archived): [El País](<https://elpais.com/internacional/2020/02/10/america/1581294344_999638.html>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-51439020>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/the_americas/el-salvador-standoff-deepens-over-loan-for-security-forces/2020/02/09/1eb51fb6-4b97-11ea-967b-e074d302c7d4_story.html>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2020/02/09/world/americas/ap-lt-bc-el-salvador-loan-standoff.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-02-09-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Launch Alliance successfully launches the European Space Agency's Solar Orbiter (SolO) satellite from Cape Canaveral Air Force Station. The probe will study the Sun, and in particular its inner heliosphere.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-51420402>).

### 2020-02-10

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1219020027](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20February%2010&oldid=1219020027>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-02-10-0-1"></a>

Context: Auno attack.

**Archived source account.** Boko Haram militants kill at least 30 people, burning them to death while they were sleeping in their vehicles in Borno State, Nigeria. Women and children are kidnapped.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-51445070>).

<a id="event-2020-02-10-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war, Northwestern Syria offensive (December 2019–March 2020).

**Archived source account.** Turkey says Syrian shelling killed five of its troops at an observation post at Taftanaz Military Airbase in Idlib Governorate. The Turkish government says it "retaliated against the attack to destroy all enemy targets and avenging our fallen troops".

Source citations (as archived): [AP News](<https://apnews.com/6bc42af087748821ec99ae128c9e761d>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-51447114>).

<a id="event-2020-02-10-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war, Northwestern Syria offensive (December 2019–March 2020).

**Archived source account.** Russian and Syrian Air Force warplanes carry out airstrikes on civilian settlements in Aleppo and Idlib provinces, killing at least 17 to 25 civilians including six children.

Source citations (as archived): [AA](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/syrian-russian-airstrikes-kill-17-civilians-in-idlib/1729063>); [MSN](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/russian-air-strikes-kill-5-civilians-in-syria-monitor/ar-BBZPLjy>); [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/russian-airstrike-kills-civilians-in-syrias-aleppo-province-attack/a-52322455>).

<a id="event-2020-02-10-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war, Northwestern Syria offensive (December 2019–March 2020).

**Archived source account.** A car bomb kills four people and injures 15 others in the Turkish-occupied city Afrin, in Aleppo Governorate.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20200210-syrian-army-shelling-kills-five-turkish-soldiers-in-idlib>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-02-10-1-1"></a>

Context: Climate change mitigation, Individual and political action on climate change.

**Archived source account.** Dozens of climate activists surround the offices of American investment management company BlackRock in central Paris and vandalize the building, demanding they disinvest from the fossil fuel industry.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-climate-change-protest-blackrock/climate-activists-invade-blackrock-office-in-paris-idUSKBN2041X2>).

<a id="event-2020-02-10-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Justice Department files lawsuits against King County, Washington and the state of New Jersey over their use of sanctuary cities.

<a id="event-2020-02-10-4-0"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Der Spiegel](<https://www.spiegel.de/politik/deutschland/annegret-kramp-karrenbauer-kuendigt-ruecktritt-als-cdu-chefin-an-a-7fae3f80-1509-4ec8-8143-45b500f19d3d>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/feb/10/annegret-kramp-karrenbauer-to-quit-as-cdu-leader-amid-far-right-firewall-row>).

<a id="event-2020-02-10-4-1"></a>

Members of the Philippine press condemn the actions in moving for the cancellation of the franchise of ABS-CBN.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-02-12-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nissan begins a US$ 90 million lawsuit against its former chairman Carlos Ghosn.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/business/2020/feb/12/nissan-launches-lawsuit-against-former-chairman-carlos-ghosn>).

<a id="event-2020-02-12-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** More than half of Malta's traffic police officers, including its chief, are arrested for overtime fraud and misuse of public resources.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-malta-fraud/more-than-half-maltas-traffic-police-arrested-for-fraud-idUSKBN2060ZD?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-02-12-4-3"></a>

Context: Trial of Maesiah Thabane.

**Archived source account.** Lesotho begins a murder investigation of First Lady Maesiah Thabane for the murder of former first lady Lipolelo Thabane and ex-wife of Prime Minister Tom Thabane.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/02/12/africa/lesotho-pm-wife-murder-probe-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-02-12-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Department of Education launches an investigation into Harvard and Yale for allegedly accepting billions of dollars in undisclosed gifts from numerous foreign governments, including those from Saudi Arabia, China, and Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-51481396>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-02-12-5-1"></a>

Context: 2020 U.S. Democratic Party presidential primaries.

**Archived source account.** Former Massachusetts governor Deval Patrick suspends his presidential campaign.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/massachusetts-gov-deval-patrick-suspends-presidential-bid/story?id=67498712>).

<a id="event-2020-02-12-5-2"></a>

Context: 2020 U.S. Democratic Party presidential primaries.

**Archived source account.** Iowa Democratic Party chairman Troy Price resigns for his handling of this year's Iowa caucuses.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/02/12/politics/troy-price-iowa-resigns/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-02-12-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Italian Senate allows former Minister of the Interior and current senator Matteo Salvini to be tried in a criminal case for illegally detaining migrants last summer.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-51473239>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-02-12-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Brazilian scientists announce the discovery of a new amoebic "Yaravirus" in Lake Pampulha. The strain was found to be significantly smaller than any known amoebic virus, and 90% of its genome appears to be genes that have never been seen before in any life-form.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/science/virus-no-genes-yaravirus-brazil-federal-university-minas-gerais-a9325931.html>); [bioRxiv](<https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2020.01.28.923185v1>); [Science magazine](<https://www.sciencemag.org/news/2020/02/scientists-discover-virus-no-recognizable-genes>).

<a id="event-2020-02-12-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** WhatsApp hits two billion users, becoming the second largest social media platform in terms of userbase behind Facebook.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-whatsapp-users/whatsapp-users-cross-2-billion-second-only-to-facebook-idUSKBN20626L?il=0>).

### 2020-02-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087455709](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20February%2013&oldid=1087455709>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-02-13-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** U.S. Defense Secretary Mark Esper says that the U.S. and the Taliban have negotiated a proposal for a seven-day reduction of violence in Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-afghanistan-talks-pentagon/u-s-taliban-have-negotiated-proposal-for-seven-day-reduction-in-violence-pentagon-chief-idUSKBN2071YX>).

<a id="event-2020-02-13-0-3"></a>

Context: Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Israeli Air Force launches an air raid on Iranian targets in the Syrian capital Damascus. Syrian state media says the Air Defense Force intercepted several missiles.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/Arab-Israeli-Conflict/Israel-strikes-Iranian-targets-near-Damascus-report-617569>).

<a id="event-2020-02-13-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Around two dozen heavily armed men dressed in military fatigues storm a court building in El Progreso, north-western Honduras, freeing Alexander Mendoza, a senior leader of the MS-13 gang and killing four police officers. Honduran President Juan Orlando Hernández offers a $80,000 reward for information leading to Mendoza's recapture.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-51501103>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2020-02-13-1-1"></a>

Context: 45th César Awards.

**Archived source account.** The entire board of France's César Awards resigns following controversy over the Academy giving Roman Polanski's An Officer and a Spy 12 award nominations, the most out of any film this year.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-51494929>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-02-13-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** American newspaper publisher McClatchy, whose assets include the Miami Herald and The Sacramento Bee, files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/homenews/media/482899-mcclatchy-nations-second-largest-newspaper-company-files-for-bankruptcy>).

<a id="event-2020-02-13-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Canadian airplane manufacturer Bombardier sells its remaining stake in the A220 model, previously called the C-Series, to France's Airbus, effectively closing its commercial aviation line of business.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/business/bombardier-financial-results-airbus-c-series-1.5462182>).

<a id="event-2020-02-13-2-3"></a>

Context: Cannabis in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** The Food Standards Agency gives producers of Cannabidiol-related products until March 2021 to register their goods, or they will be pulled from the market.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-51480940>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-02-13-3-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Mainland China.

**Archived source account.** Chinese officials report 15,152 new confirmed cases of the 2019-nCoV acute respiratory disease (COVID-19) and 254 new deaths in mainland China, the largest single day increase since the pandemic began. However, the number of confirmed cases now also includes the number of clinically diagnosed patients in Hubei province.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2020/02/13/coronavirus-latest-updates-china-hubei.html>).

<a id="event-2020-02-13-3-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Japan.

**Archived source account.** Japan's Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare reports the country's first death related to the COVID-19 pandemic, a woman in her 80s.

Source citations (as archived): [The Japan Times](<https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2020/02/13/national/science-health/health-ministry-reports-first-death-related-covid-19-japan/#.XkVgMSOnxPZ>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-02-13-4-1"></a>

Context: Sudan–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** As part of government efforts to remove the country from a list of State Sponsors of Terrorism, Sudan agrees to compensate the families of sailors killed in an al-Qaeda attack against the USS Cole.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-sudan-usa-court/sudan-agrees-to-compensate-families-of-uss-cole-victims-state-news-agency-idUSKBN2071D1>).

<a id="event-2020-02-13-4-3"></a>

Context: United States–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** Venezuelan Foreign Affairs minister Jorge Arreaza announces that his government, led by Nicolás Maduro, will take the U.S. to the International Criminal Court for alleged "crimes against humanity".

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/venezuela-slams-trump-for-sanctions-set-on-regime-change/2020/02/13/62a043ae-4e85-11ea-967b-e074d302c7d4_story.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-02-13-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Indonesian government declares that all nationals who join ISIL automatically lose their citizenship, and refuses to repatriate fighters captured in Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jakarta Post](<https://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2020/02/13/government-declares-indonesian-is-fighters-in-syria-stateless.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-02-13-6-1"></a>

Context: 2020 British cabinet reshuffle.

**Archived source account.** Amid a cabinet reshuffle by Prime Minister Boris Johnson, Sajid Javid resigns as the United Kingdom's Chancellor of the Exchequer after reportedly refusing to sack his adviser team. Javid is replaced by Chief Secretary to the Treasury Rishi Sunak, who becomes the first Hindu to hold the senior position.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/whos-in-and-whos-out-in-boris-johnsons-reshuffle-11932951>); [The Yorkshire Post](<https://www.yorkshirepost.co.uk/news/politics/who-is-rishi-sunak-the-rise-and-rise-of-the-country-s-new-chancellor-1-10255242>).

<a id="event-2020-02-13-6-2"></a>

Context: 2020 British cabinet reshuffle.

**Archived source account.** The Attorney General for England and Wales Geoffrey Cox is sacked by Johnson.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/politics/geoffrey-cox-reshuffle-cabinet-boris-johnson-attorney-general-tory-latest-a9333076.html>).

<a id="event-2020-02-13-6-3"></a>

Context: 2020 British cabinet reshuffle.

**Archived source account.** Secretary of State for Northern Ireland Julian Smith, Business Secretary Andrea Leadsom and Environment Secretary Theresa Villiers all leave the government.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-51474171>).

<a id="event-2020-02-13-6-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Senate votes 55–45 to pass a measure requiring President Donald Trump to win approval from Congress before taking further military actions against Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/02/senate-votes-limit-trumps-war-powers-iran-200213190949919.html>).

### 2020-02-14

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1240420063](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20February%2014&oldid=1240420063>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-02-14-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war, Northwestern Syria offensive (December 2019–March 2020).

**Archived source account.** A Syrian Air Force helicopter is shot down by a surface-to-air missile over the Aleppo countryside, killing both pilots. It is the second Syrian helicopter to be shot down this week by Turkish-backed forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Middle East Eye](<https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/syrian-rebels-shoot-down-second-government-helicopter-one-week>); [Xinhuanet](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2020-02/14/c_138784396.htm>).

<a id="event-2020-02-14-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Remains of 6,032 people are found with thousands of bullets in six mass graves in Karuzi Province, Burundi, the largest find yet of an excavation project into atrocities of the Burundian Civil War.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-burundi-graves/over-6000-bodies-found-in-burundis-mass-graves-idUSKBN2090GP?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-02-14-0-4"></a>

Context: Ntumbo attack.

**Archived source account.** At least 22 people are killed in an attack on a village in Northwest Region, Cameroon.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-51526358>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2020-02-14-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nepalese Sherpas condemn the Nepalese government's plan to use the army to clear rubbish from the top of Mount Everest and five other Himalayan peaks, saying only experienced Sherpas can reach those places. An army spokesman says the army will be able to reach all those summits.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-51501086>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-02-14-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Facebook and Instagram amend their advertising policies so that politicians are allowed to use influencers to promote their campaigns, in response to U.S. presidential candidate Michael Bloomberg using them to advertise his candidacy without being subjected to both sites' regulations on political ads.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.com/news/2020/02/14/bloomberg-meme-changes-facebook-instagram-115333>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2020/feb/14/facebook-reverses-political-ads-rule-bloomberg-finds-loophole>).

<a id="event-2020-02-14-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Twenty-one U.S. states reject a US$ 18 billion settlement offer by pharmaceutical manufacturers, such as McKesson Corporation and Johnson &amp; Johnson, for their role in the opioid crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/ajimpact/states-reject-opioid-makers-18bn-settlement-offer-200214234135829.html>).

<a id="event-2020-02-14-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration allows U.S. airlines to resume flight paths over much of the Persian Gulf and the Gulf of Oman, after suspending it last month due to escalating military tensions with Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-gulf-aviation/u-s-relaxes-restrictions-on-u-s-civilian-flights-over-gulf-idUSKBN2090QN?il=0>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-02-14-3-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Egypt.

**Archived source account.** The first case of coronavirus infection in the African continent is reported in Egypt.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/02/egypt-confirms-coronavirus-case-africa-200214190840134.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-02-14-4-1"></a>

Context: Belarus–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Belarus threatens to take oil from the Druzhba pipeline which carries Russian oil to central Europe across its territory, if Russia does not supply it with the required volumes of crude oil. Russian oil supplies to Belarus have not been agreed for 2020 and shipments have dwindled to 500,000 tonnes, down from a planned 2 million tonnes.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/belarus-oil-lukashenko/update-1-belarus-threatens-to-take-oil-from-russian-transit-pipeline-belta-idUSL8N2AE4SW>).

<a id="event-2020-02-14-4-2"></a>

Context: Belarus–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko says Moscow hinted at an energy supply deal in exchange for Belarus merging with Russia, which caused talks to collapse.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-belarus-oil-russia-lukashenko/russia-hints-at-belarus-joining-it-in-a-unified-state-in-exchange-for-oil-deal-lukashenko-idUSKBN20815V>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2020/02/14/world/europe/ap-eu-russia-belarus.html>).

<a id="event-2020-02-14-4-4"></a>

Context: Sri Lanka–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. State Department sanctions Sri Lankan Army Commander Shavendra Silva for alleged human rights violations during the final phase of the Sri Lankan Civil War.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-sri-lanka/u-s-blacklists-sri-lankan-army-commander-cites-killings-abuses-idUSKBN2081UR?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-02-14-4-6"></a>

Context: Kosovo–Serbia relations.

**Archived source account.** Kosovar President Hashim Thaçi and Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić agree to connect the capitals of their respective countries by rail and roads, in a deal brokered by the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/02/milestone-kosovo-serbia-sign-rail-road-deals-200215021536359.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-02-14-5-1"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Germany.

**Archived source account.** Twelve men are arrested in Germany for attempting to start a far-right organization aimed at carrying out attacks against politicians, asylum seekers, and Muslims.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/02/suspects-germany-planned-attack-muslims-refugees-200214141816203.html>).

<a id="event-2020-02-14-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A court in Istanbul, Turkey, acquits novelist Aslı Erdoğan of charges of terrorist group membership and "undermining national unity". She was one of several staff members of the pro-Kurdish newspaper Özgür Gündem accused of having ties to Kurdish militants.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-turkey-security-newspaper/turkish-court-acquits-novelist-accused-of-kurdish-militant-ties-idUSKBN2081DL>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-02-14-6-1"></a>

Context: 2019–20 Algerian protests.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of Algerians march in the capital of Algiers as the first anniversary of the protests nears, repeating their calls for overhauling the political system and ending corruption.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-algeria-protests-anniversary/algerians-keep-up-protests-a-year-after-demonstrations-began-idUSKBN2081RK?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-02-14-6-3"></a>

Context: Indigenous land claims in Canada.

**Archived source account.** Canadian National suspends operations of its railroad network in eastern Canada, and Via Rail cancels most passenger inter-city rail service in Canada, in response to a blockade by First Nations activists, in support of the Unistʼotʼen Camp in Wetʼsuwetʼen First Nation territory in British Columbia protesting the Coastal GasLink Pipeline project.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC News](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/cn-rail-shutdown-1.5463266>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2020-02-14-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Manchester City F.C. is banned from European club competition, among which the UEFA Champions League, for two seasons, and is fined €30 million, for deliberately inflating the value of their sponsorship deals to get around the UEFA Financial Fair Play Regulations. The club says it will appeal to the Court of Arbitration for Sport.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC Sport](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/51510284>).

### 2020-02-15

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1100562508](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20February%2015&oldid=1100562508>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-02-15-0-1"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** The Houthis accuse Saudi Arabia of airstrikes that killed 30 people, including civilians, in Al Jawf Governorate. The Houthis say women and children were among those killed in the strike, which was said to be a retaliation for the downing of a coalition plane the previous day.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security/yemens-houthis-say-coalition-strikes-kill-30-including-civilians-idUSKBN2090AC>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-02-15-1-1"></a>

Context: Storm Dennis.

**Archived source account.** The British Army is deployed to help with rescue efforts as the bomb cyclone kills two people.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2020/02/15/Army-deployed-to-help-combat-deadly-Storm-Dennis-in-Britain/2671581794747/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-02-15-2-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in France.

**Archived source account.** The first death from the disease inside Europe occurs in France. He was an 80-year-old Chinese tourist who had arrived in Paris with symptoms of the illness on January 16.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-51514837>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-02-15-3-1"></a>

Context: Australia–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** Several senior Australian MPs cancel a planned trip to the United Kingdom next month due to the latter allowing Huawei to help build its national 5G network. Australia had banned the Chinese telecom from participating in their network due to security concerns.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-51513886>).

<a id="event-2020-02-15-3-3"></a>

Context: India–Turkey relations.

**Archived source account.** Indian Ministry of External Affairs spokesman Raveesh Kumar tells Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan to "not interfere in India's internal affairs" after he and Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan issued a joint declaration yesterday condemning the lockdown in Jammu and Kashmir.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/02/kashmir-india-tells-turkey-don-interfere-internal-affairs-200215182136914.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-02-15-4-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Labour Party leadership election.

**Archived source account.** Shadow First Secretary of State Emily Thornberry is eliminated from the UK Labour leadership race after falling two nominations short of advancing to the next round.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-51505547>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-02-15-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Microsoft removes a security update four days after its release, upon receiving complaints that the update has been responsible for system freezes, boot problems, and installation issues for Windows.

Source citations (as archived): [Bleeping Computer](<https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/microsoft/microsoft-confirms-windows-10-kb4524244-issues-and-pulls-the-update/>).

### 2020-02-16

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1081885492](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20February%2016&oldid=1081885492>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-02-16-0-1"></a>

Context: South Sudanese Civil War.

**Archived source account.** SPLM-IO leader and former Vice President Riek Machar rejects a peace proposal by President Salva Kiir Mayardit. While Machar welcomes the provision to reduce the number of states from 32 to 10, he opposes the creation of three administrative areas.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/02/south-sudan-machar-rejects-president-kiir-peace-offer-200216090638473.html>).

<a id="event-2020-02-16-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war, Northwestern Syria offensive (December 2019–present).

**Archived source account.** Backed by Russian airstrikes, Syrian Army troops take control of most of the Aleppo countryside, including the towns of Anadan, Haritan and Kafr Hamrah and over 30 villages amid a collapse in rebel defences. Much of the area has been under rebel control since 2012.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-army/russian-backed-syrian-army-seizes-most-of-rebel-held-aleppo-province-state-media-idUSKBN20A0KQ?il=0>); [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/syrian-forces-seize-most-aleppo-province-eve-turkey-russia-talks-n1137631>).

<a id="event-2020-02-16-0-5"></a>

Context: Pansi church shooting.

**Archived source account.** Islamist gunmen kill at least 24 people, including a pastor, in a mass shooting on a church during mass in Pansi, Yagha Province, Sahel Region, Burkina Faso.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/burkina-faso-church-attack-kills-dozens/a-52404694>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-02-16-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States District Court for the Eastern District of Missouri rules that chemical companies Bayer and BASF are accountable for the adverse effects of their Dicamba-based herbicides on American farmlands, and awards the plaintiff, a peach farmer, US$265 million in damages. Bayer announces it will appeal.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bayer-dicamba-lawsuit/u-s-peach-grower-awarded-265-million-from-bayer-basf-in-weedkiller-lawsuit-idUSKBN20A0JJ?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-02-16-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A German court orders Tesla, Inc. to temporarily halt construction of new manufacturing plant Giga Berlin in Grünheide, Brandenburg, due to the threat it poses to the local wildlife and water supplies.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-51525673>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-02-16-2-1"></a>

Context: Storm Dennis.

**Archived source account.** The bomb cyclone claims another victim, bringing the death toll to three. 198 flood warnings have been placed across England.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/02/16/uk/storm-dennis-sunday-intl-gbr/index.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-02-16-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Azerbaijani police detain three opposition party leaders and more than 100 activists for attempting to protest the results of last week's parliamentary election.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-azerbaijan-election-opposition/azeri-police-detain-opposition-leaders-block-protest-against-election-result-idUSKBN20A0F3?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-02-16-3-1"></a>

#### Politics and elections

Context: 2020 Paris municipal election.

**Archived source account.** French Health Minister Agnès Buzyn announces she will run for the Parisian mayoral position on the La République En Marche\! ticket, after the party's original candidate Benjamin Griveaux withdrew yesterday due to a sexting scandal.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-france-politics/french-health-minister-to-run-for-paris-mayor-after-macron-ally-quits-idUSKBN20A0HI?il=0>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-02-17-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war, Northwestern Syria offensive (December 2019–March 2020).

**Archived source account.** Syrian President Bashar al-Assad gives a televised speech on the military offensives in north-western Syria, saying the offensives in Aleppo Governorate and Idlib Governorate will continue regardless of Turkey's threats while adding that the recent Syrian Army victories are a prelude to the opposition's "final defeat, sooner or later".

Source citations (as archived): [Al Masdar News](<https://www.almasdarnews.com/article/victory-in-aleppo-does-not-mean-end-of-syrian-war-assad/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-assad/syrias-assad-says-his-forces-gains-are-prelude-to-rebels-final-defeat-idUSKBN20B1MM>).

<a id="event-2020-02-17-0-3"></a>

Context: February 2020 Quetta bombing.

**Archived source account.** At least 10 people are killed by a suicide bomber on a motorcycle in Quetta, Balochistan, Pakistan.

<a id="event-2020-02-17-1-1"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-syria-security/syrian-forces-consolidate-control-of-aleppo-air-strikes-under-way-idUKKBN20B0X3>); [Al Masdar News](<https://www.almasdarnews.com/article/syria-to-reopen-aleppo-international-airport-for-first-time-in-9-years/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-02-17-2-1"></a>

Context: Storm Dennis.

**Archived source account.** The lower reaches of many rivers, including the Severn at Shrewsbury, continue to rise as a result of excess runoff from upstream. The River Wye in Hereford has now reached its highest level in recorded history.

<a id="event-2020-02-17-2-2"></a>

<a id="event-2020-02-17-3-1"></a>

Context: Sagamihara stabbings.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/care-home-murder-trial-court-satoshi-uematsu-death-penalty-12441848>).

<a id="event-2020-02-17-3-3"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Germany.

**Archived source account.** Investigations into a far-right organization whose members were arrested in Germany three days earlier reveal a plot, inspired by the Christchurch mosque shootings in March 2019, to carry out simultaneous, large-scale attacks on mosques across the country during prayers.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/feb/17/germanys-muslims-call-for-protection-after-far-right-terror-plot-arrests>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-02-17-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Andrew Sabisky, an advisor to UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson, resigns after the resurfacing of racist, sexist, and pro-eugenics comments, allegedly attributed to him.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-51538493>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2020-02-17-5-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Daytona 500.

**Archived source account.** Denny Hamlin wins his second consecutive Daytona 500, and his third overall, becoming the first driver to win the race consecutively since Sterling Marlin did so between 1994 and 1995. Ryan Newman is hospitalized with serious but non-life threatening injuries after an airborne crash coming to the finish.

Source citations (as archived): [WESH](<https://www.wesh.com/article/daytona-500-ryan-newman-crash/30972164>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Hanau shootings.

**Archived source account.** Nine people are killed and five others injured in two mass shootings at shisha bars in Hanau, Hesse, Germany. The attacker also kills his mother and then himself in their apartment. He expressed far-right views in a letter of confession and video.

<a id="event-2020-02-19-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Twelve Somali soldiers are killed when a suicide bomber and gunmen storm a military base in Lower Shabelle. The militants briefly capture the base before it is reclaimed. Al-Shabaab claim responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-somalia-attacks/somali-militants-kill-12-soldiers-in-attack-on-base-say-officials-idUSKBN20D1MJ>).

<a id="event-2020-02-19-0-4"></a>

Erdoğan threatens to launch an operation in Idlib by the end of the month. Kremlin Press Secretary Dmitry Peskov calls Turkish involvement in the battle "the worst scenario". The countries support opposing sides in the war.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-02-19-4-1"></a>

Context: Murder of Bashar Barakah Jackson.

**Archived source account.** Bashar Barakah Jackson, also known as ‘Pop Smoke’, is killed in Los Angeles, United States. The cause of death was multiple gunshot wounds to his torso, inflicted by a teenager during a targeted home invasion that went wrong. Pop Smoke was a rising rapper from Brooklyn, and had just released his second mixtape ‘Meet the Woo 2’. He rented an apartment in the Hollywood Hills a few days prior to his murder for a simple vacation. The day before his homicide, he accidentally leaked his address online via social media, giving the location to it’s murderers, which tragically ended his life the age of 20 years old.

Source citations (as archived): [Pop Smoke Shot Dead](<https://www.complex.com/music/2020/02/pop-smoke-killed-during-home-invasion-robbery>).

Context: Murder of Hannah Clarke.

**Archived source account.** A mother and her three children are killed in a car fire in Brisbane, Australia, in a targeted familicide carjacking by former New Zealand Warriors player Rowan Baxter. He was the ex-husband of the woman and father of the children, and he committed suicide at the scene.

Source citations (as archived): [News.com.au](<https://www.news.com.au/national/queensland/hannah-baxter-dies-after-burns-in-horrific-fire-incident/news-story/276ceb3a836aad23a1984c7438e00d1d>).

Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesman Geng Shuang says the journalists have five days to leave the country and says the article "denigrated" China's efforts to combat the virus.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-51558310>).

### 2020-02-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1131739980](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20February%2025&oldid=1131739980>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-02-25-0-1"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War (2009–present).

**Archived source account.** A U.S. airstrike kills an employee of the telecoms Hormuud Telecom. It was aimed at Al-Shabaab in Jilib, Middle Juba.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-somalia-security/somalia-telecoms-employee-killed-by-u-s-air-strike-company-idUSKBN20J26S?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-02-25-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war, Northwestern Syria offensive (December 2019–March 2020), Turkish involvement in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** As fighting continues in the Idlib Governorate, the Syrian Army takes control of rebel-stronghold Kafranbel for the first time since 2012, and 18 nearby villages including Sheikh Dames and Sheikh Mustafa.

Source citations (as archived): [RFI](<http://www.rfi.fr/en/wires/20200225-syrian-regime-retakes-symbolic-town-kafranbel-monitor>).

<a id="event-2020-02-25-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war, Northwestern Syria offensive (December 2019–March 2020), Turkish involvement in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Turkish-backed rebels recapture the village of Nayrab, west of Saraqib, after days of heavy fighting which has left dozens dead, according to Turkish state media.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/02/turkey-backed-fighters-recapture-key-town-syria-idlib-200225063927682.html>).

<a id="event-2020-02-25-0-6"></a>

Context: Turkish military intervention in the Second Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan confirms the first Turkish Armed Forces casualties in Libya since beginning a military operation in support of the GNA government after two troops are killed.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-51626743>).

<a id="event-2020-02-25-0-8"></a>

Context: North East Delhi riots.

**Archived source account.** Violent clashes in North East Delhi, India, between Hindu and Muslim protesters over the Citizenship Amendment Act continues leaving 13 people dead and at least 150 injured.

Source citations (as archived): [NDTV](<https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/pm-narendra-modi-tweets-appeal-to-my-sisters-and-brothers-of-delhi-to-maintain-peace-and-brotherhood-2185982>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-02-26-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Six prisoners are shot dead by Papua New Guinea Police as they escape from prison in Western Highlands Province. They were among 100 inmates who escaped during a mass breakout. Scores of others are captured.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/410354/six-prisoners-shot-dead-in-mass-jailbreak-in-png>).

<a id="event-2020-02-26-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Germany repeals its 2015 ban on advertisements for professional assisted suicide practices, after finding that its prohibition violated the German Constitution. Passive human euthanasia itself has been legal in the republic since 2014.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-51643306>).

<a id="event-2020-02-26-3-3"></a>

Context: Milwaukee brewery shooting.

**Archived source account.** Six people, including the shooter, are killed in a mass shooting at the Molson Coors Beverage Company in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, United States. The perpetrator, who committed suicide, was an employee who was fired earlier in the day.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2020/02/26/acritical-incident-reported-molsoncoors-milwaukee-campus/4884534002/>); [WGN-TV](<https://wgntv.com/2020/02/26/milwaukee-police-responding-to-critical-incident-at-miller-coors-headquarters/>).

<a id="event-2020-02-26-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The re-election campaign of U.S. President Donald Trump files a libel suit against The New York Times over a 2019 editorial piece that accused the Trump campaign of striking a deal with Russia during the 2016 presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-election-trump/trump-campaign-says-it-is-suing-new-york-times-over-russia-opinion-piece-idUSKCN20K2X3?il=0>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-02-26-4-1"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Spanish and Catalan government meets for the first time after breaking the talks one year ago in the named "Dialogue Board" as a way to solve the constitutional and political crisis between both governments that erupted in 2017.

Source citations (as archived): [La Vanguardia](<https://www.lavanguardia.com/politica/20200226/473795483461/constitucion-mesa-dialogo-gobierno-generalitat-catalunya-pedro-sanchez-quim-torra-ultimas-noticias-hoy-en-directo.html>).

<a id="event-2020-02-26-4-3"></a>

Context: Lynching in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. House of Representatives votes 410–4 to pass the Emmett Till Antilynching Act, which designates lynching a federal crime. This is the first time that anti-lynching legislation has ever passed Congress.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2020/02/26/809705702/it-s-about-time-house-approves-historic-bill-making-lynching-a-federal-crime>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-02-26-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Astronomers at the Catalina Sky Survey in Arizona, United States, say an object known as 2020 CD3 has been captured by Earth's gravitational field and has been in orbit since 2017, becoming a temporary natural satellite of Earth. The Minor Planet Center confirms the findings and says "no link to a known artificial object has been found", implying the object is an asteroid.

Source citations (as archived): [New Scientist](<https://www.newscientist.com/article/2235427-earth-has-acquired-a-brand-new-moon-thats-about-the-size-of-a-car/#ixzz6F6Y9rpdp>).

<a id="event-2020-02-27-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Astronomers discover the largest known explosion ever in the history of the Universe, which occurred in the Ophiuchus galaxy cluster. It replaces MS 0735.6+7421. **Archived source account.** American and Afghan Taliban leaders will meet at the Sheraton Grand Doha Resort &amp; Convention Hotel in Doha, Qatar, ahead of a signing ceremony to bring an end to the 18-year war in Afghanistan, which is now the longest war in U.S. history. Taliban deputy leader Sirajuddin Haqqani says "everyone is tired of war, it has exhausted everyone", while the longest-serving NATO Commander in Afghanistan, General John Nicholson, describes the situation as a "stalemate".

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/02/taliban-set-sign-deal-war-afghanistan-200228055452287.html>).

Source citations (as archived): [The Economist](<https://www.economist.com/britain/2020/03/01/the-eu-and-britain-start-negotiating-a-post-brexit-trade-deal>); [The Irish Times](<https://www.irishtimes.com/news/politics/uk-breaching-brexit-deal-would-be-big-break-of-trust-former-wto-head-1.4189495>).

<a id="event-2020-03-02-3-2"></a>

Context: Japan–North Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** North Korea fires two short-range projectiles from the coast of Wonsan before landing in the sea dividing the Korean Peninsula and Japan. Japan's Defence Ministry says it had not detected any projectile landing in its territory and that no ship or aircraft in the area had been damaged.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/mar/02/north-korea-fires-two-projectiles-ending-its-ban-on-long-range-tests>).

<a id="event-2020-03-02-3-4"></a>

Context: Libyan peace process.

**Archived source account.** The head of the United Nations Support Mission in Libya Ghassan Salamé resigns citing stress and health concerns. In a statement on Twitter, Salamé says he has been frustrated with foreign powers, particularly France and Russia for covertly backing Khalifa Haftar's forces in the civil war.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/mar/02/libya-peace-efforts-chaos-un-envoy-ghassan-salam-quits>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-03-02-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A hostage situation occurs at the V-Mall in San Juan, Philippines. The suspect, a disgruntled security guard, took about 60 to 70 people hostage and shot and injured another security guard. The crisis is resolved after ten hours, with the suspect being arrested following an official apology and the resignation of his bosses for alleged corruption.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN Philippines](<https://cnnphilippines.com/news/2020/3/2/V-Mall-Virra-Mall-Greenhills-shooting-incident.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-03-02-5-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Dominican Republic municipal elections.

**Archived source account.** Industrial Associations Federation's president Ramón Porfirio Báez announces the election crisis is beginning to hurt the economy.

Source citations (as archived): [Dominican Today](<https://dominicantoday.com/dr/economy/2020/03/02/botched-elections-harms-the-economy-all-sectors/>).

<a id="event-2020-03-02-5-2"></a>

Context: 2020 Dominican Republic municipal elections.

**Archived source account.** Former Santo Domingo mayor Roberto Salcedo Sr. resigns from the government and the Dominican Liberation Party.

Source citations (as archived): [Dominican Today](<https://dominicantoday.com/dr/local/2020/03/02/high-level-figure-quits-the-ruling-party-could-herald-stampede/>).

<a id="event-2020-03-02-5-4"></a>

Context: 2020 Guyanese general election.

**Archived source account.** People of Guyana head to the polls to elect the members of their National Assembly.

Source citations (as archived): [AlJazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/02/guyana-holds-crucial-election-expected-oil-boom-200228214328135.html>).

<a id="event-2020-03-02-5-6"></a>

Context: 2020 Israeli legislative election.

**Archived source account.** Israelis head to the polls for the third time in less than a year.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-election/mired-in-stalemate-israel-holds-another-election-on-netanyahus-future-idUSKBN20P00F>).

<a id="event-2020-03-02-5-8"></a>

Context: 2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries.

**Archived source account.** Minnesota Senator Amy Klobuchar suspends her presidential campaign, and joins fellow former contenders Pete Buttigieg and Beto O'Rourke in announcing their endorsement of Joe Biden.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com./2020/03/02/us/politics/amy-klobuchar-drops-out.html>).

<a id="event-2020-03-02-5-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** MSNBC political anchor Chris Matthews resigns over criticism of making sexist comments and comparing Bernie Sanders' campaign to the Nazi invasion of France.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2020/03/02/business/media/chris-matthews-resigns-steps-down-msnbc.html>).

### 2020-03-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1131753064](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20March%203&oldid=1131753064>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-03-03-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war, Northwestern Syria offensive (December 2019–March 2020), Turkish involvement in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A Syrian Air Force L-39 jet aircraft is shot down by a Turkish Air Force F-16 near the Syria–Turkey border.,

Source citations (as archived): [SOHR](<http://www.syriahr.com/?p=366778>); [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/482181-idlib-syria-turkey-plane>).

<a id="event-2020-03-03-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war, Northwestern Syria offensive (December 2019–March 2020), Turkish involvement in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Turkey says it will deploy its domestically-produced surface-to-air missile HISAR to Syria's Idlib Governorate next week.

Source citations (as archived): [Star](<https://www.star.com.tr/savunma/ssb-baskani-mujdeyi-verdi-hisar-hava-savunma-sistemi-1-haftaya-sahada-olacak-haber-1519566/>).

<a id="event-2020-03-03-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war, Northwestern Syria offensive (December 2019–March 2020), Turkish involvement in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Syrian government sources say a Turkish drone was shot down by the Syrian Air Defense Force near Idlib; subsequent footage shared by the source shows drone to be a Bayraktar TB1.

Source citations (as archived): [Muraselon](<https://en.muraselon.com/2020/03/syrian-army-retakes-the-large-city-of-saraqib-in-south-idlib/>).

<a id="event-2020-03-03-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war, Northwestern Syria offensive (December 2019–March 2020), Turkish involvement in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Four Turkish soldiers are killed and seven are wounded in Tranbeh, west of Saraqeb by Syrian Army shelling; some are transferred to Turkish hospitals in Reyhanlı by helicopter.

Source citations (as archived): [SOHR](<http://www.syriahr.com/en/?p=156324>); [SOHR](<http://www.syriahr.com/?p=366961>).

<a id="event-2020-03-03-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war, Northwestern Syria offensive (December 2019–March 2020), Turkish involvement in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Twenty-six Syrian Army troops are killed by Turkish ground and drone strikes, raising the number of pro-Syrian government forces killed by Turkey in the past five days to 139.

Source citations (as archived): [SOHR](<http://www.syriahr.com/?p=366819>); [SOHR](<http://www.syriahr.com/?p=366818>).

<a id="event-2020-03-03-0-7"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The GNA government says all flights from Mitiga International Airport, the only functioning airport in the capital Tripoli, will be shifted to Misrata Airport after Libyan National Army forces struck the airport with rockets.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-libya-security/libya-shifts-flights-from-tripoli-to-misrata-amid-heavier-bombing-idUKKBN20Q343>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-03-03-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Australian news agency Australian Associated Press (AAP) announces it will be closing down at the end of June, after 85 years of operation.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/c9d2809aaa0e8fa47c629723444d7b51>).

<a id="event-2020-03-03-1-2"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States.

**Archived source account.** In an emergency move, its first since 2008, the U.S. Federal Reserve cuts the federal funds rate by 0.5%, to a range between 1 and 1.25%.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo Finance](<https://finance.yahoo.com/news/fed-cuts-rates-by-50-basis-points-amid-coronavirus-concerns-150008506.html>).

<a id="event-2020-03-03-1-3"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States.

**Archived source account.** U.S. stocks extend their drop in response to the cuts.

Source citations (as archived): [The Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/global-stocks-gain-on-stimulus-hopes-11583206230>).

<a id="event-2020-03-03-2-1"></a>

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-03-04-1-1"></a>

<a id="event-2020-03-04-1-2"></a>

<a id="event-2020-03-04-2-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Italy.

**Archived source account.** Italy says all schools and universities will close from March 5 through March 15 to stop the spread of the virus, as the country confirms a total of 3,090 cases and 107 COVID-19-related deaths.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Spain.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe.

Context: Canada–Iran relations, Ukraine International Airlines Flight 752.

**Archived source account.** Canadian Foreign Minister François-Philippe Champagne urges Iran to allow access to the flight recorders of the Ukrainian passenger plane that was shot down in January.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ukraine-canada/on-ukraine-visit-canada-minister-presses-iran-for-access-to-black-boxes-from-plane-crash-idUSKBN20R2T8>).

The Judge Rotenberg Educational Center in Massachusetts, the last U.S. institution that still uses electroshock devices to punish patients, say they will challenge the federal ban in court.

<a id="event-2020-03-04-5-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries.

The comedian also distributed bananas (in reference to the name given in Brazil to the bras d'honneur) to the attending journalists.

Context: Government of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Oleksiy Honcharuk and his government are voted out by the Verkhovna Rada after less than six months in office. President Volodymyr Zelensky proposes Denys Shmygal as Prime Minister.

### 2020-03-05

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2020-03-05-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Egypt reopens the Pyramid of Djoser after a 14-year restoration. The pyramid is deemed the oldest stone structure of its size in the world.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/egypts-oldest-pyramid-reopens-public-14-year-restoration/story?id=69411249/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-03-05-1-1"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** British airline Flybe collapses into administration with the loss of 2,000 jobs after failing to secure financial support. The airline says the impact of the coronavirus pandemic is partly to blame for its collapse. Flybe provided more than half of UK domestic flights outside London.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-51746564>).

<a id="event-2020-03-05-1-2"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-03-11-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan, Afghan peace process.

**Archived source account.** The Taliban rejects the government's conditional prisoner release order announced by President Ashraf Ghani. The Taliban demand 5,000 Taliban prisoners held by the government be released before intra-Afghan dialogue can be initiated.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/03/taliban-rejects-afghan-gov-conditional-prisoner-release-order-200311073806368.html>).

<a id="event-2020-03-11-0-3"></a>

Context: 2020 Camp Taji attack.

**Archived source account.** A rocket attack on Camp Taji, Baghdad Governorate, housing coalition and Iraqi troops, kills two Americans and a British service member; 12 other people are injured.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-51842744>).

<a id="event-2020-03-11-1-3"></a>

<a id="event-2020-03-15-1-1"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2020/03/15/federal-reserve-cuts-rates-to-zero-and-launches-massive-700-billion-quantitative-easing-program.html>).

### 2020-03-25

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-03-25-0-2"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / Kabul gurdwara attack.

**Archived source account.** Gunmen kill 25 worshippers at a gurdwara in Kabul, Afghanistan. ISIL claims responsibility.

<a id="event-2020-03-25-0-5"></a>

Context: Libyan Civil War / 2019–20 Western Libya offensive.

**Archived source account.** Forces loyal to the GNA assault the Okba Ibn Nafa Air Base, west of Tripoli, while the Libyan National Army captures several towns near the Berber city of Zuwarah, including Zaltan, Jumayl and Ras Ajdir.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-libya-security/libya-battles-escalate-as-coronavirus-arrives-in-country-idUKKBN21C1FU>).

<a id="event-2020-03-25-1-2"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic / Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on cinema, COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China.

Source citations (as archived): [CNET](<https://www.cnet.com/news/china-is-re-releasing-avengers-and-avatar-to-revive-cinemas-after-the-coronavirus/>).

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The United States Senate and the Trump administration reaches a $2 trillion stimulus package deal following talks with Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin. The bill passes, and is expected to go to the United States House of Representatives.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/2020/03/25/trump-senate-coronavirus-economic-stimulus-2-trillion/>); [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2020/03/25/senate-passes-2-trillion-coronavirus-stimulus-package.html>).

<a id="event-2020-03-28-2-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Africa / COVID-19 pandemic in Ghana.

**Editorial account; source review partial.** Ghana’s March 30 Finance Ministry statement records partial lockdowns in the Accra-Tema-Kasoa and Kumasi metropolitan areas and a presidential COVID-19 Fund. This scoped check does not establish every timing clause of the original March 28 portal account.

Editorial date: 2020-03-28. Checked: 2026-10-21. Partial: the areas and fund are corroborated. The precise lockdown announcement date, two-week duration and March 30 commencement are not fully established by the selected passages; the original speech URL was inaccessible during review.

Evidence: [Ghana Ministry of Finance](<https://mofep.gov.gh/sites/default/files/news/MoF-Statement-to-Parliament_20200330.pdf>).

Original source account: Ghana President Nana Akufo-Addo announces a two-week partial lockdown on 27th March 2020 for Greater Accra and Kumasi, beginning on 30th March 2020. He also announced the establishment of a special fund to combat the spread of the coronavirus pandemic.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

**Archived source account.** Parliament votes 137 to 53 in favor of passing legislation to create a state of emergency without a time limit, grant Prime Minister Viktor Orbán the ability to rule by decree, suspend the parliament with no elections, and establish prison sentences for spreading fake news and leaving quarantine.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/hungary-passes-law-allowing-viktor-orban-to-rule-by-decree/a-52956243>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2020-03-30-5-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in Japan, Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports.

**Archived source account.** After getting postponed a week before, the 2020 Summer Olympics has been rescheduled to July 23, 2021, while the 2020 Summer Paralympics is now taking place for August 24, 2021.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2020/mar/30/tokyo-olympics-to-start-in-july-2021-after-coronavirus-rescheduling>).
