<a id="event-2020-04-02-1-26"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in South America / COVID-19 pandemic in Ecuador.

**Archived source account.** The Mayor of Guayaquil, Cynthia Viteri, herself infected with COVID-19, condemns the federal government's response to the pandemic as the virus rapidly spreads inside the city. A joint military and police task force has collected at least 150 bodies off the streets. The government's spokesman Jorge Wated apologizes in a message broadcast on state television.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20200402-troops-gather-scores-of-bodies-of-virus-victims-in-ecuador-city>); [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/ecuador-bodies-streets-guayaquil-coronavirus-covid-19/>).

<a id="event-2020-04-02-1-29"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in Guam.

**Archived source account.** United States Navy Captain Brett Crozier is dismissed as the commander of the USS Theodore Roosevelt aircraft carrier after he publicly raised concerns about a COVID-19 outbreak on the ship. U.S. Navy Secretary Thomas Modly says the commander "exercised extremely poor judgement". At least 100 people aboard the vessel have been reportedly infected.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-52145230>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-04-02-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** American rapper 6ix9ine is released early from prison due to coronavirus concerns.

Source citations (as archived): [Complex](<https://www.complex.com/music/2020/04/6ix9ine-early-prison-release-coronavirus-concerns>).

<a id="event-2020-04-02-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A court in Pakistan overturns the convictions of four men for the murder of Daniel Pearl. The men have been jailed for 18 years.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/04/02/asia/daniel-pearl-suspects-intl-hnk/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-04-02-3-2"></a>

Context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics / 2020 Democratic National Convention.

**Archived source account.** The Democratic National Convention is postponed from July 13 to August 17 due to COVID-19 concerns.

Source citations (as archived): [Vox](<https://www.vox.com/2020/4/2/21204517/democratic-national-convention-delayed-august-coronavirus-crisis>).

<a id="event-2020-04-02-3-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in the United States.

**Archived source account.** United States President Donald Trump invokes the Defense Production Act to clear up supply-chain issues encountered in the manufacturing of ventilator machines.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/04/02/politics/defense-production-act-ventilator-supplies/index.html>).

### 2020-04-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1082157234](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20April%203&oldid=1082157234>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2020-04-03-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Prague removes the controversial monument of Soviet General Ivan Konev, prompting anger from the Russian Embassy and Czech President Milos Zeman. Prague 6's local assembly voted to remove the Soviet-era monument in 2019.

Source citations (as archived): [RFERL](<https://www.rferl.org/a/prague-removes-statue-of-soviet-era-commander-angering-russia/30528880.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-04-03-1-2"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe.

**Archived source account.** Ford Motor Company extends the suspension of vehicle and engine production at most of its manufacturing sites in Europe to May 4 due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-healthcare-coronavirus-ford/ford-says-europe-manufacturing-ops-to-remain-suspended-at-least-until-may-4-idUSKBN21L1K4>).

<a id="event-2020-04-03-1-4"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the Dominican Republic.

**Archived source account.** The World Bank releases US$150 million to support the Dominican Republic's efforts to contain COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [Dominican Today](<https://dominicantoday.com/dr/covid-19/2020/04/03/world-bank-releases-us-150-million-for-covid-19-response-in-dominican-republic/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-04-03-2-1"></a>

Context: Cyclone Harold.

**Archived source account.** Twenty-seven people died in Solomon Islands after their boat capsized during the Cyclone Harold.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-52179853>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-04-03-3-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines.

**Archived source account.** The Philippines records its single largest daily increase in casualties with 29 deaths, bringing the total deaths in the country to 136.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/philippines-reports-29-new-coronavirus-deaths--highest-in-a-single-day-12606716>).

<a id="event-2020-04-03-3-6"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / COVID-19 pandemic in the Dominican Republic.

**Archived source account.** The Governor of the Duarte Province, Luis Núñez, tests positive for COVID-19 just after his wife dies from the virus.

Source citations (as archived): [Dominican Today](<https://dominicantoday.com/dr/covid-19/2020/04/03/the-wife-of-the-governor-of-the-duarte-province-dies-of-coronavirus/>).

<a id="event-2020-04-03-3-9"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** The Department of Health and Social Care reports 684 more deaths from COVID-19, the highest daily death toll in the country to date, bringing the country's death toll to 3,605 and 38,168 confirmed cases.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/coronavirus-684-more-covid-19-deaths-in-uk-bringing-total-to-3-605-11967903>).

<a id="event-2020-04-03-3-11"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Switzerland, Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on prisons.

**Archived source account.** Police surround the Champ-Dollon prison in Geneva, Switzerland, after dozens of prisoners refuse to return to their cells because of new coronavirus measures.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-swiss-prison/geneva-prisoners-protest-conditions-refuse-to-return-to-cells-officials-idUKKBN21L334?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-04-03-3-13"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Spain.

**Archived source account.** Spain's Ministry of Health reports 7,500 new cases and 932 more deaths from COVID-19, bringing the country's death toll to 10,935 and 117,710 confirmed cases.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/spain-coronavirus-death-toll-cases-pandemic-latest-a9444976.html>).

<a id="event-2020-04-03-3-14"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Spain.

**Archived source account.** The country overtakes Italy in the number of positives and becomes the second country in the world with more coronavirus cases.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-spain/spain-overtakes-italy-in-coronavirus-cases-death-rate-slows-idUSKBN21L1DE>).

<a id="event-2020-04-03-3-17"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in South America / COVID-19 pandemic in the Falkland Islands.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom's Falkland Islands reports their first confirmed case of COVID-19. The patient is reported to be in stable condition at King Edward VII Memorial Hospital in Stanley.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-falkland-islands/falkland-islands-reports-first-case-of-the-coronavirus-idUKKBN21L38J?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-04-03-3-19"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in South America / COVID-19 pandemic in Suriname.

**Archived source account.** Suriname reports the country's first death from COVID-19 as confirmed cases rise to 10.

Source citations (as archived): [TASS](<https://tass.com/world/1140197>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-04-03-4-1"></a>

Context: Pakistan-United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Following criticism by the US government, the government of Sindh prevents the release of Ahmed Omar Saeed Sheikh and three other men. Yesterday, the Sindh High Court overturned their convictions for the murder of Daniel Pearl. The Pakistani Foreign Minister says the "\[release\] order shall be challenged at a higher forum".

Source citations (as archived): [Outlook India](<https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2020/04/03/Pakistan-prevents-release-of-4-cleared-in-2002-death-of-Daniel-Pearl/5461585915698/>).

### 2020-04-04

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1131754212](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20April%204&oldid=1131754212>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-04-04-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** Afghan intelligence agency National Directorate of Security announces that security forces have arrested 20 ISIL–KP fighters, including leader Aslam Farooqi.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/04/afghan-forces-announce-arrest-local-isil-leader-200404171431866.html>).

<a id="event-2020-04-04-0-3"></a>

Context: 2020 Romans-sur-Isère knife attack.

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed and five others are injured in a mass stabbing in Romans-sur-Isère, Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, France. A man from Sudan was arrested at the scene. The attack is treated and investigated as a terrorist incident.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-52165522>).

<a id="event-2020-04-04-0-5"></a>

Context: Mexican Drug War.

**Archived source account.** A shootout between rival cartel gangs in Chihuahua, Mexico, kills at least 19 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Global News](<https://globalnews.ca/news/6779999/mexico-shooting-cartel/>).

<a id="event-2020-04-04-0-8"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War / Turkish military intervention in the Second Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Turkish-backed GNA forces say they have shot down three Sukhoi Su-22 jets belonging to forces loyal to Field marshal Khalifa Haftar.

Source citations (as archived): [Middle East Monitor](<https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20200404-libya-gna-shoots-down-3-sukhoi-fighters-belonging-to-haftar/>).

<a id="event-2020-04-04-0-10"></a>

Context: Withdrawal of U.S. troops from Iraq.

**Archived source account.** The United States-led CJTF–OIR hands over Al-Taqaddum Air Base to Iraqi security forces. It is the fourth military base to be returned to Iraq in recent weeks.

Source citations (as archived): [Military Times](<https://www.militarytimes.com/flashpoints/2020/04/04/us-hands-over-another-air-base-to-iraqi-forces/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-04-04-1-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Georgia.

**Archived source account.** Georgia reports its first death from COVID-19; that of a 79-year-old woman who had other illnesses and underlying health conditions.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-georgia/georgia-records-first-death-from-coronavirus-clinic-doctor-idUSKBN21M0B8?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-04-04-1-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** The Department of Health and Social Care reports 708 more deaths from COVID-19, the highest daily death toll in the country to date, bringing the UK's death toll to 4,313 and 41,903 confirmed cases.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/coronavirus-another-708-die-uk-total-now-4-313-11968554>).

<a id="event-2020-04-04-1-6"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** A 5-year-old boy dies from COVID-19, becoming Europe's youngest victim of the virus to date. He had underlying health conditions.

Source citations (as archived): [Metro](<https://metro.co.uk/2020/04/04/child-five-becomes-uks-youngest-victim-coronavirus-12508801/>).

<a id="event-2020-04-04-1-8"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom / Misinformation related to the COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** At the British government's daily press briefing on the coronavirus pandemic, Minister for the Cabinet Office Michael Gove condemns conspiracy theories being spread on social media about 5G spreading COVID-19. Several 5G telecommunications masts have been set on fire in recent days in Birmingham and Merseyside.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-britain-5g/5g-coronavirus-conspiracy-theory-is-dangerous-fake-nonsense-uk-says-idUKKBN21M0ME?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-04-04-1-10"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in France.

**Archived source account.** France reports 1,053 more deaths from COVID-19, raising the country's death toll to 7,560 and 89,953 cases. The new figures include previously unreported deaths in retirement homes.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-france-toll/french-coronavirus-death-toll-hits-new-high-as-nursing-home-tally-swells-idUSKBN21M0S9>).

<a id="event-2020-04-04-1-13"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Kuwait.

**Archived source account.** Kuwait reports its first death from COVID-19 as cases reach 479.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-kuwait/kuwait-reports-first-death-from-coronavirus-outbreak-state-news-agency-idUSKBN21M0DK?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-04-04-1-15"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey, Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on prisons.

**Archived source account.** Turkey deploys the Gendarmerie General Command to the eastern city of Batman after a riot erupts inside the city's Type-M prison. The riot comes after the Turkish parliament approved the release of 100,000 inmates due to COVID-19, but excluded journalists and political prisoners, many of whom are Kurds.

Source citations (as archived): [Ahval News](<https://ahvalnews.com/prisoner-bill/riot-erupts-southeast-penitentiary-after-parliamentary-committee-approves-prisoner>).

<a id="event-2020-04-04-1-17"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania.

**Archived source account.** The President of New Caledonia Thierry Santa self-quarantines after a member of his crisis management team tested positive for COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/413465/new-caledonia-president-in-self-isolation-amid-covid-19-outbreak>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-04-04-2-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Labour Party leadership election.

**Archived source account.** Sir Keir Starmer wins the 2020 Labour Party leadership election in the United Kingdom and becomes Leader of the Labour Party and Leader of the Opposition.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/live/2020/apr/04/labour-leadership-election-winner-keir-starmer-long-bailey-nandy-and-jeremy-corbyns-successor-to-be-announced-at-1045am-live-news>).

<a id="event-2020-04-04-2-3"></a>

Context: 2019–20 Chilean protests.

**Archived source account.** Chilean president Sebastián Piñera takes pictures in an empty Plaza Baquedano, symbol of mass protests calling for his resignation. The image provokes outrage after the protests were halted due to the coronavirus pandemic and a quarantine was declared.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/reuters/2020/04/03/world/americas/03reuters-chile-protests-president.html>).

### 2020-04-05

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1357550918](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20April%205&oldid=1357550918>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-04-05-0-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Africa / COVID-19 pandemic in South Sudan.

**Archived source account.** South Sudan Vice President Riek Machar confirms the country's first case of COVID-19. The patient is a 29-year-old woman who had arrived from Ethiopia in February and is now in isolation.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-southsudan/south-sudan-confirms-first-case-of-coronavirus-idUSKBN21N0EA>).

<a id="event-2020-04-05-0-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Africa / COVID-19 pandemic in Egypt.

**Archived source account.** Former Libyan Prime Minister Mahmoud Jibril dies in Egypt from COVID-19 at the age of 67.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-04-05/former-libya-premier-jibril-dies-in-cairo-from-coronavirus>).

<a id="event-2020-04-05-0-7"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Africa / COVID-19 pandemic in Ethiopia.

**Archived source account.** The government confirms its first death from COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-ethiopia/ethiopia-reports-its-first-death-of-a-covid-19-patient-idUSKBN21N0IE>).

<a id="event-2020-04-05-0-9"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Africa / COVID-19 pandemic in Morocco.

**Archived source account.** King Mohammed VI of Morocco pardons 5,654 prisoners and orders new measures to protect inmates from COVID-19. The prisoners were selected on the basis of their age, frail health, time spent in prison and good conduct.

Source citations (as archived): [Middle East Monitor](<https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20200405-morocco-to-release-5654-prisoners-amid-coronavirus-outbreak/>).

<a id="event-2020-04-05-0-13"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic on USS Theodore Roosevelt.

**Archived source account.** United States Navy Captain Brett Crozier, recently relieved of his command of the aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt after his letter pleading for aid for the coronavirus outbreak aboard his ship was leaked to the press, tests positive for COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2020/04/05/magazine/navy-captain-crozier-positive-coronavirus.html>).

<a id="event-2020-04-05-0-15"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state).

**Archived source account.** New York reports 8,327 new confirmed cases and 594 more deaths from COVID-19, bringing the state's death toll to 4,159 and 122,000 cases, according to Governor Andrew Cuomo.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-usa-new-york/new-york-state-reports-594-coronavirus-deaths-in-past-24-hours-idUKKBN21N0ND>).

<a id="event-2020-04-05-0-17"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / COVID-19 pandemic in Haiti.

**Archived source account.** Haiti reports the country's first death from COVID-19, a 55-year-old man with underlying health conditions.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20200405-haiti-reports-its-first-coronavirus-death>).

<a id="event-2020-04-05-0-20"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Boris Johnson is admitted to hospital 10 days after testing positive for COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-52177125>).

<a id="event-2020-04-05-0-21"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Queen Elizabeth II gives an address to the nation, just the fifth such event in the monarch's 68-year reign, where she compares social isolation to the world war evacuations, thanks the public for their resilience and the world for unifying.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-52176222>).

<a id="event-2020-04-05-0-23"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom / COVID-19 pandemic in Scotland.

**Archived source account.** Scotland's Chief Medical Officer Catherine Calderwood resigns after breaking her own rules on COVID-19 restrictions by visiting her second home in Elie and Earlsferry. She had been warned by police about her conduct.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-scotland-resignati/scotlands-chief-medical-officer-resigns-after-flouting-own-coronavirus-guidance-idUKKBN21N0WH>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-04-05-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Five people are killed in a mass shooting in Yelatma, Ryazan Oblast, Russia. The suspect has been arrested and said he shot dead four men and one woman for "talking too loudly".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-52173341>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-04-05-2-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Africa / COVID-19 pandemic in Malawi.

**Archived source account.** President Peter Mutharika announces a stimulus package to alleviate the economic stress resulting from the disease. To help finance this program, he and all government ministers are taking a ten percent wage cut for three months.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-52172164>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-04-05-3-1"></a>

Context: Misinformation related to the COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** YouTube says it will remove videos promoting a conspiracy theory linking 5G to COVID-19, while "borderline content" will be removed from search results. The decision comes after four more mobile phone masts are set on fire, and broadband engineers have received threats, in several UK cities.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/apr/05/youtube-to-suppress-content-spreading-coronavirus-5g-conspiracy-theory>).

### 2020-04-06

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256032169](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20April%206&oldid=1256032169>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-04-06-0-1"></a>

Context: Mali War.

**Archived source account.** Gunmen on motorbikes attack a military base in Bamba, Gao, Mali, killing at least 25 soldiers. No group has claimed responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhuanet](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2020-04/07/c_138952410.htm>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/04/20-malian-soldiers-killed-attack-military-base-200406103504731.html>).

<a id="event-2020-04-06-1-1"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** British department store retailer Debenhams files for administration due to "unprecedented" circumstances caused by the United Kingdom's coronavirus lockdown.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-52182199>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-04-06-2-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Boris Johnson is admitted to intensive care at St Thomas' Hospital in London as his COVID-19 symptoms worsen. Foreign Secretary Dominic Raab, as First Secretary of State, will assume Johnson's duties while he remains in the ICU.

<a id="event-2020-04-06-2-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in France.

**Archived source account.** France reports 833 more deaths from COVID-19, the highest number of deaths recorded in a single day, bringing the country's death toll to 8,911 and the number of cases to 98,010. Health Minister Olivier Véran says, "We have not reached the end of the ascent of this epidemic."

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-52191889>).

<a id="event-2020-04-06-2-6"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in France.

**Archived source account.** President Emmanuel Macron eases some lockdown restrictions for people on the autism spectrum following the requests of disability groups.

Source citations (as archived): [Metro](<https://metro.co.uk/2020/04/02/france-eases-lockdown-autistic-people-can-go-reassuring-places-12499265>).

<a id="event-2020-04-06-2-9"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / COVID-19 pandemic in Barbados.

**Archived source account.** Barbados reports its first death from COVID-19, an 81-year-old man with diabetes who recently travelled to the United Kingdom.

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, COVID-19 pandemic in Ivory Coast.

**Archived source account.** Police and protesters clash in Ivory Coast, after the latter dismantled a half-built COVID-19 testing center over fears that people using the facility would spread the virus through their district.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-ivorycoast-violenc/ivory-coast-police-clash-with-protesters-over-coronavirus-test-centre-idUSKBN21O1LT>).

<a id="event-2020-04-06-3-3"></a>

Context: Right-wing terrorism in Russia, Russia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** In an unprecedented move, the Trump administration designates a white supremacist group, based in Russia, as a terrorist organization, and imposes individual sanctions on its leaders. The organization, Russian Imperial Movement, is believed to have trained the perpetrators of a series of terrorist attacks in Gothenburg, Sweden, in 2016.

Source citations (as archived): [Associated Press](<https://apnews.com/4f5dfda48d9f13876af828757c85d852>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-04-06-4-2"></a>

Context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics / 2020 Wisconsin Democratic primary, 2020 Wisconsin Republican primary, COVID-19 pandemic in Wisconsin.

**Archived source account.** The Wisconsin Supreme Court overturns Governor Tony Evers's order to postpone tomorrow's primary elections. Furthermore, the Supreme Court of the United States rules 5–4 in favor of the Republican National Committee to overturn a lower court decision extending absentee ballot eligibility in the Wisconsin primary election to those ballots postmarked by April 13, ruling that ballots postmarked after April 7 will be invalidated.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.com/news/2020/04/06/wisconsin-governor-orders-stop-to-in-person-voting-on-eve-of-election-168527>); [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2020/04/06/wisconsin-supreme-court-halts-absentee-ballot-deadline-extension.html>).

<a id="event-2020-04-06-4-4"></a>

Context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics / COVID-19 pandemic in Poland, 2020 Polish presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Deputy Prime Minister Jarosław Gowin tenders resignation over disagreement with the ruling Law and Justice (PiS) party as to the upcoming presidential election. He stated at a press conference that the election scheduled for May 10, should be postponed, while the government pushes for the election amid the coronavirus pandemic. Gowin also resigns as Minister of Science and Higher Education.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Poland](<https://www.polskieradio.pl/395/7784/Artykul/2487977,UPDATE-Polish-deputy-PM-quits-amid-spat-over-election>).

<a id="event-2020-04-06-4-5"></a>

Context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics / COVID-19 pandemic in Poland, 2020 Polish presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Polish MPs, with 230–226 votes and two abstained, pass a bill under which the presidential election in May will be held by postal vote only. The bill now goes to the upper house, the Senate, for debate.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Poland](<https://www.polskieradio.pl/395/7784/Artykul/2488251,Polish-MPs-back-rules-to-hold-presidential-election-by-postal-vote-only>).

The U.S. becomes the first country to report over 2,000 COVID-19 deaths in a single day.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-52249963>).

<a id="event-2020-04-10-1-21"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on education.

**Archived source account.** Students of Outside Creek Elementary School in California attend classes despite Governor Gavin Newsom's order to close all schools in the state.

Source citations (as archived): [Boston](<https://www.boston.com/news/education/2020/04/10/for-students-at-a-lone-school-in-california-class-is-still-on>).

<a id="event-2020-04-10-1-23"></a>

Context: Kivu Ebola epidemic.

**Archived source account.** In a major setback for efforts to declare the end of the outbreak on Sunday, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports the first case of Ebola since February. The outbreak has killed more than 2,200 people since August 2018.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-ebola-congo/congo-reports-first-ebola-case-in-six-weeks-idUSKCN21S1P5>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-04-10-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A prison riot breaks out at a high-security prison in Angarsk, Irkutsk Oblast, Russia, allegedly in response to an officer beating an inmate. Large sections of the prison are set on fire, and casualties are reported.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-52251265>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-04-10-3-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Kiribati parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** Kiribati postpones its parliamentary elections for a week.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/413994/delayed-start-for-kiribati-elections>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-04-10-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The European Space Agency/JAXA space probe BepiColombo makes its final gravity assist around Earth, and is now on course for Venus, where it will make several gravity assist manoeuvres before finally arriving at Mercury in 2025.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-52229667>).

<a id="event-2020-04-11-2-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in South America / COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2020/04/11/the-us-now-has-the-most-coronavirus-deaths-in-the-world-surpassing-italy.html>).

<a id="event-2020-04-11-4-1"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** Sudan's Health Minister Akram Ali Altom says that his country urgently needs US$ 120 million to combat the COVID-19 pandemic. While the country has registered relatively few cases and two deaths, Altom says that if it spreads, the country is not prepared to face it.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-sudan/sudans-health-minister-says-country-needs-120-million-to-fight-coronavirus-idUSKCN21T0SY?il=0>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-04-15-0-1"></a>

Context: Mali War, COVID-19 pandemic in Mali.

**Archived source account.** Spain evacuates its troops from Mali after several soldiers become infected with COVID-19. The troops were part of the European Union's EUTM Mali training mission.

Source citations (as archived): [The Olive Press](<https://www.theolivepress.es/spain-news/2020/04/15/more-than-100-spanish-soldiers-evacuated-from-mali-after-coronavirus-outbreak/>).

<a id="event-2020-04-15-0-3"></a>

Context: Terrorism in the United States.

**Archived source account.** A 36-year-old man is arrested for attempting to firebomb a Jewish assisted living facility in Longmeadow, Massachusetts on April 3. His arrest is part of a larger investigation into a white supremacist group suspected of plotting mass killings online. He is charged with two counts of attempted arson, but is released the next day.

Source citations (as archived): [HuffPost](<https://www.huffpost.com/entry/john-michael-rathbun-arrested-jewish-nursing-home-arson-massachuetts_n_5e988e67c5b6ead1400972ee?ncid=NEWSSTAND0005>); [WWLP](<https://www.wwlp.com/news/local-news/hampden-county/man-arrested-in-connection-with-attempted-arson-at-longmeadow-jewish-living-facility-released/>).

<a id="event-2020-04-15-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** According to the United States Navy, a Russian SU-35 fighter jet intercepts a U.S. Navy P-8A Poseidon, anti-submarine and anti-surface warfare aircraft, flying over the Mediterranean Sea.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Insider](<https://www.businessinsider.com/russian-jet-buzzes-us-aircraft-inverted-2020-4>).

<a id="event-2020-04-15-1-2"></a>

None of the injuries is considered life-threatening. At least 32 others are treated at the scene.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/chicago-highway-crash-involves-nearly-60-cars-14-brought-hospitals-n1184186>); [Accuweather](<https://www.accuweather.com/en/winter-weather/major-pileup-crash-in-chicago-amid-wintry-weather/721482>).

<a id="event-2020-04-20-3-1"></a>

Context: Ramos v. Louisiana.

**Archived source account.** In a 6–3 decision, the U.S. Supreme Court rules that convictions for serious crimes requires a unanimous decision by the jury, overturning the conviction of the plaintiff, a Louisiana man, and the 1972 case Apodaca v. Oregon. The ruling paves the way for hundreds of defendants to receive new trials.

### 2020-04-24

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1082281785](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20April%2024&oldid=1082281785>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-04-24-0-1"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen, COVID-19 pandemic in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** The Saudi-led coalition announces the extension of a unilateral ceasefire by one month to fight the pandemic. The Houthis did not accept the coalition's previous ceasefire that expired Thursday. Reportedly, the Houthis "want a lifting of air and sea blockades imposed by the coalition to the regions they control before agreeing to a ceasefire".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-saudi/saudi-led-coalition-announces-one-month-extension-of-yemen-ceasefire-idUSKCN2261GS>).

<a id="event-2020-04-24-0-3"></a>

Context: Internal conflict in Myanmar.

**Archived source account.** Unknown gunmen attack the headquarters of the government-backed Pan Say militia in Muse, Shan State. The attackers opened fire with small arms and artillery before fleeing in cars and motorbikes. No group has claimed responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [The Irrawaddy](<https://www.irrawaddy.com/news/burma/gunmen-attack-govt-militia-china-myanmar-border.html>).

<a id="event-2020-04-24-0-5"></a>

Context: Kivu conflict.

**Archived source account.** An attack by members of the Democratic Forces for the Liberation of Rwanda in Virunga National Park, Democratic Republic of the Congo, leaves 17 people dead: 12 park rangers and five civilians.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/04/drc-rangers-civilians-killed-attack-virunga-national-park-200424161459752.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-04-24-1-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia.

**Archived source account.** The government bans vehicles from entering or leaving the Jakarta metropolitan area to prevent Mudik, a local observance in which migrants and migrant workers return home for Ramadan.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jakarta Post](<https://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2020/04/23/govt-temporarily-bans-passenger-travel-to-prevent-mudik.html>).

<a id="event-2020-04-24-1-3"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States.

**Archived source account.** President Donald Trump signs a US$ 484 billion interim coronavirus relief bill that will add another $310 billion to the small-business Paycheck Protection Program, as well as provide billions in aid to hospitals and for testing.

Source citations (as archived): [Axios](<https://www.axios.com/trump-signs-interim-coronavirus-relief-bill-192d7b83-ec92-4fa9-9f8c-be241e886192.html>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-04-24-2-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in the United States.

**Archived source account.** More than 50,000 people have now died in the United States from COVID-19, according to data from Johns Hopkins University.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-52415579>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-04-24-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Saudi Arabia says it will end flogging as a form of punishment, according to a government document.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-saudi-rights-flogging/saudi-arabia-to-end-flogging-as-form-of-punishment-document-idUSKCN2262VT?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-04-24-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Six activists of the Free Papua Movement are sentenced by an Indonesian court to 8–9 months in prison for treason. The ruling is condemned by Amnesty International and Human Rights Watch as a violation of their freedom of speech and assembly.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-indonesia-papua-treason/indonesia-convicts-papua-activists-of-treason-for-holding-protest-idUSKCN2270CN?il=0>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-04-24-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Brazilian Minister of Justice Sérgio Moro resigns, claiming President Jair Bolsonaro is criminally interfering with the country's law enforcement.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-politics/brazil-justice-minister-quits-accuses-bolsonaro-of-meddling-in-police-idUSKCN2261KW?il=0>).

### 2020-04-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1185383879](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20April%2025&oldid=1185383879>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-04-25-0-1"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** The separatist Southern Transitional Council (STC) announces the establishment of a self-rule administration in southern Yemen. The internationally-recognized government describes this move as "catastrophic." STC forces are deployed in the city of Aden as emergency rule is declared.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-yemen-security-south/stc-announces-plan-for-self-rule-in-south-yemen-government-calls-move-catastrophic-idUKKCN228001?il=0>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-04-25-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Lost Apple Project, a non-profit conservationist society based in the Pacific Northwest, announces the rediscovery of ten cultivars of apples previously thought to be extinct. The decad almost doubles the total amount of species the society has rescued, bringing the total to 23.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/04/25/us/extinct-apples-discovered-in-pacific-scn-trnd/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-04-25-1-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** The Department of Health and Social Care confirms the UK's death toll from COVID-19 has exceeded 20,000. It joins the United States, Italy, Spain and France as the fifth nation to reach this total.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-52424413>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-04-25-2-1"></a>

Context: Bangladesh–Myanmar relations.

**Archived source account.** Foreign Minister of Bangladesh AK Abdul Momen says that it is not the responsibility of his country to rescue more than 500 Rohingya refugees who have been at sea for weeks. Momen tells Al Jazeera they "should ask the Myanmar government first because they are their citizens".

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/04/rohingya-stranded-sea-bangladesh-responsibility-200425082607464.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2020-04-25-3-1"></a>

Context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports, COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands.

**Archived source account.** The 2019–20 Eredivisie season is declared void by the Royal Dutch Football Association.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky Sports](<https://www.skysports.com/football/news/11095/11978351/ajax-denied-title-as-dutch-eredivisie-season-declared-void>).

### 2020-04-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 955096248](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20April%2026&oldid=955096248>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-04-26-0-1"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** Southern Transitional Council (STC) forces say they are in full control of all sovereign state institutions in the port city of Aden, after capturing the Yemen Oil and Gas Corporation refinery, Aden International Airport, the central bank headquarters and the seaport. Yesterday, the STC declared self-rule in southern Yemen.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhuanet](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2020-04/26/c_139009846.htm>).

<a id="event-2020-04-26-0-2"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** Governors in the southern Yemeni Governorates of Hadhramaut, Abyan, Shabwah, Al Mahrah, and the island of Socotra reject the STC's claim to self-rule and declare their loyalty to President Abdrabbuh Mansur Hadi.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/04/yemen-southern-provinces-reject-separatists-claim-rule-200426160607212.html>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-04-26-1-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in Saudi Arabia.

**Archived source account.** King Salman issues an order to partially lift the curfew in all regions of the country except Mecca, where a 24-hour curfew continues. Saudi authorities report 16,299 infections and 136 deaths nationwide.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/04/saudi-arabia-partially-lifts-curfew-mecca-200426063100986.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-04-26-2-1"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in Saudi Arabia.

**Archived source account.** King Salman issues a royal decree, declaring that people will no longer be executed for crimes they were convicted of when they were minors.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-saudi-rights-execution/saudi-arabia-scraps-execution-for-those-who-committed-crimes-as-minors-commission-idUSKCN2280LI?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-04-26-2-3"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2019 El Paso shooting.

**Archived source account.** A survivor of the terrorist mass shooting that occurred at El Paso, Texas in August 2019 dies after nine months of hospitalization, raising the death toll to 23.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2020/04/26/business/ap-mass-shooting-texas.html>).

### 2020-04-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1115446188](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20April%2027&oldid=1115446188>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-04-27-0-1"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** In a televised address, Field Marshal Khalifa Haftar says his Libyan National Army is accepting a "popular mandate" to rule the country, seemingly declaring himself the ruler of Libya and dismissing the House of Representatives. An adviser to the Tripoli-based Government of National Accord says Haftar has exposed himself as an authoritarian.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-libya-security/libyas-eastern-leader-haftar-says-army-to-take-formal-control-idUSKCN2292RQ>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-04-27-1-1"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, Coronavirus recession.

**Archived source account.** Offshore drilling contractor Diamond Offshore Drilling files for bankruptcy due to the oil price collapse, following the reduction in oil demand during the global coronavirus pandemic.

Source citations (as archived): [The Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/diamond-offshore-files-for-chapter-11-bankruptcy-11587925188>).

<a id="event-2020-04-27-1-3"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, Coronavirus recession / Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on aviation.

**Archived source account.** Delta Air Lines announces it is suspending flights to several small-hub airports after losing $534 million in the first quarter of this year due to aviation restrictions caused by the coronavirus pandemic.

Source citations (as archived): [MLive.com](<https://www.mlive.com/news/flint/2020/04/delta-air-lines-files-to-suspend-all-flights-in-flint-lansing-and-kalamazoo.html>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-04-27-2-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** The number of worldwide cases of COVID-19 surpasses three million. The United States accounts for more than a third of the total cases.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-tally/global-coronavirus-cases-pass-3-million-as-lockdowns-begin-to-ease-idUKKCN2292AV>).

<a id="event-2020-04-27-2-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Jacinda Ardern reports no new community transmissions of COVID-19 for the first time since the pandemic began, effectively eliminating the spread of the virus.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-52436658>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-04-27-3-1"></a>

Context: Censorship in Vietnam.

**Archived source account.** A court in Vietnam sentences a man to one and a half years in jail for posting anti-government content on Facebook.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-vietnam-security-trial/vietnam-jails-facebook-user-over-anti-state-posts-idUSKCN2291AQ?il=0>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-04-27-4-1"></a>

Context: Joe Biden 2020 presidential campaign.

**Archived source account.** Speaker of the House Nancy Pelosi officially endorses former Vice President Joe Biden, the presumptive nominee in the Democratic Party primaries.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2020/04/27/us/politics/Pelosi-endorses-Biden.html>).

<a id="event-2020-04-27-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Ankara prosecutor's office launches an investigation into a lawyers' organization which condemned the head of the Directorate of Religious Affairs for implying that homosexuality causes human immunodeficiency virus (HIV). The investigation is launched on the basis that the organization may have insulted Turks' religious values.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-turkey-rights-homosexuality/turkish-ruling-party-lawyers-clash-over-cleric-comments-on-homosexuality-idUSKCN2291LE?il=0>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-04-27-5-1"></a>

Context: USS Nimitz UFO incident, USS Theodore Roosevelt UFO incidents.

**Archived source account.** The Pentagon formally releases three videos of "unidentified aerial phenomena" encountered by United States Navy pilots after determining the videos "do not reveal any sensitive capabilities or systems". The footage was previously leaked by Luis Elizondo in 2017.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/04/27/politics/pentagon-ufo-videos/index.html>).

### 2020-04-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1261870710](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20April%2028&oldid=1261870710>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-04-28-0-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Afrin bombing.

**Archived source account.** A suicide bombing, using a fuel tanker, detonates at a busy market killing at least 53 civilians, including 11 children, in Turkish-occupied Afrin, Syria. The Turkish defense ministry accused the People's Protection Units (YPG) of "carrying out the attack."

Source citations (as archived): [Rudaw](<https://www.rudaw.net/english/middleeast/syria/280420201>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/04/fuel-truck-bomb-blast-kills-dozens-syria-afrin-turkey-200428170837725.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-04-28-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** American movie theater chain AMC Theatres states it will no longer host movies produced by Universal Studios, in response to The Wall Street Journal reporting that NBCUniversal plans to release its movies simultaneously in cinemas and streaming moving forward.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/us-amc-entertainment-universal-studios/amc-will-no-longer-play-universal-studios-films-idUKKCN22B01S>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-04-28-2-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The United States surpasses one million cases of COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/04/28/health/us-coronavirus-tuesday/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-04-28-2-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in North Carolina.

**Archived source account.** A pug in Chapel Hill, North Carolina, becomes the first dog in the United States to test positive for COVID-19. Three of the humans it lives with have also tested positive for the disease.

Source citations (as archived): [WRAL-TV](<https://www.wral.com/coronavirus/chapel-hill-pug-tests-positive-for-virus-that-causes-covid-19-first-known-case-in-a-dog-in-the-us/19074499/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-04-28-3-1"></a>

Context: Bolivia–Chile relations.

**Archived source account.** Bolivia and Chile agree on a deal to return home hundreds of Bolivian migrants stranded at a makeshift camp in Santiago. The migrants will be transported to Iquique where they will spend 14 days in quarantine before finally returning to Bolivia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-chile-bolivia/bolivia-chile-strike-deal-to-return-stranded-bolivian-migrants-home-idUKKCN22A36L?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-04-28-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Colombia formalizes its membership with the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD), becoming the 37th nation in the organization.

Source citations (as archived): [OECD](<https://www.oecd.org/countries/colombia/global-oecd-welcomes-colombia-as-its-37th-member.htm>).

<a id="event-2020-04-28-3-4"></a>

Context: Czech Republic–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Mayor of Prague's sixth municipal district Ondřej Kolář announces on Prima televize that he is under police protection after a Russian man made attempts on his life, possibly due to his removal of a statue of World War II-era Soviet Marshal Ivan Konev from the city's square. Prime Minister Andrej Babiš condemns this as foreign interference, while Kremlin Press Secretary Dmitry Peskov dismisses allegations of Russian involvement as "another hoax".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-czech-russia-threat/prague-district-mayor-says-he-is-under-police-protection-against-russian-threat-idUKKCN22A3GA?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-04-28-3-6"></a>

Context: India–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The Indian Ministry of External Affairs condemns the United States Commission on International Religious Freedom after the Commission in its annual report recommends placing India on the "countries of particular concern" blacklist over the Citizenship Amendment Act, the revocation of Jammu and Kashmir's special status, and controversial comments made by Home Minister Amit Shah, among others.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/04/watchdog-india-religious-freedom-blacklist-200429030352021.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-04-28-4-1"></a>

Context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on prisons.

**Archived source account.** A prison riot at the Lurigancho jail over demands for better sanitary measures and COVID-19 medical care in San Juan de Lurigancho, Peru, leaves nine inmates dead, according to the National Penitentiary Institute.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-peru-prison/death-toll-in-peru-prison-riot-over-coronavirus-demands-rises-to-nine-idUSKCN22A25W?il=0>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-04-28-5-1"></a>

Context: 2019–2020 Lebanese protests.

**Archived source account.** Protests erupt in major cities across Lebanon for the second day over the country's continuing economic problems. Banks and vehicles are set on fire, and clashes between the protestors and the army in Tripoli leave around 40 soldiers injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-lebanon-crisis-tripoli/lebanon-cities-erupt-against-economic-hardship-one-protester-killed-in-tripoli-idUKKCN22A00V?il=0>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-04-28-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A fast radio burst is detected from the Magnetar SGR 1935+2154, the first ever detected inside the Milky Way, and the first to be linked to a known source.

Source citations (as archived): [Astronomer's Telegram](<http://www.astronomerstelegram.org/?read=13681>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2020-04-28-7-1"></a>

Context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports, COVID-19 pandemic in France.

**Archived source account.** France officially ends the 2019–20 Ligue 1 and 2019–20 Ligue 2 football seasons after banning all sporting events in the country until September. It is not yet known whether the governing body Ligue de Football Professionnel will void the seasons.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/52460468>).

### 2020-04-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1082282159](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20April%2029&oldid=1082282159>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-04-29-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** A suicide bombing in Char Asiab, Kabul Province, kills three civilians and injures 15. No group has claimed responsibility yet.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-attacks/bombing-near-afghan-capital-kills-three-amid-unabated-violence-idUSKCN22B0HD>).

<a id="event-2020-04-29-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Yanghee Lee, the United Nations special rapporteur, accuses the Myanmar Armed Forces of intensifying their attacks on civilians in Rakhine and Chin states. The Myanmar government blames Rohingya insurgents and the separatist Arakan Army for the violence.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-rakhine/myanmar-military-may-be-committing-new-war-crimes-says-departing-rights-envoy-idUSKBN22B1KG?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-04-29-1-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Icheon fire.

**Archived source account.** A fire at a four-story warehouse under construction in Icheon, South Korea, kills 38 construction workers and injures 10 others. An additional 40 people remain unaccounted for. The fire is the most deadly in the country since 2003.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-52472799>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/apr/30/south-korea-fire-kills-nearly-40-construction-workers>).

<a id="event-2020-04-29-2-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** Yemeni authorities in Aden report five cases of COVID-19, the highest total to date, amid fears that the disease could be spreading undetected in a country where millions face famine and lack medical care.

<a id="event-2020-04-29-3-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in Colombia, Venezuela–Colombia migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Over 500 Venezuelan migrants block a major toll road in northern Bogotá, Colombia, demanding they be allowed to return home after the coronavirus pandemic caused economic opportunities to dry up.

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-04-29-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. Congressman Justin Amash joins the Libertarian Party and announces his bid for the presidency. This also makes him the first Libertarian in Congress in the party's 48-year history.

Source citations (as archived): [Reason](<https://reason.com/2020/04/29/justin-amash-becomes-the-first-libertarian-member-of-congress/>).

<a id="event-2020-04-29-4-1"></a>
