Ruy Gonçalo do Valle Peixoto de Villas Boas succees him as Lieutenant ad interim of the Sovereign Military Order of Malta.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/dalla-torre-grand-master-knights-malta-dies-75-70411648>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-04-29-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** (52768) 1998 OR2, a near-Earth asteroid that is 2 km wide, makes a close approach of \{\{convert\|0.042\|AU\|e6km LD\|sigfig=2\|abbr=unit\|lk=on\}\} to Earth. It will not approach closer than this until 2079.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/mile-wide-asteroid-will-skim-past-earth-today-at-19-000mph-11980370>).

### 2020-04-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1082282368](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20April%2030&oldid=1082282368>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-04-30-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Texas man opens fire with an AK-47 style rifle at the Cuban Embassy in Washington, D.C., in a suspected hate crime. No one is injured, and the shooter is arrested and charged.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/nation/2020/04/30/cuban-embassy-shooting/>); [Associated Press](<https://apnews.com/8591f583057f48d26a236b4c2efb8959>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-04-30-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Syrian businessman and Syriatel owner Rami Makhlouf makes an "unprecedented" public appeal to his cousin, President Bashar al-Assad, on Facebook, saying a "cadre of officials" are seeking to seize his assets. Makhlouf, who was a part of President al-Assad's inner circle, says he will pay the President himself but not the state.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/an-unprecedented-facebook-video-by-assads-cousin-points-to-rift-in-syrias-ruling-family/2020/05/01/3a856096-8b9f-11ea-80df-d24b35a568ae_story.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-04-30-2-1"></a>

Context: Tornadoes of 2020.

**Archived source account.** The 2020 tornado season in the United States is named the deadliest tornado season since 2011, particularly due to the outbreaks on March 2–3 and Easter Sunday.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<https://www.foxnews.com/us/tornado-season-deadly-severe-weather-outbreak-tennessee-south-2011>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-04-30-3-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** Officials in Yemen report the country's first deaths from COVID-19 in the port city of Aden.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-52485101>).

<a id="event-2020-04-30-3-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Tajikistan.

**Archived source account.** Tajikistan reports its first confirmed cases of COVID-19. Five people have tested positive for the virus in the capital Dushanbe, and 10 others in the northern Sughd Region, according to the state-run news agency Khovar.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/04/tajikistan-declares-coronavirus-cases-200430115708060.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-04-30-4-2"></a>

Context: 2020 United States anti-lockdown protests / COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan.

**Archived source account.** Armed protesters storm the House chamber of the Michigan State Capitol to demand that Governor Gretchen Whitmer lifts the stay-at-home order.

Source citations (as archived): [Forbes](<https://www.forbes.com/sites/andrewsolender/2020/04/30/armed-protesters-storm-michigan-state-house-over-covid-19-lockdown/?sh=4bbffb6b69b5>); [New York Daily News](<https://www.nydailynews.com/coronavirus/ny-coronavirus-armed-men-storm-michigan-state-house-20200430-4jn2bkvhl5bdzaihjvahqya67u-story.html>).

<a id="event-2020-04-30-4-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Russian Prime Minister Mikhail Mishustin temporarily steps down after being diagnosed with COVID-19; he will be replaced by Andrey Belousov.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-russia-mishustin/russian-prime-minister-mikhail-mishustin-tells-putin-he-has-coronavirus-idUSKBN22C357>).

<a id="event-2020-04-30-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The government of Sudan criminalises female genital mutilation.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2020/04/30/world/africa/sudan-outlaws-female-genital-mutilation-.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-04-30-5-1"></a>

Context: Artemis program.

**Archived source account.** NASA officially selects SpaceX, Blue Origin and Dynetics to build its next-generation lunar lander to carry American astronauts to the Moon by 2024.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/us-space-exploration-nasa/musks-spacex-bezos-blue-origin-land-contracts-to-build-nasas-astronaut-moon-lander-idUKKBN22C3DI>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2020-04-30-6-1"></a>

Context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports, COVID-19 pandemic in France.

**Archived source account.** The Ligue de Football Professionnel awards Paris Saint-Germain F.C. the 2019–20 Ligue 1 title after ending the season early. It is PSG's ninth Ligue 1 title. Amiens SC and Toulouse FC are subsequently relegated to Ligue 2.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC Sport](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/52484926>).


## May

### 2020-05-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1082282531](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20May%201&oldid=1082282531>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-05-01-0-1"></a>

Context: Sinai insurgency.

**Archived source account.** ISIL claims responsibility via its Amaq News Agency for a bombing that killed and wounded several Egyptian Army personnel near the city of Bir al-Abd in North Sinai Governorate.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-egypt-security/islamic-state-claims-responsibility-for-egypts-sinai-attack-idUKKBN22D64L>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-05-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Lebanon's banking association rejects a plan proposed by the government to secure emergency funding from the International Monetary Fund, saying they were not consulted and the plan will "further destroy confidence" in the country's financial system.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lebanon-crisis-plan/lebanon-banks-reject-rescue-plan-as-government-asks-imf-for-help-idUSKBN22D5NG?il=0>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-05-01-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** All five crew members declared missing after the crash of a Canadian CH-148 Cyclone helicopter two days earlier are now presumed dead.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/may/02/five-crew-of-canadian-helicopter-presumed-dead-after-crash-off-greek-coast>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-05-01-3-1"></a>

Context: South Hedland stabbing attack.

**Archived source account.** A fly-in fly-out worker from Perth attacks seven people in South Hedland, Western Australia. None were killed, though five were hospitalised. Police shot the attacker dead.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2020/may/01/wa-police-shoot-man-dead-after-five-people-stabbed-in-pilbara-shopping-centre>).

<a id="event-2020-05-01-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A riot over food shortages at the overcrowded Los Llanos prison in Guanare, Portuguesa, Venezuela, leaves at least 46 people dead and dozens more injured, including the prison's director, according to the military.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-52517167>); [Inquirer](<https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1268328/at-least-17-dead-in-venezuela-prison-riot-says-military>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-05-01-4-1"></a>

Context: Gun control in Canada.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Justin Trudeau announces a ban on assault-style weapons, which includes buying, selling, transporting, importing or using the designated weapons. The legislation is said to be motivated by last month's killing spree in Nova Scotia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-canada-guns/canada-bans-assault-style-weapons-in-aftermath-of-mass-shooting-idUSKBN22D62V?il=0>).

### 2020-05-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1338900856](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20May%202&oldid=1338900856>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-05-02-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Arif Wazir, a prominent PTM leader, dies of injuries from an attack that was carried out in a drive-by shooting in Wanna, Pakistan, a day earlier.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<https://gandhara.rferl.org/a/pashtun-rights-activist-killed-in-waziristan-gun-attack/30588994.html>).

<a id="event-2020-05-02-0-2"></a>

Context: Iraqi insurgency (2017–present).

**Archived source account.** At least 10 members of the Popular Mobilization Forces are killed by ISIL militants in attacks in the town of Mekeeshfa and the city of Balad. Iraq and the paramilitary forces' official media report that scores of others were wounded.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/05/isil-attack-kills-hashd-al-shaabi-forces-iraq-reports-200502021705978.html>).

<a id="event-2020-05-02-0-4"></a>

Context: Mali War, Operation Barkhane.

**Archived source account.** A French Foreign Legion soldier dies at a military hospital in Paris, after being wounded in an IED blast, while conducting an operation against Islamist insurgents in Mali.

Source citations (as archived): [The Star](<https://www.thestar.com.my/news/world/2020/05/02/french-foreign-legion-soldier-dies-after-being-wounded-in-mali>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-05-02-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Six people are killed after a Beechcraft 95-B55 Baron crashes near Teniente Jorge Henrich Arauz Airport, Bolivia.

Source citations (as archived): [Aviation Safety Network](<https://aviation-safety.net/wikibase/235672>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-05-02-2-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Palau.

**Archived source account.** President of Palau Thomas Remengesau Jr. condemns the exclusion of Taiwan from the World Health Organization, saying that it "endangers, not only Taiwanese people, but people everywhere". Palau remains one of Taiwan's few political allies in the Pacific.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/415672/who-s-exclusion-of-taiwan-endangers-covid-19-fight-palau>).

<a id="event-2020-05-02-2-3"></a>

Context: Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** Brazil's Supreme Federal Court issues a 10-day injunction against President Jair Bolsonaro's demand that all 30 members of Venezuela's diplomatic team leave the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-venezuela/brazils-top-court-suspends-move-to-expel-venezuelan-diplomats-idUSKBN22E0VG?il=0>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-05-02-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Inmates take seven guards hostage at a prison in Manaus, Brazil, during an attempted escape. A raid later frees the guards and ends the prisoners' rebellion.

Source citations (as archived): [Global News](<https://globalnews.ca/news/6898231/brazil-prison-inmates-coronavirus-hostage/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-05-02-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** North Korea's state-run Korean Central News Agency reports that leader Kim Jong-un attended the ribbon-cutting ceremony for a fertilizer plant today, in his first official appearance since his disappearance from public focus last month.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-north-korea-leader/after-rumours-about-health-north-korea-state-media-report-kim-jong-un-appearance-idUSKBN22D6DD?il=0>).

### 2020-05-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1159066227](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20May%203&oldid=1159066227>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-05-03-0-1"></a>

Context: Korean conflict.

**Archived source account.** North and South Korean soldiers exchange gunfire across the DMZ at a South Korean guard post in Cheorwon, but no injuries are reported. South Korean and U.S. officials suspect the initial shots from the north to be accidental.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-52518844>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-southorea/north-and-south-korea-exchange-gunfire-across-border-at-guard-post-idUSKBN22F03N?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-05-03-0-3"></a>

Context: Piracy in the Gulf of Guinea.

**Archived source account.** Unidentified forces attack two fishing vessels near the Gabonese capital of Libreville and abduct six crewmen (3 Indonesian, 2 Senegalese, and a South Korean). It is the second pirate attack reported this year off the coast of Gabon.

Source citations (as archived): [The Korea Herald](<http://www.koreaherald.com/view.php?ud=20200506000706>).

<a id="event-2020-05-03-0-5"></a>

Context: Sinai insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Egypt's military says that 15 of its members were killed or wounded in recent operations in Sinai and that 126 suspected militants had been killed.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-egypt-security/egypt-reports-15-military-casualties-in-sinai-recently-idUSKBN22F0L7?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-05-03-0-7"></a>

Context: Macuto Bay raid, Crisis in Venezuela.

**Archived source account.** Former U.S. Green Beret Jordan Goudreau, who took part in the failed 2019 Venezuelan uprising attempt to oust Nicolás Maduro, releases a video claiming responsibility for an incursion in Venezuela, announcing the start of an effort to capture senior Venezuelan officials wanted by the U.S. government, codenamed "Operation Gideon". Goudreau claims 60 troops have successfully entered Venezuela by "land and sea" and fighting is underway.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/the_americas/venezuela-maduro-armed-invasion-guaido-opposition/2020/05/03/efb2fa88-8d51-11ea-9322-a29e75effc93_story.html>).

<a id="event-2020-05-03-0-8"></a>

Context: Macuto Bay raid, Crisis in Venezuela.

**Archived source account.** Venezuelan Interior Minister Néstor Reverol says the country's security forces have foiled a "marine incursion" by "terrorist mercenaries" from Colombia, killing at least eight gunmen and capturing two others. The foreign group reportedly landed on a beach in the city of La Guaira on speedboats.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/05/venezuela-killed-foiled-invasion-sea-200503162349161.html>).

<a id="event-2020-05-03-0-9"></a>

Context: Macuto Bay raid, Crisis in Venezuela.

**Archived source account.** State television broadcasts images it says are captured high-calibre weapons, Peruvian documents, and uniforms emblazoned with an American flag.

Source citations (as archived): [Canberra Times](<https://www.canberratimes.com.au/story/6743950/boat-attack-on-venezuela-port-foiled/?cs=14264>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-05-03-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Indonesian e-commerce site Tokopedia launches a security investigation after a hacker said they stole the information of 91 million users and plans to release it on the dark web.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-tokopedia-cyber/indonesias-tokopedia-probes-alleged-data-leak-of-91-million-users-idUSKBN22E0Q2?il=0>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-05-03-2-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Russia reports a record 10,633 new cases of COVID-19 and 58 more deaths from the virus in the last 24 hours, bringing the country's total cases to 134,686 and 1,280 deaths. Moscow's mayor Sergei Sobyanin says the peak has still not been reached, warning residents to remain indoors.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-52521426>).

### 2020-05-04

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1082289484](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20May%204&oldid=1082289484>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-05-04-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** The Taliban claims responsibility for an attack on Sunday on an Afghan military centre in southern Helmand where they say that "dozens were killed or wounded".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-taliban-attacks/taliban-attack-military-centre-in-afghanistan-casualties-reported-idUSKBN22G0FU?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-05-04-0-3"></a>

Context: Ituri conflict.

**Archived source account.** The armed forces of the Democratic Republic of Congo announce that 12 soldiers were killed in an attack by militants in Ituri Province over the weekend.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Agency](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/12-killed-in-attack-on-dr-congo-army-base/1829071>).

<a id="event-2020-05-04-0-5"></a>

Context: Macuto Bay raid.

**Archived source account.** Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro says "13 terrorists", including two U.S. citizens working for Jordan Goudreau's private security company Silvercorp USA, have been detained after foiling a plot to assassinate him, accusing them of "playing Rambo". State television broadcasts footage of captured mercenaries in Aragua.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-venezuela-security/us-veteran-behind-failed-venezuela-plot-says-two-american-mercenaries-detained-idUKKBN22G2O6>).

<a id="event-2020-05-04-0-6"></a>

Context: Macuto Bay raid.

**Archived source account.** Opposition leader Juan Guaidó denies any involvement with the Silvercorp USA operation. Jordan Goudreau claims his company signed a contract with Guaidó to remove Nicolás Maduro from power by force, but says he has only been paid "a tiny share of the amount agreed upon."

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.toledoblade.com/news/World/2020/05/04/venezuela-guaido-denies-invasion-link/stories/20200505045>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2020-05-04-1-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Pulitzer Prize.

**Archived source account.** Reuters wins the 2020 Pulitzer Prize for Breaking News Photography for its coverage of the protests in Hong Kong.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/news/picture/reuters-wins-pulitzer-prize-for-breaking-idUSRTX7H87E>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-05-04-2-1"></a>

Context: Coronavirus recession, COVID-19 pandemic in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. government announces plans to borrow $3 trillion for the second quarter, five times more than the previous record set during the 2008 financial crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-52537938>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-05-04-3-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Japan.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Shinzo Abe extends the national state of emergency to May 31.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-japan/japans-abe-extends-state-of-emergency-to-may-31-idUSKBN22G05T>).

<a id="event-2020-05-04-3-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand.

**Archived source account.** New Zealand reports no new cases of COVID-19 for the first day in almost two months.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/may/04/new-zealand-records-first-day-with-no-new-covid-19-cases-since-before-lockdown>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-05-04-4-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in Colorado.

**Archived source account.** A Colorado man who organized planned armed protests against the state’s stay-at-home orders is arrested after pipe bombs were discovered at his house.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/US/colorado-man-planning-armed-protest-states-coronavirus-restrictions/story?id=70491370>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-05-04-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** UK Trade Minister Conor Burns resigns after a watchdog group recommended suspending him from parliament for making "veiled threats" towards a company his father had financial disputes with.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-52531078>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-05-04-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A team of British and Kenyan scientists announce the discovery of Microsporidia MB, a parasitic microbe in the Microsporidia fungi group that blocks mosquitos from carrying malaria. While acknowledging they need to understand how the microbe spreads and how it blocks the disease, the team believes it has potential to be used in malaria control.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/health-52530828>); [Nature](<https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-020-16121-y>).

<a id="event-2020-05-04-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A previously undetected Apollo group asteroid 2020 JJ passes 4,350 miles (7,000 kilometres) away from Earth. It is the closest near-Earth object since 2019 UN13.

Source citations (as archived): [CNET](<https://www.cnet.com/news/asteroid-sneaks-past-satellites-in-one-of-the-closest-flybys-on-record/>).

### 2020-05-05

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1082323972](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20May%205&oldid=1082323972>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-05-05-0-1"></a>

Context: Macuto Bay raid, United States–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump denies any involvement by the U.S. government in Silvercorp USA's armed incursion into Venezuela on May 3, which left eight people dead and several others captured, including two U.S. citizens.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-security-trump/trump-says-us-government-has-nothing-to-do-with-venezuela-situation-idUSKBN22H1XL>).

<a id="event-2020-05-05-0-3"></a>

Context: Western Iran clashes (2016–present).

**Archived source account.** Gunmen kill three Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) members near the Kurdish-majority city of Divandarreh, in the Kurdistan Province, while "several counterrevolutionaries" are reportedly killed in the fighting, according to Iranian media.

Source citations (as archived): [RFERL](<https://www.rferl.org/a/three-revolutionary-guards-members-reported-killed-in-western-iran/30594623.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-05-05-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least two miners are killed in a mine collapse in Grand Cape Mount County, Liberia. The mayor of the county's administrative centre says scores of others are unaccounted for and feared dead.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-liberia-mine-collapse/liberia-ministry-says-two-killed-in-mine-collapse-local-mayor-fears-scores-more-dead-idUSKBN22H1KA>).

<a id="event-2020-05-05-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A massive fire breaks out at the 48-storey residential skyscraper Abbco Tower in Al Nahda, Sharjah, UAE. At least 12 people are injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Gulf News](<https://gulfnews.com/uae/video-my-thoughts-were-on-trying-to-get-my-wife-and-children-out-of-the-apartment-a-tenant-after-massive-fire-erupts-in-sharjah-tower-1.1588700592377>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-05-05-2-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** The Houthis-controlled area of Yemen reports its first case of COVID-19 and first death; that of a Somali man who had liver and kidney conditions. The government in the south reports nine new infections.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-yemen/yemens-houthis-report-first-coronavirus-case-a-death-in-sanaa-hotel-idUSKBN22H1HL?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-05-05-2-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil.

**Archived source account.** Brazil's Ministry of Health reports 6,935 new cases of COVID-19 and 600 more deaths, the highest daily death toll in the country to date, bringing the country's death toll to 7,921 and 114,715 total cases.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-brazil/brazil-registers-6935-new-cases-of-coronavirus-600-deaths-on-tuesday-idUSKBN22H33I>).

<a id="event-2020-05-05-2-6"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** The Department of Health and Social Care reports that the death toll from COVID-19 in the United Kingdom stands at 29,427, which is now the highest in Europe, after surpassing Italy.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-52549860>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-05-05-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Philippines' National Telecommunications Commission issues a cease and desist order to the broadcasting operations of ABS-CBN, the country's largest media network, as Congress fails to renew its franchise granted in 1995. The network signed off at 7:52 PM, Philippine Standard Time. The last time the network was shut down was upon the declaration of martial law by the Philippine dictator Ferdinand Marcos.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/05/philippines-largest-tv-network-abs-cbn-ordered-shut-200505084440098.html>); [ABS-CBN News](<https://news.abs-cbn.com/news/05/05/20/ntc-defied-congress-by-issuing-halt-order-vs-abs-cbn-lawmaker-says>); [Rappler](<https://www.rappler.com/nation/259990-abs-cbn-goes-off-air-ntc-order-may-5-2020>).

### 2020-05-06

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1363569401](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20May%206&oldid=1363569401>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-05-06-0-1"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir.

**Archived source account.** Indian Army troops kill Riyaz Naikoo, a commander of the Hizbul Mujahideen terrorist group, after launching an offensive that resulted in the death of at least three other militants in Kashmir's Pulwama district.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://in.reuters.com/article/india-kashmir/indian-troops-kill-maths-teacher-turned-rebel-commander-in-kashmir-idINKBN22I1JD>).

<a id="event-2020-05-06-0-3"></a>

Context: Macuto Bay raid, United States–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro says that the two captured American mercenaries accused of organizing an armed incursion into Venezuela will be tried in the country by its civil courts. United States Secretary of State Mike Pompeo says the U.S. government will "use every tool that we have available to try to get them back."

Source citations (as archived): [France24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20200507-nicolas-maduro-juan-guaido-donald-trump-americans-mercenaries-invasion-luke-denman-airan-berry>).

<a id="event-2020-05-06-0-5"></a>

Context: Iraqi insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Three Katyusha rockets, fired from the Bakriya neighborhood, land in the perimeter of Baghdad International Airport but cause no damage or casualties.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/iraqi-military-rockets-strike-baghdad-airport-70528261>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-05-06-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least two people are killed and two others seriously injured after a plane carrying vital medical supplies crashes near Esquel Airport in Esquel, Argentina.

Source citations (as archived): [Mirror](<https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/world-news/breaking-plane-carrying-medical-supplies-21980883>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-05-06-2-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in U.S. immigration detention.

**Archived source account.** The first death from COVID-19 in a U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) detainee is reported in a 57-year-old man from El Salvador who immigrated to the United States in 1980.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/coronavirus-live-updates/2020/05/07/852475822/first-death-of-detainee-in-an-ice-detention-center-from-covid-19>); [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/first-coronavirus-death-u-s-immigration-detention-reported-n1201711>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-05-06-3-1"></a>

Context: Shooting of Ahmaud Arbery.

**Archived source account.** A cellphone video of the shooting of an African-American man jogging in Brunswick, Georgia, surfaces. The two men who killed him claim that they believed he was a burglar and then got into a fight with him when he was fatally shot. The case is subsequently taken to a grand jury.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/05/05/us/ahmaud-arbery-jogging-georgia-shooting/index.html>); [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/ahmaud-arbery-black-jogger-georgia-fatal-shooting-video/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-05-06-4-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Polish presidential election.

**Archived source account.** The Polish governing coalition announces the presidential election, scheduled for May 10, is postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic. The new election date will be announced later.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/908a36d593e86ae089a2f717371e99c9>).

<a id="event-2020-05-06-4-2"></a>

**Editorial account; source review complete.** The National Assembly for Wales officially became Senedd Cymru and Welsh Parliament on May 6, 2020, according to the institution’s announcement.

Editorial date: 2020-05-06. Checked: 2026-10-21. The institution and effective date are supported. The separate account gives both official names while retaining the original text.

Evidence: [Senedd](<https://senedd.wales/senedd-now/news/senedd-cymru-and-welsh-parliament-names-become-law/>).

Original source account: The National Assembly for Wales is officially renamed to Senedd Cymru (Welsh Parliament)

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-05-06-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The European Southern Observatory announces the discovery of Earth's closest-known black hole (HR 6819). The invisible object in the QV Telescopii system has a mass at least four times that of our Sun, and is roughly 1,000 light years (10 quadrillion km) from Earth in the constellation Telescopium.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2020/05/06/851246887/scientists-find-nearest-known-black-hole-in-distressingly-fitting-metaphor>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-52560812>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-05-07-0-0"></a>

<a id="event-2020-05-07-0-2"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** Saudi Arabia withdraws its troops from the Yemeni island of Socotra amid separatist unrest.

Source citations (as archived): [Middle East Monitor](<https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20200507-saudi-withdraws-its-troops-from-yemens-socotra/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-05-07-1-1"></a>

Context: Visakhapatnam gas leak.

**Archived source account.** Eleven people die and over 5,000 fall ill from a styrene gas leak from an LG Polymers chemical plant in Visakhapatnam in Andhra Pradesh, India.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/articleshow/75590112.cms>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-05-07-2-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Canada.

**Archived source account.** The Canadian Catholic Jesuit community at Pickering, Ontario mourns the deaths of five members of their community, including four priests, who died of COVID-19 at the religious order’s long-term care facility.

Source citations (as archived): [Crux](<https://cruxnow.com/church-in-the-americas/2020/05/jesuits-in-canada-mourn-members-deaths-at-ontario-long-term-care-home/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-05-07-3-1"></a>

Context: China–Indonesia relations.

**Archived source account.** Indonesian Foreign Minister Retno Marsudi summons Chinese Ambassador to Indonesia Xiao Qian to express concerns about the alleged human rights violation of Indonesian workers aboard Chinese fishing vessels. This comes after a video showing Chinese sailors throwing the body of a dead Indonesian crew member overboard went viral.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jakarta Post](<https://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2020/05/07/indonesian-sailors-deaths-on-chinese-fishing-vessel-raise-questions-about-working-conditions.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-05-07-4-1"></a>

Context: Shooting of Ahmaud Arbery.

**Archived source account.** Gregory and Travis McMichael are arrested for murder and aggravated assault in relation to the February shooting of an African American man in Brunswick, Georgia.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/US/mother-unarmed-black-man-killed-georgia-speaks-ahmaud/story?id=70552216>).

<a id="event-2020-05-07-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Lesothan King Letsie III approves a law barring Prime Minister Tom Thabane from dissolving parliament and calling an election in the event of a vote of no confidence.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lesotho-politics/lesothos-king-assents-to-bill-limiting-pm-thabanes-powers-idUSKBN22J2UD?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-05-07-4-4"></a>

Context: Criminal charges brought in the Mueller special counsel investigation.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Department of Justice drops its prosecution of Michael Flynn for lying to the FBI. He previously pleaded guilty to the charges during the investigation led by Robert Mueller.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.com/news/2020/05/07/top-prosecutor-in-flynn-case-abruptly-withdraws-amid-trump-attacks-243107>).

### 2020-05-08

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-05-08-0-1"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Balochistan.

**Archived source account.** A roadside bombing in Kech, Pakistan, struck a patrol vehicle, killing six soldiers, including an army major. The Balochistan Liberation Army claimed responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2020/05/09/world/asia/ap-as-pakistan-bombing.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-05-08-1-1"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, Coronavirus recession.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. unemployment rate hits 14.7%, the highest since the Great Depression, mainly due to job losses from the COVID-19 pandemic.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/2020/05/08/april-2020-jobs-report/>).

<a id="event-2020-05-08-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Microsoft announces a $1.5 billion investment in Italy, as part of its expansion of cloud computing services around the world.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-microsoft-italy/microsoft-to-invest-1-5-billion-in-italian-cloud-business-idUSKBN22K211>).

<a id="event-2020-05-08-2-1"></a>

Context: Visakhapatnam gas leak.

<a id="event-2020-05-08-2-3"></a>

Context: Aurangabad railway accident.

**Archived source account.** A train kills 16 migrant workers who were sleeping on the tracks in Aurangabad, Maharashtra, India. According to initial inquiries, the engineer tried to stop the freight train when he saw the workers.

<a id="event-2020-05-08-3-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Kuwait.

**Archived source account.** Kuwait announces a total curfew lasting from May 10–30, as part of new measures to prevent the spread of the virus. This comes after the Health Ministry confirmed 641 new COVID-19 cases, the highest daily increase to date.

Source citations (as archived): [Gulf News](<https://gulfnews.com/world/gulf/kuwait/covid-19-kuwait-imposes-total-curfew-from-may-10-30-1.1588953296343>).

**Archived source account.** Venezuelan Chief Prosecutor Tarek William Saab formally requests the extradition of U.S. citizen Jordan Goudreau and two dissident Venezuelans, JJ Rendón and Sergio Vergara, over their involvement in the armed incursion earlier this week, known as "Operation Gideon".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-venezuela-security-plot/venezuelas-top-prosecutor-requests-extradition-of-u-s-veteran-accused-in-plot-idUKKBN22K29Q>).

<a id="event-2020-05-08-6-0"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War / 2019–20 Western Libya offensive.

<a id="event-2020-05-09-1-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** Four civilians are killed in Ghor, Afghanistan, when police open fire on protesters who grew angry at the local distribution of food, which they said favored those with political connections. Two policemen also are killed. Police say they responded when protesters tried to enter the governor's house.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-afghanistan-food/seven-killed-in-protests-over-food-distribution-in-afghanistan-local-mp-says-idUSKBN22L0I4?il=0>).

In the main event Justin Gaethje defeated Tony Ferguson to win the Interim UFC lightweight title. This set up a fight with undisputed UFC lightweight champ Khabib Nurmagomedov.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2020/05/09/sports/ufc-249-results.html>).

Turkey says Haftar's forces are now "legitimate targets" if attacks on its interests continue.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-05-12-3-1"></a>

Context: China–Australia relations; Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics.

**Archived source account.** China suspends imports of beef from four Australian abattoirs, saying that its customs agency "continuously" found violations of inspection and quarantine requirements. This comes after the Australian government last month called for an independent inquiry into the origins of the novel coronavirus.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-australia-china-beef/china-suspends-imports-from-four-australian-abattoirs-as-ties-sour-trade-idUSKBN22O0FB>).

<a id="event-2020-05-21-3-1"></a>

Context: Russia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The Trump administration announces it will withdraw from the Open Skies Treaty within six months, alleging continuous violations by Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-52760420>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-05-21-4-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** The European Court of Justice rules that Hungarian authorities circumvented EU law by holding Afghan and Iranian asylum seekers in unlawful detention at a camp near the Serbian border.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/hungary-illegally-held-asylum-seekers-ecj-rules/a-53431848>).

<a id="event-2020-05-21-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A military court in Vietnam sentences former deputy defense minister Nguyễn Văn Hiến to four years in prison for allowing three plots of land in Ho Chi Minh City to be illegally transferred from the Navy to private investors. He is also stripped of his Communist Party credentials.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-vietnam-security-trial/vietnam-jails-ex-deputy-defence-minister-over-land-scandal-idUSKBN22X1NW?il=0>).

### 2020-05-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1082326734](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20May%2022&oldid=1082326734>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-05-22-0-1"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, Coronavirus recession.

**Archived source account.** Europe's largest coach operator Shearings collapses into administration with 2,460 immediate job losses and thousands of holidays cancelled.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/business/2020/may/22/uk-holiday-firm-slg-collapses-with-2500-job-losses>).

<a id="event-2020-05-22-0-2"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, Coronavirus recession.

**Archived source account.** American car rental company Hertz files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy due to accumulating nearly $19 billion in debt.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC News](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/business/hertz-bankruptcy-car-rental-1.5581850>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-05-22-1-1"></a>

Context: Pakistan International Airlines Flight 8303.

**Archived source account.** An Airbus A320 carrying 99 people crashes in a residential area near Karachi Airport, Pakistan. Ninety-seven people onboard are killed; the other two survive with injuries. Another person died on the ground. Some people on the ground were also injured when the plane crashed near houses.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-52780289>).

<a id="event-2020-05-22-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Michigan Governor Gretchen Whitmer declares states of emergency in Gladwin, Saginaw and Arenac counties due to the Edenville Dam failure and subsequent flooding of the Tittabawassee River earlier this week.

Source citations (as archived): [WJRT-TV](<https://www.abc12.com/content/news/Whitmer-approves-emergency-declaration-for-Gladwin-County-resources-available-570699691.html>).

<a id="event-2020-05-22-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A tractor-trailer and a truck carrying passengers crash head-on on a highway in Darfur, Sudan, causing 57 deaths and 20 injuries.

Source citations (as archived): [Associated Press](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/sudan-police-43-killed-head-vehicle-crash-70826843>).

<a id="event-2020-05-22-1-5"></a>

Context: Hooghalen train crash.

**Archived source account.** A collision between a train and agricultural vehicle on a level crossing in Hooghalen, Drenthe, the Netherlands. The machinist died.

Source citations (as archived): [NOS](<https://nos.nl/artikel/2334739-machinist-omgekomen-bij-botsing-tussen-trein-en-aanhanger-in-hooghalen.html>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-05-22-2-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan.

**Archived source account.** Governor Gretchen Whitmer extends her state's stay-at-home order until June 12 and its state of emergency until June 19.

Source citations (as archived): [The Detroit News](<https://www.detroitnews.com/story/news/local/michigan/2020/05/22/whitmer-extends-stay-home-order-through-june-12/5247671002/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-05-22-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A gunman kills seven people in Ukraine's Zhytomyr Oblast after a drunken quarrel during a fishing trip. The perpetrator is arrested afterwards.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://www.msn.com/en-nz/news/world/seven-shot-dead-during-ukraine-fishing-trip/ar-BB14tGTr?li=BBqdg4K>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-05-22-4-1"></a>

Context: May 2020 New Zealand National Party leadership election.

**Archived source account.** Todd Muller defeats Simon Bridges to become the new leader of the National Party, and the Leader of the Opposition.

Source citations (as archived): [Newshub](<https://www.newshub.co.nz/home/politics/2020/05/national-party-leadership-contest-live-updates-simon-bridges-v-todd-muller.html>).

<a id="event-2020-05-22-4-3"></a>

Context: 2019–20 Hong Kong protests.

**Archived source account.** Hong Kong executive says that the newly-proposed security law will not hamper judicial independence. Many activists condemn the move; the organizer of many of last year's protests and convener of the Civil Human Rights Front Jimmy Sham says that the law is a "nuclear bomb" dropped by "the Chinese Communist Party" and calls for mass protests. Activist Joshua Wong also condemns the law and calls it a law "to silence Hongkongers".

Source citations (as archived): [The Standard Hong Kong](<https://www.thestandard.com.hk/breaking-news/section/4/147766/Jimmy-Sham-says-government-can-decide-definition-of-&#x27;secession&#x27;>).

<a id="event-2020-05-22-4-5"></a>

Context: Presidency of Jair Bolsonaro.

**Archived source account.** Following accusations by former Justice Minister Sérgio Moro and a judicial order, footage from a controversial Brazilian Cabinet meeting is released to the media. The profanity-laden footage shows President Jair Bolsonaro calling for political interference in security organs to protect his family; Bolsonaro alleges this was a reference to his private security team, while Moro says that Bolsonaro was referring to Federal Police investigations.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/05/video-cabinet-meeting-puts-brazil-bolsonaro-fire-200522202343478.html>).

<a id="event-2020-05-22-4-6"></a>

Context: Presidency of Jair Bolsonaro.

**Archived source account.** The footage also shows Environment Minister Ricardo Salles calling for the deregulation of environmental policies while the press is "distracted" by the COVID-19 pandemic.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.reuters.com/article/amp/idUSKBN22Y30Y>).

### 2020-05-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1115446290](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20May%2023&oldid=1115446290>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-05-23-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan, Afghan peace process.

**Archived source account.** The Taliban declares a three-day Eid ceasefire starting on Sunday. Taliban spokesman Zabiullah Mujahid orders all attacks to cease and only use force "if any action is taken against you by the enemy". Afghan President Ashraf Ghani welcomes the ceasefire and orders the armed forces of Afghanistan to "comply with the three-days truce and to defend only if attacked".

Source citations (as archived): [National Post](<https://nationalpost.com/pmn/news-pmn/politics-news-pmn/afghan-taliban-declare-three-day-eid-ceasefire-from-sunday>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-taliban-ceasefire/taliban-afghan-president-declare-three-day-eid-ceasefire-from-sunday-idUSKBN22Z0UH?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-05-23-0-4"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War / 2019–20 Western Libya offensive.

**Archived source account.** Forces of the international-recognized Libyan government retake two military camps, Hamza and Yarmuk, from forces loyal to Khalifa Haftar south of Tripoli.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Agency](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/libyan-army-retakes-2-camps-from-warlord-haftar/1851647>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-05-23-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A four-alarm fire destroys a warehouse at Pier 45 at Fisherman's Wharf in San Francisco, California. More than 150 firefighters are able to contain the blaze and save both the SS Jeremiah O'Brien, a World War II Liberty ship that saw action on D-Day at Normandy Beach in northwest France; and the USS Pampanito submarine, which had six war patrols from March 1944 through early 1945 in the northwestern Pacific Ocean.

Source citations (as archived): [KPIX](<https://sanfrancisco.cbslocal.com/2020/05/23/massive-4-alarm-fire-erupts-at-san-francisco-waterfront-pier/>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2020/may/23/san-francisco-d-day-ship-fire-fishermans-wharf>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-05-23-2-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China.

**Archived source account.** China reports no new cases for the first time since the pandemic began, according to the National Health Commission.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-china/china-reports-no-new-coronavirus-cases-for-first-time-since-pandemic-began-idUSKBN22Z047?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-05-23-2-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in the State of Palestine.

**Archived source account.** The Gaza Strip reports the first death from COVID-19, a 77-year-old woman.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/05/gaza-reports-covid-19-death-outbreak-fears-200523172108869.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-05-23-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Ukrainian Ministry of Internal Affairs confirms that independent member of the Verkhovna Rada Valeriy Davydenko has been found dead in his office in Kiev with a gunshot wound to the head.

Source citations (as archived): [Kyiv Post](<https://www.kyivpost.com/ukraine-politics/ukrainian-lawmaker-found-dead-in-central-kyiv.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-05-23-4-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in Spain, Protests over responses to the COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of protesters, mostly supporters of the far-right party Vox, participate in car protests in Madrid, Seville, Barcelona and other cities against the continuing lockdown and the national government.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-52783936>).

### 2020-05-24

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1115446299](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20May%2024&oldid=1115446299>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-05-24-0-1"></a>

Context: Afghan peace process.

**Archived source account.** President Ashraf Ghani pledges to speed up the release of more Taliban prisoners, and asks that the Taliban release more government prisoners in return.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/05/afghan-president-pledges-expedite-release-taliban-prisoners-200524063411899.html>).

<a id="event-2020-05-24-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Somalia.

**Archived source account.** At least five people are killed and twenty others injured by a car bomb during an Eid festival in Baidoa, Bay. No claims of responsibility have been reported.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/middle-east/2020/05/24/At-least-five-dead-in-blast-during-Somalia-Eid-festivities-Police.html>).

<a id="event-2020-05-24-0-5"></a>

Context: Insurgency in the Maghreb.

**Archived source account.** The Army of Ivory Coast and the military of Burkina Faso report that they conducted a joint operation against jihadists at the border between the two countries, killing eight suspected militants and arresting fourteen more. The operation is ongoing.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ivorycoast-burkina-security/ivory-coast-army-joins-burkina-faso-in-anti-jihadist-operation-idUSKBN2300QA?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-05-24-0-8"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War / 2019–20 Western Libya offensive.

**Archived source account.** Wagner Group fighters withdraw from the frontline near Tripoli, after the Libyan National Army suffers a series of defeats. The mayor of Bani Walid says the Russians, who are allied to Khalifa Haftar, retreated to his town then left Bani Walid Airport on three military planes to Al Jufra Airbase, while their heavy equipment were driven there.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-libya-security/russian-fighters-flown-out-of-western-libya-after-haftar-retreat-idUKKBN2300RH?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-05-24-0-10"></a>

Context: Papua conflict.

**Archived source account.** Indonesian police says an armed group had shot two health workers affiliated with the local COVID-19 task force in Wandai district, Intan Jaya, Papua.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jakarta Post](<https://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2020/05/24/papuan-armed-group-accused-of-shooting-covid-19-team-members.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-05-24-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** 3000 km of the coast of Western Australia is battered by a "once in a decade" storm.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2020/may/24/entire-western-australia-coast-to-be-battered-by-once-in-a-decade-storm>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-05-24-2-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in Montenegro.

**Archived source account.** Montenegro becomes the first European country to declare itself "coronavirus free".

Source citations (as archived): [Government of Montenegro](<http://www.gov.me/en/News/224671/Montenegro-is-free-of-COVID-19-patients.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-05-24-3-1"></a>

Context: North Korea and weapons of mass destruction.

**Archived source account.** In his first appearance in three weeks, leader Kim Jong-un meets with state officials to discuss improving nuclear war deterrence measures, including increased artillery firepower.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-kim-military/north-koreas-kim-in-first-appearance-in-weeks-vows-to-bolster-nuclear-deterrence-idUSKBN22Z0X8?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-05-24-3-3"></a>

Context: Iran–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** The first of five Iranian tankers en route to Venezuela to deliver fuel enters Venezuelan territorial waters, after being escorted by the Venezuelan Air Force and Navy. Both Iran and Venezuela warned the United States not to interfere with the delivery.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-52789276>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-05-24-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi pardons 3,157 prisoners to celebrate Eid al-Fitr.

Source citations (as archived): [Middle East Eye](<https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/egypt-pardons-former-policeman-jailed-murder-pop-singer-tamim>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-05-24-5-1"></a>

Context: National People's Congress Decision on Hong Kong national security legislation.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of protesters take to the streets of Hong Kong to oppose a controversial national security law expected to be passed by China's National People's Congress.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-52786734>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/05/24/asia/hong-kong-protest-national-security-law-intl-hnk/index.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-hongkong-protests/hong-kong-police-fire-tear-gas-on-biggest-protests-since-covid-curbs-idUSKBN23001S?il=0>).

### 2020-05-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1318375425](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20May%2025&oldid=1318375425>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-05-25-0-1"></a>

Context: Piracy in the Gulf of Guinea.

**Archived source account.** The Bulgarian captain of Portuguese-flagged cargo ship the Tommi Ritscher, who was kidnapped along with seven other sailors by pirates off the coast of Benin last month, is freed. The captain was kidnapped at the port of Cotonou in the Gulf of Guinea on April 19.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-benin-piracy-bulgaria/kidnapped-captain-of-portugal-flagged-ship-freed-bulgaria-idUSKBN23117U>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-05-25-1-1"></a>

Context: List of earthquakes in 2020, list of earthquakes in New Zealand.

**Archived source account.** A 5.9 magnitude earthquake strikes 60 miles west of Wellington, New Zealand. No injuries are reported.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/may/25/new-zealand-pm-jacinda-ardern-live-tv-earthquake-wellington>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-05-25-2-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in Japan.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Shinzo Abe lifts the state of emergency in all remaining parts of the country, including Tokyo.

Source citations (as archived): [Associated Press](<https://apnews.com/ea1e26e3d06c2c7170cd4e49d0ad1e94>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-05-25-3-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Coast Guard of Libya stops nearly 400 migrants attempting to cross the Mediterranean in five boats in the past two days, according to the office for migrants of the United Nations.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-libya-migrants/libya-stops-nearly-400-migrants-attempting-to-cross-to-europe-iom-idUSKBN2311R6>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-05-25-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The government of Cyprus will deport 17 immigrants suspected of having links to extremist groups or involved in acts of terrorism.

Source citations (as archived): [AP News](<https://apnews.com/fd68ffed5fef1c5cdf5931ee91cb6899>).

<a id="event-2020-05-25-4-2"></a>

Context: Murder of George Floyd.

**Archived source account.** George Floyd dies after being restrained by police in Minneapolis, Minnesota, United States, subsequently triggering public outrage.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/05/26/us/minneapolis-police-encounter-death-trnd/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-05-25-5-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Burundian general election.

**Archived source account.** Candidate for the ruling party, National Council for the Defense of Democracy – Forces for the Defense of Democracy, and retired general Evariste Ndayishimiye wins the election with 68.72% of votes cast amid an election preceded by political violence including the arrest, torture and murder of opposition activists, according to a local human rights group.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-burundi-election/burundis-ruling-party-wins-presidential-election-idUSKBN2311G5?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-05-25-5-3"></a>

Context: 2020 Surinamese general election.

**Archived source account.** Citizens of Suriname head to the polls in the country's latest general election. It is the first election after Suriname's president Dési Bouterse was convicted of murder for the December murders in 1982.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-52796519>).

### 2020-05-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1082327110](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20May%2026&oldid=1082327110>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-05-26-0-1"></a>

Context: Afghan peace process.

**Archived source account.** The government urges the Taliban to extend the three-day truce due to expire today. It also announces the government will release 900 Taliban prisoners today.

<a id="event-2020-05-26-0-3"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War, Libya–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States Africa Command accuses Russia of deploying fighter jets to eastern Libya to provide air support to Russian mercenaries allied to Field Marshal Khalifa Haftar, who is locked in a civil war with the UN-recognized Government of National Accord (GNA).

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-52811093>).

<a id="event-2020-05-26-0-5"></a>

Context: 2020 Democratic Republic of the Congo massacres.

**Archived source account.** The Allied Democratic Forces kill at least 17 people in a village in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, one of three massacres by the ADF this week.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-congo-security/suspected-islamist-militia-kills-at-least-17-in-northeastern-congo-idUKKBN23238D?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-05-26-0-7"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** ISWAP militants kill two soldiers and wound five others in Soueram, Far North, Cameroon. Five militants also die in the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Actu Cameroun](<https://actucameroun.com/2020/05/26/cameroun-deux-soldats-et-5-assaillants-tues-dans-une-attaque-djihadiste-a-soueram/amp/>).

<a id="event-2020-05-26-1-1"></a>

Context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on aviation, COVID-19 pandemic in Chile, Coronavirus recession.

**Archived source account.** LATAM Airlines, the largest air carrier in Latin America, files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-05-26/latam-airlines-files-chapter-11-bankruptcy-stymied-by-lockdowns>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-05-26-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Huge swarms of desert locusts destroy crops in central and western India prompting authorities to step up their response to the country's worst plague in nearly three decades.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/05/crops-destroyed-india-faces-worst-locust-attack-27-years-200526160727430.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-05-26-3-1"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Costa Rica.

**Archived source account.** Costa Rica becomes the first Central American country to legalize same-sex marriage.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-costarica-lgbt-marriage-trfn/costa-rica-allows-same-sex-marriages-in-a-first-for-central-america-idUSKBN23217L>).

<a id="event-2020-05-26-3-3"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Zambia.

**Archived source account.** President Edgar Lungu pardons a gay couple jailed for 15 years due to consensual homosexual acts amid a mass wave of pardons of nearly 3,000 inmates to celebrate Africa Freedom Day.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-zambia-lgbt/zambian-president-pardons-gay-couple-jailed-for-15-years-idUSKBN2321ZZ>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-05-26-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Social Democratic Liberal Party, the main opposition party in Fiji's parliament, is suspended from parliament for 60 days amid a political feud which has caused its appointments to be declared null and void. The party's parliament leader, Sitiveni Rabuka, said the decision will not be appealed.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/417605/fiji-s-main-opposition-party-suspended-from-parliament>).

### 2020-05-27

#### Disasters and accidents

**Archived source account.** A fire at a hospital kills five patients being treated for COVID-19 in Dhaka, Bangladesh. No cause for the fire has been determined.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bangladesh-hospital-fire/bangladesh-hospital-fire-kills-five-coronavirus-patients-idUSKBN2332UZ>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-05-27-1-1"></a>

Context: Hong Kong–United States relations, 2019–20 Hong Kong protests.

**Archived source account.** United States Secretary of State Mike Pompeo tells Congress that Hong Kong is "no longer autonomous from China" following Beijing's plans to impose a new security law on the territory, and no longer meets its special designation for trade under U.S. law that was established in the United States–Hong Kong Policy Act.

<a id="event-2020-05-27-2-2"></a>

Several buildings are looted and burned down, and riot police have been deployed.
