Context: George Floyd protests / George Floyd protests in Minnesota.

**Archived source account.** A 43-year-old protester is shot dead outside a pawnshop. The shooting is carried out by the owner of the shop. He is arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [Star Tribune](<https://m.startribune.com/man-shot-dead-outside-lake-street-pawnshop-during-unrest-is-identified/570865962/>).

<a id="event-2020-05-27-2-5"></a>

Context: Kyoto Animation arson attack.

**Archived source account.** In Kyoto, Japan, Shinji Aoba is arrested. He was moved from the hospital and charged for an arson attack at an animation center in July 2019, which killed 36 people. Aoba had been unable to be arrested due to the severe injuries he sustained during the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-japan-fire-arrests/man-arrested-over-deadly-2019-arson-at-japans-kyoto-animation-idUSKBN23303U>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/entertainment-arts-52813523>).

<a id="event-2020-05-27-2-7"></a>

Context: Terrorism in the United States, crime in Florida.

**Archived source account.** The May 24 arrest of a 23-year-old man in Tampa, Florida, is announced by federal prosecutors. He had allegedly been planning a mass shooting at Honeymoon Island State Park in support of ISIS.

Source citations (as archived): [WTSP](<https://www.wtsp.com/article/news/crime/tampa-shooting-plot-isis/67-98461c1e-73cc-4a9f-94c2-d5d9219fe502>).

<a id="event-2020-05-27-2-9"></a>

Context: Essex lorry deaths.

**Archived source account.** Judicial authorities in Belgium and France announce the arrest of 26 suspects, followed 16 simultaneous early morning raids on 26 May in Brussels and Paris, which targeted the “notably suspected” organization believed to be responsible for the tragedy in the U.K.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily News](<https://www.nydailynews.com/news/world/ny-26-arrests-deaths-vietnamese-migrants-20200528-cz3p7tyz4rcsdikfrdmt4gwody-story.html>).

<a id="event-2020-05-27-2-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** Zambian police arrest three people suspected of murdering three Chinese nationals three days prior and burning their bodies.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-52805202>).

### 2020-05-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1160057675](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20May%2028&oldid=1160057675>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-05-28-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan, Afghan peace process, May 2020 Afghanistan attacks.

**Archived source account.** In the first attack since the end of a truce declared by the Taliban, and despite a petition of the government for the Taliban to extend the ceasefire, at least 14 security forces members are killed in an attack on a checkpoint in Parwan. A government spokesperson says the Taliban also suffered casualties. The group has not commented on the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/05/afghan-forces-killed-attack-blamed-taliban-200528084958150.html>).

<a id="event-2020-05-28-0-3"></a>

Context: Rwandan genocide.

**Archived source account.** A court in Rwanda sentences former Mayor of Nyakizu Ladislas Ntaganzwa to life imprisonment for his role in orchestrating the massacre of hundreds of thousands of people in the 1994 genocide. His lawyer is planning to appeal the ruling.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/05/mayor-rwanda-sentenced-life-role-1994-genocide-200528153505555.html>).

<a id="event-2020-05-28-0-5"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Gunmen abduct multiple healthcare workers in Balad, Middle Shabelle, before killing seven of them and another civilian.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-somalia-security/seven-health-workers-civilian-killed-in-somali-village-aid-group-idUSKBN2343DV>).

<a id="event-2020-05-28-0-7"></a>

Context: Herder–farmer conflicts in Nigeria.

**Archived source account.** Gunmen kill 60 to 74 people in villages in the Nigerian state of Sokoto, where similar attacks had occurred on Monday.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/media-52830860>); [SR](<http://saharareporters.com/2020/05/28/update-death-toll-sokoto-gunmen-attack-rises-74>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-05-28-1-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from COVID-19 in the United States exceeds 100,000.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/05/27/politics/100000-deaths-moment-of-reflection/index.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-05-28-2-1"></a>

Context: 2020 China–India skirmishes, China–India relations.

**Archived source account.** China moves thousands of People's Liberation Army troops to its Himalayan border with India, bringing vehicles and heavy machinery to what India says is its territory. India sends several battalions of its Army from nearby Leh to the border in response.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/may/27/china-and-india-move-troops-as-border-tensions-escalate>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-05-28-3-2"></a>

Context: George Floyd protests / Killing of George Floyd, George Floyd protests in Minnesota.

**Archived source account.** Protests continue for a second day in Minneapolis and other U.S. cities after an unarmed man, George Floyd, died while being arrested. Some of them have escalated into riots, including looting and arson.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/05/28/us/minneapolis-george-floyd-thursday/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-05-28-3-3"></a>

Context: George Floyd protests / Killing of George Floyd, George Floyd protests in Minnesota.

**Archived source account.** A Minneapolis Police Department station is abandoned by police after being overran by protesters and is then looted and set on fire. An MPD spokesman confirmed the Third Precinct building had been evacuated "in the interest of the safety of our personnel".

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.com/news/2020/05/29/minneapolis-police-protest-george-floyd-288361>).

<a id="event-2020-05-28-3-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in Malawi, COVID-19 pandemic in Zimbabwe.

**Archived source account.** A manhunt is launched after hundreds of people, some with COVID-19, escape from quarantine centers in Zimbabwe and Malawi, with authorities worried that they will spread COVID-19 in countries whose health systems can be rapidly overwhelmed.

Source citations (as archived): [AP News](<https://apnews.com/25e117c6c44f60d86375ff3ad3209468>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2020-05-28-4-1"></a>

Context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports, COVID-19 pandemic in Massachusetts.

**Archived source account.** The 2020 Boston Marathon is officially canceled due to the COVID-19 pandemic. It is the first time in the event's 123-year history that the annual running had to be canceled. A modified version of the race, scheduled for September 14, will be run virtually, and runners who complete the marathon track in six hours or less will be eligible for the 2021 Boston Marathon.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<https://www.espn.com/olympics/trackandfield/story/_/id/29235688/boston-marathon-canceled-first-due-coronavirus>).

### 2020-05-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1354549476](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20May%2029&oldid=1354549476>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-05-29-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 15 people are killed in northern Burkina Faso after a convoy transporting traders is targeted by an unidentified armed group. Burkina Faso has been fighting Islamist terrorists amid a resurgence of attacks in the Sahel.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-burkina-security/attack-in-northern-burkina-faso-kills-at-least-15-idUSKBN2360FO?il=0>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-05-29-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump says he is terminating the country's relationship with the World Health Organization (WHO) over its handling of the COVID-19 pandemic, claiming the WHO has become a "puppet of China" and that American funding will be redirected to "other global public health needs".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-trump-who/trump-says-terminating-u-s-relationship-with-world-health-organization-over-virus-idUKKBN2352Y7?il=0>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-05-29-2-5"></a>

Context: Murder of George Floyd / George Floyd protests / George Floyd protests in the United States / George Floyd protests in California / George Floyd protests in Los Angeles County, California.

**Archived source account.** In Los Angeles, more than 500 people are arrested as the city declares the protest an "unlawful assembly".

Source citations (as archived): [Deadline](<https://deadline.com/2020/05/lapd-makes-more-than-500-arrests-in-friday-street-protests-mayor-garcetti-calls-for-peaceful-end-1202947292/>).

<a id="event-2020-05-29-2-8"></a>

Context: Murder of George Floyd / George Floyd protests / George Floyd protests in the United States / George Floyd protests in Georgia / George Floyd protests in Atlanta.

**Archived source account.** In Atlanta, the CNN Center is vandalized and police vehicles are attacked and set on fire as protests spread. Seven people are reportedly arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [Newsweek](<https://www.newsweek.com/george-floyd-protesters-smash-windows-cnn-center-atlanta-1507538>).

<a id="event-2020-05-29-2-11"></a>

Context: Murder of George Floyd / George Floyd protests / George Floyd protests in the United States / George Floyd protests in Illinois / George Floyd protests in Chicago.

**Archived source account.** In Chicago, 108 people are arrested after several police vehicles are vandalized.

Source citations (as archived): [WGN-TV](<https://wgntv.com/news/chicago-news/several-arrests-made-after-chicago-protest-over-george-floyds-death/>).

<a id="event-2020-05-29-2-14"></a>

Context: Murder of George Floyd / George Floyd protests / George Floyd protests in the United States / George Floyd protests in Minnesota / George Floyd protests in Minneapolis–Saint Paul.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of Minnesota National Guard are deployed in Minneapolis to enforce a night curfew, after Mayor Jacob Frey declared a state of local emergency amid civil unrest, but rioting and arson fires continue.

Source citations (as archived): [Star Tribune](<https://www.startribune.com/suburbs-join-st-paul-mpls-in-ordering-curfews-starting-at-8-p-m-friday/570873142/>).

<a id="event-2020-05-29-2-16"></a>

Context: Murder of George Floyd / George Floyd protests / George Floyd protests in the United States / George Floyd protests in Michigan.

**Archived source account.** In Detroit, police use tear gas to disperse a crowd of protesters and make several arrests, including one person who drove their car at a police officer. A man was killed during an altercation during the protests.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/05/30/us/detroit-man-shot-protests/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-05-29-2-18"></a>

Context: Murder of George Floyd / George Floyd protests / George Floyd protests in the United States / George Floyd protests in Texas.

**Archived source account.** In Houston, at least 137 people are arrested, eight police officers are hospitalized, and 16 police vehicles are vandalized in a riot.

Source citations (as archived): [KHOU](<https://www.khou.com/article/news/local/black-lives-matter-plans-friday-rally-for-justice-for-george/285-561ef235-8aa9-48ac-8755-0bc4fec0b768>).

<a id="event-2020-05-29-2-19"></a>

Context: Murder of George Floyd / George Floyd protests.

**Archived source account.** Several other protests against police brutality and systemic racism take place in large cities across the United States, some of which included arson, vandalism, and looting.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/us/live-news/george-floyd-protest-updates-05-28-20/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-05-29-2-20"></a>

Context: Murder of George Floyd.

**Archived source account.** Former Minneapolis Police officer Derek Chauvin, who was recorded on video kneeling on George Floyd's neck for several minutes and eventually causing his death, is taken into custody by the Minnesota Bureau of Criminal Apprehension and charged with third-degree murder and second degree manslaughter.

Source citations (as archived): [KSTP](<https://kstp.com/news/arresting-officer-derek-chauvin-taken-into-custody-by-bca-george-floyd-case/5743589/?cat=1>); [WCCO](<https://minnesota.cbslocal.com/2020/05/29/derek-chauvin-arrested-george-floyd-death-minneapolis-police-officer/>).

<a id="event-2020-05-29-2-21"></a>

**Archived source account.** Taiwan decriminalises adultery in what is considered a landmark ruling. Marital infidelity was a crime with a maximum sentence of a year in prison.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-taiwan-court-adultery/taiwan-decriminalises-adultery-in-landmark-ruling-idUSKBN23519A?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-05-29-2-22"></a>

**Archived source account.** Lesotho's Appeal Court revokes former First Lady Maesiah Thabane's bail. Thabane and her husband, former Lesotho Prime Minister Tom Thabane, are accused of ordering the murder of his first wife, Lipolelo. Both deny involvement in the crime.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lesotho-politics/lesotho-appeal-courts-revokes-bail-granted-to-former-leaders-wife-idUSKBN2352BK>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-05-29-3-1"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Hong Kong.

**Archived source account.** Pro-democracy and LGBT rights activist Jimmy Sham files a petition to the High Court to recognize his same-sex marriage, which was registered in New York City in 2014. Sham argues that not recognizing same-sex marriages violates the Basic Law.

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/law-and-crime/article/3086771/lawyers-hong-kong-rights-activist-jimmy-sham-urge>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-05-29-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A SpaceX Starship prototype (SN4) is destroyed in a large explosion during static fire testing at the SpaceX South Texas Launch Site.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2020/05/29/spacex-prototype-starship-rocket-explodes-after-test-in-texas.html>).

### 2020-05-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1160058368](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20May%2030&oldid=1160058368>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-05-30-0-1"></a>

Context: Afghan peace process; War in Afghanistan; May 2020 Afghanistan attacks.

**Archived source account.** Abdullah Abdullah, the head of Afghanistan's High Council for National Reconciliation, which leads peace efforts with the Taliban, says that his team is ready to start discussions with the armed group "at any moment". The group has not commented on Abdullah's remarks.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/05/afghanistan-abdullah-ready-taliban-talks-time-200530111207538.html>).

<a id="event-2020-05-30-0-2"></a>

Context: Afghan peace process; War in Afghanistan; May 2020 Afghanistan attacks.

**Archived source account.** A journalist and a technician are killed and seven others wounded when a private bus carrying network employees is bombed in Kabul. ISIL – Khorasan Province claims responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-attacks-media/islamic-state-kills-afghan-journalist-technician-in-bus-blast-idUSKBN2360J5?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-05-30-0-4"></a>

Context: Shooting of Iyad Halaq.

**Archived source account.** Israeli police officers open fire in Jerusalem against an unarmed Palestinian 32-year-old man who had autism; the man dies at the scene.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/may/31/israeli-minister-benny-gantz-apologises-for-police-shooting-of-palestinian-man-iyad-halak>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-05-30-1-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil.

**Archived source account.** Brazil reports a record 33,274 new cases of COVID-19 and 956 more deaths in the last 24 hours, bringing the total number of confirmed cases to 498,440 and 28,834 deaths, the fourth highest in the world.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-brazil/brazil-has-record-new-coronavirus-cases-surpasses-france-in-deaths-idUKKBN2360UC>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-05-30-2-1"></a>

Context: Ethiopia–Sudan relations.

**Archived source account.** Sudan summons its Ethiopian ambassador regarding an attack at the border between the two countries that killed military personnel and civilians, including children. A Sudanese military spokesman blamed militias "supported by Ethiopia", while there was no response from the Ethiopian government.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-sudan-ethiopia/sudan-summons-ethiopian-envoy-over-suspected-cross-border-attack-idUSKBN2360K6?il=0>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-05-30-3-3"></a>

Context: George Floyd protests / George Floyd protests in Illinois / George Floyd protests in Chicago.

**Archived source account.** A man is killed and five others are injured in four shootings at protests in Chicago, Illinois. It is not known if the attacks were carried out by the same assailant.

Source citations (as archived): [WMAQ-TV](<https://www.nbcchicago.com/news/local/1-dead-at-least-3-wounded-in-shootings-in-river-north-loop-saturday-night/2281022/>).

Context: George Floyd protests / 2020 boogaloo killings, George Floyd protests in California.

**Archived source account.** A Federal Protective Service officer is killed and another injured in an overnight drive-by shooting outside the Ronald V. Dellums Federal Building in Oakland, California, amid protests over the killing of George Floyd five days prior.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/federal-protective-service-officer-killed-another-injured-oakland-shooting-amid-n1219561>).

Context: George Floyd protests.

**Archived source account.** A protester in St. Louis dies after being accidentally struck by a truck during the protests.

Source citations (as archived): [The Mercury News](<https://www.mercurynews.com/2020/05/31/man-dragged-by-fedex-truck-dies-during-night-of-george-floyd-protests-in-st-louis/>).

<a id="event-2020-05-30-3-7"></a>

Context: George Floyd protests.

**Archived source account.** Many major cities around the United States implement curfews meant to prevent a second night of riots, including Atlanta, Chicago, Cleveland, Columbus, Denver, Los Angeles, Miami, Minneapolis, Milwaukee, Philadelphia, Pittsburgh, Portland, Rochester, Salt Lake City, and Seattle.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/curfews-go-effect-cities-around-country-george-floyd-protests-continue-n1219801>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-05-30-4-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Russian President Vladimir Putin announces the adoption of a new package of measures to support the economy and citizens in the context of the coronavirus pandemic. This payment does not cancel but supplements the previously introduced support measures. Additionally, Putin proposed to establish a monthly payment of five thousand rubles for families with children under three years of age.

Source citations (as archived): [RT](<https://www.rt.com/business/485302-putin-support-measures-business/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-05-30-5-1"></a>

Context: Crew Dragon Demo-2.

**Archived source account.** SpaceX launches Crew Dragon carrying two NASA astronauts, Doug Hurley and Bob Behnken, to the International Space Station (ISS) from Cape Canaveral Air Force Station at 3:22 pm Eastern U.S. time.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/business/live-news/spacex-launch-today-may-30/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-05-30-5-2"></a>

Context: Crew Dragon Demo-2.

**Archived source account.** Crew Dragon's mission is to check the ship's systems and the crew's readiness to work with it. Crew Dragon is heading to the ISS. It is the first time since the end of the Space Shuttle program in 2011 that American astronauts have been launched into orbit from the United States, and is the first ever crewed commercial space flight.

Source citations (as archived): [WSJ](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/elon-musks-spacex-tries-again-to-launch-nasa-astronauts-into-orbit-11590831001?mod=hp_lead_pos1>).

<a id="event-2020-05-30-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Researchers announce a 2.5cm millipede fossil discovered on the island of Kerrera, in the Scottish Inner Hebrides, is the world's oldest-known land animal, which lived 425 million years ago in the Silurian period.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-science-millipede/millipede-from-scotland-is-worlds-oldest-known-land-animal-idUKKBN2360R8>).

<a id="event-2020-05-31-4-4"></a>

Context: George Floyd protests / George Floyd protests in New York City.

**Archived source account.** A woman is facing four counts of attempted murder, as well as counts of attempted arson, reckless endangerment, criminal possession of a weapon, and assault for throwing a Molotov cocktail at an occupied NYPD van during a riot in Brooklyn.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<https://www.foxnews.com/us/samantha-shader-nypd-attempted-murder-george-floyd-protests>).

<a id="event-2020-05-31-4-5"></a>

Context: George Floyd protests.

**Archived source account.** Rioting and looting continue overnight in cities all over the United States as 12 states activate the national guard to defuse the situation.

Source citations (as archived): [Al-Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/amp/news/2020/05/george-floyd-protests-police-brutality-intensify-live-200530231110124.html>); [Voice of America](<https://www.voanews.com/usa/national-guard-called-11-states-handle-protests>).

<a id="event-2020-05-31-4-6"></a>

Context: George Floyd protests.

**Archived source account.** At least 1,383 people have been arrested in 17 cities during the protests since Thursday.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! News](<https://news.yahoo.com/police-nearly-1-400-arrests-025906931.html>).

<a id="event-2020-05-31-4-7"></a>

Context: George Floyd protests.

**Archived source account.** During protests in Indianapolis, two people are shot dead and two others injured after unidentified assailants open fire against protesters.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<https://www.foxnews.com/us/indianapolis-riot-george-floyd-death-protest-demonstration-downtown-shooting-police-investigation>).

<a id="event-2020-05-31-4-8"></a>

Context: George Floyd protests.

**Archived source account.** President Donald Trump announces his plans to designate Antifa as a terrorist organization after saying they were responsible for the looting and arson occurring during the protests. Various government and non-government officials claim that designating domestic terrorist groups is prohibited by the First Amendment.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/05/31/politics/trump-antifa-protests/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-05-31-4-9"></a>

Context: George Floyd protests.

**Archived source account.** The media is revealed to have been the target of violence and harassment at least 50 times on Friday and Saturday.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2020/may/31/george-floyd-protests-reporters-targeted-by-police-and-crowds>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-05-31-5-1"></a>

Context: Presidency of Jair Bolsonaro.

**Archived source account.** Anti-fascist protesters gather in the Brazilian cities of São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro and Belo Horizonte in response to police brutality and President Bolsonaro's defence of unconstitutional measures. A pro-government crowd forms in São Paulo, with police reporting neo-Nazi flags hung from a sound truck.

Source citations (as archived): [The Republic](<http://www.therepublic.com/2020/05/31/lt-brazil-protests/>).

<a id="event-2020-05-31-5-3"></a>

Context: 2020 New Caledonian independence referendum.

**Archived source account.** In New Caledonia, the largest pro-independence party Caledonian Union agrees to postpone the referendum on independence from France due to COVID-19 pandemic concerns. Anti-independence parties welcome the decision.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/417980/no-consensus-for-new-caledonia-independence-referendum-date>).

<a id="event-2020-05-31-5-5"></a>

Context: 2020 Niuean general election.

**Archived source account.** In Niue, Sir Toke Talagi loses his seat at the Common Roll and is now leaving his position as Premier of Niue. Former Secretary to Government Richard Hipa, a first-time candidate, topped the Common Roll votes with 440 and now looks to be a contender for the premiership.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/417977/premier-of-niue-loses-seat-in-election>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-05-31-6-1"></a>

Context: Crew Dragon Demo-2.

**Archived source account.** SpaceX's Crew Dragon spacecraft successfully docks with the International Space Station (ISS) with NASA astronauts Bob Behnken and Douglas Hurley joining the existing crew aboard the space station.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/05/31/tech/crew-dragon-docks-with-space-station-scn/index.html>).


## June

### 2020-06-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1354550286](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20June%201&oldid=1354550286>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-06-01-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** ISIL-linked militants attack a police station in South Kalimantan, Indonesia, killing an officer. One of the militants is shot dead as he tries to attack other policemen.

Source citations (as archived): [Jakarta Globe](<https://jakartaglobe.id/news/suspected-is-militants-attack-police-post-kill-officer-in-south-kalimantan>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-06-01-1-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Armenia.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan, his wife and their four children test positive for COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-armenia-pm/armenian-pm-pashinyan-tests-positive-for-coronavirus-idUSKBN2381IC>).

<a id="event-2020-06-01-1-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong.

**Archived source account.** The annual Tiananmen Square massacre vigil in Hong Kong is banned for the first time since 1990 citing health concerns due to COVID-19. The Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China, who organize the vigil, say the ban signals the end of Hong Kong's "one country, two systems".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-china-52877411>).

<a id="event-2020-06-01-1-6"></a>

Context: Kivu Ebola epidemic.

**Archived source account.** The World Health Organization reports six new cases of ebola, and UNICEF reports five deaths, in a renewed outbreak of the disease in Mbandaka, Équateur Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/06/01/health/ebola-outbreak-congo-intl/index.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-06-01-2-1"></a>

Context: United States–Zimbabwe relations, George Floyd protests.

**Archived source account.** Zimbabwe summons the U.S. envoy for comments by U.S. National Security Advisor Robert C. O'Brien suggesting that Zimbabwe is among "foreign adversaries" that could face retaliation for trying to foment unrest in the U.S. over the killing of George Floyd.

Source citations (as archived): [AP News](<https://apnews.com/58e2082c8af14e376e89a366348ce262>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-06-01-3-3"></a>

Context: United States racial unrest / George Floyd protests / Shooting of James Scurlock.

**Archived source account.** Prosecutors conclude a bar owner who fatally shot a protester during protests in Omaha, Nebraska, acted in self-defense and therefore will not press charges against him.

Source citations (as archived): [Omaha World-Herald](<https://www.omaha.com/news/crime/no-charges-will-be-filed-against-omaha-bar-owner-who-fatally-shot-protester-don-kleine/article_8e71702d-d5bf-544e-9fac-26108ac81a24.html>).

<a id="event-2020-06-01-3-5"></a>

Context: United States racial unrest / George Floyd protests / Shooting of David McAtee.

**Archived source account.** Police and National Guard troops open fire on a group of protesters after allegedly being fired upon in Louisville, Kentucky, resulting in the death of David McAtee, a local barbecue shop owner. An investigation is ongoing, while the LMPD Chief has been fired, as the officers involved in the shooting did not have their body cameras turned on.

Source citations (as archived): [Associated Press](<https://apnews.com/3804be7642245883e6987f402e9e6302>).

<a id="event-2020-06-01-3-7"></a>

Context: United States racial unrest / George Floyd protests / George Floyd protests in Washington, D.C..

**Archived source account.** An active duty military police battalion of 200 to 250 troops are deployed in the U.S. capital Washington, D.C., to provide security as protests continue. Defense officials say the troops are from Fort Bragg in North Carolina.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/06/01/politics/troops-deploying-washington-dc/index.html?utm_source=feedburner&amp;utm_medium=feed&amp;utm_campaign=Feed%3A+rss%2Fcnn_allpolitics+%28RSS%3A+CNN+-+Politics%29>).

<a id="event-2020-06-01-3-8"></a>

Context: United States racial unrest / George Floyd protests.

**Archived source account.** Forty cities across the United States impose overnight curfews in order to quell the violence from the protests.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/us/live-news/george-floyd-protests-05-31-20/h_e876f5637c75c43d696fd72e881ed21d>).

<a id="event-2020-06-01-3-9"></a>

Context: United States racial unrest / George Floyd protests.

**Archived source account.** Two protesters are shot and killed during riots in Davenport, Iowa. In a separate incident, a police vehicle is ambushed, resulting in the wounding of an officer.

Source citations (as archived): [The Des Moines Register](<https://eu.desmoinesregister.com/story/news/crime-and-courts/2020/06/01/davenport-iowa-rioting-two-people-shot-dead-police-officers-ambushed/5306484002/>).

<a id="event-2020-06-01-3-10"></a>

Context: United States racial unrest / George Floyd protests.

**Archived source account.** Two bystanders are shot and killed by "outside agitators" during protests in Cicero, Illinois.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS Chicago](<https://chicago.cbslocal.com/2020/06/01/chaos-in-cicero-2-bystanders-shot-dead-in-one-incident-liquor-store-looting-suspects-caught-hiding-in-another/>).

<a id="event-2020-06-01-3-11"></a>

Context: United States racial unrest / George Floyd protests.

**Archived source account.** Police shoot and kill an armed man wearing body armor at a protest in Las Vegas. In another incident, a policeman is shot and critically injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Reno Gazette Journal](<https://eu.rgj.com/story/news/2020/06/01/las-vegas-protest-george-floyd-black-lives-matter-protesters-trump-tower/5312668002/>).

<a id="event-2020-06-01-3-12"></a>

Context: United States racial unrest / George Floyd protests.

**Archived source account.** Anonymous sources suggest President Donald Trump is considering invoking the 1807 Insurrection Act to deploy the military to respond to protests throughout the country.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/politics-news/trump-considering-move-invoke-insurrection-act-n1221326>).

<a id="event-2020-06-01-3-13"></a>

Context: United States racial unrest / George Floyd protests.

**Archived source account.** Four police officers are shot in St. Louis amid rioting in the downtown area of the city.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Post](<https://nypost.com/2020/06/02/four-police-officers-shot-in-st-louis-amid-chaos-and-looting/>).

<a id="event-2020-06-01-3-14"></a>

Context: United States racial unrest.

**Archived source account.** An independent autopsy concludes George Floyd died of "asphyxiation from sustained pressure" and that there was "neck and back compression that led to a lack of blood flow to the brain" and that Floyd died at the scene of his arrest and not at the hospital, contradicting the Hennepin County, Minnesota coroner's report.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2020/06/01/george-floyd-independent-autopsy-findings-released-monday/5307185002/>).

<a id="event-2020-06-01-3-15"></a>

Context: United States racial unrest.

**Archived source account.** Two police vehicles drive into a crowd of protesters in New York. Similar vehicle incidents also occur in Denver and Minneapolis.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2020/06/01/george-floyd-protests-cars-vehicles-plowing-into-demonstrations/5308969002/>).

### 2020-06-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256158771](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20June%202&oldid=1256158771>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-06-02-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A US$5 billion class action lawsuit is filed against Alphabet Inc. and Google, alleging the company violates users' right to privacy by tracking them in Chrome's incognito mode.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-52887340>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-06-02-1-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in India.

**Archived source account.** India approves the use of remdesivir to treat emergency COVID-19 cases that require immediate attention.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jakarta Post](<https://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2020/06/02/india-approves-emergency-use-of-remdesivir-to-treat-covid-19-patients.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-06-02-2-1"></a>

Context: Philippines–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** President Rodrigo Duterte suspends for six months the termination of the Philippines–United States Visiting Forces Agreement. Foreign Affairs Secretary Teodoro Locsin Jr. says the decision comes due to "political and other developments in the region".

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/06/philippines-backtracks-termination-military-deal-200602142554480.html>).

<a id="event-2020-06-02-2-3"></a>

Context: United States–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo announces sanctions on four shipping firms for transporting oil from Venezuela. Three firms are based in the Marshall Islands and another in Greece. Venezuelan Foreign Minister Jorge Arreaza responds by saying Pompeo has a "criminal obsession" with Venezuela.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-venezuela-oil/u-s-sanctions-four-shipping-firms-for-transporting-venezuelan-oil-idUSKBN2392BC?il=0>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-06-02-3-1"></a>

Context: George Floyd protests in Washington, D.C..

**Archived source account.** James N. Miller, former U.S. Under Secretary of Defense for Policy, announces his resignation from the Defense Science Board, citing disagreement with the Trump administration's actions against protestors in Washington, D.C.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/opinions/2020/06/02/secretary-esper-you-violated-your-oath-aiding-trumps-photo-op-thats-why-im-resigning/>).

<a id="event-2020-06-02-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** In France, despite being banned by the police headquarters, a demonstration organized by the Justice pour Adama movement in Paris gathered 20,000 participants. They were protesting for charges against police officers who had killed a young black man, Adama Traoré, during his arrest in 2016. They also demonstrated in support of the Black Lives Matter movement in the United States, and in protest against police violence against black and Arab individuals in France in general. Some clashes occur at the end of the event. Other smaller demonstrations took place in the towns of Lyon, Marseille and Lille.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20200603-france-urges-calm-after-tense-protest-over-black-man-s-death>).

### 2020-06-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1172240229](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20June%203&oldid=1172240229>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-06-03-0-1"></a>

Context: 2020 North Indian Ocean cyclone season, Cyclone Nisarga, COVID-19 pandemic in India.

**Archived source account.** Severe Cyclonic Storm Nisarga makes landfall south of Mumbai. This is the first time a tropical cyclone has targeted the megacity since 1891. About 100,000 people have been evacuated from low-lying areas in the western Indian states of Maharashtra and Gujarat, areas already hard-hit by the COVID-19 pandemic.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://npr.org/2020/06/03/868469113/powerful-cyclone-makes-landfall-near-indian-city-of-mumbai>); [India Meteorological Department](<https://mausam.imd.gov.in/imd_latest/contents/cyclone.php>).

<a id="event-2020-06-03-0-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Ridgecrest earthquakes.

**Archived source account.** A \{\{m\|w\|link=yes\}\} 5.5 aftershock to the 2019 Ridgecrest earthquakes of July 2019 takes place. It is the third-largest earthquake of the sequence, taking place only 11 km from the Garlock Fault.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC Los Angeles](<https://www.nbclosangeles.com/news/local/preliminary-5-1-magnitude-earthquake-in-ridgecrest-felt-all-the-way-to-hollywood/2374265/>); [The Los Angeles Times](<https://www.latimes.com/california/story/2020-06-03/earthquake-5-5-quake-strikes-near-ridgecrest-calif>).

<a id="event-2020-06-03-0-5"></a>

Context: Norilsk oil spill.

**Archived source account.** Russian President Vladimir Putin declares a state of emergency after 20,000 tons of oil leaked into the Ambarnaya River near the Siberian city of Norilsk within the Arctic Circle on May 26, 2020. The spill happened when a fuel tank in a Nornickel NTEK power plant collapsed. Putin lambasted the company for not reporting the incident. The World Wildlife Fund said the accident is believed to be the second-largest in modern Russian history.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-52915807>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2020/jun/03/vladimir-putin-orders-state-of-emergency-huge-fuel-spill-siberia-power-plant-kerch>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-06-03-1-1"></a>

Context: Hong Kong–United Kingdom relations, 2019–20 Hong Kong protests.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Boris Johnson announces that the United Kingdom will change its immigration laws to offer a pathway to UK citizenship for all Hong Kong citizens who are eligible for BN(O) status, if the government of China imposes new security laws on the territory.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-52900700>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-06-03-2-3"></a>

Context: Killing of George Floyd / George Floyd protests / George Floyd protests in California.

**Archived source account.** Vallejo police announce that Sean Monterrosa, a 22-year-old Hispanic resident of San Francisco, was shot and killed by police the day before at a Walgreens. Police allege that a hammer in his pocket was mistaken for a gun. Monterrosa was on his knees.

Source citations (as archived): [The San Francisco Chronicle](<https://www.sfchronicle.com/crime/article/Attorney-identifies-SF-resident-fatally-shot-by-15315301.php?t=d760583d8b>).

<a id="event-2020-06-03-2-4"></a>

Context: Killing of George Floyd / George Floyd protests / George Floyd protests in California.

**Archived source account.** Los Angeles Mayor Eric Garcetti pledges to cut the budget of the Los Angeles Police Department by up to $150 million in the wake of allegations of police misconduct during protests.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<https://www.latimes.com/california/story/2020-06-03/protests-demanding-racial-justice-gain-momentum-across-l-a#nt=7030col1-main>).

<a id="event-2020-06-03-2-6"></a>

Context: Killing of George Floyd / George Floyd protests / George Floyd protests in Texas.

**Archived source account.** Texas State University President Denise Trauth announces on social media that a 20-year-old African-American student protestor, Justin Howell, had been critically injured by a bean bag round fired by Austin police on Sunday. Police maintain that Howell was not the intended target.

Source citations (as archived): [Austin American-Statesman](<https://www.statesman.com/news/20200603/man-injured-by-austin-police-in-protests-is-texas-state-student-university-says>).

<a id="event-2020-06-03-2-8"></a>

Context: Killing of George Floyd / George Floyd protests / Death of David Dorn.

**Archived source account.** African-American former police captain David Dorn is shot and killed while trying to protect a pawn shop in St. Louis.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/06/03/us/david-dorn-st-louis-police-shot-trnd/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-06-03-2-9"></a>

Context: Killing of George Floyd / George Floyd protests.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Senator Tom Cotton (R–AR) publishes a op-ed for the New York Times calling for the mobilization of American troops in response to the protests.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2020/06/03/business/tom-cotton-op-ed.html>).

<a id="event-2020-06-03-2-10"></a>

Context: Killing of George Floyd.

**Archived source account.** The criminal charge for former Minneapolis Police officer Derek Chauvin in the death of George Floyd is upgraded to second-degree murder, while the three officers who helped restrain Floyd are charged with aiding and abetting murder.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2020/06/03/3-more-cops-charged-in-george-floyd-death-other-officers-murder-charge-upgraded.html>).

<a id="event-2020-06-03-2-12"></a>

Context: Papua conflict, 2019 Papua protests.

**Archived source account.** An administrative court in Jakarta rules that it was unlawful for the Government of Indonesia to shut down the internet in Papua and West Papua during heightened security tensions caused by antiracism protests in the two provinces last year.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jakarta Post](<https://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2020/06/03/internet-ban-during-antiracism-unrest-in-papua-deemed-illegal.html>).

<a id="event-2020-06-03-2-13"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Lesotho First Lady Maesiah Thabane is arrested on charges of murder. Her husband, former Lesotho Prime Minister Tom Thabane, is also accused of murder but not formally charged.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lesotho-politics/lesotho-former-first-lady-arrested-in-murder-case-idUSKBN23A16M>).

<a id="event-2020-06-03-2-14"></a>

**Archived source account.** A court in France orders Rwandan genocide suspect Félicien Kabuga to be handed over to a United Nations tribunal for trial. Kabuga's lawyers said that their client would not receive a fair trial at a UN tribunal and that his health was too fragile to be transferred amidst the pandemic. However, French justice said his transfer is "not incompatible" with the decision.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-warcrimes-rwanda/french-court-orders-rwanda-genocide-suspect-be-tried-at-u-n-tribunal-idUSKBN23A1VI?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-06-03-2-15"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former President of Ecuador Abdalá Bucaram is arrested for illegal possession of weapons during a raid on his home against corruption.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN Español](<https://cnnespanol.cnn.com/2020/06/03/alerta-ecuador-detenido-expresidente-abdala-bucaram-tras-allanamiento-a-su-vivienda-2/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-06-03-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** SpaceX successfully launches and deploys 60 Starlink satellites into a low Earth orbit from Cape Canaveral Air Force Station. This brings the total number of Starlink satellites in orbit to 482.

Source citations (as archived): [Space.com](<https://www.space.com/spacex-starlink-internet-satellites-launch-success-june-2020.html>).

### 2020-06-04

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1225638996](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20June%204&oldid=1225638996>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-06-04-0-2"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War / 2019–20 Western Libya campaign.

**Archived source account.** The Government of National Accord (GNA) says they are in full control of the Libyan capital, Tripoli, after forces of the Libyan National Army (LNA), loyal to Field Marshal Khalifa Haftar, retreat from the capital after months of intense clashes in the city.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-libya-security/eastern-forces-quit-libyan-capital-after-year-long-assault-idUSKBN23B1PN>).

<a id="event-2020-06-04-0-3"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War / 2019–20 Western Libya campaign.

**Archived source account.** The GNA recaptures Tripoli International Airport on the outskirts of the capital following the withdrawal of LNA forces.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-52920373>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2020-06-04-1-1"></a>

Context: Removal of Confederate monuments and memorials.

**Archived source account.** Virginia Governor Ralph Northam orders the removal of the Robert E. Lee Monument in the state capital Richmond, saying, "In Virginia, we no longer preach a false version of history".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-52920610>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-06-04-2-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Senegal.

**Archived source account.** After violent protests erupt across the country against a lockdown imposed to combat the virus, the government announces it will "relax" the restrictions. Interior Minister Aly Ngouille Ndiaye says the curfew will be shortened and inter-regional travel ban lifted.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-senegal-unrest/senegal-to-ease-coronavirus-curfew-as-protests-spread-to-capital-idUSKBN23B028?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-06-04-2-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil.

**Archived source account.** Brazil surpasses Italy with the third-highest COVID-19 death toll.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/jun/04/coronavirus-brazil-record-daily-death-toll-mexico>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-06-04-3-1"></a>

Context: North Korea–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** North Korea issues a warning that it would end a 2018 inter-Korean military agreement if South Korea fails to stop defectors and activists from sending anti-Pyongyang leaflets into the demilitarized zone (DMZ).

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/north-korea-kims-sister-threatens-to-end-military-pact-over-leaflets/a-53677711>).

<a id="event-2020-06-04-3-3"></a>

Context: Iran–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Navy veteran Michael R. White is released from Iranian custody. White was under house arrest for nearly two years and is now en-route to Zurich, Switzerland.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/06/navy-veteran-held-iran-released-en-route-home-200604145920094.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-06-04-4-2"></a>

Context: George Floyd protests / George Floyd protests in California.

**Archived source account.** Los Angeles officials announce an end to the county-wide curfew amid continuing protests.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<https://www.latimes.com/california/story/2020-06-04/as-protests-calm-l-a-officials-come-under-fire-for-continued-curfews-use-of-force-and-l-arrests>).

<a id="event-2020-06-04-4-4"></a>

Context: George Floyd protests / Buffalo police shoving incident.

**Archived source account.** Two Buffalo police officers are suspended without pay after shoving a 75-year-old protestor to the ground. He has been hospitalized from the resulting head injury.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2020/06/05/us/buffalo-police-shove-protester-unrest.html>).

<a id="event-2020-06-04-4-6"></a>

Context: Shooting of Ahmaud Arbery.

**Archived source account.** One of the suspects involved in the shooting death of Ahmaud Arbery testifies that the gunman who shot and killed Arbery had shouted a racial slur at the victim moments after his death. The allegation opens up the possibility for hate crime charges.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/nation/2020/06/04/fellow-shooter-called-georgia-jogger-f-ing-n-he-lay-dying-road-agent-testified/>).

<a id="event-2020-06-04-4-8"></a>

Context: Freedom of religion in Russia.

**Archived source account.** A court in Russian-controlled Crimea jails a Jehovah's Witness for six years for practicing an outlawed religion in the territory.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-politics-religion/court-in-crimea-jails-second-jehovahs-witness-for-six-years-idUSKBN23B2WF>).

<a id="event-2020-06-04-4-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** Riots break out and the governor’s palace is attacked in Guadalajara, Mexico, after police officers in Ixtlahuacán de los Membrillos beat a young worker to death for not wearing a medical mask.

Source citations (as archived): [Puerto Vallarta Daily News](<https://www.vallartadaily.com/violent-protests-in-guadalajara-over-man-killed-by-police-for-not-wearing-a-mask/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-06-04-5-1"></a>

Context: 31st anniversary of the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests, 2019–20 Hong Kong protests.

**Archived source account.** The mass annual vigil commemorating the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests at Victoria Park, Hong Kong, is banned by the city police for the first time, citing concerns of local COVID-19 transmissions. Local commemorations are held across the city.

Source citations (as archived): [Hong Kong Free Press](<https://hongkongfp.com/2020/06/04/hong-kong-to-lead-tiananmen-remembrance-despite-virus-gathering-ban/>).

<a id="event-2020-06-04-5-2"></a>

Context: 31st anniversary of the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests, 2019–20 Hong Kong protests.

**Archived source account.** Tens of thousands of people, in multiple locations across Hong Kong, defy the ban against gatherings to observe the anniversary, carrying lit candles and chanting democracy slogans. The largest group, in Victoria Park, heard Lee Cheuk-yan, former Chairman of the Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements in China, read the Alliance's manifesto and vow to return next year.

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/society/article/3087496/tiananmen-vigil-hong-kong-defies-covid-19-social-distancing>); [International Business Times](<https://www.ibtimes.com/hong-kong-protesters-defy-ban-rally-remember-tiananmen-2987606>).

### 2020-06-05

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1339493721](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20June%205&oldid=1339493721>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-06-05-0-2"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War / 2019–20 Western Libya campaign.

**Archived source account.** Turkish-backed GNA forces enter the strategic Libyan National Army-held town of Tarhuna, west of Tripoli. The town is considered to be a stronghold for Field Marshal Khalifa Haftar. The GNA operations room say its forces have reached the centre of the town.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-libya-security/libyan-government-says-it-has-entered-haftar-stronghold-tarhouna-idUKKBN23C11Q>).

<a id="event-2020-06-05-0-4"></a>

Context: 2020 Democratic Republic of the Congo massacres.

**Archived source account.** The High Commissioner for Human Rights of the United Nations, Michelle Bachelet, says that more than 1,300 civilians have been killed in recent months and half a million displaced in three provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid a resurgence of attacks on the civilian population by different armed groups. Bachelet says these attacks "may amount to crimes against humanity and war crimes".

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/06/1300-civilians-killed-dr-congo-million-flee-200605091341816.html>).

<a id="event-2020-06-05-0-6"></a>

Context: Mali War, Operation Barkhane.

**Archived source account.** The French Minister of the Armed Forces Florence Parly says that AQIM emir Abdelmalek Droukdel, along with members of his inner circle, had been killed in northern Mali on 3 June 2020. She also says that French forces had also captured a senior AQIM commander in an operation in May.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-52943692>).

<a id="event-2020-06-05-0-8"></a>

Context: List of mass shootings in the United States in 2020.

**Archived source account.** Seven people are killed in an overnight shooting and arson at a residence in Valhermoso Springs, Alabama. Police believe the incident was a targeted attack, but no suspects are in custody.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/US/dead-alabama-shooting/story?id=71085699>); [WAFF-TV](<https://www.waff.com/2020/06/05/overnight-shooting-alabama-killed-valhermoso-springs/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-06-05-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Five people are killed after a Cessna 210 Centurion crashes near Puerto Vallarta, Mexico.

<a id="event-2020-06-05-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Five people are killed after a Piper PA-31T Cheyenne crashes in Eatonton, Georgia, United States.

Source citations (as archived): [Aviation Safety Network](<https://aviation-safety.net/wikibase/236713>).

<a id="event-2020-06-05-1-2"></a>

Despite the extent of the damage and the collapse of the roof, no injuries are reported as the staff was safely evacuated. The cause of the fire is currently under investigation.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/06/05/us/amazon-redlands-fire-trnd/index.html>).

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2020/06/05/new-york-city-reports-first-day-with-no-confirmed-coronavirus-deaths-since-march-11.html>).

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2020/06/05/869553801/biden-formally-secures-democratic-nomination-while-gaining-steam-against-trump>).

This marks the first time a mayor has been successfully recalled in Taiwan.

Context: George Floyd protests in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** The Mayor of London Sadiq Khan establishes the Commission for Diversity in the Public Realm in order to review statues in London. A statue of merchant and slave owner Robert Milligan is removed.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/sadiq-khan-statues-london-diversity-edward-colston-black-lives-matter-a9555941.html>).

<a id="event-2020-06-09-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tanzanian opposition leader Freeman Mbowe is attacked by unidentified assailants as he enters his home. His party, the Chadema, says the attack may have been politically motivated.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-tanzania-politics/tanzanian-opposition-leader-attacked-by-unidentified-people-idUSKBN23G0WE?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-06-09-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Darfur militia leader Ali Kushayb is handed over to the International Criminal Court in The Hague, where he is accused of crimes against humanity and war crimes, including murder and rape. He had surrendered in the Central African Republic.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-warcrimes-sudan-car/darfur-militia-leader-sent-to-icc-to-face-allegations-of-crimes-against-humanity-idUSKBN23G23Z?il=0>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-06-09-6-1"></a>

Context: Politics of Burundi.

**Archived source account.** Incumbent President Pierre Nkurunziza dies at the age of 55. Pascal Nyabenda, president of the National Assembly, assumes the presidential office ad interim.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-52984119>).

### 2020-06-10

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1362895388](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20June%2010&oldid=1362895388>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-06-10-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A gunman opens fire at a police station in Paso Robles, California, injuring a deputy with the San Luis Obispo Sheriff's Office. He then flees and kills a transient, leading to a manhunt.

Source citations (as archived): [The San Francisco Chronicle](<https://www.sfgate.com/news/article/Gunman-shoots-at-California-police-station-15329865.php>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-06-10-1-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Assam gas and oil leak.

**Archived source account.** Two firefighters are killed and four others are injured in a Baghjan gas well blowout fire in Assam, Northeast India.

Source citations (as archived): [Indian Express](<https://indianexpress.com/article/north-east-india/assam/assam-gas-leak-firefighters-death-injuries-6451909/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-06-10-2-1"></a>

Context: North Korea–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** A day after North Korea severed its hotlines with South Korea over defectors who sent anti-Pyongyang leaflets to the border, South Korea announces it is taking legal action against two organisations that conducted such operations, saying that they "have created tension between the two Koreas and caused danger to the border-area residents' lives and safety".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-southkorea-defectors/south-korea-acts-to-stop-defectors-sending-aid-messages-to-north-korea-idUSKBN23H1BF?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-06-10-2-3"></a>

Context: Proposed United States acquisition of Greenland.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo announces that the United States has reopened its consulate in Nuuk, Greenland, a year after U.S. president Donald Trump expressed his interest in purchasing the island, as part of a effort from the White House to expand U.S. presence in the Arctic and curb influence from China and Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico EU](<https://www.politico.eu/article/us-makes-greenland-return-after-trump-attempt-to-buy-it-us-consulate/>).

<a id="event-2020-06-10-2-5"></a>

Context: Territorial disputes of India and Nepal.

**Archived source account.** The Nepali parliament moves to approve a new map and revision of the national emblem which includes territory in India's Uttarakhand state.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of India](<https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/south-asia/nepal-parliament-moves-to-approve-new-map/articleshow/76290511.cms>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-06-10-3-1"></a>

Context: Assassination of Olof Palme.

**Archived source account.** Sweden closes the case of the murder of Prime Minister Olof Palme in 1986 after 34 years of investigation, indicating Stig Engström as the suspected murderer.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/06/10/europe/sweden-olof-palme-murder-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-06-10-3-3"></a>

Context: Killing of George Floyd, Police reform in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Several people, including George Floyd's brother, testify about police brutality and systemic racism before the U.S. House Judiciary Committee in support of the Justice in Policing Act of 2020.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2020/06/10/873865317/please-listen-george-floyd-s-brother-testifies-in-house-judiciary-hearing>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-06-10-4-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Polish presidential election, LGBT rights in Poland.

**Archived source account.** Ahead of the upcoming presidential election, President Andrzej Duda vows to ban teaching about LGBT issues in Polish schools in a bid to secure re-election. Duda is a staunch ally of the ruling right-wing populist Law and Justice party.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-poland-election-lgbt/polish-president-says-he-would-ban-lgbt-teaching-in-schools-idUSKBN23H2BU>).

<a id="event-2020-06-10-4-3"></a>

Context: 2020 Sri Lankan parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** Sri Lanka postpones, for a second time, the election from June 20 to August 5 due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-sri-lanka-politics-election/sri-lanka-delays-general-election-for-second-time-sets-august-5-as-new-date-idUSKBN23H1RW?il=0>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2020-06-10-5-1"></a>

Context: Modern display of the Confederate battle flag.

**Archived source account.** NASCAR announces that the display of the Confederate flag will be prohibited from all of its events and properties.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<https://www.espn.com/racing/nascar/story/_/id/29293767/nascar-bans-confederate-flags-racetracks>).

### 2020-06-11

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1082329395](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20June%2011&oldid=1082329395>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-06-11-0-1"></a>

Context: Maghreb insurgency.

**Archived source account.** At least 10 Ivorian soldiers are killed and six others wounded at the border with Burkina Faso when an armed group ambushed them; one of the attackers was also killed. It is the first attack in the country since the 2016 Grand-Bassam shootings.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/06/10-soldiers-killed-attack-ivory-coast-border-post-200611143031833.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-06-11-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the sinking of a ship carrying 53 migrants off the coast of Tunisia on Tuesday rises to at least 46 as more bodies are recovered from the sea.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-tunisia-migrants/death-toll-in-migrant-ship-disaster-off-tunisia-rises-to-46-idUSKBN23I1OT>).

<a id="event-2020-06-11-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Ministry of Emergency Management of China says that flooding in south and central China has killed more than a dozen people and forced hundreds of thousands to seek emergency shelter since 2 June.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/06/flooding-forces-hundreds-thousands-homes-china-200611060707197.html>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-06-11-2-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The United States surpasses two million cases of COVID-19, the first country in the world to do so.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/06/11/health/us-coronavirus-thursday/index.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-06-11-3-1"></a>

Context: Iraq–United States relations, Withdrawal of U.S. troops from Iraq (2020).

**Archived source account.** The United States and Iraq begin negotiations, conducted remotely, to discuss the withdrawal of U.S. troops and countering Iranian influence.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2020/06/10/world/middleeast/iraq-isis-strategic-dialogue-troops.html>).

<a id="event-2020-06-11-3-3"></a>

Context: United States war crimes.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump authorizes sanctions against the International Criminal Court in retaliation for their investigation into potential war crimes by U.S. officials.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/06/11/politics/icc-executive-order/index.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-06-11-4-1"></a>

Context: Bærum mosque shooting.

**Archived source account.** A court in Norway sentences Philip Manshaus to 21 years in prison for the racially-motivated murder of his stepsister and for attempting to kill Muslim worshippers. It is the longest prison sentence allowed by law. The prison term contains a provision that his release can be put off indefinitely should he still be considered a threat to society.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/06/norway-sentences-oslo-mosque-shooter-21-years-prison-200611083805762.html>).

<a id="event-2020-06-11-4-3"></a>

Context: Turkey–United States relations, 2016–present purges in Turkey.

**Archived source account.** A court in Turkey sentences a U.S. Consulate employee, Metin Topuz, to 8 years and 9 months in prison on charges of aiding the followers of Fethullah Gülen, the U.S.-based preacher who is accused in Turkey of being the mastermind behind a failed coup attempt in 2016 against Erdoğan. The U.S. Embassy in Ankara releases a statement on Twitter saying officials were "deeply disappointed" in the decision.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2020/06/11/world/europe/turkey-court-sentences-metin-topuz.html>).

<a id="event-2020-06-11-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** An attacker, believed to be a former student, kills the deputy head and injures five others with a knife at a school in Vrútky, Slovakia, before being killed by responding police officers.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-53006785>).

<a id="event-2020-06-11-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Senate of the Republic of Colombia approves a resolution banning the testing of cosmetics on animals, as well as the commercialization of cosmetics which are actively tested on animals.

Source citations (as archived): [La FM](<https://www.lafm.com.co/politica/colombia-ya-no-tendra-pruebas-de-cosmeticos-en-animales>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-06-11-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Dalton Tagelagi is elected new Premier of Niue by the Assembly.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/418748/dalton-tagelagi-voted-in-as-new-premier-of-niue>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2020-06-11-6-1"></a>

Context: 2020 AFL season, George Floyd protests in Australia.

**Archived source account.** After a ten-week suspension due to the COVID-19 pandemic, the 2020 AFL season resumes with Collingwood facing Richmond at the MCG. Before the match began, both teams knelt to show solidarity with the George Floyd protests. The match finished in a draw.

Source citations (as archived): [News.com.au](<https://www.news.com.au/sport/afl-2020-collingwood-vs-richmond-live-scores-news-updates-from-mcg/live-coverage/df997ed6b22e812d91771b39582e4b71>).

### 2020-06-12

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1295800465](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20June%2012&oldid=1295800465>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-06-12-0-2"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War / 2019–20 Western Libya campaign.

**Archived source account.** Eight mass graves containing hundreds of bodies are discovered in western Libya, most of them in the town of Tarhuna. The Government of National Accord (GNA) says the remains are of captured GNA fighters and civilians, apparent evidence of war crimes.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/06/expresses-horror-reported-mass-graves-discovery-libya-200611201231621.html>).

<a id="event-2020-06-12-0-4"></a>

Context: June 2020 Afghanistan attacks.

**Archived source account.** Four people are killed and eight others injured by the bombing of a mosque in Kabul. No group claimed responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-attack/four-killed-and-many-injured-in-blast-in-kabul-mosque-ministry-of-interior-idUSKBN23J1DH>).

<a id="event-2020-06-12-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** About 30 Indians cross the border into Nepal and clash with Nepali police when stopped in the district of Sarlahi. Nepali border guards opened fire, killing one man and injuring two. According to police, the forces fired when one of the men snatched a gun from them.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/06/firing-nepal-india-border-leaves-dead-strained-ties-200612104607012.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-06-12-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sanrio founder and CEO Shintaro Tsuji, whose company is best known for creating Hello Kitty, announces he will resign on July 1 citing a need to "transform the company to better respond to today's rapidly changing business environment." His grandson Tomokuni Tsuji is expected to replace him.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-53029110>).

<a id="event-2020-06-12-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Brazil's state-run oil company Petrobras says it will not do business with tankers that visited Venezuela in the past year, adhering to sanctions placed by the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-sanctions-tankers/brazils-petrobras-says-it-will-not-hire-oil-tankers-that-visited-venezuela-idUSKBN23K019?il=0>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-06-12-2-1"></a>

Context: LGBTQ rights in the United States, Abortion in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services removes protections against discrimination within Obamacare for transgender people and women seeking abortions. The move is condemned by civil rights groups and Democratic officials.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-healthcare-transgender/u-s-health-agency-reverses-obamacare-transgender-protections-idUSKBN23J37M?il=0>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-06-12-3-1"></a>

Context: Slavery in Australia.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Scott Morrison apologizes for saying there was "no slavery" in Australia. He says that he was referring specifically to the fact that the first Australian colony of New South Wales was set up without the widespread use of slave labor.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/06/12/australia/australia-slavery-scott-morrison-intl-hnk/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-06-12-3-3"></a>

Context: Lebanese liquidity crisis.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds protest over the handling of the country's economic crisis, many calling for Hassan Diab's government to resign. The Lebanese pound has lost 70 percent of its value since October, when protests began. The government announced the central bank will begin injecting more United States dollars into the market on Monday.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-53031683>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/ajimpact/protests-rock-lebanon-currency-collapses-200612060707797.html>).

<a id="event-2020-06-12-3-5"></a>

Context: 2020 Republican Party presidential primaries, Donald Trump 2020 presidential campaign.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump announces the MAGA Rally that was to be held on June 19, in Tulsa, Oklahoma, is rescheduled to June 20. The rally's original date had been widely criticized because the 19th is Juneteenth, the date commemorating the end of American slavery. The location was also criticized due to it being where the 1921 Tulsa race massacre took place, because of the ongoing George Floyd protests.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/06/12/politics/donald-trump-tulsa-rally-juneteenth/index.html>); [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/homenews/campaign/502573-trump-reschedules-tulsa-rally-after-criticism-of-overlap-with-juneteenth>).

<a id="event-2020-06-12-3-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** President-elect of Burundi Évariste Ndayishimiye is set to take power immediately, days after the death of incumbent Pierre Nkurunziza, as the constitutional court says "it is not necessary to have an interim period", and that Ndayishimiye should be sworn-in "as soon as possible".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-burundi-politics/burundis-president-elect-to-take-power-immediately-after-death-of-former-leader-idUSKBN23J27O?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-06-12-3-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** On the 122nd anniversary of the Philippines's independence from Spain, more than a thousand protestors march at the main campus of the University of the Philippines in Manila to protest a controversial anti-terrorism bill introduced by President Rodrigo Duterte.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-philippines-rights-protests/philippine-protesters-rally-over-controversial-anti-terror-bill-idUSKBN23J1FG?il=0>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-06-12-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Twitter says it has removed a network of more than 170,000 accounts it says were spreading pro-Communist Party of China propaganda on the social media platform, saying the Chinese-based network had links to earlier state-backed operations on Facebook and YouTube. More than a thousand Russia-based misinformation accounts are also removed.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-53018455>).

### 2020-06-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1258208864](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20June%2013&oldid=1258208864>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-06-13-0-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Monguno and Nganzai massacres.

**Archived source account.** ISWAP kills over 20 soldiers and 40 civilians in attacks in Monguno and Nganzai in Borno, Nigeria – four days after they killed 82 civilians in Gubio.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-nigeria-security-idUKKBN23K0VY>).

<a id="event-2020-06-13-0-3"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** Coalition spokesman Turki al-Malki says the armed forces destroyed a ballistic missile targeting the Saudi border city of Najran. In a statement, the spokesman said the missile was launched from the Yemeni city of Saada and that some people were slightly injured when it was destroyed. The Houthis did not claim responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/06/saudi-led-coalition-destroyed-missile-targeting-najran-200613144607924.html>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-06-13-1-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in Chile.

**Archived source account.** More than 3,100 deaths are officially reported in the country. However, an investigation reported the Ministry of Health told the World Health Organization that the death toll reached 5,000 cases.

Source citations (as archived): [France24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20200613-chile-replaces-health-minister-as-covid-19-deaths-spike>).

<a id="event-2020-06-13-1-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in Chile.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-06-13-2-1"></a>

Context: Czech Republic–Poland relations, COVID-19 pandemic in Poland.

**Archived source account.** Poland's Ministry of National Defence admits its army briefly invaded and occupied the Czech Republic for several days last month in a "misunderstanding", the Polish soldiers took up positions near a chapel on the Czech side of the border in Moravia as part of coronavirus measures, and prevented Czech visitors from the site.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-53034930>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-06-13-3-1"></a>

Context: Killing of Rayshard Brooks.

**Archived source account.** Protestors set fire to a Wendy's restaurant in Atlanta, Georgia, U.S., in response to Rayshard Brooks' death the evening before. Outside the restaurant the previous day, two police officers shot Brooks after he attempted to escape from them after a tussle in which he took one of the officer's taser and discharged it at one of them following a DUI investigation.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/jun/14/rayshard-brooks-shooting-protesters-set-fire-to-restaurant-where-black-man-shot-dead>).
