### 2020-07-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1192142546](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20July%2013&oldid=1192142546>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-07-13-0-1"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** The Houthis launch missiles and drones into Saudi Arabia during an overnight attack. The movement claims it successfully hit Saudi warplanes, military installations, an airport and the Jizan oil facility, operated by Aramco. Saudi-led coalition spokesman Turki al-Maliki says they destroyed four missiles and six drones launched against the kingdom from capital of Yemen, Sanaa.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/07/yemen-houthis-saudi-oil-facility-hit-overnight-attack-200713082015159.html>).

<a id="event-2020-07-13-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan; July 2020 Afghanistan attacks.

**Archived source account.** The Taliban attack an intelligence building in Aybak, Samangan Province, leaving 11 people dead and 63 people injured. The attack started with a suicide car bombing at the government compound and finished after gunmen were killed by Afghan security forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-attacks/taliban-attack-on-afghan-government-compound-kills-10-wounds-dozens-idUSKCN24E0O5?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-07-13-0-5"></a>

Context: 2020 Armenian–Azerbaijani skirmishes; Nagorno-Karabakh conflict.

**Archived source account.** Several Armenian and Azerbaijani soldiers are killed and/or wounded after a clash at the border of the Azerbaijani exclave of Nakhchivan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-azerbaijan-armenia-conflict-idUSKCN24E12B>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-07-13-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Diageo plc announces that Johnnie Walker Scotch whisky will soon be sold in paper bottles. The bottles will be made from wood pulp and will be fully recyclable. A trial run is scheduled for spring 2021. In addition, Diageo is co-launching Pulpex with venture management firm Pilot Lite that will make paper bottles for beverage companies such as Unilever and PepsiCo.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-53392949>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-07-13-2-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in California.

**Archived source account.** California Governor Gavin Newsom orders further restrictions and prohibitions on indoor activities, building on previous orders. California has seen a sustained rise in COVID-19 cases in recent weeks, resulting in the state pausing and rolling back some reopening plans.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2020/07/13/california-to-close-indoor-restaurants-movie-theaters-and-bars-statewide-as-coronavirus-cases-rise.html>).

<a id="event-2020-07-13-2-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan.

**Archived source account.** Michigan begins tighter restrictions on public face mask usage, including $500 fines for refusal to wear one and the potential loss of business licenses for failure to enforce their usage.

Source citations (as archived): [MLive.com](<https://www.mlive.com/public-interest/2020/07/michigan-businesses-must-start-enforcing-mask-rule-monday.html>).

<a id="event-2020-07-13-2-7"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Turkmenistan.

**Archived source account.** State media issues an order from the Ministry of Health mandating that all citizens wear masks to combat "dust", and maintain a distance between people of at least one meter (3 feet). The Turkmen government maintains that the country remains free of COVID-19 but refuses to explain the purpose of these mandates.

Source citations (as archived): [CTV News](<https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/turkmenistan-orders-mask-wearing-to-combat-dust-1.5022101>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-07-13-3-1"></a>

Context: China–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** In response to the United States placing sanctions on Chinese officials for their roles in the internment of Uyghurs, the Chinese Foreign Ministry announces it will place sanctions on several American politicians, such as Senators Marco Rubio and Ted Cruz, and the government agency Congressional-Executive Commission on China for "wrong actions".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-53387331>).

<a id="event-2020-07-13-3-2"></a>

Context: China–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. State Department formally rejects most of China's maritime claims in the South China Sea.

Source citations (as archived): [U.S. Department of State](<https://www.state.gov/u-s-position-on-maritime-claims-in-the-south-china-sea/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-07-13-4-1"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in the United States.

**Archived source account.** An appeals court overturns a ruling by a federal judge blocking the execution of convicted murderer Daniel Lewis Lee, who along with Chevie Kehoe, murdered a family during a home invasion in Arkansas in 1996. It will be the first federal execution since 2003.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-53385642>).

<a id="event-2020-07-13-4-2"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Federal district judge Tanya Chutkan blocks the four federal executions scheduled for July and August including that of Daniel Lewis Lee, whose execution was scheduled for later today per the Chicago U.S. Court of Appeals' ruling Sunday. Judge Chutkan said this will allow continuation of the condemned men’s legal challenges to the new lethal injection protocol. She stated scientific evidence before the court overwhelmingly indicates the 2019 protocol is very likely to cause extreme pain and needless suffering during their executions. The federal government is likely to appeal her ruling.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-executions/u-s-judge-delays-first-federal-executions-in-17-years-idUSKCN24E1A8>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2020/07/13/890375338/judge-orders-halt-as-federal-executions-are-set-to-resume-this-week>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-07-13-5-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Polish presidential election.

**Archived source account.** The National Electoral Commission announces that incumbent President Andrzej Duda has been re-elected after winning 51.2% of the votes in a second round run-off with challenger Rafał Trzaskowski.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-53385021>).

<a id="event-2020-07-13-5-3"></a>

Context: Politics of Ivory Coast.

**Archived source account.** Ivory Coast's Vice President Daniel Kablan Duncan resigns days after the death of Prime Minister Amadou Gon Coulibaly. His office says he is leaving for personal reasons.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ivorycoast-politics/ivory-coast-vice-president-resigns-days-after-pms-death-idUSKCN24E1D9?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-07-13-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Nathan Law says he is in the United Kingdom after fleeing persecution from a controversial security law implemented by the Hong Kong government.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-53393030>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2020-07-13-6-1"></a>

Context: Washington Redskins name controversy.

**Archived source account.** The Washington Redskins announce they are dropping the team nickname and logo after decades of criticism of them being offensive to Native Americans. The new name will be announced later.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.wnem.com/news/us_world_news/washington-nfl-team-dropping-redskins-name-after-87-years/article_cf6297cb-39f1-505c-a1c4-22d37e0624ed.html>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/nfl/redskins/2020/07/13/washington-redskins-change-team-name-nfl-franchise/5371250002/>).

<a id="event-2020-07-14-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The fire on USS Bonhomme Richard continues for a third consecutive day. The United States Navy says its crews have made significant progress fighting flames and reducing smoke, but it is still unclear when the fire will be extinguished. There have been 61 injuries; 38 sailors and 23 civilians have been treated mostly for minor injuries related to firefighting.

<a id="event-2020-07-14-3-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in New York.

**Archived source account.** New York Governor Andrew Cuomo adds Minnesota, New Mexico, Ohio and Wisconsin to the state's quarantine requirement list, while Delaware is removed.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in Virginia.

**Archived source account.** Virginia Governor Ralph Northam says that he will increase enforcement of masks and social distancing as cases in the Hampton Roads area spike.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Moderna is expected to start a late stage clinical trial at 87 study locations in the United States for its COVID-19 vaccine on July 27.

<a id="event-2020-07-14-3-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mongolia puts five districts under a six-day quarantine after a 15-year-old boy dies of the bubonic plague in the remote Gobi-Altai province amid fears of an epidemic.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/world/2020/07/14/15-year-old-boy-dies-of-bubonic-plague-in-Mongolia-amid-outbreak-fears.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-07-14-4-1"></a>

Context: China–United States relations, 2019–20 Hong Kong protests.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump signs legislation and an executive order that will "hold China accountable" for recent "oppressive actions" in Hong Kong by ending its preferential economic status with the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/f160b6dd3b6bb73bfa5556ec9348edfd>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-hongkong-security-trump/trump-ends-hong-kong-preferential-status-citing-oppressive-beijing-actions-against-city-idUSKCN24F2KQ>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-07-14-5-2"></a>

Context: Capital punishment / Capital punishment in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of the United States rules 5–4 to lift the block on four federal executions scheduled for July and August. Convicted murderer Daniel Lewis Lee, whose execution was scheduled for the previous afternoon, is executed by lethal injection at the federal penitentiary in Terre Haute, Indiana. Two more executions are scheduled for later in the week.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/daniel-lewis-lee-execution-terre-haute-supreme-court/2020/07/14/18e3bf20-c5c7-11ea-b037-f9711f89ee46_story.html>).

<a id="event-2020-07-14-5-4"></a>

Context: Capital punishment / Capital punishment in Iran, 2019–2020 Iranian protests.

**Archived source account.** Following a social media campaign that generated 7.5 million posts with the hashtag \#do\_not\_execute, the Iranian authorities halt the impending executions of three anti-government protestors who were arrested during street protests in November 2019 in which hundreds of demonstrators were killed. A retrial is ordered.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-53417228>).

<a id="event-2020-07-14-5-7"></a>

Context: George Floyd protests / George Floyd protests in Kentucky.

**Archived source account.** Nearly 100 people protesting the police killing of Breonna Taylor are arrested outside the home of Kentucky Attorney General Daniel Cameron.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/nearly-100-breonna-taylor-protesters-arrested-kentucky-attorney-general-s-n1233848>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-07-14-6-2"></a>

Context: 2020 United States elections / 2020 United States Senate elections.

**Archived source account.** People in Maine, Alabama, and Texas are expected to cast their votes in both regular and run off primaries.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/07/14/politics/primary-elections-texas-alabama-maine/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-07-14-6-3"></a>

Context: 2020 United States elections / 2020 United States Senate elections.

**Archived source account.** Former Auburn football coach Tommy Tuberville defeats former attorney general Jeff Sessions in the Alabama Republican primary. Tuberville will face Democratic incumbent Doug Jones.

Source citations (as archived): [Vox](<https://www.vox.com/2020/7/14/21324520/tuberville-wins-gop-senate-primary-july-sessions>).

<a id="event-2020-07-14-6-5"></a>

Context: July 2020 New Zealand National Party leadership election.

**Archived source account.** Todd Muller resigns as leader of the New Zealand National Party citing health and family reasons. A party caucus elects Judith Collins as the party's new leader.

Source citations (as archived): [Stuff](<https://www.stuff.co.nz/national/politics/300056130/todd-muller-resigns-as-leader-of-the-national-party>); [Stuff2](<https://www.stuff.co.nz/national/politics/300056981/judith-collins-the-new-leader-of-national-party-promises-to-crush-the-government>).

<a id="event-2020-07-14-6-7"></a>

Context: 2020 Belarusian presidential election.

**Archived source account.** The Belarusian election commission bars two prominent opposition candidates to current President Alexander Lukashenko from running in the election, ensuring a victory for Lukashenko. The barred candidates are Viktar Babaryka who was disqualified for an open criminal case against him and Valery Tsepkalo whose signatures on a supporting petition were nullified.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-belarus-election/two-main-challengers-to-belarus-president-barred-from-election-ballot-idUSKCN24F10W?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-07-14-6-9"></a>

Context: 2020 Hong Kong pro-democracy primaries.

**Archived source account.** Exit polls results show a strong support for young pro-democracy candidates, including independent activist Joshua Wong and League of Social Democrats candidate Jimmy Sham. A spokesperson for the Liaison Office of China in Hong Kong says that the election could be in violation of the new security law and could be nullified.

Source citations (as archived): [NHK-World](<https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/20200714_35/>).

<a id="event-2020-07-14-6-11"></a>

Context: International students in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The Trump administration reverses its student visa policy, announced on July 6, to deport international students whose courses move fully online. The plan met stiff opposition. At least 59 universities and the attorneys general of 18 states sued to block this directive. Federal district judge Allison Burroughs dismisses the first case brought to court as moot because the federal government has agreed to rescind the policy.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-53410285#>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2020/07/14/trump-ice-college-student-visa-rule-online-classes-fall-2020/5437654002/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-07-14-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** UK Digital Media minister Oliver Dowden announces to the House of Commons that the country's mobile providers will be barred from buying 5G equipment from Huawei starting December 31, and will be required to remove it from their networks by 2027. Lord Browne resigned from his position as chairman of Huawei's UK branch shortly before the announcement.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-53403793>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-07-15-6-2"></a>

Context: 2020 United States presidential election / Donald Trump 2020 presidential campaign.

<a id="event-2020-07-15-6-4"></a>

Context: 2020 North Macedonian parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** Voters in North Macedonia head to the polls to elect the members of the country's assembly. It is the first election after the country adopted its new name following a decade-long dispute. The election had to be postponed once due to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** Kuwait's 91-year-old Emir, Sabah Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah, is admitted to hospital for what aides described as "routine" medical tests. Crown Prince Nawaf Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah, the Emir's 83-year-old half-brother and designated successor, will temporarily carry out some of the Emir's duties.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-53459994>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/07/kuwait-sheikh-sabah-admitted-hospital-medical-checks-200718143551522.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2020-07-18-5-2"></a>

Context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports / 2020 Major League Baseball season, 2020 Toronto Blue Jays season, COVID-19 pandemic in Toronto.

**Archived source account.** The Government of Canada rejects an exemption for the Toronto Blue Jays to play their home games in Rogers Centre in Toronto.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<https://www.espn.com/mlb/story/_/id/29488579/blue-jays-not-allowed-play-games-canada>).

### 2020-07-19

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1083153786](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20July%2019&oldid=1083153786>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-07-19-0-1"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War; Libya-Sudan relations.

**Archived source account.** Sudanese forces arrest about 160 people on the border with Libya who were en-route to enter the neighboring country to operate as "mercenaries". A General for the Rapid Support Forces says that "sending Sudanese to fight in Libya as mercenaries is unacceptable".

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/middle-east/2020/07/19/Sudan-forces-arrest-160-mercenaries-en-route-to-Libya.html>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-07-19-1-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong.

**Archived source account.** Hong Kong records its highest one-day increase in cases since the pandemic began, with 108 new cases, including 83 local transmission cases and 25 imported cases.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-53462362>).

<a id="event-2020-07-19-1-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong.

**Archived source account.** Chief Executive Carrie Lam announces new measures including plans to make it compulsory to wear masks inside any public indoor venue and a new order for non-essential civil servants to work from home.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20200719-hong-kong-leader-says-coronavirus-critical-after-100-new-cases>).

<a id="event-2020-07-19-1-6"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia.

**Archived source account.** Indonesia reports its highest one-day increase in COVID-19 deaths and recoveries, with 127 new deaths bringing the nationwide death toll to 4,143, and 2,133 new recoveries bringing the nationwide number of recoveries to 45,401.

Source citations (as archived): [detikHealth](<https://health.detik.com/berita-detikhealth/d-5099704/2-rekor-corona-di-indonesia-pasien-sembuh-dan-meninggal-terbanyak-per-19-juli>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-indonesia-cases/indonesia-reports-1639-new-coronavirus-cases-and-127-deaths-idUSKCN24K0AX>).

<a id="event-2020-07-19-1-9"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in Texas.

**Archived source account.** Texas Governor Greg Abbott announces that five United States Navy teams would be deployed to hospitals in Harlingen, Del Rio, Eagle Pass, and Rio Grande City.

Source citations (as archived): [Texas Tribune](<https://www.texastribune.org/2020/07/19/texas-coronavirus-hot-spots-navy-rio-grande-valley/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-07-19-2-1"></a>

Context: Israel–European Union relations.

**Archived source account.** The Israeli government approves the subsea EastMed pipeline which will supply Europe with natural gas. The construction of the pipeline is expected to be completed by 2025, and will provide an estimated 10 billion cubic meters of gas per year.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-israel-europe-natgas/israel-approves-pipeline-deal-to-sell-gas-to-europe-idUKKCN24K0FJ?il=0>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-07-19-3-3"></a>

Context: George Floyd protests / George Floyd protests in Oregon / George Floyd protests in Portland.

**Archived source account.** Portland Mayor Ted Wheeler renews calls for federal troops to leave the city, accusing them of "using abusive tactics against protesters."

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-53466718>).

<a id="event-2020-07-19-3-5"></a>

Context: 2019–2020 Iranian protests, Capital punishment in Iran.

**Archived source account.** Iran halts the execution of three young men who were sentenced to death for taking part in anti-government protests last year. Their lawyer says a request for a new trial was accepted by the Supreme Court after a hashtag against their executions went viral.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-53463685>).

<a id="event-2020-07-19-3-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Algerian man in Antwerp, Belgium, dies after a police officer knelt on his back during an arrest outside a bar. The death was compared to that of George Floyd.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-53478230>).

<a id="event-2020-07-19-3-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Officials in Sierra Leone report that four protesters, looking to block the movement of a power generator to another town, were killed in the city of Makeni in Saturday's protests after both police and soldiers opened fire on them. The government had acknowledged "potential loss of life" but had not provided details.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-leone-protests/four-killed-in-sierra-leone-protest-after-police-and-army-open-fire-idUSKCN24K0GV?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-07-19-3-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** A shooting at the home of U.S. District Judge Esther Salas leaves her son dead and her husband injured. Salas herself is not injured. Law enforcement officials say the gunman was dressed in a FedEx uniform.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/fecbf88ebc2b33e35c291a43ad52939a>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/07/19/us/federal-judge-esther-salas-shooting-investigation/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-07-19-4-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Syrian parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** Syrians head to the polls to elect 250 seats of parliament. It is expected that President Bashar al-Assad and his party will win most seats. It is also the first time the elections are being held in areas formerly controlled by anti-Assad forces.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/syria-holds-parliamentary-elections-amid-new-sanctions-crippling-economy/a-54230462>).

<a id="event-2020-07-19-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Kuwait's ruler, Emir Sabah Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah, 91, undergoes successful surgery and medical treatment. Crown Prince Nawaf Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah, who is 83, temporarily assumes some of the powers and will maintain such powers until "the health event is over".

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/27604a5745ee5b6adfd23bf11c967476>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-07-19-5-1"></a>

Context: Emirates Mars Mission.

**Archived source account.** Mitsubishi Heavy Industries successfully launches Hope, a United Arab Emirates space probe to Mars, from Tanegashima Space Center in Japan. It is the first mission to Mars from the Arab world.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/uae-mars-mission-hope-spacecraft-japan-space-a9627481.html>).

### 2020-07-20

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1219268688](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20July%2020&oldid=1219268688>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-07-20-0-1"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War, Egypt–Libya relations.

**Archived source account.** In a closed-door session, the Parliament of Egypt authorizes the military to intervene in neighbouring Libya. President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi has said Sirte is a "red-line", and that any attack on the strategic Libyan city would prompt Egyptian military action.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/egypts-lawmakers-vote-deploying-troops-libya-71873091>).

<a id="event-2020-07-20-0-3"></a>

Context: Israeli involvement in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Syrian air defenses respond to a strike over Damascus attributed to Israel, state media reports, in the latest wave of attacks that Western intelligence sources have said were Israeli strikes on a major Iranian-backed ammunition depot on the edge of the capital. According to a Syrian military sources, at least seven soldiers were wounded in the attack which also inflicted "heavy material damage".

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/syria/.premium-israeli-strikes-target-iranian-backed-militias-near-damascus-report-says-1.9008241>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2020-07-20-1-2"></a>

Context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on cinema / Cinema of China, COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China, COVID-19 pandemic in Shanghai.

**Archived source account.** Cinemas in Shanghai and Chengdu reopen after a six-month closure.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-china-cinemas/cinemas-in-china-begin-to-reopen-after-six-month-coronavirus-closure-idUSKCN24L147>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-07-20-2-1"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Popular music magazine Q announces it is ceasing operations after 34 years in print amid an accelerated downturn in sales due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-bauer-media-group/uk-music-magazine-q-to-close-after-34-years-hurt-by-coronavirus-pandemic-idUKKCN24L2OX?il=0>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-07-20-3-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil.

**Archived source account.** Citizenship Minister Onyx Lorenzoni and Education Minister Milton Ribeiro test positive for COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-brazil-idUSKCN24L235>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-07-20-4-1"></a>

Context: European Union response to the COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** The EU meeting on a post-coronavirus recovery fund enters deadlock on its fourth day. Complicating matters, the group is also negotiating a deal for the bloc's next long-term budget. Today's early talks over a proposed €750bn ($857bn / £680bn) recovery package have reportedly been testy. Resumption is scheduled for 14:00 GMT.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-53468554>).

<a id="event-2020-07-20-4-3"></a>

Context: China–United Kingdom relations, Hong Kong–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** UK Foreign Minister Dominic Raab announces that the United Kingdom will "immediately and indefinitely" suspend its extradition treaty with Hong Kong over the controversial national security law.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-53476811>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-07-20-5-2"></a>

Context: George Floyd protests in the United States / George Floyd protests in Chicago.

**Archived source account.** Mayor Lori Lightfoot says she has "great concerns" about the possibility that President Donald Trump could deploy federal agents to Chicago to crack down on gun violence and protests, similar to an approach in Portland, Oregon. The Trump Administration will be sending 175 federal agents to Chicago to assist police in curbing violent crime.

Source citations (as archived): [WBBM-TV](<https://chicago.cbslocal.com/2020/07/20/mayor-lori-lightfoot-concerned-about-trump-possibly-deploying-federal-agents-in-chicago-thats-not-what-we-need/>).

<a id="event-2020-07-20-5-4"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in Iran.

**Archived source account.** Iranian Mahmoud Mousavi-Majd, convicted of spying for the United States and Israel and on the Revolutionary Guards commander, Qasem Soleimani, is executed by hanging in Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-53470950>).

<a id="event-2020-07-20-5-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police in Panama arrest a person linked to a mass shooting two days ago which resulted in six young people killed with gunshot wounds to the head. Investigators suspect that it was a targeted attack.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-53467067>).

<a id="event-2020-07-20-5-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Roy Den Hollander, a self-described antifeminist lawyer, is named as the attacker behind the shooting at the home of U.S. District Judge Esther Salas last night, which left her son dead and her husband critically injured. Den Hollander has been found dead at a home in Rockland, New York, and is also being investigated in connection to the earlier shooting death of a southern California lawyer.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2020/07/20/esther-salas-mark-anderl-shooting-new-jersey-home/5470802002/>); [The Daily Beast](<https://www.thedailybeast.com/gunman-ambushes-nj-federal-judge-esther-salas-husband-mark-anderl-and-son-at-home>); [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/suspect-shooting-death-federal-judge-s-son-found-dead-believed-n1234365>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-07-20-6-1"></a>

Context: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Georgia.

**Archived source account.** Democratic Party of Georgia Chair and State Senator Nikema Williams is selected by the party's Executive Committee to replace the name of the late incumbent John Lewis on the ballot for Georgia's 5th congressional district for the November 3 general election.

Source citations (as archived): [Atlanta Journal-Constitution](<https://www.ajc.com/politics/politics-blog/democrats-tap-nikema-williams-to-replace-john-lewis-on-november-ballot/KM475QUFGRBMXMHCHWJN56SNMA/>).

<a id="event-2020-07-20-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** King Salman of Saudi Arabia, 84, is admitted to a hospital due to an inflammation of the gall bladder. The hospitalization prompts Iraqi Prime Minister Mustafa Al-Kadhimi to cancel his scheduled visit to Saudi Arabia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-saudi-politics-king/saudi-king-salman-84-admitted-to-hospital-idUSKCN24L055>).

### 2020-07-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1358344194](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20July%2021&oldid=1358344194>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2020-07-21-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Heads of Christian Denominations (ZHOCD) churches meet with Zimbabwe's political leaders to discuss pressing issues affecting the country. The southern African nation of 14.3 million is 72% Protestant and 11% Catholic, with 15% adhering to ethnic religions.

Source citations (as archived): [Vatican News](<https://www.vaticannews.va/en/africa/news/2020-07/zimbabwe-churches-mediate-between-government-and-opposition.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-07-21-1-1"></a>

Context: Greece–Turkey relations.

**Archived source account.** Greece accuses Turkey of encroaching on its territorial waters after a NAVTEX was issued by the Turkish Naval Forces for "seismic surveys" off Greek islands in the Mediterranean Sea between Cyprus and Crete from July 21 to August 2.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-greece-turkey/greece-says-turkish-plans-to-map-sea-encroach-on-its-territory-idUSKCN24M2FV>).

<a id="event-2020-07-21-1-2"></a>

Context: Greece–Turkey relations.

**Archived source account.** The government places the Hellenic Armed Forces on high alert after Turkish Air Force fighter jets entered Greek airspace over Strongyli Megistis.

Source citations (as archived): [Ekathimerini](<https://www.ekathimerini.com/254951/article/ekathimerini/news/armed-forces-on-alert-over-turkish-exploration-off-kastellorizo>).

<a id="event-2020-07-21-1-4"></a>

Context: Iran–Iraq relations.

**Archived source account.** Iraqi Prime Minister Mustafa Al-Kadhimi meets Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei and President of Iran Hassan Rouhani where he says that "Iraq is a country that won’t allow any aggression or challenge to Iran from its territory", in the first trip abroad by Kadhimi.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-iraq/iraq-pm-on-tehran-visit-says-wont-allow-threats-to-iran-from-iraqi-soil-idUSKCN24M1E9?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-07-21-1-6"></a>

Context: Taiwan–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** Oxford City Council overwhelmingly passes a motion to establish sister city relationships with an as-yet-undetermined Taiwanese city due to Taiwan's strong human rights record and success at keeping the COVID-19 pandemic under control. This will be Taiwan and the UK's first sister city relationship and the first sister city in East Asia for Oxford.

Source citations (as archived): [Taiwan News](<https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/en/news/3970904>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-07-21-2-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Sudanese Revolution.

**Archived source account.** Sudan's former president Omar al-Bashir goes on trial for several charges, including fomenting a coup in 1989 that overthrew the government of Sadiq al-Mahdi. The trial is adjourned to a bigger courtroom. If convicted, 76-year-old al-Bashir could face the death penalty.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/07/sudan-bashir-trial-1989-coup-brought-power-200721072640425.html>).

<a id="event-2020-07-21-2-3"></a>

Context: Lutsk hostage crisis.

**Archived source account.** A gunman carrying explosives takes 16 people hostage aboard a public bus in Lutsk, Ukraine. Police said they identified the man, who had expressed frustrations with the Ukrainian system on social media. All the hostages are freed unharmed following the gunman's surrender to police after hours of negotiations, shortly before the President Volodymyr Zelensky gave into one of the gunman's demands and posted a video on Facebook saying, "Everyone should watch the 2005 film Earthlings."

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/9f60460ff774acb4a40a0c5198bd072c>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-53489527>).

<a id="event-2020-07-21-2-5"></a>

Context: Censorship in Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** Pakistan blocks Bigo Live and threatens a similar move with the app TikTok over "immoral, obscene and vulgar" content. The Pakistan Telecommunications Authority says in a statement that the two platforms could have "extremely negative effects on the society in general and youth in particular", without elaborating.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/2da0cf781bd4ecc15ef060f1e91ee5bf>).

<a id="event-2020-07-21-2-7"></a>

Context: Corruption in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Ohio House Speaker Larry Householder is arrested for bribery.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/powerful-ohio-lawmaker-arrested-following-fbi-raid-his-farm-n1234469>).

<a id="event-2020-07-21-2-9"></a>

Context: List of mass shootings in the United States in 2020.

**Archived source account.** Fifteen people are injured, six seriously, in a mass shooting at a funeral home in Chicago, Illinois. One person is in custody, but a motive remains unclear.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/fourteen-injured-shootout-chicago-funeral-city-reels-surge-gun-violence-n1234547>).

<a id="event-2020-07-21-2-11"></a>

Context: Islam in Germany.

**Archived source account.** The Landtag of Baden-Württemberg announces a full ban on face coverings in schools, including burqas and niqabs worn by Muslims. Previously, the ban only applied to teachers in Baden-Württemberg. Minister-President Winfried Kretschmann says that full-face veiling "does not belong in a free society".

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/german-state-bans-burqas-in-schools/a-54256541>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-07-21-3-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Bulgarian protests.

**Archived source account.** The government survives a motion of no confidence by 124 votes against, 102 votes in favour, amidst ongoing large-scale anti-government protests.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bulgaria-government/bulgarias-government-survives-no-confidence-vote-over-corruption-idUSKCN24M0ZJ>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-07-21-4-1"></a>

Context: Twitter suspensions.

**Archived source account.** Twitter bans 7,000 accounts and places restrictions on a further 150,000 that promote QAnon-related content. The social media site also announces that terms connected to the conspiracy theory will be barred from appearing on its trending topics and search feature.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/tech/tech-news/twitter-bans-7-000-qanon-accounts-limits-150-000-others-n1234541>).

### 2020-07-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1083156815](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20July%2022&oldid=1083156815>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-07-22-0-1"></a>

Context: Israeli involvement in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A Hezbollah militiaman is killed by an Israeli airstrike, apparently on Monday night, near Damascus International Airport, Syria, the group reports. It is their first casualty since they warned that if it suffered further killings, they would retaliate.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-hezbollah/hezbollah-fighter-killed-in-israeli-strike-near-damascus-death-notice-idUSKCN24N0YE>).

<a id="event-2020-07-22-0-3"></a>

Context: Papua conflict.

**Archived source account.** Indonesian security forces deny that two people they killed late last week were "innocent civilians". The Indonesian military is fighting the separatist West Papua Liberation Army in the region, which reported that the two killed were shot without provocation.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/421754/indonesian-military-denies-shooting-civillians-in-papua>).

<a id="event-2020-07-22-0-5"></a>

Context: Kurdish–Turkish conflict, Operations Claw-Eagle and Tiger.

**Archived source account.** Turkish troops have now advanced 40 km inside northern Iraq and established over 30 "temporary bases" in its ongoing military offensive against the Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK), according to a Turkish official. An unnamed Turkish official tells Reuters the unprecedented advance is a prelude to an assault on the Qandil Mountains, the PKK's main stronghold in Iraq.

Source citations (as archived): [Ahval News](<https://ahvalnews.com/operation-claw-tiger/turkish-offensive-north-iraq-extends-beyond-usual-anti-pkk-campaign-analysts>).

<a id="event-2020-07-22-0-7"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** ISWAP releases a video showing the execution of five kidnapped aid workers in Nigeria. The International Rescue Committee and Action Against Hunger confirmed the authenticity of the video and condemned the killings of their colleagues.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/africa/nigeria-president-says-islamic-militants-kill-5-aid-workers/2020/07/22/41392914-cc62-11ea-99b0-8426e26d203b_story.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2020-07-22-1-1"></a>

Context: Removal of Confederate monuments and memorials.

**Archived source account.** The United States House of Representatives votes on a bill to remove Confederate statues from the United States Capitol, as well as replacing the bust of Chief Justice Roger B. Taney with Associate Justice Thurgood Marshall.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/07/22/politics/house-confederate-statues-vote/index.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-07-22-2-1"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** South Korea's economy enters recession after exports plunge to their lowest levels since 1963.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-southkorea-economy-gdp/south-korea-enters-recession-as-exports-plunge-by-most-since-1963-idUKKCN24O005?il=0>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-07-22-3-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Atlantic hurricane season, 2020 Pacific hurricane season.

**Archived source account.** Two tropical storms, one in the Atlantic Ocean (Gonzalo) and the other in the Pacific (Douglas), are expected to become hurricanes Thursday. Gonzalo, with maximum sustained winds of 50 mph, is east of Barbados in the Windward Islands, moving toward the west near 12 mph (19 km/h), leading Barbados to issue a Hurricane watch. Douglas's maximum sustained winds have increased to near 100 mph (155 km/h), and landfall on Hawaii is expected Sunday.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2020/07/22/tropical-storm-gonzalo-forms-atlantic-likely-hurricane/5486024002/>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/weather/2020/07/22/hurricane-douglas-hawaii/>).

<a id="event-2020-07-22-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Floods in Vietnam's Hà Giang province result in at least five deaths and damage more than 2,800 houses.

Source citations (as archived): [VnExpress](<https://e.vnexpress.net/news/news/floods-landslides-kill-five-in-northern-vietnam-4133776.html>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-07-22-4-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Japan.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-07-22-5-1"></a>

Context: China–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States orders the closure of China's consulate in Houston. Morgan Ortagus, the spokeswoman for the U.S. Department of State, says that the United States directed the consulate's closure "in order to protect American intellectual property and Americans' private information". The Chinese government condemns the "outrageous and unjustified" move and threatens countermeasures against the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/07/orders-closure-china-consulate-houston-200722090154988.html>).

<a id="event-2020-07-22-5-3"></a>

Context: Canada–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** A Canadian federal court rules the Canada–United States Safe Third Country Agreement to be invalid, saying it violates the Charter of Rights and Freedom by making the country complicit in the United States's abuses of asylum seekers in detention. The ruling goes into effect within six months to give Parliament time to respond.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-canada-refugee-safethird/canadian-court-rules-invalid-safe-third-country-pact-with-u-s-idUSKCN24N2B2?il=0>).

The mayors of Portland, Seattle, Washington, D.C., Chicago, Atlanta and Kansas City pen a letter to Barr and acting Secretary of Homeland Security Chad Wolf expressing "deep concern and objection to the deployment of federal forces in our cities".

Source citations (as archived): [Forbes](<https://www.forbes.com/sites/andrewsolender/2020/07/22/trump-announces-federal-law-enforcement-surge-in-cities-with-high-crime-rates/>).

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/derek-chauvin-and-wife-face-felony-tax-fraud-charges/>).

<a id="event-2020-07-22-6-6"></a>

Context: Protests over responses to the COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Israel, Corruption in Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/gallery/2020/jul/22/israelis-protest-against-netanyahu-in-jerusalem-in-pictures>).

<a id="event-2020-07-22-6-8"></a>

Context: 2020 Piacenza scandal; Police brutality in Italy.

**Archived source account.** Seven Carabinieri are arrested in Piacenza, Italy, after being accused of drug trafficking, receiving stolen goods, extortion, illegal arrest, torture, grievous bodily harm, embezzlement, abuse of office and fraud. The "leader" of the group, officer Montella, arrested and charged people with fake proof of crimes that the detainees never committed.

Source citations (as archived): [Corriere della Sera](<https://www.corriere.it/cronache/20_luglio_27/piacenza-carabinieri-arrestati-maresciallo-orlando-sentito-gip-in-30-anni-non-mai-avuta-sanzione-f9929098-cff2-11ea-b6b4-c1fd88d9cdd9.shtml>).

<a id="event-2020-07-22-6-9"></a>

They were sentenced with 13 other refugees to seven months in jail and caning last month for illegally entering the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-rohingya-malaysia/malaysia-spares-rohingya-refugees-from-caning-idUSKCN24N0NT?il=0>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-07-23-4-3"></a>

Context: Killing of George Floyd / George Floyd protests / George Floyd protests in Portland, Oregon.

**Archived source account.** Portland Mayor Ted Wheeler is tear-gassed in the city's downtown, according to video from a New York Times journalist. The video shows Wheeler, wearing goggles and a face mask amid a crowd of people, holding his nose and closing his eyes in distress as a cloud of tear gas drifts by him. It is unknown at this time who is responsible for deploying the tear gas and there is nothing to indicate the mayor was targeted.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/07/23/us/portland-protests-mayor/index.html>).

Context: Killing of George Floyd / Police reform in the United States.

<a id="event-2020-07-23-4-8"></a>

Context: 2019 Samoa assassination plot.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of Samoa denies a bid by two of the three defendants in the case to be able to return to Australia, where they have permanent residencies. The Court argued that, aside of the lockdown due to the COVID-19 pandemic, "no amount of surety bond would overcome the risk of the men not returning for their trial", which is set for November.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/421805/samoa-assassination-plot-accused-denied-australian-return>).

<a id="event-2020-07-23-4-10"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Israel.

**Archived source account.** Israeli MPs pass a bill to begin the process to outlaw conversion therapy, being the first Middle Eastern country to do so. The bill was passed as two of the main coalition parties joined the opposition in supporting it. It must pass two more approvals to become a new law.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-53511329>).

<a id="event-2020-07-23-6-1"></a>

Context: Censorship in Malaysia.

**Archived source account.** Malaysian Communications Minister Saifuddin Abdullah retracts his announcement yesterday that video producers on social media would require a license per the 1981 National Film Development Corporation of Malaysia (FINAS) Act, following public outcry. The initial proposal was made following the government's dispute with Al Jazeera over a documentary concerning the discrimination migrant workers faced in the country during the COVID-19 pandemic.

<a id="event-2020-07-23-6-4"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/science/space/china-launches-ambitious-attempt-land-rover-mars-rcna59>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-07-24-0-1"></a>

Context: Iraqi insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Four Katyusha rockets hit the Besmaya Range Complex in Baghdad, Iraq, where Spanish coalition troops are stationed, causing material damage but no casualties, according to the Iraqi military. No group has claimed responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-security/rockets-hit-military-base-south-of-baghdad-no-casualties-military-idUSKCN24P2CQ?il=0>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2020-07-24-1-2"></a>

Context: George Floyd protests / George Floyd protests in Chicago, List of monuments and memorials removed during the George Floyd protests.

**Archived source account.** Two statues of Christopher Columbus are removed from Chicago's Grant Park and Arrigo Park, in the city's Little Italy. Chicago mayor Lori Lightfoot said these temporary removals are a response to demonstrations that became unsafe for both protesters and police. Injuries and arrests resulted when, on July 17, police clashed with protesters who attempted to topple the Grant Park statue. Activists say that monuments of Columbus, blamed for the genocide and exploitation of the Americas' Indigenous people, should not be on public display. Chicago's Fraternal Order of Police criticized these removals.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-53530752>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2020/07/24/us/christopher-columbus-chicago.html>).

<a id="event-2020-07-24-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Muslims hold their first Friday prayers in the historic Hagia Sophia in Istanbul, Turkey, for the first time since the government annulled the 1934 decision to establish it as a museum, and reclassified the building as a mosque.

Source citations (as archived): [Hurriyet Daily News](<https://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/first-friday-prayers-held-in-hagia-sophia-after-mosque-reconversion-156812>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Spain.

**Archived source account.** Spain reports its highest daily rise of cases since the end of the state of emergency with 971 new infected cases.

Source citations (as archived): [El País](<https://english.elpais.com/society/2020-07-24/spain-records-highest-daily-rise-in-coronavirus-cases-since-may-8.html>).

<a id="event-2020-07-24-2-10"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** The World Health Organization reports a record increase in global COVID-19 cases with 284,196 new cases in last 24 hours. United States and Brazil account for almost half the total.

Source citations (as archived): [France24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20200724-who-reports-record-single-day-increase-in-global-coronavirus-cases>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-07-24-3-1"></a>

Context: China–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** China orders the closure of the United States Consulate in Chengdu, in retaliation for the United States closure of the Chinese consulate in Houston, Texas.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-53522640>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-07-24-4-2"></a>

Context: George Floyd protests / George Floyd protests in Portland.

**Archived source account.** Eighteen protestors are charged in Portland, Oregon, after the Trump administration sent federal police forces into the city last week. The protesters are charged with crimes such as assaulting police, arson, and trespassing.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-global-race-protests/u-s-charges-18-portland-protesters-as-it-sends-tactical-police-to-seattle-idUSKCN24P246?feedType=mktg&amp;feedName=topNews&amp;WT.mc_id=Partner-Google>).

<a id="event-2020-07-24-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Vietnam bans the import of wildlife and wildlife products in an effort to prevent new pandemics.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-53525954>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-07-24-5-2"></a>

Context: 2020 United States presidential election / 2020 United States presidential election in Arizona.

**Archived source account.** The headquarters of the Arizona Democratic Party are burnt down in the early hours of 24 July in an apparent arson attack, according to Phoenix Police Department. Nobody was hurt in the attack. The attack comes in the wake of several opinion polls showing Democratic Party presidential nominee Joe Biden as leading against his opponent, Republican Party presidential nominee Donald Trump in the state.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/elections/2020/07/24/fire-damages-arizona-democratic-party-headquarters/5507493002/>).

<a id="event-2020-07-24-5-5"></a>

Context: George Floyd protests / George Floyd protests in Portland.

**Archived source account.** A "Wall of Vets" join the front lines of the city's growing protests to support the rights of the protesters, to counter the demonstrators' "violent anarchists" label, and to support Navy veteran Christopher J. David, who, on Monday, was struck by federal officers as he approached them to ask a question. A "Wall of Moms" in yellow shirts and a "Wall of Dads" in orange shirts line up behind the vets, who stayed together until a cloud of tear gas scattered much of the crowd.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2020/07/25/us/a-wall-of-vets-joins-the-front-lines-of-portland-protests.html?action=click&amp;module=Top%20Stories&amp;pgtype=Homepage>); [(The New York Times)²](<https://www.nytimes.com/2020/07/20/us/portland-protests-navy-christopher-david.html>).

<a id="event-2020-07-24-5-7"></a>

Context: 2020 Belarusian presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Prominent opposition leader Valery Tsepkalo and his two sons flee to Russia after being barred from running in the election and alleged threats of prosecution by the prosecutor's office, which declined to comment on Tsepkalo's escape.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-belarus-election/belarus-opposition-leader-flees-abroad-with-two-sons-ahead-of-election-idUSKCN24P1MV?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-07-24-5-9"></a>

Context: 2020 Thai protests.

**Archived source account.** In continuing protests across the country, young Thai activists burn images of Prime Minister Prayut Chan-o-cha and his deputy, Prawit Wongsuwan, outside the government house in growing calls for their resignations.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-thailand-protests/thai-youths-burn-image-of-pm-as-resignation-calls-grow-idUSKCN24P1JA?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-07-24-5-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** Roughly half of the staff of index.hu, Hungary's biggest news site, resign in protest of the firing of the editor-in-chief last week. The termination happened months after 50% of the site's advertising was purchased by media executive Miklos Vaszily, who has close ties to Prime Minister Viktor Orbán.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2020/07/24/world/europe/hungary-poland-media-freedom-index.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-07-24-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Facebook and Twitter remove, on order of the Supreme Federal Court, numerous accounts that support Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro for promoting fake news. The Brazilian Labour Party, a member of the ruling coalition, condemns Justice Alexandre de Moraes for issuing the order.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-fakenews/facebook-twitter-remove-accounts-of-bolsonaro-supporters-following-court-order-idUSKCN24Q009?il=0>).

### 2020-07-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087457901](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20July%2025&oldid=1087457901>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-07-25-0-2"></a>

Context: War in Darfur / 2020 Darfur attacks.

**Archived source account.** At least 20 people are killed and 22 others wounded in a mass shooting in a village in South Darfur, Sudan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://ca.reuters.com/article/topNews/idCAKCN24Q0JJ>).

<a id="event-2020-07-25-0-4"></a>

Context: American-led intervention in Iraq (2014–2021).

**Archived source account.** CJTF–OIR hands over control of Besmaya Range Complex in Baghdad Governorate, which houses Spanish troops, to Iraqi security forces. It is the seventh military base to be handed over to Iraqi forces since the beginning of the withdrawal of U.S. and coalition troops.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2020-07/25/c_139239948.htm>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-07-25-1-2"></a>

Context: 2020 Atlantic hurricane season / Hurricane Hanna.

**Archived source account.** Tropical Storm Hanna is upgraded to a hurricane and heads toward the Texas coast, threatening to bring heavy rain, storm surge and possible tornadoes. Hanna is reported as the first hurricane of the 2020 Atlantic hurricane season by the U.S. National Hurricane Center.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/9ad8058b3e666cf8b3f93b7ceb2ee1c4>).

<a id="event-2020-07-25-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed when a microlight aircraft crashes into a home in Wesel, NRW, Germany.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-53539010>).

<a id="event-2020-07-25-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four people are killed when a small plane crashes in Blatten, Valais, Switzerland.

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-07-25-2-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong.

**Archived source account.** Hong Kong reports a record of 133 new cases of COVID-19 for the fourth consecutive day, as well as two deaths. 126 of these cases are locally transmitted.

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/health-environment/article/3094681/hong-kong-third-wave-elderly-man-becomes-citys>).

<a id="event-2020-07-25-2-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea.

**Archived source account.** South Korea reports 113 new cases of COVID-19. This is the largest one-day increase since March. Of these new cases, 86 were imported and 27 were locally transmitted.

Source citations (as archived): [The Japan Times](<https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2020/07/25/asia-pacific/south-korea-reports-113-coronavirus/>).

<a id="event-2020-07-25-2-7"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Vietnam.

**Archived source account.** Vietnam confirms its first case of COVID-19 community transmission in 100 days. A patient is a 57-year-old man in Da Nang who had no prior contact with any known cases.

Source citations (as archived): [VnExpress](<https://e.vnexpress.net/news/news/vietnam-confirms-first-case-of-COVID-19-community-transmission-in-100-days-4135963.html>).

<a id="event-2020-07-25-2-9"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Qatar.

**Archived source account.** Retired footballer and current coach of Al Sadd SC Xavi Hernández announces he tested positive for COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [Forbes](<https://www.forbes.com/sites/tomsanderson/2020/07/25/fc-barcelona-legend-xavi-tests-positive-for-covid-19/>).

<a id="event-2020-07-25-2-11"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in North Korea.

**Archived source account.** Kim Jong-un convenes an emergency meeting of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, declares a state of emergency, and orders the lockdown of Kaesong after a person suspected of having COVID-19 returned from South Korea, after illegally crossing the DMZ. If confirmed, it would be the first time a case of COVID-19 has been officially acknowledged by North Korea.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-northkorea-idUSKCN24Q0TC>).

<a id="event-2020-07-25-2-14"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in Florida.

**Archived source account.** Florida surpasses New York, once the epicenter of the pandemic, to hold the second highest number of COVID-19 cases in the United States, with a total 414,511 confirmed cases.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/07/25/health/us-coronavirus-saturday/index.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-07-25-3-2"></a>

Context: George Floyd protests / George Floyd protests in Seattle.

**Archived source account.** Forty-five people are arrested after protesters throw explosives and rocks at police in Seattle. Other rioters set fire to a portable trailer and a construction site, police allege in a series of tweets. Twenty-one officers were injured, including one who was hospitalized with a leg injury caused by an explosive.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/07/25/us/seattle-protest-riot/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-07-25-3-4"></a>

Context: George Floyd protests / George Floyd protests in Texas.

**Archived source account.** During an evening protest in Austin, Texas, a man is fatally shot as he approached a vehicle and the driver inside opened fire. A police spokesperson says the victim may have been carrying a rifle. She added that the suspect was detained and is cooperating with police.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.dallasnews.com/news/texas/2020/07/26/man-fatally-shot-at-protest-in-austin/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-07-25-4-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Central African Republic general election.

**Archived source account.** Deposed president François Bozizé announces his bid for the presidency, despite being the subject of sanctions by the United Nations and an arrest warrant, issued by the current government, for alleged crimes against humanity. The Central African Republic has been in a civil war between Muslims and Christians since he was deposed in 2013. It is not known whether the charges against him will play a role in his candidacy.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-centralafrica-vote-bozize/deposed-central-african-republic-leader-announces-presidential-bid-idUSKCN24Q0O4?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-07-25-4-3"></a>

Context: 2020 Thai protests, LGBT rights in Thailand.

**Archived source account.** An LGBT group gathers at the Democracy Monument, Bangkok, to call for legalization of same-sex marriage in addition to the three demands stated by Free Youths.

Source citations (as archived): [Prachatai](<https://prachatai.com/journal/2020/07/88756>).

<a id="event-2020-07-25-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Parliament of Somalia conducts a no-confidence vote of 170–8 to oust Prime Minister Hassan Ali Khaire.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-somalia-politics/somalias-parliament-votes-to-oust-pm-hassan-ali-khaire-idUSKCN24Q0EW?il=0>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-07-25-5-1"></a>

Context: Global warming.

**Archived source account.** A record high temperature of 21.7°C (71.1°F) is recorded on the Arctic archipelago of Svalbard, according to the Norwegian Meteorological Institute.

Source citations (as archived): [Global News](<https://globalnews.ca/news/7217861/norway-arctic-archipelago-warming/>).

### 2020-07-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1104626586](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20July%2026&oldid=1104626586>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-07-26-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** A bombing at an outdoor market in Ras al-Ayn, al-Hasakah, Syria, kills at least eight people and injures 19 others. Turkey, which occupies the border town, blames Kurdish insurgents for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/82d059b11be6a4e824be065420c80969>).

<a id="event-2020-07-26-0-3"></a>

Context: Afghan peace process.

**Archived source account.** The Taliban accuse the government of re-capturing freed Taliban prisoners, a claim Kabul denies as "incorrect". A Taliban spokesman tells the government to "bear responsibility for the consequences", as fears grow that some of the prisoners are returning to the battlefield. As part of the peace process, the government has freed around 5,000 prisoners.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/taliban-accuse-kabul-of-re-arresting-freed-insurgents-12964490>).

<a id="event-2020-07-26-0-5"></a>

Context: War in Donbass.

**Archived source account.** The government of Ukraine concludes a ceasefire deal with rebel forces, which will begin at midnight. The conflict in Eastern Ukraine has been going on since 2014, and has killed over 14,000 people.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/a8880b415ff024cbf353c8d1a88dec17>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-07-26-1-2"></a>

Context: 2020 Atlantic hurricane season / Hurricane Hanna.

**Archived source account.** Hurricane Hanna weakens to a tropical depression after making landfall in southern Texas and northern Mexico.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/07/26/weather/tropical-storm-hanna-texas-hurricane-douglas/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-07-26-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two adults and a baby are killed when a Piper PA-32 crashes in West Jordan, Utah. Four other people are injured, three critically.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/07/26/us/utah-plane-crash-backyard-trnd/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-07-26-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Malaysia launches a search and rescue operation as 24 Rohingya are feared dead off the coast of Langkawi. According to the authorities, the people tried to swim to the coast when their boats could not make it to land.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-rohingya-malaysia/twenty-four-rohingya-feared-drowned-off-malaysian-resort-island-idUSKCN24R0BP>).

<a id="event-2020-07-26-1-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 15 people are dead and 21 others injured in a bus accident near Phong Nha, Quảng Bình Province, Vietnam. Some local officials said that the driver had possibly lost control when making a turn.

Source citations (as archived): [VnExpress](<https://e.vnexpress.net/news/news/15-dead-in-central-vietnam-as-reunion-trip-ends-in-tragedy-4136319.html>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-07-26-2-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Vietnam.

**Archived source account.** Da Nang becomes Vietnam's first province or centrally governed city to reinstate social distancing measures after two new local infection COVID-19 cases with unknown source of transmission.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-vietnam/vietnamese-city-reimposes-distancing-after-first-local-infections-in-months-idUSKCN24R07C>).

<a id="event-2020-07-26-2-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in North Korea.

**Archived source account.** North Korea declares a state of emergency after its first case of COVID-19 is confirmed. The government claims the patient defected to South Korea then returned to North Korea.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Beast](<https://www.thedailybeast.com/kim-jong-un-finally-admits-coronavirus-is-in-north-korea>).

<a id="event-2020-07-26-2-7"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Australia.

**Archived source account.** Australia reports its deadliest day since COVID-19 pandemic hit the country, with 10 new deaths in the last 24 hours; all of them in Victoria, which also reports its highest one day increase of new deaths.

Source citations (as archived): [The Age](<https://www.theage.com.au/national/victoria/victoria-s-deadliest-covid-19-day-state-records-459-new-cases-and-ten-deaths-20200726-p55fik.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-07-26-3-1"></a>

Context: George Floyd protests in Australia.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of New South Wales grants the New South Wales Police permission to block a Black Lives Matter protest in Sydney that is due to be held on July 28. The Supreme Court ruled that the rally is a prohibited public assembly, but police agreed to a stay stopping the order taking effect until 10am on July 27 pending the lodging of any appeal.

Source citations (as archived): [The Sydney Morning Herald](<https://www.smh.com.au/national/nsw/supreme-court-grants-prohibition-order-over-sydney-black-lives-matter-protest-20200725-p55fhe.html>).

<a id="event-2020-07-26-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** French police arrest a 39-year-old Rwandan refugee who is charged with arson after he admitted setting fires inside Nantes Cathedral on July 18, which destroyed the 17th-century grand organ and stained-glass windows.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-53542936>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-07-26-4-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Thai protests.

**Archived source account.** An event called "Let's run, Hamtaro" is organised at the Democracy Monument in Bangkok. It was initially an online activism, later spread via Twitter, and eventually gathered around 3,000 people. The event consisted of running around the monument whilst singing a jingle from Hamtaro, a famous Japanese cartoon, with some amendments to the lyrics as a satire to political corruption. The well-known lyrics from Hamtaro; "the most yummy things of all are... sunflower seeds\!", was amended into a satire "the most yummy things of all are... citizens' taxes\!".

Source citations (as archived): [Thairath](<https://www.thairath.co.th/news/politic/1897705>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-thailand-protests/delicious-taxes-thai-protesters-use-japanese-cartoon-hamster-to-mock-government-idUSKCN24R0ID?feedType=mktg&amp;feedName=topNews&amp;WT.mc_id=Partner-Google>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2020-07-26-5-1"></a>

Context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on association football, 2020 V.League 1.

**Archived source account.** The Vietnamese national football league becomes the first in the world to be postponed for a second time due to COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [VnExpress](<https://vnexpress.net/tam-dung-v-league-2020-4136374.html>).

### 2020-07-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1302693459](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20July%2027&oldid=1302693459>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-07-27-0-2"></a>

Context: War in Darfur / 2020 Darfur attacks.

**Archived source account.** The UN says approximately 500 gunmen attacked a Masalit community in West Darfur, looting, burning down houses, and killing more than 60 people.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/more-than-60-killed-in-fresh-attacks-in-sudans-darfur-region/a-54325767>).

<a id="event-2020-07-27-0-4"></a>

Context: 2020 Israel–Hezbollah clashes.

**Archived source account.** Explosions and exchanges of fire are heard during an armed incident involving Israeli troops and Hezbollah at the border between Israel and Lebanon. Four Hezbollah militants crossed the border and fled back to Lebanon after being shot at, while IDF reported no Israeli casualties. An Israeli shell smashed in a Lebanese civilian home, narrowly missing a family in the house at the time, but nobody was hurt.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/reuters/2020/07/27/world/middleeast/27reuters-israel-lebanon.html?searchResultPosition=4>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-lebanon/netanyahu-warns-hezbollah-against-playing-with-fire-after-frontier-incident-idUSKCN24S1KN?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-07-27-0-6"></a>

Context: 2019–2021 Iraqi protests.

**Archived source account.** Two protesters in Baghdad are killed by Iraqi security forces when they are hit by teargas canisters in the head and on the neck; the forces also opened fire at demonstrators in Tahrir Square. The protesters were protesting power cuts in the midst of a heatwave. It was the first major spate of violence at the Square in months. Prime Minister Mustafa Al-Kadhimi condemns the killings and orders an investigation.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-protests/two-protesters-die-after-clashes-with-police-in-baghdad-medics-security-sources-idUSKCN24S1FA?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-07-27-0-8"></a>

Context: Mali War.

**Archived source account.** ECOWAS demands the release of Malian opposition leader Soumaila Cissé, who was kidnapped in March just days before a disputed election, asks 31 elected MPs whose results were disputed to resign, and requests an urgent inquiry into protesters' deaths on 10–12 July. President Ibrahim Boubacar Keïta is given ten days to respond to the bloc's proposals or face sanctions.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-53556636>).

<a id="event-2020-07-27-0-10"></a>

Context: War in Donbass.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine's military says pro-Russian separatists have violated a ceasefire in Eastern Ukraine just hours after it was declared, after opening fire on Ukrainian positions with anti-tank grenade launchers and small arms. Ukrainian forces did not return fire.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://reuters.com/article/uk-ukraine-crisis-ceasefire/ukraine-says-separatists-violated-ceasefire-within-hours-idUKKCN24S11M>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2020-07-27-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Musician Drake breaks the record for the most top ten hits on the Billboard Hot 100, surpassing Madonna.

Source citations (as archived): [Billboard](<https://www.billboard.com/articles/business/chart-beat/9425101/drake-record-hot-100-top-10-hits-popstar-greece>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-07-27-2-1"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** The price of gold hits a record high of US$1,944 per ounce as uncertainty over the global economy grows due to a resurgence in COVID-19 cases. The previous record was set in 2011 when prices hit US$1,921 per ounce.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/07/27/investing/gold-price-record-high/index.html>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-07-27-3-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in China / COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong.

**Archived source account.** Hong Kong announces a ban on all dine-in services at restaurants and restricting public gatherings not from the same family to only two people starting 29 July and orders the compulsory wearing of masks in outdoor public areas, with only medical exemptions. Sports venues and swimming pools are also closed.

Source citations (as archived): [Bisnis Indonesia](<https://traveling.bisnis.com/read/20200727/223/1271596/kasus-covid-19-masuk-periode-kritis-hong-kong-larang-total-makan-di-restoran>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-07-27/hong-kong-to-ban-dining-in-require-masks-outside-cable-tv-says>).

<a id="event-2020-07-27-3-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in China / COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong.

**Archived source account.** Hong Kong reports a record 145 cases of COVID-19; 142 of them are locally transmitted.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/healthcoronavirus-hongkong-cases/hong-kong-records-145-cases-of-coronavirus-new-daily-high-idUSP8N2BE01D>).

<a id="event-2020-07-27-3-7"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in China / COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China.

**Archived source account.** China reports 61 new cases, up from 46 cases a day earlier, with new infections not involving people returning from overseas hitting the highest number since early March of 57.

Source citations (as archived): [U.S. News &amp; World Report](<https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2020-07-26/china-reports-61-new-covid-19-cases-for-sunday-highest-daily-domestic-infections-since-march-6>).

<a id="event-2020-07-27-3-9"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in India.

**Archived source account.** India reports 50,362 new cases of COVID-19 in the last 24 hours. This is the highest one day increase since the pandemic hit the country and the first time daily new cases in India crossed 50,000 mark.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of India](<https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/record-50000-new-covid-cases-on-sunday-5000-deaths-in-7-days/articleshow/77188842.cms>).

<a id="event-2020-07-27-3-11"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia.
