Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania.

**Archived source account.** Samoa extends the state of emergency until September 27. Prime Minister Tuilaepa Aiono Sailele Malielegaoi says he fears the practice of congregating in large numbers would likely see the virus entering the (at this time) COVID-19-free country.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/424761/samoa-extends-state-of-emergency>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-08-29-3-1"></a>

Context: Israel–United Arab Emirates peace agreement, Israel–United Arab Emirates relations.

**Archived source account.** Khalifa bin Zayed Al Nahyan of the United Arab Emirates issues a decree abolishing a law that mandated an economic boycott on Israel following the approval of the historic peace deal between the two countries. On the Israeli side, the first El Al commercial flight from Israel to the UAE is expected on Monday.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya English](<https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/gulf/2020/08/29/UAE-abolishes-Israel-boycott-law-allows-commercial-deals-with-Israelis-.html>).

<a id="event-2020-08-29-3-3"></a>

Context: Azerbaijan–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** A senior advisor to Azerbaijani President Ilham Aliyev accuses Russia of arming Armenia since the start of the recent border clashes.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-azerbaijan-armenia-russia/azerbaijan-accuses-moscow-of-arming-armenia-since-july-clashes-idUSKBN25P0L4?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-08-29-3-5"></a>

Context: Czech Republic–Taiwan relations, China–Czech Republic relations, One-China policy.

**Archived source account.** Czech Senate President Miloš Vystrčil travels to Taiwan on an official visit to promote business links between the two countries, despite the Czech Republic maintaining unofficial relations with Taiwan as it recognizes the One-China policy of the People's Republic of China (PRC). In response to the visit, the PRC's foreign ministry warns the Czech government of "possible consequences" for Czech companies with operations in mainland China.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-taiwan-czech/czech-senate-speaker-leaves-for-taiwan-visit-angering-china-idUSKBN25P0LE>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-08-29-4-1"></a>

Context: Protests over responses to the COVID-19 pandemic, COVID-19 pandemic in Germany.

**Archived source account.** Police in Berlin disperse around 18,000 anti-lockdown protesters massed in the Brandenburg Gate, despite a ruling from the city's administrative court the previous day that overturned the government's ban on public demonstrations. Police claim "most" of the protesters failed to observe "the minimum" social distancing measures implemented in the city.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/1976659/berlin-halts-anti-corona-rally-as-european-cities-protest-masks>).

<a id="event-2020-08-29-4-3"></a>

Context: George Floyd protests in Portland, Oregon, killings of Aaron Danielson and Michael Reinoehl.

**Archived source account.** A person is shot and killed, and several others arrested, amidst a violent confrontation between Black Lives Matter protesters and a large caravan of supporters of President Donald Trump in Portland, Oregon. The shooting victim is later identified as a member of the far-right Patriot Prayer.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/9193c733a02ab33304b32e1c27ce7d55>).

<a id="event-2020-08-29-4-5"></a>

Context: George Floyd protests in Canada.

**Archived source account.** Black Lives Matter protesters topple the historic 125-year-old Macdonald Monument of Sir John A. Macdonald, the first Prime Minister of Canada, in downtown Montreal. The incident draws condemnation from political leaders, including Quebec Premier François Legault.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/08/statue-canada-prime-minister-toppled-protesters-200830175937226.html>).

<a id="event-2020-08-29-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sweden bans far-right Danish leader Rasmus Paludan from entering the country for two years in response to last night's unrest in the city of Malmö, in which hundreds of Muslim youths clashed with police following the burning of a Quran. Malmö police say his behaviour posed "a threat to the fundamental interests of society".

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/2020/08/29/hundreds-of-islamophobic-rioters-clash-with-police-in-malmo>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-08-29-5-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Belarusian protests, Censorship in Belarus.

**Archived source account.** The Belarusian Association of Journalists revokes the accreditation of several foreign journalists covering the anti-government protests, resulting in the detention or deportation of some of those journalists.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.eastbaytimes.com/2020/08/29/belarus-cracks-down-on-journalists-2-ap-staff-deported/>).

<a id="event-2020-08-29-5-3"></a>

Context: MV Wakashio oil spill.

**Archived source account.** Protests erupt in Port Louis, Mauritius, over the government's handling of the disaster and after dozens of dolphins are found dead on the beaches. Meanwhile, Prime Minister Pravind Jugnauth blames bad weather for the slow response to the disaster as task teams from France and the United Nations arrive.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/b6666247c7c230ac7aa86b314cfa7dd2>).

<a id="event-2020-08-29-5-5"></a>

Context: 2020 Liberal Democratic Party (Japan) leadership election.

**Archived source account.** The Liberal Democratic Party in Japan is set to pick the next Prime Minister around September 15 after the sudden resignation of current Prime Minister Shinzo Abe. Former defense minister Shigeru Ishiba and former foreign minister Fumio Kishida announce they intend to run but Chief Cabinet Secretary Yoshihide Suga and defense minister Taro Kono are considered the potential candidates. Environment minister Shinjiro Koizumi is also a candidate but deemed "too young" by party's veterans.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-japan-politics-abe-suga/in-race-to-replace-japans-abe-loyalist-suga-emerges-as-strong-contender-idUSKBN25P0C7?il=0>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2020-08-29-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Indonesian Youth and Sports Ministry and the National Sports Committee of Indonesia officially recognize esports as a sport, following a week-long virtual conference held by the latter. This would allow esports to be included in official national multi-sport competitions along with traditional sports.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jakarta Post](<https://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2020/08/29/game-on-esports-officially-becomes-a-sport-in-indonesia.html>).

### 2020-08-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1100576086](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20August%2030&oldid=1100576086>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2020-08-30-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Following the death of American actor Chadwick Boseman two days prior, the tweet by his family announcing his death becomes the most-liked tweet in history with over 7.1 million likes. It surpasses a tweet made by former U.S. President Barack Obama in the aftermath of the Unite the Right rally in 2017, which has over 4.3 million likes.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/08/29/us/most-liked-tweet-of-all-time-chadwick-boseman-trnd/index.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-08-30-1-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** At least three migrants die when their boat catches fire off the coast of Crotone, Calabria, Italy. Another five migrants are injured as well as two police officers who tried to help them.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-europe-migrants-italy/at-least-three-migrants-die-as-boat-catches-fire-off-italy-idUSKBN25Q0L0?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-08-30-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Floods across Italy kill two people, injure some others, and leave one more missing. Severe damage to homes and other buildings is reported, and evacuations are ongoing in areas of some cities.

Source citations (as archived): [3bmeteo](<https://www.3bmeteo.com/giornale-meteo/cronaca-meteo-diretta--temporali--nubifragi-e-grandine-si-spostano-al-centro--nord-verso-un-miglioramento--situazione-e-previsioni-382572>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-08-30-2-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in India.

**Archived source account.** India reports 78,761 new cases in the past 24 hours, thus marking the highest single-day rise in case numbers recorded anywhere in the world. The record was previously set by the United States, which reported 77,638 new cases on July 17. This puts India's overall case tally to 3.5 million.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://amp.france24.com/en/20200830-india-sets-world-s-highest-single-day-rise-with-78-761-new-coronavirus-cases>).

<a id="event-2020-08-30-2-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea.

**Archived source account.** South Korea begins to restrict operations of restaurants, bakeries, and franchise coffee chains in the Seoul Capital Area in an effort to contain the spread of COVID-19. Restaurants and bakeries can operate dine-in services until 9 p.m., and only takeaway and delivery will be permitted from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m.. For franchise coffee chains, only takeout or delivery will be permitted regardless of operating hours. These restrictions will exist until September 7.

Source citations (as archived): [Yonhap News Agency](<https://m-en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20200828010700320?section=national/national>).

<a id="event-2020-08-30-2-8"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** More than 1,700 people in the United Kingdom are reported to have tested positive for COVID-19 in the last 24 hours, the largest weekend number since the middle of May, and the highest number of reported cases since June 4.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/aug/30/seven-people-on-tui-flight-from-greek-island-zante-to-cardiff-test-positive-for-covid>); [Reuters](<https://uk.mobile.reuters.com/article/amp/idUKKBN25Q0MT>).

<a id="event-2020-08-30-2-10"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Greece.

**Archived source account.** The number of cases in Greece reaches 10,000.

Source citations (as archived): [Madison.com](<https://madison.com/business/the-latest-confirmed-virus-cases-exceed-10-000-in-greece/article_57ffca3f-d939-5ead-b0c6-fb57dd18ba7e.html>).

<a id="event-2020-08-30-2-12"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Colombia.

**Archived source account.** The number of confirmed cases in Colombia reaches 600,000, ahead of the end of more than five months of lockdown.

Source citations (as archived): [National Post](<https://nationalpost.com/pmn/health-pmn/colombia-coronavirus-cases-pass-600000-deaths-close-to-19400>).

<a id="event-2020-08-30-2-14"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Jacinda Ardern mandates the wearing of face masks on public transport in Auckland once the city's alert level 3 restrictions are lifted at 11:59 p.m. local time, following a report of two new cases.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/aug/30/new-zealand-coronavirus-two-new-cases-as-auckland-lockdown-due-to-lift>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-08-30-3-1"></a>

Context: Greek–Turkish relations, Aegean dispute.

**Archived source account.** Turkey demands that Greece withdraws its troops from the Aegean island of Kastellorizo, saying Greece had violated the 1947 peace treaty, which called for the formerly Italian-occupied Kastellorizo to be demilitarized, with a recent troop deployment. The Greek government says the event was a "routine troop rotation".

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-08-30/turkey-tells-greece-to-pull-troops-from-island-at-heart-of-rift?srnd=markets-vp>).

<a id="event-2020-08-30-3-3"></a>

Context: Belarus–Germany relations, 2020 Belarusian protests.

**Archived source account.** The German foreign ministry announces it will summon the Belarusian ambassador in Berlin, after the Belarusian Association of Journalists revoked the accreditation of several foreign journalists covering the anti-government protests the previous day, including members of the German media.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.thelocal.de/20200830/germany-summons-belarus-envoy-over-foreign-media-crackdown>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-08-30-4-1"></a>

Context: France–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** French Minister of the Armed Forces Florence Parly reveals that a lieutenant-colonel of the army stationed at a NATO base in Italy has been arrested and indicted on charges of espionage on behalf of another government, after he was reported to have supplied "sensitive" documents to an officer of the GRU, a Russian military intelligence agency.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/france-jails-senior-military-officer-over-charges-of-spying-for-russia-report-2287667>).

Context: 2020 Montenegrin parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** Montenegrins head to the polls to elect a new session to parliament. Neither the ruling pro-Western coalition, dominated by the Democratic Party of Socialists, nor the pro-Russian and Serbia opposition are projected to have a majority.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-montenegro-election/divided-montenegro-on-course-for-knife-edge-election-idUSKBN25P0UM?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-08-30-5-2"></a>

Context: 2020 Montenegrin parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** Following exit polls, the Montenegrin opposition led by Zdravko Krivokapić claims victory in the election with Krivokapić saying "the regime has fallen".

### 2020-08-31

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1139385660](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20August%2031&oldid=1139385660>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-08-31-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Darfur; Sudanese conflict in South Kordofan and Blue Nile.

**Archived source account.** A peace deal is signed between Sudan's transitional government and the Sudan Revolutionary Front in South Sudan's capital Juba, raising hopes of peace after nearly 18 years of civil wars in the country. According to the agreement, the states Blue Nile, South Kordofan, and West Kordofan will be granted self-rule. The deal does not, however, include two major belligerent groups, the SPLM–N and SLM/A.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/sudan-signs-landmark-peace-deal-with-rebel-alliance/a-54770720>).

<a id="event-2020-08-31-0-3"></a>

Context: Gaza–Israel conflict, Gaza–Israel clashes in 2020.

**Archived source account.** Palestinian militant group Hamas announces that a ceasefire agreement has been reached with the Israeli government to end a month-long series of cross-border firing involving the launch of incendiary balloons in the Gaza Strip. The agreement follows mediation talks with Egyptian and Qatari officials.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/aug/31/hamas-and-israel-agree-end-to-cross-border-bombing-in-gaza>).

<a id="event-2020-08-31-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war, Israeli involvement in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights reports that 11 people, including one civilian, are killed by airstrikes allegedly carried out by the Israel Defense Forces near Damascus.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/report-from-syria-attacks-on-damascus-640649>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2020-08-31-1-1"></a>

Context: Korean Wave.

**Archived source account.** South Korean boy band BTS become the first all-South Korean act to top the United States record chart, after their single "Dynamite" debuted at number one on the Billboard Hot 100 chart.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/music/2020/sep/01/bts-k-pop-stars-become-first-all-south-korean-act-to-top-us-singles-charts>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-08-31-2-1"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in India, COVID-19 recession.

**Archived source account.** India's economy contracts by 23.9% in the April–June quarter, the country's worst recession on record since the government started releasing quarterly data in 1996. The lockdown caused massive disruptions to economic activity during the quarter.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/amp/world-asia-india-53973772>); [Bloomberg Quint](<https://www.bloombergquint.com/business/india-gdp-contracts-a-record-239-in-april-june-quarter>).

<a id="event-2020-08-31-2-3"></a>

Context: Argentine debt restructuring.

**Archived source account.** Argentina announces a deal with its creditors, allowing a way out of its ninth sovereign default.

Source citations (as archived): [Irish Times](<https://www.irishtimes.com/business/economy/argentina-defuses-default-crisis-with-massive-debt-deal-1.4343629>).

<a id="event-2020-08-31-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Amazon Prime Air wins Federal Aviation Administration approval to operate a drone delivery service in the United States. Amazon becomes the third drone delivery service to win flight approval, after UPS and Wing.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/e1480f2cdc2700c45f8b5c53ccd6d0f3>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-08-31-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two explosions in the United Arab Emirates kill three people and injure several others. One of the explosions occurred in Abu Dhabi and the other in Dubai.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-emirates-restaurant-blast/three-killed-several-hurt-in-two-uae-restaurant-blasts-idUSKBN25R103?il=0>).

**Archived source account.** Over 8,000 acres are burnt and one house destroyed after a scrub fire grows out of control near New Zealand's Lake Pukaki, requiring the evacuation of Mount Cook Village.

<a id="event-2020-08-31-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the floods across Italy rise to seven people, as heavy rains affects more cities. Many more injuries and some missing are reported.

She says the rise in cases was "partly the result of a greater number of people being tested", but it is "undoubtedly a concern" and that any connection between cases is being "carefully considered" by health protection teams.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-08-31-5-1"></a>

Context: Israel–United Arab Emirates peace agreement, Israel–United Arab Emirates relations, Israel–Saudi Arabia relations.

**Archived source account.** Israeli flag carrier El Al launches the first direct commercial flight between Israel and the United Arab Emirates following the normalization of relations between the two countries. The inaugural flight, which transported high-level delegations from Israel and the United States from Tel Aviv to Abu Dhabi, flew over Saudi Arabian airspace for the first time by an Israeli commercial aircraft. High-level officials on the flight include Senior Advisor to the U.S. President Jared Kushner, U.S. National Security Advisor Robert C. O'Brien, and Israeli National Security Advisor Meir Ben-Shabbat.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/08/flight-israeli-plane-heads-uae-saudi-arabia-200831070159156.html>).

<a id="event-2020-08-31-5-3"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2020 Belarusian presidential election, Belarus–Estonia relations, Belarus–Latvia relations, Belarus–Lithuania relations.

**Archived source account.** The governments of the Baltic states declare Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko and 29 other government officials persona non grata for suspected electoral fraud in the recent election and for attempting to suppress the protests responding to the election.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1329473/baltic-states-impose-sanctions-against-belarus-ahead-of-eu>).

<a id="event-2020-08-31-5-5"></a>

Context: France–Lebanon relations, 2019–20 Lebanese protests, aftermath of the 2020 Beirut explosion.

**Archived source account.** French President Emmanuel Macron visits Beirut, Lebanon, for the second time since the explosion to urge politicians to enact political and economic reforms.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/08/france-macron-returns-beirut-press-reforms-200831181941308.html>).

<a id="event-2020-08-31-5-7"></a>

Context: 2020 China–India skirmishes.

**Archived source account.** The Indian defence ministry accuses China's People's Liberation Army of militarising along the Line of Actual Control near the disputed Pangong Lake in Ladakh. India claims China had violated the consensus arrived at previous high-level meetings, but the Chinese foreign ministry denied the claim with their spokesperson saying, "the Chinese border troops have always strictly abided by the Line of Actual Control and have never crossed the line."

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/08/31/asia/india-china-border-intl-hnk-scli/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-08-31-5-9"></a>

Context: Australia–China relations.

**Archived source account.** Australian foreign minister Marise Payne confirms that Chinese-born Australian journalist Cheng Lei, an anchor for the China Global Television Network, a state-controlled media broadcaster, has been detained in Beijing under "residential surveillance" since August 14. The Chinese foreign ministry has not cited a rationale behind her detention.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/08/31/media/cheng-lei-detained-australia-china/index.html>); [South China Morning Post](<https://www.scmp.com/news/china/politics/article/3099619/chinese-born-australian-cgtn-journalist-cheng-lei-detained>).

<a id="event-2020-08-31-5-10"></a>

Context: Australia–China relations.

**Archived source account.** The Chinese commerce ministry probes the Australian wine industry on 40 allegations of violating countervailing duties, following a complaint by the China Wine Industry Association regarding recent wine imports from Australia.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/08/31/business/australia-china-wine-imports-intl-hnk/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-08-31-5-12"></a>

Context: China–Czech Republic relations, One-China policy.

**Archived source account.** The Czech foreign ministry summons the Chinese ambassador in Prague over threats made by Chinese foreign minister Wang Yi against Senate President Miloš Vystrčil, who is on an official visit to Taiwan.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/czechs-summon-chinese-envoy-over-taiwan-row-13069278>).

<a id="event-2020-08-31-5-14"></a>

Context: Russia–Slovakia relations.

**Archived source account.** The Russian foreign ministry expels three Slovak diplomats from Moscow in a reciprocal move after the Slovak foreign ministry expelled three Russian diplomats from Bratislava on August 11 for alleged espionage.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Agency](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/politics/russia-expels-3-slovak-diplomats-in-reciprocal-move/1958568>).

<a id="event-2020-08-31-5-16"></a>

Context: France–Turkey relations, European Union–Turkey relations, Aegean dispute.

**Archived source account.** French Foreign Minister Jean-Yves Le Drian calls for a "coordinated European response" to recent Turkish aggression towards Greece and Cyprus in the Eastern Mediterranean, saying "Europe needs to leave the age of innocence behind and shape its own destiny".

Source citations (as archived): [Ekathimerini](<https://www.ekathimerini.com/256409/article/ekathimerini/news/french-fm-calls-for-coordinated-european-response-to-turkey>).

<a id="event-2020-08-31-5-18"></a>

Context: Foreign involvement in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The United States vetoes a United Nations Security Council resolution calling for "the prosecution, rehabilitation, and reintegration" of terrorists. Ambassador Kelly Craft attributes the veto to the resolution's exclusion of repatriating foreign fighters in the Syrian and Iraqi Civil Wars.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://globalnews.ca/news/7308143/us-veto-un-anti-terrorism-resolution/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-08-31-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Rwandan humanitarian and Presidential Medal of Freedom recipient Paul Rusesabagina is shown off in handcuffs at the Rwanda Investigation Bureau headquarters in Kigali. The Bureau says he is detained on charges of terrorism, but does not say where or when he was arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/rwanda-rusesabagina-arrest-1.5706082>).

<a id="event-2020-08-31-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Australian Minister for Population, Cities and Urban Infrastructure Alan Tudge announces that the Parliamentary Joint Committee on Intelligence and Security will probe the alleged interference by foreign governments at the country's universities.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2020/08/31/australia-to-probe-foreign-influence-at-universities----------.html>).

<a id="event-2020-08-31-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Lawyers representing the families of the victims of Malaysia Airlines Flight 17 state their intention to seek unspecified damages from four suspects charged by the Dutch Public Prosecution Service in connection with the incident. The claims have yet to be filed, as a Dutch District Court shall determine whether Dutch or Ukrainian law would be applied.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/mh17-malaysian-airlines-trial-missile-russia-ukraine-13069326>); [VOA](<https://www.voanews.com/east-asia-pacific/families-malaysia-airlines-mh17-victims-want-damages-lawyers-say>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-08-31-7-1"></a>

Context: Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** Disputed President Nicolás Maduro pardons 110 lawmakers and associates of disputed acting President Juan Guaidó. Communications Minister Jorge Rodríguez says the pardons were made "in the interests of promoting national reconciliation".

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.manilatimes.net/2020/09/01/news/latest-stories/venezuelas-maduro-pardons-opposition-lawmakers/762078/>).

<a id="event-2020-08-31-7-3"></a>

Context: 2020 Guinean presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Incumbent President Alpha Condé accepts the nomination of his party, the Rally of the Guinean People, to run in the October election. Condé is allowed to seek a third term under the new constitution passed following a referendum in March that reset the presidential term limits.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/20200831-guinea-s-conde-to-run-for-3rd-term-says-ruling-party>).

<a id="event-2020-08-31-7-5"></a>

Context: Politics of Lebanon.

**Archived source account.** Mustapha Adib, the current Lebanese ambassador to Germany, is designated by President Michel Aoun as the country's prime minister following the resignation of Hassan Diab and his cabinet in the wake of the Beirut explosion earlier this month.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/lebanon-taps-diplomat-mustapha-adib-to-lead-new-government/a-54765106>).

<a id="event-2020-08-31-7-7"></a>

Context: Politics of Monaco.

**Archived source account.** Pierre Dartout is sworn in as Minister of State, succeeding Serge Telle.

Source citations (as archived): [L'Observateur de Monaco](<https://www.lobservateurdemonaco.mc/infos/politique/pierre-dartout-ceremonie-monaco>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-08-31-8-1"></a>

Context: Discoveries of exoplanets.

**Archived source account.** NASA’s Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite discovers TOI-824b, a Hot Neptune exoplanet that orbits dwarf star TOI-824, which is located 210 light-years away in the constellation Circinus.

Source citations (as archived): [Sci-News](<http://www.sci-news.com/astronomy/toi-824b-rare-hot-neptune-nearby-dwarf-star-08797.html>).


## September

### 2020-09-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1083543655](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20September%201&oldid=1083543655>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-09-01-0-2"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / September 2020 Afghanistan attacks.

**Archived source account.** At least three Afghan security forces members are killed and five more injured when gunmen storm their compound in the city of Gardez in Paktia Province. The Taliban claims responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [TOLOnews](<https://tolonews.com/afghanistan/3-security-force-members%C2%A0killed-taliban-attack-paktia>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2020-09-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** French satirical weekly newspaper Charlie Hebdo announces it will republish caricatures depicting Muhammad that sparked violent protests, ahead of a trial of suspected perpetrators of the mass shooting in January 2015 scheduled the following day.

Source citations (as archived): [The Brussels Times](<https://www.brusselstimes.com/news/art-culture/129406/charlie-hebdo-republishes-cartoons-depicting-prophet-mohammed/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-09-01-2-2"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, COVID-19 recession / COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil.

**Archived source account.** The Brazilian economy officially enters a recession after the country's statistics institute reported a 9.7% decline of its gross domestic product (GDP) in the second quarter, which is the second consecutive quarter of a decline in its GDP. It is Brazil's largest quarterly drop since 1996.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/en/news/3999819>); [Financial Times](<https://www.ft.com/content/dc045f17-c90b-4098-bda1-4f7471699070>).

<a id="event-2020-09-01-2-5"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, COVID-19 recession / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Germany.

**Archived source account.** German economic minister Peter Altmaier reports that the country's economy is facing an "unexpected" V-shaped recovery with its GDP currently forecasted to decline by 5.8% in 2020, in contrast to an earlier projection of a 6.3% decline.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.malaymail.com/news/money/2020/09/01/germany-sees-strong-economic-rebound-no-second-virus-lockdown/1899189>).

<a id="event-2020-09-01-2-6"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, COVID-19 recession / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe.

**Archived source account.** The Eurostat reports that consumer prices in the Eurozone have deflated from 0.4% in July to -0.2% in August, the bloc's first deflation since May 2016.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://rappler.com/business/inflation-rate-eurozone-august-2020>).

<a id="event-2020-09-01-2-8"></a>

Context: McDonald's litigation.

**Archived source account.** American fast food company McDonald's is sued by 50 black owners for racial discrimination. According to the lawsuit, McDonald's steered black franchisees to stores which had lower revenue and higher security expenses than stores in more affluent areas.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/b17e8bd40fcebf05af98a40a5ad91e9f>).

<a id="event-2020-09-01-2-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** Zimbabwe says it will return land that was seized from foreigners between 2000 and 2001, saying foreign citizens who had their land seized, mostly Dutch, British and German nationals, could now apply to get it back. The government says black farmers who received land under the controversial land reform programme would now be moved to allow the former owners "to regain possession".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-53988788>).

<a id="event-2020-09-01-2-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** American social media service Facebook announces it may block Australian users from sharing both local and international news stories on its platform, should the Australian government enact legislation that would require technology companies in the country to pay local news organisations.

Source citations (as archived): [The Japan Today](<https://japantoday.com/category/world/facebook-threatens-ban-on-australians-sharing-news-posts>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-09-01-3-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in Iowa.

**Archived source account.** The city council of Ames, Iowa passes a mask mandate with a vote of 5-1. The decision came after the New York Times named the city as a COVID-19 hotspot.

Source citations (as archived): [The Ames Tribune](<https://www.amestrib.com/story/news/2020/09/01/ames-city-council-passes-mandate-5-1-but-does-not-include-penalty/5687035002/>).

<a id="event-2020-09-01-3-6"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / COVID-19 pandemic in Belize.

**Archived source account.** The number of cases in Belize reaches past 1,000.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jamaica Observer](<http://www.jamaicaobserver.com/latestnews/Belize_records_more_than_1,000_COVID-19_cases?profile=1754>).

<a id="event-2020-09-01-3-8"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / COVID-19 pandemic in Mexico.

**Archived source account.** The number of cases in Mexico reaches past 600,000. The death toll in the country reaches to 65,241.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-mexico-tally-idUSKBN25T01D>).

<a id="event-2020-09-01-3-11"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Greece.

**Archived source account.** Due to some recent spikes in cases, authorities delay the schools' reopening to September 14 in order to allow time for vacationers to return to big cities to limit the movement of asymptomatic people. Students and teachers are told to wear face masks, which will be handed out for free to both public and private schools.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Agency](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/greece-virus-fears-push-back-school-opening-1-week/1960212>).

<a id="event-2020-09-01-3-13"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Russia.

**Archived source account.** The total number of confirmed cases in Russia passes one million, after 4,729 new cases were reported in the last 24 hours.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://beta.ctvnews.ca/national/coronavirus/2020/9/1/1_5087257.html>).

<a id="event-2020-09-01-3-15"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Arab Emirates.

**Archived source account.** The United Arab Emirates reports 574 cases, marking a second consecutive day in which the country recorded over 500 new cases.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-emirates/uae-reports-over-500-new-covid-19-cases-for-second-consecutive-day-idUSKBN25S5ZN>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-09-01-4-3"></a>

Context: Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / COVID-19 pandemic in Costa Rica, COVID-19 pandemic in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Costa Rica reopens their borders to Americans from 11 states and Washington, D.C.. On September 15, Americans traveling from Colorado, Massachusetts, and Pennsylvania will be allowed to enter the country. However, American travelers will be required to present a negative COVID-19 test in order to enter.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/homenews/514590-costa-rica-lifting-restrictions-on-travelers-from-11-us-states-dc>).

<a id="event-2020-09-01-4-5"></a>

Context: 2020 China–India skirmishes.

**Archived source account.** The Embassy of China in India accuses the Indian Armed Forces of "conducting flagrant provocations" along the Line of Actual Control near the disputed Pangong Lake in Ladakh. The statement comes a day after the Indian defence ministry accuses China's People's Liberation Army of militarising along the same area, to which the Chinese foreign ministry denied.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/09/01/asia/india-china-pangong-tso-lake-dispute-intl-hnk/index.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-09-01-5-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in the United States, Eviction in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention issues an order temporarily halting residential evictions on public health grounds, with the goal of slowing the spread of the COVID-19. The order lasts through December 31 and applies to individual renters earning no more than $99,000 in annual income.

Source citations (as archived): [Newsmax](<https://www.newsmax.com/t/newsmax/article/984973?section=us&amp;keywords=cdc-eviction-virus&amp;year=2020&amp;month=09&amp;date=01&amp;id=984973>).

<a id="event-2020-09-01-5-3"></a>

Context: Shooting of Dijon Kizzee.

**Archived source account.** Protests in Los Angeles continued for a second night following the police shooting of Dijon Kizzee, 29, who Los Angeles Police Department officers say was riding a bike in "violation of vehicle codes".

Source citations (as archived): [Forbes](<https://www.forbes.com/sites/isabeltogoh/2020/09/02/la-protests-continue-for-second-day-after-black-man-dijon-kizzee-fatally-shot-by-police/#79af4c417d86>).

<a id="event-2020-09-01-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pakistan's telecommunication authority blocks the usage of online dating applications Grindr, SayHi, Skout, Tagged and Tinder within the country, citing "the negative effects of immoral/indecent content streaming" to Pakistani users.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/09/02/tech/pakistan-tinder-grindr-hnk-intl/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-09-01-6-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Bougainvillean general election.

**Archived source account.** The general election of the Autonomous Region of Bougainville concludes. It began August 12 and lasted three weeks due to the COVID-19 pandemic. Results are expected to be announced mid-September.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/423311/bougainville-election-underway-today>); [RNZ2](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/419215/bougainville-allowing-for-three-week-election-because-of-covid-19>).

<a id="event-2020-09-01-6-3"></a>

Context: Proposed second Scottish independence referendum.

**Archived source account.** Scottish First Minister Nicola Sturgeon announces that her party will draft legislation for a new referendum on Scottish independence from the United Kingdom before Scotland's parliament election next year.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-britain-scotland-independence/scottish-nationalists-announce-plans-for-new-independence-referendum-idUKKBN25S5U4>).

<a id="event-2020-09-01-6-5"></a>

Context: Politics of the Solomon Islands, One-China policy.

**Archived source account.** Malaita Province Premier Daniel Suidani announces an independence referendum to potentially secede from the Solomon Islands due to growing tensions over the central government's diplomatic switch to China and a recent incident where Taiwanese medical supplies were seized by the government.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/425181/solomons-province-to-start-groundwork-on-independence-referendum>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-solomonislands-malaita/solomons-province-pushes-for-independence-in-china-switch-fallout-idUSKBN25T09U>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-09-01-7-1"></a>

Context: Russian interference in the 2020 United States elections.

**Archived source account.** Facebook says it has discovered a Russian influence campaign based in Saint Petersburg called Peace Data on the site which targeted left-wing voters in the United States and United Kingdom, by recruiting freelance journalists to write English-language articles concerning domestic politics, racial and political tensions, and criticism of President Donald Trump and his Democratic opponent, Joe Biden. Twitter says it has suspended five accounts related to the Russian campaign.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://reuters.com/article/uk-usa-election-facebook-russia/facebook-says-russian-influence-campaign-targeted-left-wing-voters-in-u-s-uk-idUKKBN25S5UB?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-09-01-7-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Norwegian parliament director Marianne Andreassen reveals in a press conference that several members of the Storting, and some employees, had their email accounts hacked last week. She did not name who was responsible.

Source citations (as archived): [Forbes](<https://www.forbes.com/sites/davidnikel/2020/09/01/norway-parliament-hit-by-email-hack/#55301bda27b8>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2020-09-01-8-2"></a>

Context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports / 2020 NFL season.

**Archived source account.** The National Football League will require all coaches and staff in bench areas to wear masks.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/nfl/2020/09/01/nfl-coaches-staff-near-bench-wear-masks-coronavirus-covid-19/5687499002/>).

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1083703562](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20September%202&oldid=1083703562>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-09-02-0-1"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Seven people are dead and 14 others injured after a Boko Haram suicide bomber blew himself up at a village hosting internally displaced people in Far North, Cameroon.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nigeria-security-bokoharam-cameroun/seven-killed-in-suicide-bomb-attack-in-northern-cameroon-village-idUSKBN25T30O>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2020-09-02-1-1"></a>

Context: Changes made due to the George Floyd protests.

**Archived source account.** The BBC reverses its controversial decision to ban the songs "Rule, Britannia\!" and "Land of Hope and Glory" from the 2020 Last Night of the Proms over concerns over their links to colonialism and slavery. Critics of the songs, including Chi-chi Nwanoku and Gareth Malone, say the songs are "outdated" and glorify racism.

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, COVID-19 recession / COVID-19 pandemic in Australia.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-09-02-5-2"></a>

Context: Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the Maldives.

**Archived source account.** The Ministry of Foreign Affairs tightens the country's visa policy for tourists, requiring all tourists to present a negative test result, after it was reported that at least 45 people at several of the country's resorts have contracted the virus.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/maldives-tightens-tourist-virus-rules-spike-covid-19-cases-13075610>).

<a id="event-2020-09-02-5-3"></a>

Context: Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** The Taiwanese foreign ministry unveils a new design to the country's passport cover after claiming that the current design has led foreign governments into mistakenly imposing COVID-19 pandemic-related travel restrictions intended for mainland Chinese citizens on Taiwanese citizens.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/taiwan-redesigns-passport-to-avoid-confusion-with-china/a-54789718>).

<a id="event-2020-09-02-5-5"></a>

Context: 2020 China–India skirmishes, Internet censorship in India.

**Archived source account.** India bans 118 apps linked to Chinese companies including popular Tencent-backed video game PUBG Mobile, stating they are "prejudicial to sovereignty and integrity of India".

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-09-02/tencent-s-pubg-banned-by-india-as-tensions-with-china-escalate>).

<a id="event-2020-09-02-5-7"></a>

Context: China–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** United States Secretary of State Mike Pompeo announces new restrictions on senior Chinese diplomats visiting the U.S., requiring them to secure an approval from U.S. authorities to meet with local government officials or to visit universities and colleges in the country. Pompeo describes the restrictions as a "reciprocal move" after the Chinese government had imposed similar restrictions on U.S. officials.

Source citations (as archived): [Kyodo News](<https://mainichi.jp/english/articles/20200903/p2g/00m/0in/056000c>).

<a id="event-2020-09-02-5-9"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabia–United Arab Emirates relations.

**Archived source account.** Saudi Arabia opens its airspace to all flights between the United Arab Emirates and "all countries", upon the request of the Emirati government. The move comes days after Israel and the United Arab Emirates restored diplomatic ties and Israeli flag carrier El Al commenced commercial flights to the UAE. Saudi Arabia still maintains a policy of neither maintaining diplomatic ties nor recognising Israel, and does not allow Israeli aircraft to fly in Saudi Arabian airspace under any other circumstances.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/saudi-allows-overflights-by-uae-services-to--all-countries--13076270>).

<a id="event-2020-09-02-5-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States places sanctions on several senior officials in the International Criminal Court, including Chief Prosecutor Fatou Bensouda, for launching an investigation into allegations of American war crimes in the current Afghanistan war.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-54003527>).

<a id="event-2020-09-03-3-1"></a>

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-09-04-4-1"></a>

Context: Football Leaks.

**Archived source account.** Rui Pinto begins his trial at the Central Criminal Procedure Court in Lisbon, Portugal, on charges of attempted qualified extortion, violation of secrecy, and illegally accessing information for leaking financial transactions within European association football.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/09/trial-opens-accused-football-leaks-mastermind-200904153518688.html>).

<a id="event-2020-09-04-4-3"></a>

Context: United States v. Guzmán.

**Archived source account.** Mexican drug lord Joaquín "El Chapo" Guzmán appeals to the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit against his life imprisonment sentence handed down by the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of New York in July 2019. Guzmán's lawyer claims that his maximum-security isolation at the Metropolitan Correctional Center following his extradition to the United States in January 2017 made him heavily unaware about his case and limited his ability to participate in his defense.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/convicted-mexican-drug-lord-el-chapo-appeals-against-life-sentence-2290811>).

<a id="event-2020-09-04-4-5"></a>

Context: Killing of Daniel Prude.

**Archived source account.** Protests over a fatal police encounter in Rochester, New York began peacefully but ended with authorities using tear gas and pepper balls following incidents of vandalism and violence. It was the third straight night of protests after video was released earlier in the week showing Rochester Police Department officers holding Daniel Prude on the ground with a spit sock on his head in March. Prude stopped breathing and was declared brain dead at a hospital.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/09/05/us/rochester-protests-daniel-prude-death/index.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-09-06-4-1"></a>

Context: 2020–2021 United States racial unrest, George Floyd protests in Portland, Oregon.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of people protested against police violence and racial injustice in Portland, Oregon in demonstrations that have now lasted over 100 days since George Floyd was killed. Molotov cocktails were thrown in the street sparking a large fire and prompting police to declare a riot. Tear gas was again deployed to clear protesters.

Source citations (as archived): [CP24](<https://www.cp24.com/world/dozens-arrested-as-violent-portland-protests-continue-1.5094370>).

<a id="event-2020-09-06-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 90 people are arrested in protests against the postponement of the 2020 Hong Kong legislative election. Among the arrested are vice-convener of the Civil Human Rights Front Figo Chan as well as League of Social Democrats (LSD) Leung Kwok-hung and Raphael Wong. Three other members of the LSD are fined for breaching a social gathering cap: Tsang Kin-shing, Jimmy Sham and Chan Po-ying.

Source citations (as archived): [The Standard](<https://www.thestandard.com.hk/breaking-news/section/4/154826/Jordan-protesters-against-LegCo-election-postponement-arrested>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-hongkong-security-protests/hong-kong-police-fire-pepper-balls-at-protesters-opposed-to-election-delay-new-law-idUSKBN25X0AX>).

<a id="event-2020-09-06-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** One person is killed and seven others injured during a series of stabbings in Birmingham, United Kingdom. The attacks are carried out by a single perpetrator, who is hunted by police. The motive is currently unknown.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-birmingham-54045143>).

<a id="event-2020-09-11-6-1"></a>
