**Archived source account.** Run-off parliamentary elections are being held in Iran. The first round of the election was held in February and provoked criticism as more than 7000 applicants got barred from participating.

Source citations (as archived): [Foreign Brief](<https://www.foreignbrief.com/daily-news/iran-to-hold-run-off-parliamentary-elections/>).

<a id="event-2020-09-11-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Deputy Prime Minister of Samoa Fiame Naomi Mata'afa resigns over three proposed constitutional amendments, which would alter the power of the land and titles court. She also leaves the Human Rights Protection Party. Other MPs have already left the party over the issue and formed a new opposition party.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/425809/samoa-s-deputy-prime-minister-quits-cabinet-over-controversial-bills>).

### 2020-09-12

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1367567012](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20September%2012&oldid=1367567012>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-09-12-0-2"></a>

Context: Iraqi insurgency / 2020 Iraq attacks.

**Archived source account.** Two bombs are detonated, killing a civilian, in Mosul.

Source citations (as archived): [National Iraqi News Agency](<http://ninanews.com/Website/News/Details?key=855999>).

<a id="event-2020-09-12-0-4"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The United States embassy in Libya reports that the Libyan National Army (LNA), commanded by Khalifa Haftar, has committed itself to end months-long blockade of oil facilities, saying that "the LNA had conveyed personal commitment from General Haftar to allow the full reopening of the energy sector no later than September 12".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-libya-oil/libyas-haftar-committed-to-ending-oil-blockade-u-s-says-idUSKBN2630W5?il=0>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-09-12-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A fire kills at least four people and injures another eight in Karachi, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Dawn](<https://www.dawn.com/news/1579279/4-killed-8-injured-after-building-catches-fire-in-karachis-hijrat-colony>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-09-12-2-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in France.

**Archived source account.** French health authorities report 10,561 new confirmed cases in the past 24 hours, a new daily record for France as the number tops 10,000 for the first time.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://amp.france24.com/en/20200912-france-records-over-10-000-covid-19-cases-in-24-hours-for-first-time>).

<a id="event-2020-09-12-2-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in India.

**Archived source account.** India's total COVID-19 cases surged to 4,65 million after the country reports world's record daily jump of 97,570 new cases and 1,201 deaths in the last 24 hours.

Source citations (as archived): [Hindustan Times](<https://m.hindustantimes.com/india-news/with-record-97-570-new-covid-19-cases-india-s-tally-goes-past-4-6-million/story-zGMjvNMCKRMqA3b9o1oU5L_amp.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-09-12-3-1"></a>

Context: Afghan peace process.

**Archived source account.** The first peace talks between the government and the Taliban start in Doha, Qatar. The Taliban had confirmed it would attend after the final release of six of their prisoners. Abdullah Abdullah, representing the government, says they are seeking a "dignified peace" while U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo calls the meeting "historic".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-53976968>).

<a id="event-2020-09-12-3-3"></a>

Context: Aegean dispute, France–Greece relations.

**Archived source account.** Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis announces an arms deal with France for the purchase of Dassault Rafale fighter aircraft and FREMM multipurpose frigates, as well as the recruitment of 15,000 additional troops, amid ongoing tension in the eastern Mediterranean.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/greece-announces-major-arms-purchase-as-tensions-with-turkey-rise?cx_testId=20&amp;cx_testVariant=cx_4&amp;cx_artPos=1#cxrecs_s>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-09-12-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019–2020 Colombian protests.

**Archived source account.** Protests against police brutality in Colombia rage for third day in Bogotá. The death toll from the protests rise to 13 people killed.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/09/colombia-police-brutality-protests-rage-day-bogota-200912160831909.html>).

<a id="event-2020-09-12-4-3"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in Iran.

**Archived source account.** Iran executes Navid Afkari, a wrestler who was convicted of killing a security guard during anti-government protests in 2018. According to media, which quoted the judiciary in Fars, the execution was carried out after insistence from the victim's family. Activists and Afkari's family claim he made a forced confession to the crime.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/iran-executes-champion-wrestler-navid-afkari/a-54903900>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/09/12/sport/iran-wrester-navid-afkari-executed-intl/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-09-12-5-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2020 Malian coup d'état.

**Archived source account.** Weeks after ousting President of Mali Ibrahim Boubacar Keïta, the military announced the formation of a transitional government with the goal to enable elections in 18 months. The move is criticised by civilian protest groups.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/mali-junta-pushes-18-month-transitional-government-following-coup/a-54908965>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2020-09-12-6-2"></a>

Context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports / 2020 Breeders' Cup.

**Archived source account.** It is announced that the upcoming Breeders' Cup Classic horse race will be held in November at the Keeneland racetrack in Lexington, Kentucky, U.S., without the attendance of fans due to the ongoing pandemic.

Source citations (as archived): [The Bloodhorse](<https://www.bloodhorse.com/horse-racing/articles/243432/breeders-cup-plans-keeneland-return-no-fans-for-2020>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/state-governments-health-lexington-kentucky-virus-outbreak-27c3ca8e22b78b3da23c96c15da875b3>).

### 2020-09-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1083739731](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20September%2013&oldid=1083739731>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-09-13-0-1"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** A Boko Haram suicide bomber detonated herself at a village in Zeleved, Far North, Cameroon, killing five civilians. Another female suicide bomber made a failed attempt, resulting only in injuries to herself.

Source citations (as archived): [RFI](<https://www.rfi.fr/fr/afrique/20200913-attaque-extreme-nord-cameroun-jihadistes-zeleved>).

<a id="event-2020-09-13-0-3"></a>

Context: Islamic terrorism in Europe.

**Archived source account.** A Portuguese man is stabbed to death during a suspected jihadist attack in Morges, Switzerland. The victim was chosen at random, as the attacker entered a shop and stabbed him. The suspect had been known to the Federal Intelligence Service since 2017 for dissemination of jihadist propaganda and had been arrested in April 2019 following an arson attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Swissinfo](<https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/murder-suspect-acted--out-of-vengeance-against-the-swiss-state-/46040334>).

<a id="event-2020-09-13-0-5"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Protesters, some armed with guns, set ablaze a House of Representatives building in Benghazi, Libya. Protests against deteriorating living conditions and corruption continue in eastern Libya for a third consecutive day.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://reuters.com/article/uk-libya-security/protesters-set-government-building-on-fire-in-eastern-libya-idUKKBN2640FH?il=0>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-09-13-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nvidia announce that they are acquiring Arm Holdings, the market-dominant designer of smartphone processors, for US$40 billion in the semi-conductor industry's largest-ever deal.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/technology-54142567>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-09-13-2-1"></a>

Context: Hurricane Sally.

**Archived source account.** Hurricane warnings are issued to multiple locations in Louisiana and Mississippi as Hurricane Sally approaches from the Gulf of Mexico with sustained winds of 50 mph. Flood watches are still in effect in Florida's west coast, including Tampa.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/09/13/weather/tropical-storm-sally-sunday/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-09-13-2-3"></a>

Context: 2020 Nepal floods.

**Archived source account.** Torrential rains cause landslides in Bahrabise and Baglung, in Nepal, killing a total of 12 people and leaving 21 others missing.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nepal-landslides/landslides-in-nepal-kill-12-people-at-least-21-missing-idUSKBN2640IU?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-09-13-2-5"></a>

Context: 2020 Western United States wildfire season.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the wildfires reaches 33 in California, Oregon, and Washington after nearly a dozen people reported missing in southern Oregon are accounted for, authorities say.

Source citations (as archived): [The Columbian](<https://www.columbian.com/news/2020/sep/13/death-toll-from-west-coast-wildfires-reaches-33/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-09-13-3-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia, 2020 Indonesia large-scale social restrictions.

**Archived source account.** Jakarta releases a new set of rules in the second round of stricter social restrictions, which will take effect on September 14. Different from the first round of restrictions, aside from 11 essential services that can continue to be operated, markets, shopping malls and worship with only local residents are allowed to be attended and continue to operate with 50% capacity. Non-essential government and private office operations must have 25% capacity and isolation must occur in government-appointed facilities if anyone tested positive without symptoms or mild symptoms.

Source citations (as archived): [Jakarta Globe](<https://jakartaglobe.id/news/jakartas-lockdown-to-ban-home-isolation-impose-harsher-sanction-on-violation-in-offices>).

<a id="event-2020-09-13-3-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea.

**Archived source account.** South Korea eases its tough social distancing measures for the next two weeks until September 28 in the Seoul Capital Area. The government lifts a ban on on-site dining after 9 p.m. local time, though it still requires restaurants and cafes to restrict seating and record patrons' names and contact details. Effective tomorrow, franchise coffee shops will resume normal operations, after restricting service to takeouts.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/south-korea-seoul-social-distance-covid-19-restrictions-13106854>).

<a id="event-2020-09-13-3-7"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Lebanon.

**Archived source account.** Ninety United Nations peacekeeping forces of UNIFIL test positive for COVID-19. A spokesman for UNIFIL says the personnel were transferred to a special facility with equipment to treat the disease.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://english.alarabiya.net/en/coronavirus/2020/09/13/Coronavirus-Ninety-UN-peacekeepers-in-south-Lebanon-contract-COVID-19>).

<a id="event-2020-09-13-3-9"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Israel, COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns.

**Archived source account.** It is announced that Israel will enter a three-week nationwide lockdown starting on September 18 to contain the spread of COVID-19 after a second-wave surge of new cases. During the lockdown, Israelis will have to stay within 500 metres of their houses, but can travel to workplaces that will be allowed to operate on a limited basis. Schools and shopping malls will be closed but supermarkets and pharmacies will remain open.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-israel-idUSKBN2640SS>).

<a id="event-2020-09-13-3-11"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic, COVID-19 pandemic in Saudi Arabia.

**Archived source account.** It is announced that Saudi Arabia will lift all travel restrictions for citizens on January 1, the state news agency SPA said. The kingdom will also partially lift its suspension of international flights on September 15 to allow "exceptional categories" of citizens and residents to travel.

Source citations (as archived): [Arab News](<https://www.arabnews.com/node/1733916/saudi-arabia>).

<a id="event-2020-09-13-3-13"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal.

**Archived source account.** After twice in a single week reporting the biggest daily increases in new cases since the national lockdown was lifted in May, with 646 on Wednesday and then 687 on Friday, Portugal reports another high increase of 673 new cases and seven deaths, bringing the cumulative totals to 63,983 confirmed cases and 1,867 deaths since the first infections were detected in the country on March 2. The 2020/2021 school year is set to start in-person classes between September 14 and September 17 nationwide.

Source citations (as archived): [DGS](<https://covid19.min-saude.pt/wp-content/uploads/2020/09/195_DGS_boletim_20200913.pdf>); [DGEstE](<https://www.dgeste.mec.pt/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/Orientacoes-DGESTE_DGE_DGS-20_21.pdf>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-09-13-4-1"></a>

Context: Internal conflict in Myanmar.

**Archived source account.** A joint statement made by eight of the 15 members of the United Nations Security Council urges Myanmar and the separatist Arakan Army to halt hostilities in northern Rakhine State and southern Chin State due to the "heavy toll" the fighting is having on the civilian population.

Source citations (as archived): [The Star Malaysia](<https://www.thestar.com.my/aseanplus/aseanplus-news/2020/09/13/un-council-members-urge-halt-to-myanmar-arakan-army-fighting>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-09-13-5-1"></a>

Context: Killing of Jennifer Laude.

**Archived source account.** After being pardoned by Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte, Joseph Scott Pemberton is deported to the United States. The former US Marine apologizes to the victim's family and thanks Duterte for the pardon.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN Philippines](<https://www.cnn.ph/news/2020/9/13/Pemberton-message-Laude-family-thanks-Duterte-pardon.html>).

<a id="event-2020-09-13-5-3"></a>

Context: 2020–2021 United States racial unrest.

**Archived source account.** Two Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department deputies are shot while parked at a metro station in Compton. A small crowd, including demonstrators, gathers near the hospital in Lynwood where the deputies were transported. Witnesses say members in the group were chanting anti-law enforcement slogans and at one point tried to get inside the hospital.

Source citations (as archived): [KABC-TV](<https://abc7.com/la-deputies-shot-los-angeles-shooting-compton-ambush/6420532/>).

<a id="event-2020-09-13-5-4"></a>

Context: 2020–2021 United States racial unrest.

**Archived source account.** Protests erupt in Lancaster, Pennsylvania after a police officer shot and killed a man who charged the officer with a knife following a domestic disturbance. Police arrest 13 people after members of the crowd allegedly damaged police vehicles and threw bricks at the police station, the post office, and nearby businesses.

Source citations (as archived): [Lancaster Online](<https://lancasteronline.com/news/local/8-people-4-from-outside-lancaster-county-arrested-after-monday-morning-protests-in-lancaster-city/article_9af58784-f6ad-11ea-870a-4358342867aa.html>).

<a id="event-2020-09-13-5-6"></a>

Context: 2020 republication of Muhammad caricatures.

**Archived source account.** Around 200 people in Istanbul, Turkey demonstrate against French magazine Charlie Hebdo's decision to republish cartoons of the Prophet Mohammed

Source citations (as archived): [France24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20200913-protest-in-istanbul-against-charlie-hebdo-cartoons>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-09-13-6-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Belarusian protests.

**Archived source account.** Belarusian security forces close off Independence Square and October Square in Minsk, as 100,000 people gather in the capital calling for President Alexander Lukashenko to resign. At least 250 protesters are detained by police.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-belarus-election-detentions/at-least-100000-protesters-gather-in-belarusian-capital-police-detain-250-idUKKBN2640II?il=0>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/09/belarus-police-detain-250-protesters-minsk-crowds-swell-200913124048821.html>).

<a id="event-2020-09-13-6-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in Israel.

**Archived source account.** Housing Minister Yaakov Litzman resigns in protest of holiday lockdown, he also accuses the government of failing to act earlier and deliberately picking Rosh Hashanah as the start date of closure.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/housing-minister-litzman-resigns-in-protest-of-looming-holiday-lockdown/>).

### 2020-09-14

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1100579225](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20September%2014&oldid=1100579225>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-09-14-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four soldiers are killed during a raid at a house in north Lebanon in pursuit of a militant wanted in connection with a fatal shooting last month. The militant is killed during the raid, and is identified as Khaled al-Talawi, a former Islamic State member who formed a splinter terrorist cell.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/lebanon-crisis-security-int-idUSKBN2650GL>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-09-14-1-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Atlantic hurricane season.

**Archived source account.** Hurricane Sally rapidly intensifies into a strong Category 1 hurricane, and is expected to make landfall near the Louisiana-Mississippi border as a strong Category 2 hurricane.

Source citations (as archived): [National Hurricane Center](<https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/text/refresh/MIATCDAT4+shtml/141631.shtml?>).

<a id="event-2020-09-14-1-2"></a>

Context: 2020 Atlantic hurricane season.

**Archived source account.** Governor of Louisiana John Bel Edwards declares a state of emergency for New Orleans and other parts of the state as it is expected that Hurricane Sally will make landfall as a strong hurricane on Tuesday.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/09/14/us/tropical-storm-sally-louisiana-monday/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-09-14-1-3"></a>

Context: 2020 Atlantic hurricane season.

**Archived source account.** Hurricane Paulette makes landfall on Bermuda as a high-end Category 1 hurricane.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<https://www.foxnews.com/world/bermuda-hurricane-paulette-eye-weather-storm-island-tropical-atlantic-hurricane-season>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-09-14-2-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 vaccine.

**Archived source account.** The United Arab Emirates approves Sinopharm's vaccine for frontline workers following successful Phase III clinical trials in Abu Dhabi. The WHO-recognized trial began on July 16 and involved 31,000 volunteers.

Source citations (as archived): [The National](<https://www.thenational.ae/uae/health/coronavirus-uae-authorises-emergency-use-of-vaccine-for-frontline-workers-1.1077680>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-09-14-3-1"></a>

Context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics, COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania.

**Archived source account.** President of Palau Tommy Remengesau Jr. announces he will be hosting an in-person meeting with the leaders of Kiribati, Nauru, the Federated States of Micronesia and the Marshall Islands. Nauru's President Lionel Aingimea says the leaders agreed to attend Palau's Independence Day on October 1 as the five Pacific countries remain free of COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/426010/palau-to-host-in-person-micronesian-leaders-summit>).

<a id="event-2020-09-14-3-3"></a>

Context: China–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The Embassy of the United States, Beijing says Terry Branstad is expected to leave his post as U.S. Ambassador to China in early October. No reason is given for the move and no replacement has been announced. China says it was not notified.

Source citations (as archived): [SCMP](<https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3101485/china-us-tension-ambassador-china-terry-branstad-stepping-down>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-09-14-4-1"></a>

Context: Connecticut v. ExxonMobil Corp..

**Archived source account.** Connecticut Attorney General William Tong files a lawsuit against ExxonMobil for their products contributing to the emissions that cause global warming and climate change.

Source citations (as archived): [CTMirror](<https://ctmirror.org/2020/09/14/tong-takes-on-exxonmobil-over-climate-change/>).

<a id="event-2020-09-14-4-3"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Duma arson attack.

**Archived source account.** Amiram Ben-Uliel, an Israeli terrorist who killed a Palestinian couple and their 18-month-old son during a racially-motivated arson attack in Duma, Nablus, West Bank in 2015, is sentenced to life imprisonment by an Israeli court.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://ca.reuters.com/article/topNews/idCAKBN2652BN>).

<a id="event-2020-09-14-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A man is in a coma after he was hit by a police car and kicked in the head by an officer during an arrest in Melbourne, Australia. Prior to the incident, the victim was being treated at a hospital for mental health issues.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-54146225>).

<a id="event-2020-09-14-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** A court in Rwanda charges Paul Rusesabagina, who inspired the film Hotel Rwanda, with 12 counts, including "terrorism, complicity in murder and forming or joining an armed group", among other charges. Rusesabagina, a strong critic of President Paul Kagame, did not respond to an offer of a plea.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/09/hotel-rwanda-hero-paul-rusesabagina-charged-terrorism-200914090417473.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-09-14-5-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Liberal Democratic Party (Japan) leadership election.

**Archived source account.** Yoshihide Suga wins a ruling Liberal Democratic Party leadership election, paving the way for him to become Prime Minister in a parliamentary vote this week.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-japan-politics-results/japans-suga-wins-ruling-party-leadership-race-to-replace-abe-idUSKBN2650P1>).

<a id="event-2020-09-14-5-3"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Tobruk-based House of Representatives resigns amid violent protests in eastern Libya over deteriorating living conditions and corruption. A spokesman for Field Marshal Khalifa Haftar, who is the de facto leader of eastern Libya, says the administration supports peaceful protests but would not allow "terrorists and the Muslim Brotherhood" to hijack them.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-54145499>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-09-14-6-1"></a>

Context: Climate change in the Arctic.

**Archived source account.** Satellite imagery shows that a big chunk of ice shattered into many small pieces from the last remaining ice shelf in Nioghalvfjerdsfjorden, Greenland.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-54127279>).

<a id="event-2020-09-14-6-2"></a>

Context: Climate change in the Arctic.

**Archived source account.** The discovery of the perfectly preserved remains of a cave bear, believed to be 22,000 to 39,500 years old (Late Pleistocene), is made in Lyakhovsky Islands, Siberia in the thawing permafrost.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/577b29734cb7ce40518eac6a5303cfb4>).

<a id="event-2020-09-14-6-4"></a>

Context: Life on Venus.

**Archived source account.** The Jane Greaves-led international scientific team announce that they have detected a gas called phosphine in the atmosphere of Venus that indicates microorganisms may inhabit Earth's inhospitable neighbor. If confirmed, it would be the first known extraterrestrial life.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-space-exploration-venus/potential-sign-of-alien-life-detected-on-inhospitable-venus-idUSKBN2652GO>).

### 2020-09-15

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1273224843](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20September%2015&oldid=1273224843>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-09-15-0-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Mongolia.

**Archived source account.** The government announces the re-opening of retail stores, cultural and public events, production, and entertainment centers tomorrow, as well as schools, universities, and kindergartens on September 21. However, the country's borders will remain closed.

Source citations (as archived): [News.mn](<https://news.mn/en/793934/>).

<a id="event-2020-09-15-0-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil.

**Archived source account.** Brazil reports 1,113 deaths, the country's highest in two weeks, thus bringing the death toll to 133,119.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-brazil/brazil-registers-1113-coronavirus-deaths-highest-toll-in-almost-two-weeks-idUSS0N2FD01D>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-09-15-1-2"></a>

Context: Canada–United States relations / Canada–United States trade relations, Trump tariffs.

**Archived source account.** The United States announces the suspension of the 10 percent tariff imposed on Canadian aluminum imports since August with the Office of the U.S. Trade Representative citing a "sharp" decline in imports for the decision.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.rfi.fr/en/wires/20200915-us-removes-10-percent-tariff-canadian-aluminum>).

<a id="event-2020-09-15-1-4"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis, Germany–Greece relations.

**Archived source account.** Germany agrees to take 1,500 migrants from Greece following a devastating fire at the Moria Refugee Camp on the island of Lesbos.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/2020/09/15/germany-to-take-in-1-500-migrants-from-greek-islands-after-lesbos-fire>).

<a id="event-2020-09-15-1-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Turkish Volkan Bozkır becomes the new President of the United Nations General Assembly.

Source citations (as archived): [UN News](<https://news.un.org/en/story/2020/06/1066562>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-09-15-2-1"></a>

Context: Immigration detention in the United States.

**Archived source account.** A whistleblower working at an Immigration and Customs Enforcement facility in Georgia details a high rate of hysterectomies and other alleged medical neglect in a complaint to the Department of Homeland Security. Rep. Bennie Thompson, the House Homeland Security Committee chairman, says the allegations of hysterectomies being performed on women without consent are "incredibly disturbing".

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/09/15/politics/immigration-customs-enforcement-medical-care-detainees/index.html>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-54160638>).

<a id="event-2020-09-15-2-3"></a>

Context: Poisoning of Alexei Navalny.

**Archived source account.** Russian opposition figure Alexei Navalny issues his first public statement since his poisoning via Instagram, having been taken off the ventilator the previous day.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://today.rtl.lu/news/world/a/1580244.html>).

<a id="event-2020-09-15-2-5"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Cabo Delgado.

**Archived source account.** A woman is killed in Cabo Delgado, Mozambique, by soldiers accusing her of being an Islamic State-linked group militant. A soldier beat her with a stick several times before the rest of the group was ordered to "kill her on the side of the road" and shoot her. The murder is condemned by human rights groups, while authorities promise an investigation.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-54159307>).

<a id="event-2020-09-15-2-7"></a>

Context: Shooting of Breonna Taylor.

**Archived source account.** The city of Louisville, Kentucky, settles a wrongful death lawsuit with the family of Breonna Taylor, who was killed in a raid on her apartment by police in March. Her family will receive $12 million and several police reforms will also be enacted in the city as part of the agreement.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/09/15/us/breonna-taylor-louisville-settlement/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-09-15-2-9"></a>

Context: Lebanon Ohio Fifth Third Bank Robbery.

**Archived source account.** A bank robbery occurs at a Fifth Third Bank in Warren County, Ohio.

Source citations (as archived): [Dayton Daily News](<https://www.daytondailynews.com/news/warren-county-fifth-third-bank-held-up-in-robbery/XZ5FZY7WNZBJBCUBMMT5NH7ZNY/>).

Context: War in Afghanistan / September 2020 Afghanistan attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [TOLOnews](<https://tolonews.com/afghanistan-166365>).

<a id="event-2020-09-16-0-5"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Two men are injured during a rocket attack in Ashdod, Israel. In response, the Israel Defense Forces strike Hamas sites in the Gaza Strip.

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2020-09-16-1-1"></a>

Context: List of monuments and memorials removed during the George Floyd protests.

**Archived source account.** In Popayán, Colombia, members of the Misak indigenous community topple and decapitate a monument dedicated to Spanish conquistador Sebastián de Belalcázar.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-54186047>).

<a id="event-2020-09-16-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom returns three antique bronze sculptures to India more than 40 years after they were stolen from a Hindu temple in Tamil Nadu. They were found in London after one was offered for sale in 2019. A total of four bronzes from the Vijayanagara period, which lasted from the 14th to the 17th century, were stolen in 1978 from a temple dedicated to the god Vishnu in Nagapattinam.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/britain-india-statues/uk-hands-over-to-india-statues-stolen-from-hindu-temple-in-1978-idINKBN267326>).

<a id="event-2020-09-16-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis appoints Bishop Mario Grech, the former Bishop of Gozo, Malta, as secretary-general of the Synod of Bishops. Bishop Grech replaces Cardinal Lorenzo Baldisseri, just prior to his 80th birthday.

Source citations (as archived): [Vatican Press Office](<https://press.vatican.va/content/salastampa/en/bollettino/pubblico/2020/09/16/200916b.html>).

<a id="event-2020-09-16-1-4"></a>

**Editorial account; source review partial.** Nintendo’s own support notice dates the end of most 3DS online services to April 8, 2024, with specified exceptions and continued access to some downloads. The source’s broad claim that support ended in September 2020 therefore requires qualification.

Editorial date: 2020-09-16. Checked: 2026-10-21. Partial: hardware production, online services, software updates and repair support are different milestones. This check does not establish which September 16 milestone the original uncited assertion intended; it does not silently replace it with a production claim.

Evidence: [Nintendo Support](<https://en-americas-support.nintendo.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/63227/~/nintendo-3ds-and-wii-u-eshop-discontinuation>).

Original source account: Nintendo officially ends support for the 3ds family

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-09-16-4-1"></a>

Context: Venezuelan protests, Crisis in Venezuela.

**Archived source account.** A United Nations Human Rights Council fact-finding mission formally accuses the Venezuelan government of crimes against humanity, including cases of killings, torture, violence against political opposition and disappearances since 2014. President Nicolás Maduro and other senior Venezuelan officials are among those implicated in the charges.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-54176927>).

<a id="event-2020-09-16-4-3"></a>

Context: International reactions to the 2020 Belarusian presidential election and protests.

**Archived source account.** The head of the Russian Foreign Intelligence Service (SVR), Sergey Naryshkin, accuses the United States of "working behind the scenes" in Belarus towards another "colour revolution", funding bloggers and training activists through NGO's against the interests of Belarusian citizens. Minister of Defence Sergey Shoygu flies to Minsk after disputed Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko said he had asked Russian President Vladimir Putin for weapons during a meeting in Moscow on Monday. Minister of Finance Anton Siluanov says Russia will, before the end of the year, disburse the first $1-billion tranche of a loan that was agreed also on Monday, to help Belarus' financial stability.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-belarus-election/russia-accuses-u-s-of-promoting-revolution-in-belarus-toughens-stance-idUSKBN2672NC>).

<a id="event-2020-09-16-4-5"></a>

Context: Cross-Strait relations, Taiwan–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Sources around President Donald Trump say that the United States plans to sell as many as seven major weapons systems, including mines, cruise missiles and drones to Taiwan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/usa-taiwan-arms-exclusive-idUSKBN2672F2>).

<a id="event-2020-09-16-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen announces plans to repeal the Dublin Regulation and reform the migration policy of the European Union, which von der Leyen says will be presented on September 23.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/20200916-dublin-rule-for-asylum-seekers-to-be-replaced-eu-s-von-der-leyen-says>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-09-16-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Rwandan humanitarian and Presidential Medal of Freedom recipient Paul Rusesabagina, the subject of the film Hotel Rwanda, faces 25 years to life in prison if convicted of the crimes with which he is charged, according to the prosecution. Rusesabagina had called for armed resistance against the government of Paul Kagame on YouTube. Rusesabagina, however, declined to respond to the charges.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-rwanda-politics/hotel-rwanda-hero-could-face-maximum-life-in-prison-prosecution-says-idUSKBN2671WI?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-09-16-5-1"></a>

Context: Republicanism in Barbados.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister of Barbados Mia Mottley announces that the Caribbean island will become a republic next year before its 55th anniversary of independence from the United Kingdom in November 2021, replacing Elizabeth II as head of state with a Barbadian. Governor-General Sandra Mason says "the time has come to fully leave our colonial past behind."

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/barbados-to-remove-queen-as-head-of-state-next-year-12072973>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-09-17-5-1"></a>

Context: Women in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** President Ashraf Ghani signs an amendment allowing mother's names to appear on their child's birth certificate, after discussion on the law was delayed by the National Assembly last week. The move is seen as a "significant milestone" for women's rights, following Afghan tradition stating that using a woman's name in public brings shame on their family.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC Australia](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2020-09-18/afghan-government-passes-law-mother-name-birth-certificate/12634162>).

<a id="event-2020-09-17-5-2"></a>

Magistrate Cheang Kei-hong adjourned sentencing to October 13 and praised the perpetrator for "loving society", while also commenting that Leung was not hurt seriously.

Source citations (as archived): [The Standard](<https://www.thestandard.com.hk/section-news/section/4/223079/Old-man-gets-court-praise-for-attack-on-&#x27;Long-Hair&#x27;>).

Context: 2020–2021 United States racial unrest.

<a id="event-2020-09-18-3-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Spain / COVID-19 pandemic in the Community of Madrid.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in France.

<a id="event-2020-09-18-3-8"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of Ireland.

Meanwhile, indoor visitations are only allowed between one other household, most sporting events will be cancelled, and attendance at weddings and funerals is going to be capped at 25 guests effective September 21.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/coronavirus-dublin-placed-under-risk-level-three-restrictions-12074775>).

Ever since the end of national lockdown in May, this has been the fourth time that the country has registered some record increases in new cases, with all four records occurring during a ten-day window.

Source citations (as archived): [DGS](<https://covid19.min-saude.pt/wp-content/uploads/2020/09/200_DGS_boletim_20200918.pdf>).

Group Hong Kong Marriage Equality (HKME) welcomes the first ruling while Sham condemns his case outcome.

The government says it has stopped selling Vanuatuan citizenship but promises further investigation into the matter.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/426414/vanuatu-warned-about-citizenship-sale-flaw>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-09-19-5-1"></a>

Context: United States sanctions against Iran.

**Archived source account.** The United States Secretary of State Mike Pompeo declares the 2015 nuclear accord with Iran as no longer in force. He also warns that the United States "is prepared to use our domestic authorities to impose consequences" for other countries that do not enforce the sanctions. Britain, France, Germany, China, and Russia oppose the snapback sanctions.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2020/09/19/us/politics/us-iran-un-sanctions.html>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/09/claims-sanctions-iran-reinstated-world-disagrees-200920053722999.html>).

<a id="event-2020-09-19-5-3"></a>

Context: Canada–China relations.

**Archived source account.** Canadian Foreign Minister François-Philippe Champagne announces that Canada has ceased discussing any free trade agreements with China. Canada has walked away from free-trade talks with China amid soured relations over arrest of Huawei CFO Meng Wanzhou and the detention of Michael Kovrig and Michael Spavor. He states that "the China of 2020 is not the China of 2016".

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<https://www.scmp.com/news/world/united-states-canada/article/3102178/canada-has-abandoned-free-trade-talks-china-says?utm_term=Autofeed&amp;utm_medium=Social&amp;utm_content=article&amp;utm_source=Twitter#Echobox=1600454665>).

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/asia-pacific/bangladesh-india-agree-to-curb-border-killings-/1978850>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-09-19-6-1"></a>

Context: Immigration detention in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Police arrest 86 people at a protest against the Immigration and Customs Enforcement in Times Square. The rally called for the abolition of ICE in the wake of allegations of a high rate of hysterectomies and alleged medical neglect.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/09/20/us/times-square-nyc-ice-protest/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-09-19-6-3"></a>

Context: Terrorism in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) releases a statement that a screening facility for White House mail intercepted a package containing ricin poison that was addressed to Donald Trump earlier this week. The FBI and the Secret Service are investigating where the package came from and whether others have been sent through the postal service.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-54221893>).

<a id="event-2020-09-19-6-5"></a>

Context: Central African Republic Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A Paris court indicts Eric Bagale, a former presidential guard of former Central African Republic President François Bozizé and head of an anti-balaka militia, for "complicity in crimes against humanity" and "criminal association for the preparation of a war crime" on acts his militia committed between 2007 and 2014.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://guardian.ng/news/france-indicts-central-africa-war-crimes-suspect/>).

<a id="event-2020-09-19-6-7"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Hachalu Hundessa riots.

**Archived source account.** The attorney general of Ethiopia files terrorism charges against opposition activist Jawar Mohammed for the unrest that erupted following the assassination of musician Hachalu Hundessa last June. Jawar is due to appear in court on Monday to respond to the charges.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ethiopia-politics/ethiopia-files-terrorism-charges-against-leading-opposition-activist-idUSKCN26A0LW>).

<a id="event-2020-09-19-6-9"></a>

Context: Rochester shooting.

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed and 14 others injured in a mass shooting at a home in Rochester, New York. It is the largest mass shooting in the city's history.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2020/09/19/rochester-new-york-shooting-house-party/5837515002/>); [The Rochester Democrat and Chronicle](<https://www.democratandchronicle.com/story/news/2020/09/19/rochester-mass-shooting-near-public-market/5836840002/>).

**Archived source account.** The United States embassy in Manama warns American citizens in Bahrain of the "need for caution", days after the gulf kingdom signed a U.S.-backed deal with Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.barrons.com/news/us-issues-security-alert-for-citizens-in-bahrain-01600714205>).

<a id="event-2020-09-21-2-3"></a>

Context: United States sanctions against Iran, International sanctions during the Venezuelan crisis, United States–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo announces the imposition of an arms embargo on the Iranian Ministry of Defence and Armed Forces Logistics and other entities involved in Iran's nuclear program, including the government of disputed Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro for providing weapons to Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/us-announces-un-sanctions-on-iran-venezuela-maduro-13131554>); [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2020/09/21/trump-administration-sanctions-iranian-defense-ministry-venezuelas-maduro.html>).

<a id="event-2020-09-21-2-5"></a>

Context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on international relations, COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines.

**Archived source account.** President Rodrigo Duterte lifts a moratorium on Filipino health professionals to work overseas during the pandemic.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/asia-pacific/philippines-lifts-overseas-travel-ban-on-health-workers/1980195>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-09-21-3-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2012 Burgas bus bombing.

**Archived source account.** A court in Bulgaria sentences two men, a Lebanese Australian and a Lebanese Canadian, to life in prison in absentia, for their roles in the suicide bombing of a bus in Burgas in 2012 that killed five Israeli tourists, the Bulgarian driver and the bomber. The whereabouts of the men is unknown and they are the subject of an Interpol red notice.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/0620d303fdc33bcff08119beba8d6084>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-09-21-4-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Malian coup d'état.

**Archived source account.** Bah Ndaw is named as Mali's interim President by the National Committee for the Salvation of the People military junta. Coup leader Assimi Goïta is appointed as Vice President.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/09/ba-named-mali-interim-president-colonel-named-vp-200921145418103.html>).

### 2020-09-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1186939580](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20September%2022&oldid=1186939580>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: War in Afghanistan / September 2020 Afghanistan attacks.

**Archived source account.** Insurgents kills at least 14 security forces in Gizab District, Uruzgan Province.

Source citations (as archived): [TOLOnews](<https://tolonews.com/afghanistan-166504>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-09-22-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Abu Dhabi ends its alcohol licence system, meaning residents will no longer need a licence to buy and consume alcohol. Customers must be at least 21 and the purchase should be for personal use only, according to the Abu Dhabi Department of Culture &amp; Tourism.

Source citations (as archived): [The National](<https://www.thenational.ae/uae/environment/abu-dhabi-to-end-alcohol-licence-system-for-residents-1.1081266>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-09-22-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An arms depot belonging to Hezbollah explodes in Ain Qana, Nabatieh, Lebanon, injuring several people.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lebanon-crisis-south-fire/arms-depot-of-iran-backed-hezbollah-explodes-in-south-lebanon-source-says-idUSKCN26D1P1>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-09-22-3-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands.

**Archived source account.** The Netherlands posts a record weekly number of new confirmed cases. In the week ending today, cases hit 13,471, an increase of 60% on the 8,265 cases reported the week prior.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://mobile.reuters.com/article/amp/idUSKCN26D1PB>).

<a id="event-2020-09-22-3-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from COVID-19 in the United States exceeds 200,000.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/amp/world-us-canada-54244515>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-09-22-4-1"></a>

Context: Israel–United Arab Emirates agreement, Bahrain–Israel normalization agreement.

**Archived source account.** The Palestinian National Authority resigns the chairmanship of the Council of the Arab League in protest of the bloc's failure to condemn Bahrain and the United Arab Emirates's normalization of ties with Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/palestinians-quit-arab-league-role-over-uae-bahrain-israel-deal/a-55017984>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-09-22-5-1"></a>

Context: Religion in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Russian special forces, including Federal Security Service agents, arrest cult leader Vissarion, who claims to be the reincarnation of Jesus Christ, after storming several remote hamlets occupied by his followers in Krasnoyarsk Krai. Russian authorities say he will be charged with organizing an "illegal religious organisation", as well as subjecting his followers to extortion and emotional abuse.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/sep/22/cult-leader-vissarion-reincarnation-jesus-arrested-siberia-russia>).

<a id="event-2020-09-22-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** American journalist and filmmaker Andre Vltchek is found dead inside his car in Istanbul, Turkey. Turkish police are treating the death as "suspicious", and have launched an investigation.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Sabah](<https://www.dailysabah.com/turkey/investigations/us-journalist-found-dead-in-istanbul-under-suspicious-circumstances>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-09-22-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Astronomers find glowing auroras around 67P/Churyumov–Gerasimenko. This is the first comet discovered to have them.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/nasa-astronomers-northern-lights-aurora-rosetta-comet-chury/>).

### 2020-09-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1249115634](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20September%2023&oldid=1249115634>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-09-23-0-1"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Eastern-based forces of Khalifa Haftar's Libyan National Army (LNA) say they have killed Abu Moaz al-Iraqi, leader of ISIL in Libya, in the desert city of Sebha.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-libya-security/eastern-libyan-forces-say-they-killed-islamic-state-leader-idUSKCN26E3BW?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-09-23-0-3"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Egypt.

**Archived source account.** Three Egyptian police officers and four convicted terrorists on death row are killed during a failed attempt to escape from Tora Prison in Cairo.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-egypt-prison/three-egyptian-policemen-four-militants-killed-in-prison-break-attempt-idUKKCN26E355?il=0>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-09-23-1-1"></a>

Context: List of explosions.

**Archived source account.** A fuel tanker explodes on a highway in Kogi State, Nigeria, destroying several nearby vehicles and killing at least 25 people. The victims include a number of Kogi State Polytechnic students whose school bus was destroyed in the blast.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-54262443>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-09-23-2-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in India.

**Archived source account.** The number of deaths in India exceeds 90,000. In the past 24 hours, the country reported 83,347 new cases and 1,085 more deaths.

Source citations (as archived): [The Nation PK](<https://nation.com.pk/23-Sep-2020/total-covid-19-death-toll-crosses-90k-in-india>); [Deccan Herald](<https://www.deccanherald.com/national/indias-covid-19-tally-crosses-56-lakh-mark-with-83347-new-cases-death-toll-tops-90000-891705.html>).

<a id="event-2020-09-23-2-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in India.

**Archived source account.** Railway Minister Suresh Angadi dies from the disease at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences in New Delhi.

Source citations (as archived): [Khaleej Times](<https://www.khaleejtimes.com/coronavirus-pandemic/coronavirus-indias-railways-minister-suresh-angadi-dies-from-covid-19>).

<a id="event-2020-09-23-2-6"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Israel.

**Archived source account.** Israel reports a record jump of 6,923 new cases in the past 24 hours, as the country imposes a second nationwide lockdown to prevent the spread of the virus. Further restrictions are being considered.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/9/23/israel-sees-highest-ever-daily-spike-in-coronavirus-infections>).

<a id="event-2020-09-23-2-8"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands.

**Archived source account.** The number of cases in the Netherlands surpasses 100,000, after a record of 2,357 new cases is reported in the last 24 hours.

Source citations (as archived): [Dutch News](<https://www.dutchnews.nl/news/2020/09/coronavirus-cases-top-100000-in-the-netherlands-more-regional-measures-likely/>).

<a id="event-2020-09-23-2-10"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 vaccine.

**Archived source account.** Johnson &amp; Johnson enters a Phase III clinical trial for its potential vaccine, becoming the fourth vaccine company backed by Operation Warp Speed to do so. The trial is expected to enroll up to 60,000 volunteers across 215 locations in the United States and other countries.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2020/09/23/coronavirus-vaccine-johnson-johnson-begins-late-stage-covid-19-trial-.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-09-23-3-2"></a>

Context: North Korea–South Korea relations / List of border incidents involving North and South Korea.

**Archived source account.** The South Korean defense ministry alleges that North Korean officials killed and cremated an official from the South Korean fisheries ministry who disappeared from a ship conducting maritime patrol activities along the Northern Limit Line on September 21 and entered North Korean territory by the following afternoon.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://spectrumnews1.com/oh/cincinnati/ap-online/2020/09/24/seoul-north-korea-fired-at-a-s-korean-and-burned-his-body>).

<a id="event-2020-09-23-3-4"></a>

Context: Iran–Saudi Arabia relations, Iran–Saudi Arabia proxy conflict.

**Archived source account.** King Salman of Saudi Arabia calls for a "comprehensive and firm" response to Iran's nuclear program and condemns what he describes as "its expansionist activities, create its terrorist networks, and use terrorism", adding that it produces nothing but "chaos, extremism, and sectarianism". An Iranian official rebuffs the accusations as "baseless".

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/9/23/saudi-king-calls-for-comprehensive-solution-on-iran-in-un-speech>).

<a id="event-2020-09-23-3-6"></a>

Context: Mexico–United States relations, Immigration detention in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Mexico is investigating claims that six Mexican women were sterilised while in a migrant detention center, says Foreign Minister Marcelo Ebrard. A whistleblower the previous week alleged hysterectomies were being performed on immigrants in the United States without their proper consent. Mexico called such operations "unacceptable".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-54265571>).

<a id="event-2020-09-23-3-8"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Argentina.

**Archived source account.** President Alberto Fernández demands Iran extradite the Iranian citizens accused of responsibility for the 1994 AMIA bombing in Buenos Aires and states that the demand is of "vital importance".

Source citations (as archived): [Argentine Official News Agency Télam](<https://www.telam.com.ar/notas/202009/517233-la-amia-destaco-el-reclamo-de-fernandez-a-iran-ante-la-onu-para-esclarecer-el-atentado-de-1994.html>).

<a id="event-2020-09-23-3-10"></a>

Context: Belarus–United States relations, International reactions to the 2020 Belarusian presidential election and protests.

**Archived source account.** The United States formally no longer recognizes Alexander Lukashenko as President of Belarus, according to a U.S. Department of State statement. A State Department spokesperson calls for a new "free and fair election" in Belarus under independent observation.

Source citations (as archived): [Axios](<https://www.axios.com/us-lukashenko-president-belarus-353ed235-98f7-446f-919a-6a6cdab81975.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-09-23-4-1"></a>

Context: Shooting of Breonna Taylor.

**Archived source account.** A grand jury in Louisville, Kentucky, indicts former police officer Brett Hankison on felony charges of wanton endangerment for firing into a neighboring apartment, but no officers are charged directly with Breonna Taylor's death. A large police presence is seen in Louisville as protests continue.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2020/09/23/kentucky-grand-jury-breonna-taylor-brett-hankison-charged/3467413001/>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/us/live-news/breonna-taylor-announcement/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-09-23-4-2"></a>

Context: Shooting of Breonna Taylor.

**Archived source account.** Two Louisville Metro Police officers are shot and wounded during protests over the Breonna Taylor indictment. One suspect is reportedly in custody.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/28a283922de8784f6fca5c42fe8e5bca>).

<a id="event-2020-09-23-4-3"></a>

Context: Shooting of Breonna Taylor.

**Archived source account.** After the city declared a state of emergency, Governor Andy Beshear sends the Kentucky Army National Guard to Louisville in response to the protests.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/homenews/state-watch/517905-kentucky-governor-authorizes-national-guard-as-protesters-gather-over>).

<a id="event-2020-09-23-4-5"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in the Cook Islands.

**Archived source account.** Human rights campaigners urge Cook Islands' MPs to abolish Article 64 of the Crimes Act, which criminalises gay men with up to 14 years' imprisonment. The activists call on the lawmakers to abide by the Constitution. The Cook Islands is a sovereign territory belonging to New Zealand.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/426741/human-rights-campaigners-urge-cook-island-mps-to-uphold-constitution>).

<a id="event-2020-09-23-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hong Kong pro-democracy camp activist Joshua Wong loses a court case against his disqualification from running in last year's November election. The returning officer had disqualified him because she did not believe Wong had changed his stance on Hong Kong independence and his "subversive intentions".

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/law-and-crime/article/3102666/hong-kong-opposition-activist-joshua-wong-loses-legal>).

<a id="event-2020-09-23-5-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2020 Belarusian presidential election, 2020 Belarusian protests.

**Archived source account.** President Alexander Lukashenko is sworn in for a sixth term in office at an unannounced inauguration at the Independence Palace in Minsk. The opposition and some foreign governments do not recognize the legitimacy of the inauguration, and call for continued civil resistance.

Context: Death and funeral of Ruth Bader Ginsburg.

**Archived source account.** Deceased Associate Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg lies in repose in the United States Supreme Court Building. She is both the first woman and the first Jewish American to receive such an honor.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-54271027?at_campaign=64&amp;>).

Context: 2020 United States presidential election, Donald Trump 2020 presidential campaign.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump refuses to commit to a peaceful transfer of power if he loses the November 3 presidential election, saying "We're going to have to see what happens".

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/8bb28627b03474a3a5ce2454ae3d1639?utm_campaign=SocialFlow&amp;utm_medium=AP&amp;utm_source=Twitter>).

<a id="event-2020-09-23-5-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ishmael Toroama is declared President-elect of the Autonomous Region of Bougainville following an election process that began six weeks ago. Toroama secured 48,766 votes cast and promised to solve the issue of independence.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/426722/ishmael-toroama-declared-president-elect-of-bougainville>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-09-23-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Astronomers announce the crescent shadow of Messier 87's supermassive black hole is wobbling. Back in April 2019, the Event Horizon Telescope captured the crescent shadow of the black hole, making it the first image ever taken of a black hole.

Source citations (as archived): [Sci News](<http://www.sci-news.com/astronomy/wobbling-crescent-shadow-messier-87-supermassive-black-hole-08880.html>).

<a id="event-2020-09-23-6-1"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Sci News](<http://www.sci-news.com/archaeology/chromium-crucible-steel-persia-08879.html>).

<a id="event-2020-09-24-1-0"></a>

<a id="event-2020-09-24-2-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in France.

**Archived source account.** French health authorities report a new record of 16,096 daily cases in the last 24 hours, the highest since the beginning of the pandemic. The new record comes a day after the government announced new restrictions on bars and restaurants in major cities, including Marseille and Paris, provoking an outcry from local politicians and business owners.

The measure will remain in place for three weeks until October 16.

<a id="event-2020-09-25-2-6"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia.

**Archived source account.** Malaysia reports 260 new cases, the second biggest daily spike since the pandemic began. The sharp increase in infections comes after a surge in travel to and from Sabah for the state elections. The national tally now stands at 11,484 cases with a total of 136 deaths.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/covid-19-malaysia-sabah-second-largest-daily-spike-260-new-cases-13170180>).

<a id="event-2020-10-01-3-12"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in Washington (state), 2020 Washington wildfires.

**Archived source account.** A family of seven people who lost their homes during the Labor Day fires in the state tests positive for COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox13news](<https://www.fox13news.com/news/washington-family-loses-home-in-wildfire-then-all-test-positive-for-covid-19>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/10/01/us/coronavirus-family-lost-home-trnd/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-10-01-3-13"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States.

**Archived source account.** President Donald Trump confirms that top aide Hope Hicks has tested positive for coronavirus and says he and First Lady Melania Trump will begin their "quarantine process" while waiting for their own test results.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/10/01/politics/hope-hicks-positive-coronavirus/index.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-10-01-4-1"></a>

Context: Post-Brexit United Kingdom relations with the European Union.

**Archived source account.** After the United Kingdom ignored their demands made in early September to scrap the Internal Market Bill by the end of the month, the European Commission sends a letter to the government of the United Kingdom informing them of its intent to pursue international legal action over the bill, which the European Union claims violates international law by overriding article four of the Brexit withdrawal agreement.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://asiatimes.com/2020/10/eu-launches-legal-action-over-uk-brexit-bill/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-10-01-5-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Las Vegas shooting.

**Archived source account.** Amidst the third anniversary of the mass shooting in Las Vegas, Nevada, the Las Vegas Metropolitan Police Department backtracks on an earlier decision and has included, in the official death toll, two women who died from gunshot wound complications over the past year, thereby increasing it from 58 to 60.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/virus-outbreak-las-vegas-las-vegas-mass-shooting-nevada-shootings-ea1ab5537d62f9e3e52bb4f770910452>); [The Las-Vegas Review Journal](<https://www.reviewjournal.com/local/local-las-vegas/sisolak-we-will-never-never-forget-those-killed-in-oct-1-shooting-2134042/>).

<a id="event-2020-10-01-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Belgium's court of appeal recognizes the genealogical DNA test result of Delphine Boël as the daughter of King Albert II, thereby instating her to the title of Princess of Belgium with the predicate "Her Royal Highness". Having been recognized as the illegitimate daughter of Albert, Boël was given the honorific Jonkvrouw, the lowest rank within the Belgian titled nobility, prior to the decision.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/belgian-kings-hidden-daughter-wins-fight-to-be-princess>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-10-01-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Alessandro Cardelli and Mirko Dolcini are sworn in Captains Regent of San Marino. Cardelli becomes the world's youngest head of state.

Source citations (as archived): [San Marino RTV](<https://www.sanmarinortv.sm/news/attualita-c4/alessandro-cardelli-e-mirko-dolcini-sono-i-nuovi-capitani-reggenti-a194943>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-10-01-7-1"></a>

Context: Life on Venus.

**Archived source account.** According to a study from researchers at the University of California, Riverside, Venus would be able to support life if Jupiter hadn't altered its orbit around the Sun nearly 4 billion years ago.

Source citations (as archived): [Phys.org](<https://phys.org/news/2020-09-venus-habitable-today-jupiter.html>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/10/01/world/venus-habitable-jupiter-scli-intl-scn/index.html>).

Walmart will maintain a minority shareholding.

<a id="event-2020-10-02-2-14"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-10-02-3-2"></a>

Context: Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Australia, COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand, Australia–New Zealand relations.

**Archived source account.** Australian Prime Minister Scott Morrison and New Zealand Prime Minister Jacinda Ardern finalise plans for a trans-Tasman "travel bubble". Australia will permit the entry of travellers from New Zealand into New South Wales and the Northern Territory if they have stayed in New Zealand for at least two weeks effective October 16. New Zealand, however, has not reciprocated any lifting of travel restrictions for Australian travellers.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/oct/02/australia-new-zealand-travel-bubble-open-within-two-weeks>).

Context: Belarus–European Union relations, European Union–Turkey relations, International reactions to the 2020 Belarusian presidential election and protests.

**Archived source account.** The European Council agrees on sanctions against Belarus. Opposition by Cyprus is lifted by also agreeing on a warning to Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-eu-summit/eu-leaders-break-deadlock-to-impose-sanctions-on-belarus-idUSKBN26M3YM>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/eu-leaders-overcome-cyprus-veto-agree-to-belarus-sanctions/2020/10/01/9c0a9a10-0445-11eb-b92e-029676f9ebec_story.html>).

Context: Cambodia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The Pentagon says it is "concerned" about reports that Cambodia has demolished a U.S.-funded facility at the Ream Naval Base, which could be linked to Chinese military and economic pressure on the country. The Center for Strategic and International Studies says the Cambodian government appears to have razed the building last month.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-usa-cambodia-military/cambodia-demolished-u-s-built-facility-on-naval-base-researchers-idUKKBN26N39Q?il=0>).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-venezuela-russia/venezuela-says-it-receives-shipment-of-russian-sputnik-v-coronavirus-vaccine-idINL1N2GT1A2>).

<a id="event-2020-10-02-4-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Czech Senate election.

**Archived source account.** The first round of the latest Senate elections are being held in the Czech Republic. The voters can decide over the composition of a third of the Senate's 81 total seats.

Source citations (as archived): [Foreign Brief](<https://www.foreignbrief.com/daily-news/first-round-of-voting-for-czech-senate-elections-to-begin/>).

<a id="event-2020-10-02-4-3"></a>

Context: Islam in France.

**Archived source account.** President Emmanuel Macron announces a crackdown on "Islamist separatism" in Muslim communities in France, saying a bill tackling Islamist separatism would be sent to parliament early next year. Among the measures, will include a ban on foreign imams, restrictions on home schooling, and the creation of an "Institute of Islamology" to tackle Islamic fundamentalism.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-france-macron-separatism/macron-launches-crackdown-on-islamist-separatism-in-muslim-communities-idUKKBN26N20W?il=0>).

**Archived source account.** A car bombing near the district governor’s compound in Shinwar District, Nangarhar Province, kills at least 15 people and wounds another 30. Gunmen tried to enter the district governor’s compound but were killed by security forces.

<a id="event-2020-10-03-0-4"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Sabah](<https://www.dailysabah.com/politics/azerbaijan-president-slams-nagorno-karabakh-mediators-as-fighting-rages-on/news>).

<a id="event-2020-10-03-0-5"></a>

Context: Second Nagorno-Karabakh War.

**Archived source account.** Azerbaijan says its troops have captured Suqovuşan (Madaghis), Talış, Mehdili, Aşağı Maralyan, Şəybəy, Quycaq and Aşağı Əbdürrəhmanlı following clashes with Armenian and Artsakh forces. President Ilham Aliyev tweets "Madagiz is ours. Karabakh is Azerbaijan\!".

<a id="event-2020-10-03-0-6"></a>

Context: Second Nagorno-Karabakh War.

**Archived source account.** Iran says ten shells have fallen inside Iranian territory as fighting rages between Armenia and Azerbaijan in Nagorno-Karabakh. More than 35 stray mortar shells have hit Iran since the recent fighting began, causing damage to housing units and the injury of a child.

<a id="event-2020-10-03-0-8"></a>

Context: War in Darfur.

**Archived source account.** The transitional government of Sudan signs a peace deal with the main rebel groups fighting in the conflict. The Sudan People's Liberation Movement-North, which had refused to engage in previous talks, joined this time. The U.S. Special Envoy for Sudan and South Sudan, Donald Booth, hails the deal as a "historic achievement".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-sudan-politics/sudan-and-main-rebel-groups-formalise-peace-deal-idUSKBN26N3MO?il=0>).
