#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-10-04-0-1"></a>

Context: Second Nagorno-Karabakh War.

**Archived source account.** Azerbaijan's second-largest city Ganja is shelled by Artsakh forces, destroying several buildings and killing at least one civilian. Ganja International Airport is also bombed. Azerbaijani Defence Minister Zakir Hasanov says it is a "clearly provocative" move that was "expanding the conflict".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-54407436>).

<a id="event-2020-10-04-0-2"></a>

Context: Second Nagorno-Karabakh War.

**Archived source account.** The Artsakh capital Stepanakert is struck with MLRS missiles resulting in heavy casualties and leaving the city without power. Artsakh President Arayik Harutyunyan warns major cities in Azerbaijan are now "legitimate targets of the defence army" following the strikes on Stepanakert.

Source citations (as archived): [Eurasianet](<https://eurasianet.org/armenia-azerbaijan-fighting-expands-far-beyond-the-front-lines>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-54407436>).

<a id="event-2020-10-04-0-3"></a>

Context: Second Nagorno-Karabakh War.

**Archived source account.** Azerbaijani troops reportedly seize control of the city of Cəbrayil (Jabrayil) from Artsakh forces. Armenia denies the city has fallen.

Source citations (as archived): [Ahval News](<https://ahvalnews.com/nagorno-karabakh/azerbaijani-forces-take-city-jabrayil-they-make-territorial-gains-nagorno-karabakh>).

<a id="event-2020-10-04-0-4"></a>

Context: Second Nagorno-Karabakh War.

**Archived source account.** Azerbaijan says medium-range missiles have hit its Khizi and Absheron districts, as well as the city of Mingachevir.

Source citations (as archived): [APA](<https://apa.az/en/frontline-news/Hikmet-Hajiyev:-Armenians-launched-two-300-km-mid-range-missile-in-Khizi-and-Absheron-regions-332077>).

<a id="event-2020-10-04-0-6"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Germany, Antisemitism in 21st century Germany.

**Archived source account.** An attack by an Islamic extremist kills one tourist and injures the other. The suspect was later arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/germany-security-suspect-int-idUSKBN2772B9>).

<a id="event-2020-10-04-0-7"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Germany, Antisemitism in 21st century Germany.

**Archived source account.** Amid the celebration of Sukkot, a 26-year-old Jewish student suffers a traumatic brain injury after being attacked with a shovel by a 29-year-old German Kazakh man as he entered a synagogue in Hamburg. Police later discover a piece of paper with a swastika on it in one of the attacker's trouser pockets. Foreign Minister Heiko Maas denounces the attack as "repugnant antisemitism".

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/man-reportedly-attacks-jewish-student-with-shovel-outside-hamburg-synagogue/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-10-04-1-1"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom, Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on cinema.

**Archived source account.** Cineworld announces it is temporarily shutting down all its cinemas in the United Kingdom and United States, putting more than 5,500 jobs at risk, after reporting £1.3bn in losses since the COVID-19 lockdown.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-54407213>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-10-04-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Five people who went missing during heavy floods in France two days ago are found dead in river banks in the Italian region of Liguria, while a man is found dead at the border between the two countries. Italy is also affected by floods. A man has died in his car during the floods in the French region of Saint-Martin-Vésubie.

Source citations (as archived): [Il Fatto Quotidiano](<https://www.ilfattoquotidiano.it/2020/10/04/maltempo-trovati-5-cadaveri-in-liguria-tra-i-detriti-della-mareggiata-in-zona-non-sono-stati-segnalati-dispersi-allerta-in-emilia-per-il-po/5953734/>); [L'Union](<https://www.lunion.fr/id195775/article/2020-10-04/intemperies-dans-les-alpes-maritimes-un-homme-retrouve-mort-saint-martin-vesubie>).

<a id="event-2020-10-04-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A multiple-vehicle collision on a main road in Fuyu, Jilin, China, kills 18 people. Police say an inquiry is under way into the cause of the accident.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/china-road-crash-18-killed-after-minivan-hits-tractor-and-then-collides-with-car-12089546>).

<a id="event-2020-10-04-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eight migrants are dead, while 12 more are missing, after three unidentified smugglers hijacked their boat off the coast of Djibouti, according to eyewitnesses and the International Organization for Migration. The agency reports that the migrants had attempted to reach Saudi Arabia via Yemen, but were forced to return to the Horn of Africa due to COVID-19 pandemic-related travel restrictions.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.macaubusiness.com/8-migrants-dead-12-missing-off-djibouti-coast-iom/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-10-04-3-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Poland.

**Archived source account.** Poland surpass 100,000 cases of COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://nationalpost.com/pmn/news-pmn/crime-pmn/polands-total-number-of-coronavirus-cases-exceeds-100000-2>).

<a id="event-2020-10-04-3-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Russia reports 10,499 new cases in the past 24 hours, setting a record for the highest number of daily new cases since May 15, when the outbreak was at its peak and lockdowns were in place in parts of the country. This is also the first time that daily new infections surpassed 10,000 since May.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Sabah](<https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/russia-records-over-10000-coronavirus-cases-for-1st-time-since-may>).

<a id="event-2020-10-04-3-7"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom surpasses 500,000 cases of COVID-19 after a backlog of infections left out of Public Health England's daily figures between September 25 and October 2 led to a record 22,961 cases reported in 24 hours. The glitch led to 15,841 cases not being passed on to data dashboards used for contact tracing.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/oct/04/delay-in-reporting-uk-coronavirus-cases-risks-further-spread-say-scientists>).

<a id="event-2020-10-05-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The government announces it will ban the animal fur trade, becoming the first country to do so. The government said the record was due to a change of methodology which includes additional cases that were not reported from June.

The restrictions will last two weeks, but restaurants will remain open with strict health protocols.

The measure, which will take effect tomorrow, will include closing times for establishments at 11:00 p.m. local time with the last customer permitted to enter an hour earlier, and capacity in bars and restaurants limited to 50% indoors and 60% outdoor in a similar move that was implemented in Madrid.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-10-09-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / Taliban insurgency / October 2020 Afghanistan attacks.

**Archived source account.** The Taliban kills four Afghan soldiers and four police officers in Aliabad District, Kunduz Province. Five soldiers and two police are also injured in the attack. In Helmand Province, the Taliban kills at least three security forces and injures another three.

Source citations (as archived): [TOLOnews](<https://tolonews.com/afghanistan-166919>).

<a id="event-2020-10-09-0-5"></a>

Context: Second Nagorno-Karabakh War.

**Archived source account.** Armenia and Azerbaijan agree to a ceasefire in the disputed Nagorno-Karabakh effective 03:00 a.m. local time, following Russian-brokered peace talks in Moscow. However, fighting continues and both sides accuse each other of violating the agreement.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-54488386>).

<a id="event-2020-10-09-0-7"></a>

Context: Mali War.

**Archived source account.** Switzerland says it has been informed that a female Swiss hostage has been killed in Mali by jihadist group Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal Muslimin. The exact circumstances of the killing are still unclear, according to Foreign Minister Ignazio Cassis.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-swiss-mali/swiss-hostage-in-mali-killed-swiss-foreign-ministry-idUKKBN26U2FD?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-10-09-0-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** An attack leaves at least eight people dead at a camp for Rohingya people in Bangladesh. Bangladeshi authorities detain 12 people after multiple attacks, including arson and gunfire, occurred for several days.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera English](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/10/9/several-killed-in-gang-war-at-rohingya-camps-in-bangladesh>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-10-09-6-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Czech Senate election.

**Archived source account.** The second round to elect a third of the Czech Republic's Senate takes place. The first round indicated an electoral victory for Prime Minister Andrej Babiš' party ANO 2011.

Source citations (as archived): [Foreign Brief](<https://www.foreignbrief.com/daily-news/czech-senate-to-start-second-round-of-elections/>).

<a id="event-2020-10-09-6-3"></a>

Context: 2020 Nobel Peace Prize.

**Archived source account.** The Nobel Peace Prize is awarded to the United Nations World Food Programme "for its efforts to combat hunger, for its contribution to bettering conditions for peace in conflict-affected areas and for acting as a driving force in efforts to prevent the use of hunger as a weapon of war and conflict."

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/europe/live-news/nobel-peace-prize-2020-scli-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-10-09-6-5"></a>

Context: Cyprus dispute.

**Archived source account.** The self-declared Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus re-opens Varosha, Famagusta, to the public. The area was abandoned in 1974 during the Turkish invasion of Cyprus, and access is forbidden under international law imposed by the United Nations Buffer Zone in Cyprus. Russia condemns the decision, calling it "unacceptable", and Cyprus has requested the United Nations intervene to stop the re-opening.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/oct/09/terrible-day-anger-as-pictures-show-varosha-beach-in-cyprus-opening-after-46-years>).

<a id="event-2020-10-09-6-7"></a>

Context: 2020 United States presidential debates.

**Archived source account.** The Commission on Presidential Debates formally cancels the second presidential debate of the 2020 election, scheduled for October 15 between Donald Trump and Democratic Party nominee Joe Biden. It is the first time in U.S. history that a presidential debate has been cancelled. An alternative "virtual debate" was proposed due to health concerns after Trump tested positive for COVID-19, but was turned down by Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/10/09/politics/second-presidential-debate-canceled/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-10-09-6-9"></a>

Context: 2020 Kyrgyzstani protests.

**Archived source account.** President Sooronbay Jeenbekov declares a state of emergency in the capital Bishkek and deploys the country's armed forces across the city following serious political unrest that came after the now-overturned 2020 elections.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/10/09/europe/kyrgyzstan-troops-state-emergency-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-10-09-6-10"></a>

Context: 2020 Kyrgyzstani protests.

**Archived source account.** Jeenbekov says that he is ready to resign once a new cabinet is approved.

Source citations (as archived): [Financial Times](<https://www.ft.com/content/db1e81f1-a330-4fb0-8eca-3898cd3c355b>); [Nagaland Post](<http://www.nagalandpost.com/ready-to-resign-after-cabinet-s-approval-kyrgyz-president/223041.html>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-10-12-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A highway is closed and power is shut off in parts of Helmand Province amidst brutal fighting in which 71 Taliban fighters have been killed and the deputy shadow governor of Helmand, Mawlawi Ghafoor, has been arrested. The governor's office says that Ghafoor was recently released as part of peace negotiations.

Source citations (as archived): [TOLO News](<https://tolonews.com/afghanistan-166984>).

<a id="event-2020-10-12-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** British Airways CEO Álex Cruz is fired as the airline struggles with both reduced passengers caused by the COVID-19 pandemic, and heavy criticisms from labour unions and MPs for massive firings and large pay cuts. Sean Doyle, CEO of Irish flag carrier Aer Lingus, immediately assumes his position.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-54505840>).

<a id="event-2020-10-12-1-3"></a>

<a id="event-2020-10-12-2-0"></a>

Maharashtra Chief Minister Uddhav Thackeray orders an investigation into the cause.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-54505643?__twitter_impression=true>); [NDTV](<https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/major-power-outage-in-mumbai-due-to-incoming-electric-supply-failure-2308740>).

<a id="event-2020-10-13-3-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands.

**Archived source account.** The number of daily cases in the Netherlands surges by 7,393, which is new record high for a single day.

Source citations (as archived): [CGTN](<https://newsaf.cgtn.com/news/2020-10-13/Daily-COVID-19-infections-in-Netherlands-hit-new-high-Uz0tI76Bqw/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-10-13-3-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands.

**Archived source account.** Authorities reports the first confirmed death from COVID-19 reinfection. It comes after an elderly woman, aged 89, who had a rare bone marrow type of non-Hodgkin lymphoma, called Waldenström's macroglobulinemia, which compromised her immune system, died because of reinfection of the virus.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/global-health/science-and-disease/first-death-covid-19-reinfection-reported-netherlands/amp/>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/10/13/europe/covid-19-dutch-woman-reinfection-death-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-10-13-3-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Mark Rutte and Health Minister Hugo de Jonge announce new restrictions, such as restarting a partial lockdown. The new measures include closing bars and restaurants, banning alcohol sales after 8:00 p.m. local time, restricting retail opening hours, and banning gatherings of more than 30 people across the country. This measure also includes making wearing cloth masks mandatory for people at least 13 years old in indoor spaces. The government says the measures will take effect tomorrow and last for at least four weeks, with a review of their impact after two weeks.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20201013-dutch-pm-rutte-imposes-partial-lockdown-to-contain-coronavirus>).

<a id="event-2020-10-13-3-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Giuseppe Conte signs a decree that restricts private gatherings to more than six people inside homes and sets a limit of 30 guests for banquets organized after religious or civil ceremonies. It also bans parties, school trips, and informal amateur contact sports, while also ordering restaurants, bars, and ice-cream sellers to stop serving non-seated customers after 9:00 p.m. local time to avoid crowds.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2020/10/13/world/italy-tightens-rules-for-the-second-time-in-a-week-to-slow-infections.html>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-10-18-0-5"></a>

A video showing the Azerbaijani flag over the partially destroyed crossing is circulated on Azeri media. The bridges had been under Armenian control since 1993.

Source citations (as archived): [Almasdar News](<https://www.almasdarnews.com/article/azerbaijan-announces-capture-of-ancient-bridge-in-karabakh/>); [RIA](<https://ria.ru/20201018/azerbaydzhan-1580366141.html>).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/us-armenia-azerbaijan-karabakh/nagorno-karabakh-says-death-toll-among-its-military-rises-to-673-since-start-of-conflict-idUSKBN27306E>).

<a id="event-2020-10-18-0-8"></a>

Context: End SARS.

**Archived source account.** The Governor of Osun State, Nigeria, Gboyega Oyetola, escapes an assassination attempt. As he addressed a crowd, gunmen, also carrying machetes and throwing rocks, attacked his position. According to authorities, he was unharmed, but some of his bodyguards were injured.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-54589359>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2020-10-18-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Hay Festival announces it will cease hosting festivities in Abu Dhabi unless Emirati minister Sheikh Nahyan bin Mubarak Al Nahyan resigns. Yesterday he was accused of sexually assaulting a female British curator last February.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-54589968>).

<a id="event-2020-10-18-2-1"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, COVID-19 pandemic in Italy.

**Archived source account.** Italy approves a new $4.7 billion stimulus package in its 2021 budget to foster an economic rebound from the recession caused by the COVID-19 pandemic.

Source citations (as archived): [TRT World](<https://www.trtworld.com/business/italy-announces-new-stimulus-package-to-revive-virus-hit-economy-40682>).

<a id="event-2020-10-18-3-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Central Vietnam floods.

**Archived source account.** A landslide caused by heavy rain in central Vietnam hits an army barracks, killing at least 14 soldiers and leaving others missing.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/asia/vietnam-landslide-army-barracks-flooding-death-toll-quang-tri-latest-b1133088.html>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-10-18-4-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Italy.

**Archived source account.** Italy reports 11,705 new infections in the past 24 hours, the highest number in a single day yet since the outbreak started in February.

Source citations (as archived): [The Globe and Mail](<https://www.theglobeandmail.com/world/article-italy-daily-coronavirus-cases-hit-new-record-high-at-11705-health/>).

<a id="event-2020-10-18-4-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Italy.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Giuseppe Conte announces new measures that would give mayors a plan to impose curfews in their cities and towns at 9:00 p.m. local time. It also announces that it will suspend fairs and other local festivals; restaurants and bars are restricted to table service only after 6:00 p.m. local time with a maximum of six people, but they can still be closed at midnight. The new restrictions will come into effect at midnight and last until November 13.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/coronavirus-italy-tightens-socialising-rules-to-combat-covid-spike-including-a-rule-of-six-12107993>).

<a id="event-2020-10-18-4-6"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Switzerland.

**Archived source account.** Switzerland announces that it will ban gatherings of more than 15 people and issues a nationwide obligation to wear masks in all indoor public places and public transport in order to combat the spread of COVID-19. The new restrictions will take effect tomorrow.

Source citations (as archived): [Swiss Info](<https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/swiss-tighten-measures-to-combat-spike-in-covid-19-cases/46104530>).

<a id="event-2020-10-18-4-9"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania / COVID-19 pandemic in Australia, COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns.

**Archived source account.** Victorian Premier Daniel Andrews announces an easing of lockdown restrictions across Victoria, particularly Melbourne, after more than 100 days of the city's lockdown, effective at 11:59 p.m. AEST. According to new rules, five kilometre travel restrictions have been extended to 25 kilometres, with the city's two-hour time limits on gathering and exercising outside scrapped. Further restrictions are to be eased in the city on November 1, allowing retail and hospitality sectors to reopen.

Source citations (as archived): [9 News](<https://www.9news.com.au/national/coronavirus-melbourne-strict-lockdown-restrictions-to-ease-victoria/d36dfdf1-74aa-4aff-b7a8-b44540fc35ee>).

<a id="event-2020-10-18-4-11"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania / COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand.

**Archived source account.** New Zealand reports the first community case since September 25. This comes after a man who worked in the Ports of Auckland and Taranaki tested positive for COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [Newshub](<https://www.newshub.co.nz/home/new-zealand/2020/10/coronavirus-new-community-case-of-covid-19-in-new-zealand.html>).

<a id="event-2020-10-18-4-14"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia.

**Archived source account.** Malaysia surpasses 20,000 COVID-19 cases after a record of 871 new infections was reported in a single day; 702 of them are from Sabah. In addition, a record 701 recoveries were also reported.

Source citations (as archived): [The Malaysian Reserve](<https://themalaysianreserve.com/2020/10/18/malaysia-records-new-highest-covid-19-cases-and-recoveries/>); [The Straits Times](<https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/malaysia-reports-record-871-new-coronavirus-cases-and-seven-more-deaths>).

<a id="event-2020-10-18-4-16"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in the State of Palestine.

**Archived source account.** Palestinian chief negotiator Saeb Erekat is hospitalized in Hadassah University Hospital in Ein Karem, near Jerusalem, after his condition worsens due to COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-54587544>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-10-18-5-1"></a>

Context: Sanctions against Iran.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Security Council arms embargo on Iran formally expires. It had been in effect since 2007 and was due to expire under the 2015 Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action. Iranian Foreign Minister Mohammad Javad Zarif says, "Today's normalization of Iran's defense cooperation with the world is a win for the cause of multilateralism and peace and security in our region".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/uk-usa-iran-un-arms/iran-sees-no-arms-buying-spree-as-it-expects-un-embargo-to-end-idUSKBN2720WB>).

Context: Murder of Samuel Paty.

**Archived source account.** An eleventh person is detained in connection to the murder of history teacher Samuel Paty.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-france-security-idUSKBN2730DH>).

<a id="event-2020-10-18-6-2"></a>

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-10-18-7-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Bolivian general election.

**Archived source account.** Citizens in Bolivia head to the polls to elect their new president. This is the first time elections are held since the 2019 Bolivian political crisis which saw Evo Morales resigning from power and Jeanine Áñez temporarily taking power. The two main candidates are Luis Arce, representing Morales's party Movement for Socialism, and Carlos Mesa, representing the centrist Revolutionary Left Front.

Source citations (as archived): [CGTN](<https://news.cgtn.com/news/2020-10-18/Bolivia-hopes-for-a-peaceful-presidential-election-on-Sunday-UGsbFWU1Hi/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-10-18-7-2"></a>

Context: 2020 Bolivian general election.

**Archived source account.** An unofficial quick-count released by Unitel Bolivia projects Arce as the clear winner.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bolivia-election-arce/bolivian-socialist-candidate-set-to-win-election-outright-rapid-count-shows-idUSKBN2740CW>).

<a id="event-2020-10-18-7-4"></a>

Context: 2020 Guinean presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Citizens in Guinea head to the polls as incumbent Alpha Condé seeks another term facing off against the only other candidate, Cellou Dalein Diallo of the Union of Democratic Forces of Guinea political party.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/10/18/polls-open-in-guinea-as-president-conde-seeks-third-term>).

<a id="event-2020-10-18-7-6"></a>

Context: 2020 Northern Cypriot presidential election.

**Archived source account.** In a surprise upset, nationalist Prime Minister Ersin Tatar narrowly defeats pro-reunification incumbent Mustafa Akıncı in the second round to become President of Northern Cyprus.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/turkish-cypriot-hardliner-ousts-incumbent-president-in-northern-cyprus-vote/a-55314270>).

<a id="event-2020-10-18-7-8"></a>

Context: 2019–20 Chilean protests.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people gather in Plaza Baquedano, in downtown Santiago, to mark the first anniversary of the Chilean protests. Two churches were burned by a group of violent protesters.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/10/19/americas/chile-anniversary-protests-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-10-18-7-9"></a>

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-10-19-2-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Russia / COVID-19 vaccination in Russia.

**Archived source account.** It is announced that the first results of Russia's clinical trial for its Sputnik V vaccine will include data from 5,000 to 10,000 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-russia-vaccine-dat-idUSKBN27422I>).

<a id="event-2020-10-19-2-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Russia's new cases surge to a new record high of 15,982 in the last 24 hours, including 5,376 in Moscow, pushing the case total to 1,415,316.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-russia-cases-idUSKBN2740TI>).

<a id="event-2020-10-19-2-8"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom / COVID-19 pandemic in Wales, COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns.

**Archived source account.** First Minister Mark Drakeford announces that Wales will introduce a "firebreak" lockdown, which will require anyone to stay home between October 23 and November 9. Under those rules, pubs, restaurants, hotels, and non-essential businesses must close; primary schools will reopen after the half-term break, but only seventh and eighth years in secondary schools can return at that time under the new "firebreak" rules. In addition, gathering with people from other households indoors or outdoors will be banned.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-wales-54598136>).

<a id="event-2020-10-19-2-10"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Austria.

**Archived source account.** Chancellor Sebastian Kurz announces that private gatherings of more than six people indoors and twelve people outdoors will be banned in Austria from October 23, in an effort to curb the spread of COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [Dpa international](<https://www.dpa-international.com/topic/austria-limits-indoor-gatherings-six-people-slow-covid-19-urn%3Anewsml%3Adpa.com%3A20090101%3A201019-99-02593>).

<a id="event-2020-10-19-2-12"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of Ireland, COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns.

**Archived source account.** Taoiseach Micheál Martin announces that Ireland will move to Level Five for a period of six weeks. The new restrictions will take effect at midnight on October 21 and remain in place until December 1. Under Level Five restrictions, non-essential business will close, people will only be able to exercise within 5 km of their homes except for essential reasons, and no social or family gatherings are allowed in homes or gardens. However, schools and creches are to remain open, and elite sporting events can take place.

Source citations (as archived): [Gov.ie](<https://www.gov.ie/en/press-release/66269-ireland-placed-on-level-5-of-the-plan-for-living-with-covid/>); [ITV](<https://www.itv.com/news/utv/2020-10-19/republic-of-ireland-to-move-to-highest-level-of-covid-restrictions>).

<a id="event-2020-10-19-2-14"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Slovenia.

**Archived source account.** The government formally declares 30-day nationwide "state of epidemic" (known overseas as state of emergency) starting today. There are no changes for employees, students and others, but 9:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. local time curfew will be imposed tomorrow. The decree also limits gatherings to six people and movement among regions unless for essential or emergency reasons will be banned.

Source citations (as archived): [Government of Slovenia](<https://www.gov.si/en/news/2020-10-18-prime-minister-janez-jansa-the-epidemic-has-been-declared-today-for-the-whole-of-slovenia/>); [Barrons](<https://www.barrons.com/news/slovenia-brings-in-curfew-to-fight-virus-surge-01603113004?tesla=y>).

<a id="event-2020-10-19-2-16"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Spain.

**Archived source account.** The President of Navarra, María Chivite, announces a perimetral lockdown of the region, closing bars and restaurants, and limiting gatherings to cohabiting people, starting on Thursday and lasting for 15 days. In the last two weeks, Navarra has experienced a cumulative incidence of more than 900 per 100,000 inhabitants.

Source citations (as archived): [eldiario.es](<https://www.eldiario.es/navarra/navarra-confina-limita-entradas-salidas-comunidad-cierra-bares-restaurantes-frenar-contagios_1_6304183.html>).

<a id="event-2020-10-19-2-20"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Israel / COVID-19 vaccination in Israel.

**Archived source account.** The Israel Institute for Biological Research announces that its COVID-19 vaccine candidate will be named as Brilife, with phase 1 human trails expected to start during the end of the month.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/israel-names-its-vaccine-candidate-brilife-646254>).

<a id="event-2020-10-19-2-22"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Iran.

**Archived source account.** Iran reports 337 new deaths in the previous 24 hours, a new record of deaths since the beginning of the pandemic, pushing the death toll in the country to 30,712.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/iran-daily-covid-19-death-toll-hits-a-record-337-state-tv-13314464>).

<a id="event-2020-10-19-2-24"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina.

**Archived source account.** Argentina surpasses one million cases of COVID-19, becoming the fifth country to do so after the United States, India, Brazil, and Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-54609384>).

<a id="event-2020-10-19-2-26"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Canada.

**Archived source account.** Canada surpasses 200,000 cases of COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [CTV News](<https://www.ctvnews.ca/health/coronavirus/covid-19-cases-in-canada-surpass-200-000-1.5151488>).

<a id="event-2020-10-19-2-28"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 vaccine, COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil.

**Archived source account.** Sinovac Biotech's CoronaVac appears to be safe in providing protection against COVID-19, as preliminary results of Phase III clinical trial in Brazil show. São Paulo's Instituto Butantan, one of Brazil's leading biomedical research centres carrying out the trials, says CoronaVac proved to be safe after its two doses were applied to 9,000 volunteers, but said data on how effective it is in protecting people against COVID-19 will not be released until it has been tested on all 15,000 volunteers in newly expanded trials.

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<https://www.scmp.com/news/world/americas/article/3106177/tests-show-coronavirus-vaccine-chinas-sinovac-safe-says-brazils>).

<a id="event-2020-10-19-2-29"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** The total number of worldwide confirmed COVID-19 cases surpasses 40 million. The United States remains the global leader in case numbers, accounting for 20% of all cumulative cases, with India closely following at 19%.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2020/oct/19/coronavirus-live-news-global-infections-near-40m-as-us-covid-cases-rise-in-all-but-two-states?page=with:block-5f8d877b8f08d277d177d878>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-10-19-3-1"></a>

Context: Sudan–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump announces that the U.S. will remove Sudan from the list of State Sponsors of Terrorism after Sudan deposits US$335 million in a fund to compensate families of American victims of the 1998 United States embassy bombings. Sudanese Prime Minister Abdalla Hamdok thanks the U.S. government for the decision. The United States Congress would still have to approve restoring Sudan's sovereign immunity.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-sudan-usa/trump-u-s-to-remove-sudan-from-state-terrorism-sponsors-list-after-payment-to-victims-idUSKBN2742BE>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-10-20-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / October 2020 Afghanistan attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [TOLOnews](<https://tolonews.com/afghanistan-167188>).

<a id="event-2020-10-20-0-4"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / October 2020 Afghanistan attacks.

<a id="event-2020-10-20-0-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Gunmen storm a jail in Beni, Democratic Republic of the Congo, and free more than 1,300 inmates, also attacking the military camp that provides security to the prison. The town's mayor blames the Allied Democratic Forces, which he says used electrical equipment. Twenty inmates return, and two are shot dead.

It is reported that the soldiers had built a barricade and ambulances could not reach the protest area.

<a id="event-2020-10-20-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Canadian town of Asbestos, Quebec, votes to rename itself as Val-des-Sources. The name change, approved by a majority of the town's 7,000 residents, must now be approved by the provincial government.

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-10-20-2-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Bulgaria.

**Archived source account.** After new infections in Bulgaria hit a record 1,024 cases in the past 24 hours, Health Minister Kostadin Angelov announces that the country will make wearing protective masks obligatory in all outdoor spaces on October 22 in an attempt to slow the spread of the virus by about 30% and help prevent the health system from being overwhelmed.

Source citations (as archived): [Sofia Globe](<https://sofiaglobe.com/2020/10/20/covid-19-bulgaria-makes-wearing-masks-outdoors-compulsory-from-october-22/>).

<a id="event-2020-10-20-2-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Germany, COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns.

**Archived source account.** German authorities in Bavaria impose a lockdown in the district of Berchtesgadener Land starting at 2:00 p.m. local time today, making it the first area in Germany to go back into lockdown since April. Residents in the district for the next two weeks are not allowed to leave their homes unless for essential reasons, such as outdoor exercise, going to work, or buying groceries.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-germany/part-of-bavaria-goes-into-first-german-lockdown-since-april-idUSL8N2HA69V>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-54618827>).

Interior Minister Gérald Darmanin says France was confronted by an "enemy within".

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of people protests in Naples after stricter COVID-19 measures were imposed in the city and the whole region of Campania. Source citations (as archived): [Il Fatto Quotidiano](<https://www.ilfattoquotidiano.it/2020/10/24/proteste-a-napoli-contro-le-misure-di-de-luca-prima-il-corteo-per-le-strade-del-centro-poi-lancio-di-fumogeni-e-scontri-con-la-polizia/5978037/>); [ITV](<https://www.itv.com/news/2020-10-24/violent-protests-in-naples-as-italys-covid-restrictions-intensify>).

<a id="event-2020-10-23-4-4"></a>

Context: George Floyd protests, 2020–2021 United States racial unrest / George Floyd protests in Minneapolis–Saint Paul.

**Archived source account.** Federal prosecutors announce that Ivan Harrison Hunter, an alleged member of the Boogaloo Bois, has been charged for firing an AK-47 at a police station in Minneapolis during protests sparked by the killing of George Floyd.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/boogaloo-bois-member-charged-connection-shooting-minneapolis-police-station-during-n1244562>).

<a id="event-2020-10-23-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Gambia announces that they have submitted a lawsuit against Myanmar for their role in the Rohingya genocide at the International Court of Justice in The Hague.

Source citations (as archived): [Dhaka Tribune)](<https://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/rohingya-crisis/2020/10/23/the-gambia-submits-case-against-myanmar-for-rohingya-genocide (>); [The Daily Star)](<https://www.thedailystar.net/rohingya-crisis/news/the-gambia-files-memorial-icj-showing-myanmar-responsible-genocide-against-rohingyas-1983193 (>).

<a id="event-2020-10-23-4-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** The decomposed remains of seven people, believed to be undocumented migrants, are discovered in a fertiliser container in Asunción, Paraguay. The container set off from Serbia on 21 July and travelled through Croatia, Egypt, Spain and Argentina en route to Paraguay. Three of the seven were identified as being from Morocco and one from Egypt. According to the coroner, asphyxiation was the likely cause of death.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-54675172>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-10-26-4-1"></a>

Context: France–Turkey relations, aftermath of the murder of Samuel Paty.

**Archived source account.** Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan calls on all Turks and the Muslim world to boycott France over French President Emmanuel Macron's crackdown on radical Islam in French society. Erdoğan says Muslims in France are now "subjected to a lynch campaign similar to that against Jews in Europe before World War II". The leaders of Germany, Italy and the Netherlands condemn Erdoğan's comments and declare their support for France.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-54692485>).

<a id="event-2020-10-26-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Japan rejects the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons after all nuclear powers boycott the treaty. This rejection happened days after the United Nations said there was enough signatories for it to go into effect and following pressure from atomic bomb survivors to adopt it. Japan states it is unrealistic to pursue the treaty with both nuclear and non-nuclear states being sharply divided over it, and instead the country will serve as a bridge to narrow the gap between the two sides.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/japan-rejects-nuclear-ban-treaty-survivors-pushing-73831333>).

Police prevented the protesters from reaching the French Embassy.

<a id="event-2020-10-27-3-7"></a>

Agreements on nuclear energy, earth sciences and alternative medicine are also signed.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-turkey-netherlands-erdogan/erdogan-files-criminal-complaint-against-dutch-politician-wilders-idUSKBN27C1PK?il=0>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-10-27-4-1"></a>

Context: 2020–2021 United States racial unrest, Killing of Walter Wallace.

**Archived source account.** Protests break out in Philadelphia after police shoot and kill Walter Wallace, who they say had been armed with a knife. There are also reports of vandalism, including looting, spray painting and smashing of windows at a police station. Police also say 30 officers have been injured, many of which were struck by bricks and other debris, and that 91 protesters were arrested.

<a id="event-2020-10-28-3-44"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in South Africa.

Source citations (as archived): [Sowetanlive](<https://www.sowetanlive.co.za/news/south-africa/2020-10-28-cyril-ramaphosa-goes-into-self-isolation/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-10-28-4-1"></a>

Context: France–Turkey relations.

**Archived source account.** Turkey threatens to take "legal and diplomatic action" in response to French magazine Charlie Hebdo's caricature mocking Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan. Turkish Vice President Fuat Oktay condemns the publication. France responds by saying that the country would not give in to "destabilisation and intimidation attempts."

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20201028-turkey-blasts-charlie-hebdo-s-immoral-caricature-of-erdogan>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-10-28-5-1"></a>

Context: 2020–2021 United States racial unrest, Black Lives Matter.

**Archived source account.** Protesters march through Philadelphia for a second night, demanding racial justice after the killing of Walter Wallace. The marches began peacefully but became more confrontational into the evening and Wednesday morning. Police and the city's office of emergency management said looting was reported in several areas. Protesters try to erect makeshift barricades using bins while police use pepper spray and batons after saying they were attacked by demonstrators.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-54710244>).

<a id="event-2020-10-28-5-3"></a>

Context: Gretchen Whitmer kidnapping plot.

**Archived source account.** An unsealed search warrant reveals that Barry Croft, one of the suspects accused in federal court of plotting to kidnap Michigan Governor Gretchen Whitmer, has also discussed South Carolina Governor Henry McMaster and President Donald Trump as possible targets.

Source citations (as archived): [The Detroit News](<https://www.detroitnews.com/story/news/local/michigan/2020/10/28/militia-member-helped-feds-infiltrate-whitmer-kidnap-crew-fbi-says/6060368002/>); [The Post and Courier](<https://www.postandcourier.com/columbia/news/sc-gov-mcmaster-was-target-of-group-accused-of-plotting-to-kidnap-michigan-governor/article_36a665a4-196d-11eb-a91c-0ffded180433.html>).

<a id="event-2020-10-28-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The FBI arrests five people in the United States, and charges three more, for spying on opponents of the Chinese Communist Party and trying, among other things, to coerce them to return home to face trial.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-54724471>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-10-29-0-3"></a>

Context: Islamic terrorism in Europe / Terrorism in France / 2020 Nice stabbing.

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed at Notre-Dame de Nice in Nice, by an attacker shouting "Allahu Akbar". The city's mayor describes the incident as "terrorism" while police investigate the case. The attacker has been shot and arrested by police.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-france-security-nice/three-dead-as-woman-beheaded-in-knife-attack-at-french-church-idUSKBN27E17D>).

<a id="event-2020-10-29-0-4"></a>

Context: Islamic terrorism in Europe / Terrorism in France.

**Archived source account.** A man is arrested near a church in Sartrouville, Île-de-France, after police received a call from his father. The man had been trying to carry out a stabbing attack and was quoted as saying he was inspired by the Nice attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Le Parisien](<https://www.leparisien.fr/yvelines-78/un-homme-interpelle-pres-d-une-eglise-a-sartrouville-apres-avoir-voulu-faire-comme-a-nice-29-10-2020-8405566.php>).

<a id="event-2020-10-29-0-5"></a>

Context: Islamic terrorism in Europe / Terrorism in France.

**Archived source account.** A man is shot dead by police in Montfavet, Avignon, after threatening police and a trader of a North African background with a handgun. The man was reported to be a member of a far-right French organisation and also having a history of psychiatric treatment.

Source citations (as archived): [Libération](<https://www.liberation.fr/france/2020/10/29/avignon-un-attaque-menee-par-un-identitaire_1803871>).

<a id="event-2020-10-29-0-6"></a>

Context: Islamic terrorism in Europe / Terrorism in France.

**Archived source account.** A man carrying a knife is arrested in Lyon for plotting to attack people aboard a tram, according to police.

Source citations (as archived): [Le Parisien](<https://www.leparisien.fr/faits-divers/lyon-un-homme-arme-d-un-couteau-arrete-dans-le-centre-ville-29-10-2020-8405559.php>).

<a id="event-2020-10-29-0-7"></a>

Context: Islamic terrorism in Europe / Terrorism in France.

**Archived source account.** An hour after the attack in Nice, a French guard is stabbed and wounded by a knifeman outside the French consulate in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. The attacker is then arrested by security forces.

Source citations (as archived): [The News International](<https://www.thenews.com.pk/amp/736551-saudi-man-arrested-for-attacking-guard-at-french-consulate-in-jeddah>).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-congo-security/suspected-islamists-kill-18-torch-church-in-east-congo-idUKKBN27E1WQ>).

<a id="event-2020-10-31-0-2"></a>

Context: Second Nagorno-Karabakh War / Armenia–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan formally requests "urgent consultations on providing security" to Russian President Vladimir Putin amid its escalating conflict with Azerbaijan in disputed Nagorno-Karabakh that has left thousands dead. Russia says it would provide "necessary" assistance to Armenia without alluding further.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20201031-armenia-requests-russia-s-help-after-no-new-trucein-nagorno-karabakh-conflict>).

Source citations (as archived): [TASS](<https://tass.com/world/1218643>); [Al Masdar News](<https://www.almasdarnews.com/article/azerbaijani-forces-use-white-phosphorus-over-karabakh-video/>).

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/10/31/21-dead-in-new-dr-congo-massacre-by-adf-rebel-group-official>).

Context: 2020 Nigeria hostage rescue.

**Archived source account.** SEAL Team Six conducts a predawn raid in northern Nigeria, rescuing American hostage Philip Walton, who was kidnapped in Niger. The Pentagon says no U.S. military personnel were injured in the operation.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/seal-team-6-rescues-us-citizen-philip-walton-nigeria/>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-11-02-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four civilians are killed and 22 others injured after a gunman opens fire in six locations in the streets of Vienna, Austria, near the central Schwedenplatz square. The Interior Minister described it as a "terror attack". The attacker was shot dead, and is identified as an Islamic supporter who tried to join the group in Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-54788613>).

<a id="event-2020-11-02-2-2"></a>

Context: 2020 Pacific typhoon season / Typhoon Goni.

**Archived source account.** The death toll in the Philippines from Typhoon Goni, the world's strongest this year, rises to 20 people. Electricity, water and phone networks are cut off in Catanduanes, while homes are buried under volcanic rocks in Albay; those two are the provinces where all the deaths occurred. About one million people have been evacuated.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/11/2/typhoon-goni-duterte-to-inspect-damage-as-philippine-toll-rises>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-11-04-0-1"></a>

Context: Tigray War.

**Archived source account.** The Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF) launches a surprise attack on the Northern Command of the federal army of Ethiopia, resulting in multiple casualties and the capture of 5 federal military bases in Tigray Region including the Northern Command headquarters. Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed orders a military response, saying that the "last red line has been crossed". Later in the day, federal troops enter the region and heavy fighting is reported.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-954805088>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ethiopia-conflict/ethiopia-sends-army-into-tigray-region-heavy-fighting-reported-idUSKBN27K0ZS?il=0>).

Context: 2020 Atlantic hurricane season.

**Archived source account.** Hurricane Eta is set to head towards Florida after hitting the Caribbean and Central America, especially Nicaragua and parts of Honduras. The slow-moving hurricane, which peaked at category 4, caused floods and devastation in Nicaragua and hurricane warnings are still in place for parts of Nicaragua.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/11/04/weather/hurricane-eta-wednesday/index.html>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-11-05-0-2"></a>

Context: Second Nagorno-Karabakh War / 2020 bombardment of Stepanakert.

**Archived source account.** Azerbaijani forces shell the Artsakh capital of Stepanakert and several other cities, including Shusha and Martuni, using heavy artillery. A journalist in the capital told Reuters, "The air raid siren hasn't stopped all day". Reporters Without Borders calls on the United Nations and Azerbaijan to allow the evacuation of civilians, including 80 local and foreign journalists.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-armenia-azerbaijan/heavy-shelling-hits-nagorno-karabakhs-largest-city-sources-idUSKBN27L2M3>).

<a id="event-2020-11-05-0-4"></a>

Context: Second Nagorno-Karabakh War / Lachin offensive.

**Archived source account.** The strategic Lachin corridor is closed by Armenian forces as Azerbaijani troops advance within a few kilometres south of Shusha.

Source citations (as archived): [RFERL](<https://www.rferl.org/a/azerbaijani-forces-close-in-on-nagorno-karabakh-s-unassailable-mountain-fortress-city-shushi-susa-/30932210.html>).

<a id="event-2020-11-05-0-6"></a>

Context: Tigray military intervention.

**Archived source account.** The Ethiopian National Defense Force declares it is "at war" with the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF), which controls the northern Tigray Region. TPLF Chairman Debretsion Gebremichael says fighting with federal troops is taking place in western Tigray.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/nov/05/ethiopian-military-claims-to-be-at-war-with-tigray-leaders>).

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1361328141](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20November%209&oldid=1361328141>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-11-09-0-1"></a>

Context: Second Nagorno-Karabakh War.

**Archived source account.** A Russian Mil Mi-24 helicopter is shot down by the Azerbaijani Armed Forces over Armenia, near the Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic. Russia says two crew members are killed. Azerbaijan apologizes, extends condolences, and offers to pay compensation.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-54874162>).

<a id="event-2020-11-09-0-2"></a>

Context: Second Nagorno-Karabakh War.

**Archived source account.** Artsakh officials in Nagorno-Karabakh confirm the loss of Shusha to Azeri forces. Many civilians in Shusha have fled, and fighting is closing on the region's capital, Stepanakert.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/11/9/ethnic-armenians-confirm-loss-of-shusha-to-azeri-forces>).

<a id="event-2020-11-09-0-3"></a>

Context: Second Nagorno-Karabakh War.

**Archived source account.** Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan announces he has signed a deal with Azerbaijan and Russia to end the war by Tuesday morning. A Kremlin spokesman confirms the deal. Later, Azerbaijan's president Ilham Aliyev says a "trilateral agreement" has been signed. President of Russia Vladimir Putin says Russian peacekeepers will be deployed. The agreement cedes several districts to Azerbaijan, including the Lachin District. The agreement will also establish a transport corridor through Armenia, linking Azerbaijan to Nakhchivan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-armenia-azerbaijan/armenia-says-signs-deal-with-azerbaijan-and-russia-to-end-conflict-idUSKBN27P1FL>).

<a id="event-2020-11-09-0-4"></a>

Context: Second Nagorno-Karabakh War.

**Archived source account.** The peace deal is met with anger in Armenia as thousands protest against it in the capital Yerevan with some protesters storming the parliament building.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/nov/10/nagorno-karabakh-armenia-pm-signs-deal-to-end-war-with-azerbaijan-and-russia>).

<a id="event-2020-11-09-0-5"></a>

Context: Second Nagorno-Karabakh War.

**Archived source account.** Hours after signing of the deal, Ararat Mirzoyan, the president of Armenia's National Assembly, is pulled from his car and attacked by an angry mob of protesters.

Source citations (as archived): [Interfax](<https://www.interfax.ru/world/736343>).

<a id="event-2020-11-09-0-7"></a>

Context: ISIL insurgency in Iraq.

**Archived source account.** Unidentified gunmen using grenades and automatic weapons attacked an army post in western Baghdad, killing 11 people, including soldiers. Both the military and police have launched a manhunt for the gunmen.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/11/9/gunmen-kill-11-in-attack-on-iraqi-army-post-in-baghdad>).

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/11/11/bahrain-pm-has-died-royal-palace-says>).

Context: 2019–20 Hong Kong protests; Legislative Council of Hong Kong.

**Archived source account.** Four Hong Kong pro-democracy activists, Alvin Yeung, Dennis Kwok, Kwok Ka-ki and Kenneth Leung, are stripped of their seats following a decision by China's National People's Congress Standing Committee. 15 pro-democracy legislators announced their resignations shortly after the announcement, also declaring "that 'One Country, Two Systems' has come to an end". Critics fear this will turn the legislature into a rubber stamp for pro-Beijing policies.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/11/11/asia/hong-kong-lawmakers-unseated-china-intl-hnk/index.html>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/nov/11/china-pro-democracy-hong-kong-lawmakers-opposition-oust>).

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1288770257](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20November%2012&oldid=1288770257>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-11-12-0-1"></a>

Context: Tigray military intervention.

**Archived source account.** Amnesty International reports that massacres are taking place in the Tigray Region of Ethiopia after a conflict broke out last week. Amnesty cites witnesses blaming the Tigray People's Liberation Front for the "horrific tragedy" taking place as airstrikes continue to hit the region after Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed blamed the political group of committing war crimes. Amnesty's report could not identify the perpetrators of the massacres.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ethiopia-conflict/amnesty-reports-massacre-in-ethiopias-tigray-as-conflict-rages-idUSKBN27S0K3>).

<a id="event-2020-11-12-1-2"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic / Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in India.

**Archived source account.** Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announces a $35.14 billion package to stimulate the economy by boosting jobs, consumer demand, manufacturing, agriculture and exports hit by the COVID-19 pandemic. She said the package includes 9 billion rupees ($121 million) for development of a vaccine by the government’s biotechnology department.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/india-announces-35-billion-economic-stimulus-package-74165709>).

<a id="event-2020-11-12-2-6"></a>

### 2020-11-14

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1100711306](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20November%2014&oldid=1100711306>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-11-14-0-2"></a>

Context: Tigray conflict / Asmara rocket attacks.

**Archived source account.** Explosions are reported in the Eritrean capital Asmara amid reports of a missile attack from Tigray, Ethiopia. The Eritrean government confirms missiles were launched at the capital but said that they missed and instead landed in the countryside. The attack comes just hours after the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF) threatened to target Eritrea.

Source citations (as archived): [Eritrea Hub](<https://eritreahub.org/missiles-hit-eritrean-capital-asmara-after-tigray-threatens-to-attack-eritrea>).

<a id="event-2020-11-14-0-3"></a>

Context: Tigray conflict.

**Archived source account.** The TPLF launched missiles at Gondar Airport and Bahir Dar Airport in Amhara Region, Ethiopia. A spokesman for the TPLF says, "As long as the attacks on the people of Tigray do not stop, the attacks will intensify".

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/11/14/africa/ethiopia-airport-tigray-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-11-14-0-4"></a>

Context: Tigray conflict.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of people cross the Tekezé River on small boats into Sudan, fleeing the escalating fighting in Tigray. There are now around 8,000 refugees stranded on the Ethiopia–Sudan border.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-ethiopia-conflict-refugees/fleeing-tigray-war-ethiopians-cross-river-into-sudan-idUKKBN27U0JS?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-11-14-0-6"></a>

Context: 2020 Western Saharan clashes.

**Archived source account.** The Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic declares war on Morocco, formally ending a 29-year truce.

Source citations (as archived): [Axios](<https://www.axios.com/western-sahara-end-independence-truce-morocco-b97f386e-6ca3-45fb-aefe-13656f37f54d.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-11-15-6-1"></a>

Context: SpaceX Crew-1, Expedition 64.

**Archived source account.** SpaceX successfully launches its Crew Dragon spacecraft carrying three NASA astronauts, Michael S. Hopkins, Victor J. Glover, Shannon Walker and JAXA astronaut Soichi Noguchi to the International Space Station. It is the first crewed operational flight of a Crew Dragon spacecraft and the first night launch in the United States since STS-130.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-54938444>).

Abiy also confirms that airstrikes are being carried out but defines them as "precision-led and surgical", denying claims of civilian casualties.

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-11-17-4-2"></a>

Context: 2020 United States presidential election / Presidential transition of Joe Biden.

**Archived source account.** President-elect Joe Biden and Vice President-elect Kamala Harris attend an unofficial security briefing from a team consisting of former advisers to both the Obama and Trump administrations. The briefing stems from the Trump administration's refusal to cooperate with the Biden-Harris transition team.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-election/biden-kamala-harris-briefing-trump-transition-b1724404.html>).

<a id="event-2020-11-17-4-3"></a>

Context: 2020 United States presidential election.

**Archived source account.** President Donald Trump fires Chris Krebs, the Director of the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA), which oversaw the security of the 2020 election. Deputy Director Matthew Travis, who had expected to become acting director, is forced to resign. Krebs and the CISA have refuted Trump's accusations of voter fraud, calling the election the "most secure in American history". Trump has called Krebs' statements "highly inaccurate".

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national-security/trump-fires-dhs-election-official/2020/11/17/97d3fa5c-251c-11eb-952e-0c475972cfc0_story.html>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-11-19-0-1"></a>

Context: Tigray conflict.

**Archived source account.** Federal troops seize the town of Shire Inda Selassie from the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF) as government forces advance on the Tigray Region's capital Mekelle. There are conflicting reports of the status of Axum, with both sides claiming to control the town. TPLF leader Debretsion Gebremichael says his forces will never surrender and calls on all Tigrayans, including children, to mobilize and take up arms.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-54984056>); [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-ethiopia-conflict-axum/leader-of-ethiopias-rebel-tigray-forces-says-axum-town-with-us-idUKKBN27Z10E>).

<a id="event-2020-11-19-0-2"></a>

<a id="event-2020-11-22-0-1"></a>

Context: Insurgency in the Maghreb.

**Archived source account.** Al-Qaeda in the Islamic Maghreb (AQIM) names Algerian Islamist Abu Obaida Yusuf al-Annabi as its new leader, following the death of Abdelmalek Droukdel during the Battle of Talahandak in June. Al-Annabi has been on the U.S. "international terrorist" blacklist since September 2015, and he has regularly appeared in jihadist propaganda videos.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/11/22/al-qaeda-in-north-africa-appoints-leader-to-replace-droukdel>).

Context: Tigray conflict / Battle of Mekelle (2020).

**Archived source account.** Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed issues an ultimatum to the leaders of the Tigray People's Liberation Front, giving the group 72 hours to surrender before federal forces begin a ground offensive to capture the region's capital Mekelle. The Ethiopian military says Mekelle will be "encircled" and "shown no mercy".

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/nov/22/ethiopian-military-warns-mekelle-civilians-ahead-of-assault-on-city>).

<a id="event-2020-11-24-0-6"></a>

Context: Kivu conflict.

**Archived source account.** Following a two-year trial, former Nduma Defense of Congo militia leader Ntabo Ntaberi Sheka is sentenced to life imprisonment for "murder, rape, sexual slavery and enlisting children under 15 years old" by a military court. Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/11/24/impunity-is-not-inevitable-dr-congo-ex-warlord-gets-life-term>).

**Archived source account.** Japan detects a new case of what is believed to be a highly pathogenic strain of avian influenza at a poultry farm in Fukuoka Prefecture. #### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-11-27-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed rejects talks with the leadership of the Tigray People's Liberation Front but says he is willing to talk to representatives "operating legally". The meeting with African Union (AU) representatives Ellen Johnson Sirleaf of Liberia, Joaquim Chissano of Mozambique and Kgalema Motlanthe of South Africa, comes after his announcement of a "final phase" of an offensive on the region's capital Mekelle.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/coronavirus-pandemic-abiy-ahmed-ethiopia-united-nations-kenya-f497300cca1a6560c5e8ae48fde442b5>).

Context: Mali War.

**Archived source account.** Six rice farmers are killed by gunmen in the village of Farabougou, Mali, bringing the death toll to 23 since the siege of the village by suspected jihadists began nearly two months ago.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/mali-security/six-farmers-killed-near-besieged-central-mali-village-says-town-mayor-idUSKBN2871YF>).

<a id="event-2020-11-27-0-7"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Indonesia.

**Archived source account.** Four Christians are killed and seven houses are burned by militants in Sigi, Central Sulawesi. The police believes that attacks was carried out by East Indonesia Mujahideen (MIT), a terrorist group linked to the Islamic State.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/indonesia-police-hunt-suspected-militants-4-killed-christians-13657572>).

<a id="event-2020-11-27-0-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iran's most senior nuclear scientist, Mohsen Fakhrizadeh, is assassinated by gunmen in Absard. The attackers blow up a car and then open fire on his vehicle, seriously wounding him; he later dies in a hospital. Three or four of the attackers are later killed during a gunfight with Fakhrizadeh's bodyguards. Iran's Foreign Minister Mohammad Javad Zarif has called the killing an act of state terror.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-55105934>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-11-28-0-2"></a>

Context: Tigray conflict / Mekelle offensive.

**Archived source account.** Federal forces say that they have seized the town of Wukro in Ethiopia's Tigray Region as they advance on the region's capital Mekelle. Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF) leader Debretsion Gebremichael confirms that government forces had started an operation to capture Mekelle, saying his forces are "ready to die in defence of our right to administer our region".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-55111061>).

<a id="event-2020-11-28-0-3"></a>

Context: Tigray conflict / Mekelle offensive.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed says that the Ethiopian military is in "full control" of Mekelle after entering the regional capital with limited resistance and are now searching for Tigrayan officials. Chief of General Staff Birhanu Jula Gelalcha says government forces have now "completely controlled Mekelle", and that 7,000 Northern Command members being held hostage by the TPLF have been freed.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/11/28/ethiopian-army-takes-full-control-of-tigray-capital-abiy-says>).

<a id="event-2020-11-28-0-4"></a>

### 2020-11-30

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-11-30-0-1"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Al-Shabaab militants attack a military base in Baladweyne, Somalia, killing 21 people. Fifty-one militants also died during the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2020-12/02/c_139556545.htm>).

<a id="event-2020-11-30-0-3"></a>

Context: Mali War.

**Archived source account.** Rocket attacks are carried out in three northern Malian cities – Gao, Kidal and Ménaka – against French military bases. No one is killed or injured. Al-Qaeda in the Islamic Maghreb claims responsibility for the attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [Le Monde](<https://www.lemonde.fr/afrique/article/2020/11/30/plusieurs-attaques-contre-des-camps-de-l-armee-francaise-et-des-forces-de-l-onu-au-mali_6061680_3212.html>).

<a id="event-2020-11-30-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iraqi and local officials say a senior Iranian Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) commander and three others have been killed in a drone strike near the Iraq–Syria border. The identity of the commander and who conducted the airstrike is currently unknown.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/iraq-iran-syria-militias/air-strike-kills-irgc-commander-at-iraq-syria-border-iraqi-officials-idUSKBN28A2SB>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-11-30-1-1"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** British retail tycoon Philip Green's Arcadia Group collapses into administration, putting over 13,000 jobs at risk and becoming the United Kingdom's biggest corporate casualty of the COVID-19 pandemic so far. Arcadia CEO Ian Grabiner blames the pandemic for the company's demise, saying "the obstacles we encountered were far too severe".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-retail-green/philip-greens-arcadia-uk-fashion-group-falls-into-administration-idUSKBN28A2TQ?il=0>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-12-01-0-1"></a>

Context: 2020–21 Australian bushfire season.

**Archived source account.** A bushfire on Fraser Island, a UNESCO World Heritage Site off the coast of Queensland, has burned across half the island and may irreversibly damage its unique ecosystem. Extinguishment has been ruled unlikely.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2020/dec/01/catastrophic-bushfire-on-queenslands-fraser-island-threatens-ecological-disaster>).

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/dec/01/arecibo-radio-telescope-collapses-puerto-rico>).

<a id="event-2020-12-01-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Five people are killed and 18 others injured in Trier, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany, when a man drives an SUV into a pedestrian zone. The driver, a 51-year-old male German national, was arrested and was reportedly drunk at the time of the crash.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-55148518>).

<a id="event-2020-12-01-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A group of gunmen attack a bank and block roads in Cametá, Brazil, taking several hostages and stealing money. The attackers kill a hostage with a gunshot to the head, while a security guard and a policeman are injured. Several shots and explosions were also reported. It appears that the target of the attack was a branch of Banco do Brasil, the same bank robbed in Criciúma the previous night.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-55155377>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-12-01-5-1"></a>

Context: 2020 SO.

**Archived source account.** Unknown astronomical object 2020 SO makes its closest approach to Earth at a perigee distance of approximately 0.13 lunar distances (50,000 km; 31,000 mi). Researchers, who discovered 2020 SO on September 17, 2020, are still unsure whether the object is a small near-Earth asteroid or an artificial object. The booster of Surveyor 2's Atlas-Centaur rocket, launched by NASA in 1966, is suspected by the Jet Propulsion Laboratory.

Source citations (as archived): [CNET](<https://www.cnet.com/how-to/how-to-watch-a-mysterious-object-that-might-be-space-junk-fly-near-earth-today/>).

<a id="event-2020-12-01-5-3"></a>

Context: Chang'e 5, Chinese Lunar Exploration Program.

**Archived source account.** China National Space Administration probe Chang'e 5 successfully lands at Mons Rümker on the Moon for the first lunar sample-return mission since the Soviet Union's Luna 24.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2020/12/01/science/china-moon-landing.html>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-55148998>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-12-02-3-1"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Hungary.

**Archived source account.** Hungarian MEP, EPP Chief Whip and Vice-President, and one of the founders of the anti-LGBT Fidesz party, József Szájer, resigns after being detained by police at a homosexual orgy in Brussels alongside several other diplomats. He stands accused by Belgian authorities of being in possession of illegal drugs and violating COVID-19 restrictions.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-55145989>).

<a id="event-2020-12-02-3-3"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in Egypt.

**Archived source account.** Amnesty International condemns a sharp rise in the use of the death penalty in Egypt, accusing authorities of executing 57 people in October and November alone, nearly double the number recorded in the whole of 2019.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-55161872>).

<a id="event-2020-12-02-3-5"></a>

Context: 2019–20 Hong Kong protests, Hong Kong national security law.

**Archived source account.** Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong is sentenced to 13 and a half months in prison for inciting an "illegal assembly" while two other activists, Agnes Chow and Ivan Lam, receive 10 months and 7 months in prison, respectively, for similar charges.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/hong-kong-activist-joshua-wong-and-two-others-jailed-for-role-in-pro-democracy-protests/a-55792585>).

Context: 2020 Thai protests.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Prayut Chan-o-cha is acquitted of breaching ethics clauses in the Constitution, allowing him to remain in power.

Source citations (as archived): [The Diplomat](<https://thediplomat.com/2020/12/thai-prime-minister-acquitted-of-ethics-breach-retains-post/>).

<a id="event-2020-12-02-3-9"></a>

Context: Legality of cannabis, Single Convention on Narcotic Drugs.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Commission on Narcotic Drugs (CND) votes to reclassify cannabis as a less dangerous drug after removing it from Schedule IV of the 1961 Single Convention on Narcotic Drugs, where it was listed alongside opioids such as heroin. This change is expected to bolster medical research and legalization efforts around the world.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2020/12/02/world/europe/cannabis-united-nations-drug-policy.html>).
