#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-12-03-3-1"></a>

Context: North Macedonia–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** North Macedonia and the United Kingdom sign a Partnership, Trade and Cooperation Agreement to continue preferential trade terms after the end of the UK's Brexit transition period on December 31. The agreement also strengthens political, economic, security, and cultural ties between both nations.

Source citations (as archived): [Gov.uk](<https://www.gov.uk/government/news/north-macedonia-and-uk-sign-partnership-trade-and-cooperation-agreement>).

<a id="event-2020-12-03-3-3"></a>

Context: Nauru–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States and Nauru sign a trade deal which is expected to provide access to the full range of investment support offered by the United States to the Pacific Island nation. Nauru High Commissioner Michael Aroi thanked Joseph Cella, the U.S. Ambassador to several Pacific Island nations, for continuing American support to boost relations between both countries.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/432095/nauru-high-commissioner-to-fiji-michael-aroi-signs-trade-deal-with-us-ambassador-joseph-cella-in-fiji>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-12-03-4-2"></a>

Context: 2020–2021 United States racial unrest / Kenosha unrest shooting.

**Archived source account.** The Kenosha County Circuit Court orders Kyle Rittenhouse, the 17-year-old teen accused of shooting three people, two fatally, during protests in Kenosha, Wisconsin, to stand trial for first degree homicide and reckless endangerment. His lawyers are claiming he did so in self defense.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/US/teen-suspect-kyle-rittenhouse-stand-trial-charges-shooting/story?id=74518909>).

<a id="event-2020-12-03-4-4"></a>

Context: Hong Kong national security law, Pro-democracy camp (Hong Kong).

**Archived source account.** Hong Kong media tycoon and pro-democracy activist Jimmy Lai is denied bail and remains in custody over alleged fraud related to the lease of a building that houses his Apple Daily, an anti-government newspaper.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/hongkong-security-jimmylai/hong-kong-media-tycoon-jimmy-lai-in-custody-after-fraud-charge-idUSP8N2BE02A>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-12-03-5-1"></a>

Context: Misinformation related to the COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** Facebook announces that it will remove misinformation related to COVID-19 vaccines as countries prepare to distribute them.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2020/12/03/facebook-to-remove-misinformation-about-coronavirus-vaccines.html>).

<a id="event-2020-12-03-5-3"></a>

Context: Chinese space program.

**Archived source account.** The China National Space Administration probe Chang'e 5 lifts off from the surface of the moon as it begins a journey back to Earth after collecting samples of lunar soil. The ascender will rendezvous with the orbiter, transferring over the samples, and the orbiter will then land at a location in Inner Mongolia, China.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-55179983>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-12-04-2-1"></a>

Context: Federated States of Micronesia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The Federated States of Micronesia declines to host the annual Operation Christmas Drop with the U.S. Air Force. The annual operation, which delivers food and other humanitarian aid to Pacific islanders, has been cancelled by Micronesian President David W. Panuelo, who cited the threat of COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/432131/federated-states-of-micronesia-opts-out-of-annual-us-military-humanitarian-mission-due-to-covid-19-concerns>).

<a id="event-2020-12-04-2-3"></a>

Context: Rohingya refugee crisis, Ashrayan Project.

**Archived source account.** Despite international pressure to back down, Bangladesh begins transferring thousands of Rohingya refugees to the remote island of Bhasan Char in the Bay of Bengal. Bangladesh says all the refugees being moved have given consent and that the relocation was voluntary.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-55177688>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-12-04-3-1"></a>

Context: Decriminalization of non-medical cannabis in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The House of Representatives votes 228–164 to pass a bill, known as the Marijuana Opportunity Reinvestment and Expungement Act, that would decriminalize recreational cannabis at a federal level.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-55191808>).

<a id="event-2020-12-04-3-3"></a>

Context: 2020 Nova Scotia attacks.

**Archived source account.** Three people have been arrested for illegally providing ammunition to the gunman who killed 22 people across Nova Scotia, Canada in April. One of the three arrested is the gunman's common-law spouse.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/nova-scotia/spouse-portapique-gunman-lisa-banfield-charges-ammunition-1.5828411>).

<a id="event-2020-12-04-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Mayor of Liverpool, England, Joe Anderson is arrested along with four others for conspiracy to commit bribery and witness intimidation. He is subsequently suspended from the Labour Party.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-merseyside-55192375>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-12-04-4-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Montenegrin parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** The parliament of Montenegro approves a new coalition government of centre-right, pro-Serb minority and green parties, formally ending three decades of Democratic Party of Socialists of Montenegro (DPS) rule in the country. New Prime Minister Zdravko Krivokapić vows to dismantle a state apparatus built by the DPS, and root-out corruption and organised crime.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-montenegro-government/montenegro-approves-new-coalition-overturning-three-decades-of-socialist-role-idUKKBN28E2M5>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-12-04-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Great Internet Mersenne Prime Search completes testing of all Mersenne numbers with exponents less than 100,000,000. Following the milestone, the server experienced an increase in traffic, prompting maintenance and the temporary removal of the top section of the "Milestones" page which normally shows the live real time progress report toward upcoming milestones.

Source citations (as archived): [Mersenne Forum](<https://www.mersenneforum.org/showpost.php?p=565292&amp;postcount=2047>); [YCombinator](<https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=25306698>).

### 2020-12-06

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1326379190](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20December%206&oldid=1326379190>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-12-06-0-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in Washington, D.C..

**Archived source account.** Rudy Giuliani, former New York City mayor and personal lawyer to President Donald Trump, tests positive for COVID-19 and is admitted to a hospital in Washington, D.C.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/12/06/politics/rudy-giuliani-coronavirus-positive/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-12-06-0-7"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / COVID-19 pandemic in Canada / COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario.

**Archived source account.** Ontario reports 1,924 cases, a new single-day record.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/toronto/ontario-covid-19-update-december-6-1.5830417>).

<a id="event-2020-12-06-0-10"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Germany.

**Archived source account.** Bavaria formally declares a “disaster situation” in the state and announces to tighten its lockdown restrictions starting from December 9, banning people from leaving their homes with some exception and a nightly curfew from 9:00 p.m. to 5:00 a.m. local time in communities that have more than 200 infections per 100,000 inhabitants within seven days.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-12-06/bavaria-tightens-covid-lockdown-and-declares-disaster-situation>).

<a id="event-2020-12-06-0-12"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Russia reports a new single-day record of 29,039 cases, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 2.46 million.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://mobile.reuters.com/article/amp/idUSKBN28G07M>).

<a id="event-2020-12-06-0-14"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Italy.

**Archived source account.** Italy surpasses 60,000 deaths from COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [The Irish Times](<https://www.irishtimes.com/news/world/europe/coronavirus-italy-passes-60-000-covid-19-related-deaths-1.4429213?mode=amp>).

<a id="event-2020-12-06-0-16"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Sweden.

**Archived source account.** Sweden imposes new restrictions on large gatherings and issues alcohol sale curfews and school closures amid a rise of cases.

Source citations (as archived): [Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/long-a-holdout-from-covid-19-restrictions-sweden-ends-its-pandemic-experiment-11607261658>).

<a id="event-2020-12-06-0-19"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea.

**Archived source account.** The number of new confirmed cases in South Korea reaches a nine-month high of 631 cases in the last 24 hours, the majority being from the Seoul Capital Area. The country now has 37,546 total confirmed cases, according to data from the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency.

Source citations (as archived): [Yonhap News Agency](<https://m-en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20201206000652320?section=national/national>).

<a id="event-2020-12-06-0-20"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea.

**Archived source account.** The government decides to raise social distancing level to level 2.5 in the Seoul Capital Area for the next three weeks.

Source citations (as archived): [The Korea Herald](<http://www.koreaherald.com/view.php?ud=20201206000172>).

<a id="event-2020-12-06-0-22"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia, COVID-19 vaccine.

**Archived source account.** Indonesia receives its first shipment of 1.2 million doses of the CoronaVac vaccine.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/indonesia-first-covid-19-vaccine-china-sinovac-jokowi-13713098>).

<a id="event-2020-12-06-0-24"></a>

Context: Havana syndrome.

**Archived source account.** An expert committee of the U.S. National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine releases a report, concluding that "directed" microwave radiation was the likely cause of illnesses among American diplomats in Cuba and China.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-55203844>).

<a id="event-2020-12-06-0-26"></a>

Context: Eluru outbreak.

**Archived source account.** At least one person has died and 227 have been hospitalised by an unidentified illness in Eluru, India. The patients had a wide range of symptoms from nausea to fits and falling unconscious, and all had tested negative for SARS-CoV-2.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-55209763>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-12-06-1-1"></a>

Context: Corruption in Indonesia, Corruption Eradication Commission.

**Archived source account.** Indonesian social affairs minister Juliari Batubara turns himself in to the national anti-corruption agency for COVID-19 pandemic aid graft.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/indonesia-minister-turns-covid-19-aid-graft-74564963>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-12-06-2-1"></a>

Context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics, COVID-19 pandemic in Arizona.

**Archived source account.** The Arizona State Legislature announces that the House and Senate will close for a week starting tomorrow due to COVID-19 concerns. The move comes shortly after Rudy Giuliani, who met with several Republican lawmakers to discuss supposed election fraud in the 2020 presidential election, tested positive for COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [KSAZ-TV](<https://www.fox10phoenix.com/news/arizona-house-of-representatives-building-to-close-on-dec-7-for-one-week-due-to-rise-of-covid-19>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/nation/2020/12/07/arizona-legislature-closed-covid-giuliani/>).

<a id="event-2020-12-06-2-3"></a>

Context: 2020 Romanian legislative election.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Romania head out to elect the members of their country's Chamber of Deputies and Senate. Widespread lack of interest in politics and the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic have raised fears of a low voter turnout.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20201206-low-turnout-expected-at-romania-s-elections-in-the-shadow-the-coronavirus>).

<a id="event-2020-12-06-2-5"></a>

Context: 2020 Venezuelan parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** Parliamentary elections are underway in Venezuela amidst multiple ongoing crises. The election is boycotted by the political opposition to President Nicolás Maduro and has been called unfair by international observers.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/venezuelans-vote-in-parliamentary-election-amid-deep-crises/a-55836514>).

<a id="event-2020-12-06-2-7"></a>

Context: Anglophone Crisis.

**Archived source account.** Cameroon holds its first regional elections amidst criticism of President Paul Biya and a growing separatist insurgency in the English-speaking areas of the country. The election will elect representatives to local councils and is supported by the government, whereas separatists have vowed to disrupt the election, arresting anyone participating in it. Gunfire is also reported in some areas.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/cameroon-election/cameroon-holds-first-ever-regional-elections-separatists-vow-disruption-idUSKBN28G0AW?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-12-06-2-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** Supporters of President-elect Maia Sandu gather in Moldova to call for the resignation of the Russia-backed government and a new parliamentary election.

Source citations (as archived): [San Francisco Chronicle](<https://www.sfgate.com/news/amp/Protesters-in-Moldova-demand-early-parliamentary-15779772.php>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-12-06-3-1"></a>

Context: Uncrewed spaceflights to the International Space Station.

**Archived source account.** A SpaceX Falcon 9 launches a cargo ship into orbit to re-supply the International Space Station.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/spacex-launch-dragon-cargo-ship-space-station/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2020-12-06-4-1"></a>

Context: 2020 NFL season.

**Archived source account.** In American football, the Cleveland Browns defeat the Tennessee Titans 41-35 to secure their first winning season since 2007.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.beaconjournal.com/story/sports/pro/browns/2020/12/06/browns-titans-score-baker-mayfield-nfl-week-13-myles-garrett/3801591001/>).

<a id="event-2020-12-06-4-3"></a>

Context: 2020 Formula One World Championship.

**Archived source account.** Racing Point's Sergio Pérez wins the 2020 Sakhir Grand Prix at the Bahrain International Circuit, claiming his first Formula One win, and becoming the first Mexican Formula One driver to win a race since Pedro Rodríguez won the 1970 Belgian Grand Prix.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2020/dec/06/sergio-perez-wins-sakhir-grand-prix-after-george-russell-robbed-by-puncture>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-12-07-0-1"></a>

<a id="event-2020-12-07-1-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in Washington, D.C..

<a id="event-2020-12-07-1-15"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Denmark.

<a id="event-2020-12-07-1-17"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Italy.

**Archived source account.** Interior Minister Luciana Lamorgese tests positive for COVID-19.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Hungary.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Viktor Orbán announces that the country will maintain its COVID-19 restrictions until January 11.

Source citations (as archived): [News.trust.org](<https://news.trust.org/item/20201207114447-92fjx>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Lithuania.

**Archived source account.** The Lithuanian government announces that it will tighten and extend the nationwide lockdown until the end of the year. People are advised to leave their homes only for essential reasons, and the education of senior students will be conducted remotely.

<a id="event-2020-12-07-1-23"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia.

**Archived source account.** Former vice-governor of Jakarta and former vice-presidential candidate Sandiaga Uno tests positive for COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [detikNews](<https://news.detik.com/berita/d-5285589/sandiaga-uno-positif-corona>).

<a id="event-2020-12-07-1-28"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in India, COVID-19 vaccine.

**Archived source account.** The Indian government announces that the country will speed up their reviews of vaccines developed by Pfizer and AstraZeneca.

Source citations (as archived): [Hindustan Times](<https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/india-speeding-up-review-of-pfizer-astra-covid-19-vaccines-government-official/story-b17fSMZzQmLHM56TkN1DCK.html>).

<a id="event-2020-12-07-1-30"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Australia.

**Archived source account.** Victoria eases restrictions, allowing larger private and public gatherings, relaxing patron quotas for businesses (including allowing nightclubs to reopen for the first time since the pandemic began), and relaxing mask-wearing rules. The state has not reported a COVID-19 case in 37 days.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2020/dec/06/victoria-eases-covid-restrictions-again-as-it-reaches-37-days-without-a-case>).

<a id="event-2020-12-07-1-32"></a>

Context: Eluru outbreak.

**Archived source account.** The number of people infected by a mysterious illness in the city of Eluru, Andhra Pradesh, India, increases to more than 400. The majority of those infected are children and young people.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/12/07/asia/india-mystery-illness-intl-hnk-scli/index.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-12-07-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Holy See Press Director Matteo Bruni announces that Pope Francis will make his first international apostolic visit in 15 months after accepting the invitation of the Republic of Iraq and the local Catholic Church to visit the Middle Eastern country of Iraq from 5–8 March 2021.

Source citations (as archived): [Vatican News](<https://www.vaticannews.va/en/pope/news/2020-12/pope-francis-apostolic-journey-iraq-march-2021.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-12-07-3-1"></a>

Context: Islamic Defenders Front, Islam in Indonesia.

**Archived source account.** Six suspected supporters of controversial Indonesian Islamic cleric Muhammad Rizieq Shihab are killed in a clash with police on a highway near Jakarta. The incident occurred when a police car was attacked while following a car believed to be carrying supporters of the cleric, resulting in a shootout. The police have been investigating the cleric for violations of health protocols during the COVID-19 pandemic after large gatherings occurred to celebrate his return to the country from self-exile in Saudi Arabia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-indonesia-security-idUSKBN28H0GY>).

<a id="event-2020-12-07-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The National Football League announces an investigation into the Washington Football Team for allegations of workplace sexual harassment.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/sports/2020/12/07/beth-wilkinson-lawsuit-washington-football/>).

<a id="event-2020-12-07-3-4"></a>

Context: Hong Kong Autonomy Act.

**Archived source account.** The US Department of the Treasury imposes sanctions on all 14 Vice Chairpersons of the National People's Congress of China, for "undermining Hong Kong's autonomy and restricting the freedom of expression or assembly."

Source citations (as archived): [US Department of the Treasury](<https://home.treasury.gov/policy-issues/financial-sanctions/recent-actions/20201207>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-12-07-4-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Ghanaian general election.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Ghana head to the polls to elect their president as well as the members of parliament. Current president Nana Akufo-Addo of the New Patriotic Party is expected to have a tight race with his most promising challenger, John Mahama of the National Democratic Congress.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ghana-election/voting-starts-in-ghana-presidential-and-parliamentary-election-idUSKBN28H0JQ>).

<a id="event-2020-12-07-4-3"></a>

Context: 2020 Egyptian parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** The final phase of Egypt's latest parliamentary election begins. The voting process will continue until the end of the next day.

Source citations (as archived): [Arab News](<https://www.arabnews.com/node/1773886/middle-east>).

<a id="event-2020-12-07-4-5"></a>

Context: 2020 Venezuelan parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** President Nicolás Maduro's United Socialist Party of Venezuela has reportedly won almost 68% in Venezuela's latest parliamentary election. The vote was overshadowed by a boycott of the political opposition led by Juan Guaidó and a low voter turnout of only 31%.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/venezuela-maduro-wins-total-control-of-legislature-after-vote/a-55836514>).

<a id="event-2020-12-07-4-6"></a>

Context: 2020 Venezuelan parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** The United States refuses to recognize the results, describing the election as a "charade". The European Union also rejects the legitimacy of the election.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-election-results-idUSKBN28H0L3>); [VOA](<https://www.voanews.com/americas/us-condemns-venezuela-election-charade>).

<a id="event-2020-12-07-4-8"></a>

Context: 2020 Romanian legislative election.

**Archived source account.** Incumbent Prime Minister Ludovic Orban resigns after the poor results of his candidacy in the legislative election. He is succeeded ad interim by Minister of National Defence Nicolae Ciucă.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-55222276>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2020-12-07-5-1"></a>

Context: Belarus at the Olympics.

**Archived source account.** The International Olympic Committee announces that Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko and his son Viktor will be banned from all Olympic Games, including the upcoming Tokyo Games.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/amp/Sports/wireStory/ioc-suspends-belarus-president-lukashenko-olympic-games-74586905>).

<a id="event-2020-12-07-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The International Olympic Committee, after an unanimous vote, decides to make competitive breakdancing a sport, and would appear in the 2024 Olympics in Paris.

Source citations (as archived): [Deadline.com](<https://deadline.com/2020/12/olympics-breakdancing-official-sport-paris-2024-games-1234651956/>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

There are no reported casualties. UN spokesman Stephane Dujarric says the reports are "alarming".

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/africa-ethiopia-united-nations-kenya-f945a81239325a418ee22f123058f39f>).

Source citations (as archived): [Vatican News](<https://www.vaticannews.va/en/vatican-city/news/2020-12/apostolic-penitentiary-plenary-indulgence-year-st-joseph.html>).

In court, Zam denied most of the allegations against him and said he was only engaged in "media work".

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-12-10-3-1"></a>

Context: Israel–Morocco normalization agreement, International recognition of Israel, Israel–Morocco relations, Political status of Western Sahara, 2020.

**Archived source account.** The United States says that Morocco will normalize diplomatic relations with Israel, becoming the fourth Arab country to do so in recent months, in an agreement mediated by the United States. U.S. President Donald Trump also says that he recognizes "Moroccan sovereignty over the entire Western Sahara territory". Morocco says that the United States "will open a consulate in Western Sahara as part of Morocco’s deal with Israel".

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/israel-morocco-agree-to-normalize-relations-in-latest-us-brokered-deal-651742/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/israel-usa-morocco-idUSKBN28K2CN>).

Source citations (as archived): [Ynet News](<https://www.ynetnews.com/article/ryDEM21hP>); [European Jewish Press](<https://ejpress.org/norwegian-parliament-cuts-palestinian-aid-due-to-continued-incitement-to-hate-in-school-textbooks/>).

<a id="event-2020-12-11-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Senate approves the $740 billion National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2021 (NDAA) by 84 votes to 13, which would be sufficient to override a possible presidential veto. President Donald Trump objects to Section 230 of the Communications Decency Act that currently provides legal immunity to social media companies, and also to a provision in the NDAA that will prohibit military bases to be named for Confederate generals.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-defense-congress/u-s-senate-backs-massive-defense-bill-defying-trump-veto-threat-idUSKBN28L24P>).

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/south-korea-orders-schools-to-shut-as-covid-19-cases-spike-13768064>).

<a id="event-2020-12-14-3-33"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in South Africa.

**Archived source account.** President Cyril Ramaphosa announces that public gatherings will be limited to no more than 100 people for indoor events and 250 people for outdoor events, and that the nationwide curfew will be extended from 11:00 p.m. to 4:00 a.m. throughout the holiday season. He also said that alcohol will only be sold from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. local time, Monday to Thursday.

Source citations (as archived): [Independent Online](<https://www.iol.co.za/news/politics/ramaphosa-announces-new-curfew-restrictions-on-alcohol-and-public-gatherings--58266986-7ca2-4df1-9a15-4a2a222f9666>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-12-14-4-1"></a>

Context: Sudan–United States relations, Global war on terrorism.

**Archived source account.** Secretary of State Mike Pompeo announces that the United States has removed Sudan from the list of state sponsors of terrorism. Sudan had recently paid a $335 million settlement to the US government for US victims of terrorist attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/sudan-usa/u-s-to-remove-sudan-from-terrorism-list-on-monday-embassy-idUSKBN28O0TG?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-12-14-4-3"></a>

Context: Turkey–United States relations, CAATSA.

**Archived source account.** Secretary of State Mike Pompeo announces that the United States has imposed sanctions on Turkey over its acquisition of the S-400 missile defense system from Russia. This move is the first time that the CAATSA has been used to penalize a U.S. ally.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/joe-biden-politics-turkey-ankara-russia-c77d08a1ec06ebb3dae99bb05a67191b>).

<a id="event-2020-12-14-4-5"></a>

Context: North Korea–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** South Korea bans the launching of propaganda leaflets into North Korea. The balloon propaganda campaigns have been used by North Korean defectors and Korean reunification activists for decades to spread anti-government propaganda, news from the outside world that is restricted in the North, money, food, and USB flash drives containing South Korean media. The ban also outlaws the use of loudspeaker propaganda broadcasts. Violators of the ban will face up to three years in prison or 30 million won ($27,400) in fines.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-southkorea/south-korea-bans-anti-north-leaflets-defector-says-he-wont-stop-idUSKBN28O1OI>).

<a id="event-2020-12-14-5-1"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in Singapore.

**Archived source account.** The judicial commissioner of Singapore sentences a Bangladeshi national to death after he was found guilty of murdering his Indonesian girlfriend two years ago. In Singapore, a charge of murder carries the mandatory death penalty.

Source citations (as archived): [The Straits Times](<https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore/courts-crime/man-sentenced-to-death-for-killing-girlfriend-after-she-refused-to-stop>).

<a id="event-2020-12-14-6-1"></a>

Context: 2020 United States presidential election.

**Archived source account.** The Electoral College meets in the state capitals to officially elect the next President. Joe Biden, the presumptive president-elect, is officially elected president after securing California's 55 electoral votes and will be inaugurated on January 20. Outgoing President Donald Trump continues to dispute the results of the election, claiming widespread electoral fraud, despite numerous failed lawsuits.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live/2020/dec/14/electoral-college-joe-biden-us-election-donald-trump-coronavirus-covid-19-pfizer-vaccine-russia-hackers-live-updates>).

<a id="event-2020-12-14-6-5"></a>

Context: 2020 United States presidential election / Republican reactions to Donald Trump's claims of 2020 election fraud.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.com/Politics/michigan-rep-paul-mitchell-quits-republican-party-trumps/story?id=74725718>).

<a id="event-2020-12-15-4-1"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in Japan.

**Archived source account.** The Tokyo District Court sentences serial killer Takahiro Shiraishi, dubbed the "Twitter killer", to death, for murdering nine people at his apartment in 2017 and dismembering their bodies. Shiraishi, who was found mentally competent, pled guilty and told the court his crimes had a sexual motive.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2020/12/15/asia/japan-twitter-killer-intl-hnk/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-12-15-4-3"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Hungary.

**Archived source account.** The National Assembly passes a number of changes to the Constitution of Hungary which bar same-sex couples from adopting children. The amendments also lowers the legal threshold for the government to declare a state of emergency, and further reduces the oversights the government is required to take with regard to the spending of public funds, which critics say will allow the government to use state money to benefit loyalists.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2020/12/15/world/hungary-laws-orban-gay-rights.html>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** Gunmen attack a security checkpoint in Puli Khumri, Baghlan Province, killing 13 police officers. An armoured personnel carrier and several police vehicles are also destroyed during the attack, which Afghan officials blame on the Taliban. No group has claimed responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/12/16/taliban-kill-13-policemen-in-northern-afghanistan>).

<a id="event-2020-12-16-0-3"></a>

Context: Second Nagorno-Karabakh War.

**Archived source account.** Dozens of Artsakh Defence Army troops are reportedly captured during an Azerbaijani "anti-terror" raid on several villages in Nagorno-Karabakh. The villages had previously been returned to Azerbaijan as part of the 2020 ceasefire agreement. Artsakh's Defence Ministry says that it "lost contact" with a number of military posts overnight, with as many as 60 to 160 personnel missing. Videos uploaded to social media appear to show captured soldiers.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-55329493>).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mexico-crime/former-mexican-governor-of-jalisco-killed-in-attack-idUSKBN28S1PY?il=0>).

**Archived source account.** Supporters of the controversial Indonesian Islamic cleric Muhammad Rizieq Shihab clash with police during a demonstration in Jakarta, demanding immediate release of Shihab from police detention. Shihab was arrested last weekend for violations of health protocols during the COVID-19 pandemic after large gatherings occurred to celebrate his return to the country from self-exile in Saudi Arabia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-indonesia-security-islamist-protest/supporters-of-hardline-indonesian-cleric-clash-with-police-in-jakarta-idUKKBN28S17N>).

<a id="event-2020-12-18-3-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of the United States, in an unsigned 6–3 decision, dismisses Trump v. New York, ruling that the challenge to the Trump administration's memo requiring the Census Bureau to report the results of the 2020 United States census with the exclusion of undocumented immigrants for apportionment is premature, and that no judicial review can be taken until after the data has been collected. The Bureau faces a December 31 deadline to report the results, which they have previously indicated that they may miss.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2020/12/18/us/supreme-court-census.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-12-18-5-1"></a>

Context: 2020 United States federal government data breach.

**Archived source account.** The Department of Energy confirms that it has been breached along with other federal government agencies, but says that the country's nuclear weapons arsenal has not been compromised. The mass data breach is now considered the worst ever cyberattack on the U.S. government.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-55358332>).

<a id="event-2020-12-18-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A review of some recent medical studies shows that memory T cells may play a role in a phenomenon known as cross-reactivity, which researchers found may perhaps give certain people, in some cases, some level of immunity to the virus that causes COVID-19 even without them having been exposed to or infected with the virus, or having received a vaccine. There are certain structural and clinical similarities between the virus that causes COVID-19 and the other coronaviruses that are related to it, which cause SARS and MERS.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/health/medical/some-people-may-have-preexisting-immunity-to-the-coronavirus/ar-BB1c1Ftr>).

<a id="event-2020-12-18-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The British Antarctic Survey confirms that Iceberg A-68, one of the largest ever recorded icebergs with a surface area of 5,800 square kilometres, has broken in two in the South Atlantic as it approaches South Georgia island. The new smaller iceberg has been named A68D.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/dec/18/massive>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-12-20-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan; December 2020 Afghanistan targeted killings.

**Archived source account.** A car bombing in Kabul targeting Khan Mohammad Wardak, a lawmaker, kills nine people and wounds more than 20 others. Wardak is among the injured. Attacks also occur in Logar, Nangarhar, Helmand, and Badakhshan, with an unknown number of civilians and security forces killed. No group claims responsibility for these attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-attack/nine-dead-as-kabul-car-bombing-targets-afghan-lawmaker-idUSKBN28U097?il=0>).

**Archived source account.** Eight rockets are fired at the U.S. Embassy in Baghdad, Iraq, prompting the activation of C-RAM air defences.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/iraqi-officials-rockets-target-us-embassy-baghdad-74831850>).

### 2020-12-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1347525860](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20December%2021&oldid=1347525860>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-12-21-0-1"></a>

Context: Central African Republic Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Rwanda deploys what it calls a "protection force" to the Central African Republic after its peacekeepers were attacked by advancing rebel forces on the capital Bangui. The Rwandan and Central African Republic governments accuse former President François Bozizé of backing the rebels and plotting a coup, which he denies. Russia also sends troops and heavy weaponry to support the government.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-55394042>).

<a id="event-2020-12-21-0-4"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / December 2020 Afghanistan attacks.

**Archived source account.** Rahmatullah Nikzad, head of the journalists’ union in Ghazni, dies after being shot three times in the chest by unknown assailants. Nikazd is the fifth journalist to have been killed in Afghanistan in the last two months, and the seventh this year.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://www.voanews.com/south-central-asia/prominent-journalist-killed-eastern-afghanistan>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2020-12-21-1-1"></a>

Context: Removal of Confederate monuments and memorials.

**Archived source account.** A statue of Confederate general Robert E. Lee presented by Virginia is removed from the National Statuary Hall of the United States Capitol. It is slated to be replaced by a statue of civil rights activist Barbara Rose Johns.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2020/dec/21/barbara-johns-robert-e-lee-capitol-washington>).

Source citations (as archived): [Business Insider](<https://www.businessinsider.com/stimulus-deal-passed-house-democrats-direct-checks-unemployment-mcconnell-senate-2020-12>).

<a id="event-2020-12-21-2-2"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/on-small-business/senate-passes-virus-relief-sends-bill-to-trump-congress-update/2020/12/21/0ec68d76-43f6-11eb-ac2a-3ac0f2b8ceeb_story.html>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/dec/21/covid-relief-bill-stimulus-checks-congress-republicans-democrats>).

<a id="event-2020-12-21-4-51"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** Pakistan Senator Kalsoom Perveen dies from COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [The Express Tribune](<https://tribune.com.pk/story/2276808/pml-n-senator-kalsoom-parveen-succumbs-to-covid-19>).

<a id="event-2020-12-21-4-53"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore, COVID-19 vaccine.

**Archived source account.** Singapore receives the Pfizer-BioNTech vaccine, becoming the first country in Asia to do so.

Source citations (as archived): [CNET](<https://www.cnet.com/google-amp/news/singapore-becomes-first-asian-country-to-receive-batches-of-pfizer-vaccine/>).

<a id="event-2020-12-21-4-56"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Africa / COVID-19 pandemic in Egypt.

**Archived source account.** Egypt reports 664 new cases in the past 24 hours, the highest single-day total in a months, bringing the nationwide total to 125,555 cases.

Source citations (as archived): [Egypt Independent](<https://egyptindependent.com/egypt-reports-664-new-coronavirus-cases-29-deaths-on-sunday/>).

<a id="event-2020-12-21-4-58"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Africa / COVID-19 pandemic in Morocco.

**Archived source account.** Morocco's government announces that they will impose a nationwide curfew from 9:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. local time and will require all cafes, shops, supermarkets, and restaurants to close at 8:00 p.m. beginning December 23. In Casablanca, Marrakech, Agadir, and Tangier, all restaurants will be closed for three weeks.

Source citations (as archived): [Morocco World News](<https://www.moroccoworldnews.com/2020/12/329493/covid-19-morocco-announces-national-night-curfew-starting-wednesday/>).

<a id="event-2020-12-21-4-60"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Africa / COVID-19 pandemic in Sudan, Variant of Concern 202012/01.

**Archived source account.** Sudan will ban all travellers from the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, and South Africa beginning December 23 due to the discovery of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-sudan-idUSKBN28V2OU>).

<a id="event-2020-12-21-4-62"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Australia, Variant of Concern 202012/01.

**Archived source account.** New South Wales detects two cases of the new variant of SARS-CoV-2 in travellers returning from the United Kingdom.

Source citations (as archived): [The Australian](<https://www.theaustralian.com.au/breaking-news/more-transmissible-strain-of-covid19-brought-into-australia-from-uk/news-story/38ab9a0522ab61cfa2295c09342c6b7d>).

<a id="event-2020-12-21-4-64"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Colombia, COVID-19 vaccine.

**Archived source account.** Colombia announces that it will receive 1.7 million doses of the Tozinameran vaccine.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-colombia-vaccine-idUSKBN28V260>).

<a id="event-2020-12-21-4-66"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Antarctica.

**Archived source account.** The first cases of COVID-19 in Antarctica are reported. 36 people test positive for the virus after spending a week at the Base General Bernardo O'Higgins, in the Chilean Antarctic Territory.

Source citations (as archived): [Infobae](<https://www.infobae.com/america/agencias/2020/12/21/reportan-brote-de-coronavirus-en-base-chilena-en-la-antartida/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-12-21-5-1"></a>

Context: Sudan–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States Congress formally reinstates Sudan's sovereign immunity. Sudan had paid the U.S. a $335 million settlement to victims of al-Qaeda attacks. The U.S. will partially pay off Sudanese bilateral debt, and its debt to the International Monetary Fund (IMF), while making another US$700 million available until September 2022 for assistance to the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/sudan-usa-idUSKBN28W0FX>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-12-21-6-1"></a>

Context: Essex lorry deaths.

**Archived source account.** Two men are found guilty at London's Old Bailey of the manslaughter of 39 Vietnamese people whom they were smuggling into the UK. The 39 people suffocated in a lorry during the journey across the North Sea, from Zeebrugge to Purfleet, in October 2019.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-55399004>).

<a id="event-2020-12-21-6-3"></a>

Context: Halle synagogue shooting.

**Archived source account.** Germany's Federal Court of Justice sentences the perpetrator of the 2019 synagogue shooting to life imprisonment with subsequent preventive detention.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-germany-shooting-trial-idUSKBN28V1PI>).

<a id="event-2020-12-21-6-5"></a>

Context: 2020 Belarusian protests.

**Archived source account.** Former Miss Belarus winner Volha Khizhynkova is released from prison after 42 days for protesting against President Alexander Lukashenko.

Source citations (as archived): [Zee News](<https://www.dnaindia.com/world/news-miss-belarus-2008-released-after-42-days-in-prison-for-anti-government-protests-2863271>).

<a id="event-2020-12-21-6-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Outgoing United States Attorney General William Barr announces charges against a bomb maker for his role in the 1988 bombing of Pan Am Flight 103 near Lockerbie, Scotland.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-55399551>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-12-21-7-1"></a>

Context: Poisoning of Alexei Navalny.

**Archived source account.** A report surfaces that a Federal Security Service agent allegedly involved in the plot to poison the Russian opposition leader was "duped" by Navalny into admitting that the poison was planted in Navalny's underpants.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2020/12/21/europe/russia-navalny-poisoning-underpants-ward/index.html>).

<a id="event-2020-12-21-7-3"></a>

Context: 2020 United States anti-lockdown protests.

**Archived source account.** About 300 demonstrators attempt to storm the Oregon State Capitol during a special legislative session closed to the public, but they are warded off by the Oregon State Police. The group, which called for reopening Oregon in the wake of COVID-19 mitigation measures, included members of groups such as Proud Boys and Patriot Prayer.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Beast](<https://www.thedailybeast.com/heavily-armed-far-right-mob-descends-on-oregon-capitol>); [Statesman Journal](<https://www.statesmanjournal.com/story/news/politics/2020/12/21/protesters-gather-oregon-legislature-starts-special-session/3993102001/>).

<a id="event-2020-12-21-7-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Constitutional Court of Kosovo nullifies the parliamentary vote that elected Prime Minister Avdullah Hoti in June, after discovering that one of the members who voted was ineligible due to a prison sentence. The ruling mandates that Acting President Vjosa Osmani must call a new election to be held no longer than 40 days from the announcement.

Source citations (as archived): [RFE/RL](<https://www.rferl.org/a/kosovo-elections-hoti-parliament/31012759.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-12-21-8-1"></a>

Context: Great conjunction.

**Archived source account.** The planets Jupiter and Saturn appear at their closest in the sky since 1623, in an event known as a great conjunction. The closest approach will occur at 18:22 UTC, when the two planets will be one-tenth of a degree apart; they will appear to be a binary object to the naked eye.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/2020/12/21/the-great-conjunction-jupiter-and-saturn-to-align-in-the-sky-tonight>).

### 2020-12-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1347526051](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20December%2022&oldid=1347526051>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-12-22-0-2"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / December 2020 Afghanistan attacks.

**Archived source account.** Four prison doctors are killed after a magnetic bomb attached to their vehicle exploded in Kabul. A civilian passerby also died in the attack. The bombing follows a series of recent assassination attempts and targeted killings of prominent Afghan figures.

Source citations (as archived): [Channel NewsAsia](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/prison-doctors-among-5-killed-in-kabul-bombing-13823242>).

<a id="event-2020-12-22-0-4"></a>

Context: War in Darfur.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Security Council votes to end the United Nations–African Union Mission in Darfur on December 31, beginning a complete withdrawal of peacekeeping forces by June 30, 2021.

Source citations (as archived): [Middle East Monitor](<https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20201223-un-african-union-peacekeeping-mission-in-sudans-darfur-to-end-december-31/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-12-22-1-1"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States.

**Archived source account.** President Donald Trump says that he might not sign the $900 billion relief bill, which was passed by both the House and Senate. He also calls for Congress to amend the bill and increase stimulus checks to Americans earning under $75,000 per year from $600 to $2,000. House Speaker Nancy Pelosi agrees to work with Congress to increase the payout amount.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/2020/12/22/trump-stimulus-video-bill/>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/amp/world-us-canada-55420366>); [WFLA-TV](<https://www.wfla.com/community/health/coronavirus/pelosi-responds-to-trump-lets-push-for-2k-this-week/>).

<a id="event-2020-12-22-2-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic, Variant of Concern 202012/01 / COVID-19 pandemic in Guatemala.

**Archived source account.** Guatemala announces a mandatory two-week quarantine for anyone who has recently visited the United Kingdom or South Africa in an effort to prevent the spread of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2. The restrictions will last for two months.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-britain-guatemala/guatemala-to-restrict-entry-to-travelers-from-britain-south-africa-idUKKBN28W091?il=0>).

The numbers also represent an approximate 15 percent increase compared to the previous year, which is the largest single-year percentage increase since 1918.

**Archived source account.** Singapore bans all long-term passport holders and short-term visitors who had travel history to the United Kingdom within the last 14 days to enter the country beginning tomorrow at 11:59 p.m. local time due to the emergence of a new strain of SARS-CoV-2.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Sri Lanka, Variant of Concern 202012/01.

**Archived source account.** Sri Lanka's Civil Aviation Authority bans all flights to and from the United Kingdom beginning on December 23 to prevent a new strain of SARS-CoV-2 from spreading to the country.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Taiwan.

**Archived source account.** Taiwan reports their first locally transmitted case since April 12 after an unidentified patient tested positive for COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-12-22/world-s-longest-virus-free-streak-ends-as-taiwan-case-emerges>).

<a id="event-2020-12-22-2-37"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in France, Variant of Concern 202012/01.

**Archived source account.** France agrees to reopen its border with the United Kingdom after it was closed for 48 hours due to the spread of a new variant of the virus in England. Planes, boats, and Eurostar trains will resume services tomorrow but only British, French, and EU citizens or residents who show a negative COVID-19 test result from the previous 72 hours will be allowed to travel until January 6.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-55418565>).

<a id="event-2020-12-22-2-39"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of Ireland.

**Archived source account.** Taoiseach Micheál Martin announces a return of "Level 5" lockdown in the country with specific adjustments from Christmas Eve until at least January 12.

Source citations (as archived): [The Journal](<https://www.thejournal.ie/new-level-5-restrictions-ireland-5308834-Dec2020/>).

<a id="event-2020-12-22-2-41"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Slovakia.

**Archived source account.** Finance Minister Eduard Heger tests positive for COVID-19.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom reports a record 36,804 new cases in the past 24 hours. In addition, the country also reports 691 new deaths, the highest daily total in nearly a month.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/covid-19-uk-records-highest-daily-increase-in-cases-and-another-691-deaths-12170371>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Fiji, Variant of Concern 202012/01.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-12-22-3-2"></a>

Context: Israel–Morocco relations / Israel–Morocco normalization agreement.

**Archived source account.** El Al operates the first direct commercial flight between Israel and Morocco following the normalization agreement between the two countries on December 10. Senior Advisor to the U.S. President Jared Kushner and Israel's National Security Advisor Meir Ben-Shabbat are among the high-level officials on board the flight.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.barrons.com/news/first-israel-morocco-direct-commercial-flight-takes-off-01608626104?tesla=y>).

<a id="event-2020-12-22-3-4"></a>

Context: Colombia–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Migración Colombia confirms the expulsion of two Russian diplomats accused of espionage.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-colombia-russia/colombia-confirms-exit-of-russian-officials-local-media-alleges-spying-idUSKBN28W2A5>).

Context: Cayman Islands–United States relations, COVID-19 pandemic in the Cayman Islands.

**Archived source account.** The appeals court of the Cayman Islands reduces the prison sentence of Georgia teenager Skylar Mack from 4 months to 2 months. Mack was arrested on November 29 for breaching quarantine rules.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/skylar-mack-us-teen-jailed-cayman-islands-resentenced-two-months/>).

<a id="event-2020-12-22-3-8"></a>

Context: China–South Korea relations, Russia–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** South Korea says it has scrambled fighter jets after four Chinese and fifteen Russian military aircraft entered its air defense identification zone. South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff says that it was notified in advance by China of a joint military exercise between China and Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-southkorea-china-russia/s-korea-scrambles-jets-as-chinese-russian-aircraft-enter-air-defence-zone-idUKKBN28W13G?il=0>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-12-22-4-1"></a>

Context: Cabinet of Indonesia.

**Archived source account.** President Joko Widodo announces a year-end reshuffle of the Onward Indonesia Cabinet with the replacement of six ministers who had been in the cabinet since October 2019, including two ministers who were arrested by the Corruption Eradication Commission due to separate bribery cases.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jakarta Post](<https://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2020/12/22/jokowi-announces-end-of-year-cabinet-reshuffle.html>).

Context: Cabinet of Indonesia.

**Archived source account.** Sandiaga Uno, businessman and former candidate of the 2019 presidential election, is appointed as the new Tourism and Creative Economy Minister. It is the first time in Indonesian history that all candidates who previously ran in a presidential election serve together in the same cabinet.

Source citations (as archived): [Jakarta Globe](<https://jakartaglobe.id/news/jokowi-appoints-former-rival-sandiaga-uno-as-minister-in-cabinet-shakeup>).

Source citations (as archived): [JPost](<https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/law-to-avoid-knesset-dispersal-fails-to-pass-elections-on-march-23-652855>).

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2020/12/22/us/politics/alex-padilla-kamala-california-senate.html>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: War in Afghanistan / December 2020 Afghanistan attacks.

Manafort was convicted of tax fraud and obstructing an investigation; Stone of lying to Congress; Kushner of tax evasion, campaign finance offences and witness tampering.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-55433522>).

However, House Speaker Nancy Pelosi announces that the House will still hold a vote on the bill on Monday.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/amp/2020/12/24/house-votes-on-2000-stimulus-checks-after-trump-supports-them.html>); [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/white-house/pelosi-says-house-vote-bigger-stimulus-payments-after-gop-blocks-n1252335>).

The coast guard confirmed they had rescued people and were searching for others who were on the boat, which was carrying a total of 45 people.

### 2020-12-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1354549172](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20December%2026&oldid=1354549172>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-12-26-0-1"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Israeli military (IDF) carries out several airstrikes in the Gaza Strip, in response to overnight rocket attacks in Israel. IDF says it targeted a rocket manufacturing site, underground infrastructure and a military post. Two minor injuries are reported. The attacks caused power outages in the eastern part of the strip. Hamas claims the strikes damaged a children's hospital, a centre for disabled people, and damaged the windows of several residential buildings. IDF claims that the damage was due to detonations of ground munitions.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/12/26/israeli-air-attacks-gaza-injuries>); [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/hamas-israeli-strike-damaged-gaza-childrens-hospital-special-needs-center>).

<a id="event-2020-12-26-0-3"></a>

Context: Kashmir conflict.

**Archived source account.** India arrests 75 Kashmiri political leaders and activists for "preventive custody" due to recent violence following local elections.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/12/26/india-detains-75-in-kashmir-after-local-election>).

**Archived source account.** The Cleveland Browns announce that they will close their facility and delay their flight to New Jersey for an upcoming matchup with the New York Jets after a player on the team tested positive for COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-nfl-idUSKBN2900IA>).

### 2020-12-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1123483714](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20December%2027&oldid=1123483714>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-12-27-0-1"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Boko Haram jihadists storm a village near Gamboru, Borno State, Nigeria, killing three people and kidnapping more than 40 others. It is the second mass abduction by the Islamist group this month.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/12/27/at-least-40-loggers-feared-abducted-in-northeast-nigeria>).

<a id="event-2020-12-27-0-3"></a>

Context: Spillover of the Syrian Civil War in Lebanon.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of Syrian refugees flee a makeshift camp in North Governorate, Lebanon, after local youths storm the camp and torch tents, wounding three people, according to the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-lebanon-refugees-syrians-camp/hundreds-of-syrians-flee-lebanon-camp-as-tents-torched-idUKKBN2910H0?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-12-27-0-5"></a>

Context: War in Darfur.

**Archived source account.** Sudan says it will deploy troops to South Darfur "in large numbers" following recent tribal violence between the Masalit and Fula.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-sudan-security/sudan-deploys-troops-in-south-darfur-after-tribal-violence-report-idUKKBN2910PY?il=0>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-12-27-1-1"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States.

**Archived source account.** President Donald Trump signs the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2021, which contains a $900 billion COVID-19 relief package, before Monday's deadline, in order to avert a government shutdown. This comes after Trump called the bill a "disgrace" last week.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/us-policy/2020/12/27/trump-stimulus-shutdown-congress/>); [Politico](<https://www.politico.com/news/2020/12/27/congress-stimulus-deal-450380>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-12-27-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Cameroon, a bus travelling from Douala, to the capital Yaoundé collides with a truck and plunges into a ravine, killing at least 37 people and injuring 19 others.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/international/world-news/cameroon-bus-accident-kills-at-least-37/articleshow/79979068.cms>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2020-12-27-3-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / COVID-19 pandemic in Canada / COVID-19 pandemic in British Columbia, Variant of Concern 202012/01.

**Archived source account.** British Columbia reports their first case of the new variant of SARS-CoV-2 from a man in Island Health who returned from the United Kingdom on December 15 and tested positive on December 19.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/british-columbia/b-c-person-infected-covid-19-variant-1.5855654>).

<a id="event-2020-12-27-3-6"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / COVID-19 pandemic in Canada / COVID-19 pandemic in Quebec.

**Archived source account.** Quebec reports 6,783 cases and 110 deaths between 24 and 26 December, bringing the total number of cases to 192,655 and deaths to 8,023.

Source citations (as archived): [Toronto Star](<https://www.thestar.com/news/canada/2020/12/27/quebec-reports-6783-new-covid-19-cases-110-additional-deaths-since-december-24.html>).

<a id="event-2020-12-27-3-8"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. surpasses 19 million cases of COVID-19, having averaged 185,000 daily cases over the past week.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/policy/healthcare/public-global-health/531760-us-coronavirus-cases-pass-19-million>).

<a id="event-2020-12-27-3-11"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Oman.

**Archived source account.** Oman officially begins a vaccination campaign against COVID-19 using the Pfizer-BioNTech vaccine. The country is the last Gulf Cooperation Council member state to begin vaccinations. Health Minister Ahmed Al-Saidi is one of the first citizens to receive a dose of the vaccine.

Source citations (as archived): [Arab News](<https://www.arabnews.com/node/1783571/amp>).

<a id="event-2020-12-27-3-12"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Oman.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Committee decides to reopen Oman's land, sea, and air borders on December 29 after closing them on December 21 due to fears of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2. All travellers must show a negative PCR test within 72 hours before entering the country and must have valid health insurance. In addition, all travellers must quarantine for seven days and take another test after completing their quarantine.

Source citations (as archived): [Hindustan Times](<https://m.hindustantimes.com/world-news/oman-to-reopen-airport-borders-on-tuesday-after-mutation-scare/story-wFvcxdPHWi0RjD3TzdU1QN_amp.html>).

<a id="event-2020-12-27-3-14"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia.

**Archived source account.** Indonesia reports a record 6,983 recoveries in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of recoveries to 583,676.

Source citations (as archived): [Kompas](<https://nasional.kompas.com/read/2020/12/27/16151101/update-27-desember-pecah-rekor-6983-pasien-covid-19-sembuh-dalam-sehari>).

<a id="event-2020-12-27-3-16"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Jordan, Variant of Concern 202012/01.

**Archived source account.** Jordan reports their first two cases of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2 in a couple who travelled from the United Kingdom.

Source citations (as archived): [Medical Xpress](<https://medicalxpress.com/news/2020-12-jordan-coronavirus-variant-cases-minister.html>).

<a id="event-2020-12-27-3-18"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Saudi Arabia.

**Archived source account.** Saudi Arabia announces that they will lift their flight ban on non-Saudis leaving the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/en/coronavirus/2020/12/27/Coronavirus-Coronavirus-Saudi-Arabia-lifts-flight-ban-for-non-Saudis-leaving-the-kingdom>).

<a id="event-2020-12-27-3-20"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea.

**Archived source account.** South Korea extends its current social distancing measures aimed at reducing the spread of COVID-19 until January 3, as record numbers of new cases are being reported.

Source citations (as archived): [The Straits Times](<https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/south-korea-extends-social-distancing-rules-amid-rising-daily-covid-19-cases>).

<a id="event-2020-12-27-3-23"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Austria.

**Archived source account.** Austria begins administering the Pfizer-BioNTech vaccine tozinameran to its citizens. An 84-year-old woman becomes the first Austrian to be vaccinated against COVID-19 at the Medical University of Vienna.

Source citations (as archived): [ORF](<https://orf.at/stories/3195150/>).

<a id="event-2020-12-27-3-25"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the Czech Republic.

**Archived source account.** The Czech Republic begins a vaccination campaign against COVID-19 using the Pfizer-BioNTech vaccine tozinameran, with Prime Minister Andrej Babiš and World War II veteran Emilie Řepíková among the first people to get vaccinated.

Source citations (as archived): [Expats.cz](<https://www.expats.cz/czech-news/article/czech-covid-19-vaccinations-begin-with-prime-minister-andrej-babis>).

<a id="event-2020-12-27-3-27"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Greece.

**Archived source account.** Greece officially begins a vaccination programme against COVID-19, with ICU nurse Efstathia Kambissiouli, President Katerina Sakellaropoulou and Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis among the first people to get vaccinated.

Source citations (as archived): [The National Herald](<https://www.thenationalherald.com/archive_general_news_greece/arthro/covid_19_vaccinations_begin_in_greece_greek_president_pm_vaccinated-1476393/>).

<a id="event-2020-12-27-3-29"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Norway, Variant of Concern 202012/01.

**Archived source account.** Norway reports its first cases of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2, after two people who travelled from the United Kingdom earlier in December test positive for COVID-19.

<a id="event-2020-12-27-3-31"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal, Variant of Concern 202012/01.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Romania.

**Archived source account.** Romania begins a vaccination campaign against COVID-19 using the Pfizer-BioNTech vaccine tozinameran. The first person vaccinated is a 26-year-old doctor from Bucharest.

Source citations (as archived): [Diário do Nordeste](<https://diariodonordeste.verdesmares.com.br/politica/hamilton-mourao-testa-positivo-para-covid-19-e-fica-em-isolamento-em-brasilia-1.3026951>).

<a id="event-2020-12-27-3-39"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in South America / COVID-19 pandemic in Uruguay.

**Archived source account.** Uruguay reported a record of 11 deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 158.

Source citations (as archived): [El País](<https://www.elpais.com.uy/informacion/salud/coronavirus-uruguay-registraron-casos-nuevos-muertes.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-12-27-4-1"></a>

Context: Kaiyuan stabbing attack.

**Archived source account.** Seven people are killed and seven others injured in a mass stabbing in Kaiyuan, Liaoning, China. The attacker has been arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-55460642>).

<a id="event-2020-12-27-4-3"></a>

Context: 2020 Nashville bombing.

**Archived source account.** Authorities officially identify the perpetrator of Friday's suicide bombing in Nashville, Tennessee, as 63-year-old Anthony Quinn Warner and conclude that he had been acting alone.

Source citations (as archived): [The Tennessean](<https://www.tennessean.com/story/news/crime/2020/12/27/nashville-explosion-questions-remain-investigation-enters-day-3/4050488001/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2020-12-27-5-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Nigerien general election.

**Archived source account.** Citizens in Niger head to the polls to elect their President in their first democratic power transfer since the country's independence from France. The election comes amidst a growing Islamist insurgency as Mohamed Bazoum is the favourite to succeed incumbent Mahamadou Issoufou, who is stepping down after serving two five-year terms.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/niger-stages-historic-election-despite-jihadist-attacks/a-56066362>).

<a id="event-2020-12-27-5-3"></a>

Context: 2020 Central African general election.

**Archived source account.** Elections in the Central African Republic are underway, after a campaign marred by violence between government and rebel forces.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-55458427>).

### 2020-12-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1361328773](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20December%2028&oldid=1361328773>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-12-28-0-1"></a>

Context: Insurgency in the North Caucasus.

**Archived source account.** Two knife-wielding assailants kill a police officer and wound another in Grozny, Chechnya. The attackers are shot dead while trying to seize weapons. It is the second attack against police in the city in recent months; in October, two officers were killed by militants.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-russia-security-grozny/gunmen-shoot-dead-two-law-enforcement-officers-in-russias-chechnya-reports-idUKKBN2920YW?il=0>).

<a id="event-2020-12-28-0-3"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Second Nagorno-Karabakh War.

**Archived source account.** An Azerbaijani soldier is killed and another injured in a shooting in Nagorno-Karabakh. Azerbaijan blames the attack on "an Armenian armed group"; all the six attackers are shot dead.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/12/28/nagorno-karabakh-azerbaijan-says-one-dead-in-armenian-attack>).

<a id="event-2020-12-28-0-5"></a>

Context: Mali Civil War, Operation Barkhane.

**Archived source account.** Three French Army troops are killed when their armoured personnel carrier hits a roadside bomb in Hombori, Mali.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20201228-three-french-soldiers-killed-in-mali-operation>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-12-28-1-1"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The United States House of Representatives passes the CASH Act, a bill that increases direct payments from $600 to $2,000, with a vote of 275–134. The bill is expected to head to the United States Senate for a vote.

Source citations (as archived): [Newsweek](<https://www.newsweek.com/house-passes-2000-stimulus-checks-after-trump-signs-relief-bill-fate-uncertain-senate-1557469>); [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/homenews/house/531883-house-passes-bill-boosting-stimulus-checks-to-2000>).

<a id="event-2020-12-28-1-2"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Senator Bernie Sanders announces that he will filibuster a Senate vote to override President Donald Trump's veto of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2021 if the Senate doesn't vote on providing $2,000 direct payments to Americans.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.com/news/2020/12/28/bernie-sanders-filibuster-delay-defense-veto-override-451697>).

<a id="event-2020-12-28-1-4"></a>

Context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on tourism, COVID-19 pandemic in Sri Lanka.

**Archived source account.** Sri Lanka reopens the island for tourism after closing it for nine months.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Insider](<https://www.businessinsider.com/sri-lanka-reopens-tourists-travel-bans-covid-19-2020-12>).

<a id="event-2020-12-28-1-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Russian-led consortium Nord Stream AG says it has completed the construction of the Nord Stream 2 natural gas pipeline in Germany's exclusive economic zone in the Baltic Sea. The U.S. had previously threatened to impose wider sanctions on the project if work continued.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-russia-nordstream2-germany/nord-stream-2-gas-pipeline-says-has-completed-section-in-german-waters-idUKKBN2921OH?il=0>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-12-28-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Russian-flagged fishing trawler Onega capsizes near the Novaya Zemlya archipelago in the Barents Sea. 17 fishermen are missing and presumed dead, while two have been rescued. Search and rescue operations in the area have been suspended due to strong winds and low temperatures.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2020/12/28/17-missing-after-russian-fishing-boat-sinks-in-barents-sea-a72495>).

<a id="event-2020-12-28-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A power outage lasting several hours affects over 10 million people in Mexico, including in the capital Mexico City.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mexico-electricity-idUSKBN292226>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2020-12-28-5-1"></a>

Context: 2020–2021 United States racial unrest, Andre Hill protests.

**Archived source account.** Officer Adam Coy, who fatally shot Andre Hill was fired. Coy had failed to follow the required protocol by not turning on his body camera and failed to aid the dying man. Hill's killing was the second police-involved shooting in Columbus, Ohio in weeks, setting off renewed protests against the authorities for excessive use of force.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2020/12/28/950976148/columbus-ohio-officer-who-shot-and-killed-andre-hill-is-fired>).

<a id="event-2020-12-28-5-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China.

**Archived source account.** A court in China sentences a citizen journalist to four years in prison for "picking quarrels and provoking trouble" while reporting during the peak of the COVID-19 pandemic earlier this year in Wuhan. The journalist's lawyer says that they will probably appeal the verdict.,

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-china-journalist/china-jails-citizen-journalist-for-four-years-over-wuhan-virus-reporting-idUSKBN2920EI?il=0>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-55463241>).

<a id="event-2020-12-28-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A court in Saudi Arabia sentences women's rights activist Loujain al-Hathloul to five years and eight months in prison on grounds of "various activities prohibited by the anti-terrorism law". The verdict comes despite pressure from international organizations to release her.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/saudi-arabia-jails-womens-rights-activist-loujain-al-hathloul-local-media/a-56071860>).
