### 2020-12-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1355125047](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20December%2029&oldid=1355125047>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2020-12-29-0-1"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell blocks an attempt by Senate Democrats to increase the direct payments from $600 to $2,000. However, McConnell also said that the Senate will consider a process to provide $2,000 in stimulus checks to Americans, a measure that is supported by both Democrats and President Donald Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/congress/mcconnell-blocks-senate-democrats-move-pass-2-000-coronavirus-checks-n1252483>); [Business Insider](<https://www.businessinsider.com/mcconnell-senate-2000-stimulus-checks-2020-12>).

<a id="event-2020-12-29-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The first commercial Boeing 737 MAX flight in the United States since worldwide groundings began in March 2020 occurs. The flight, between New York City's LaGuardia Airport and Miami International Airport, was operated by American Airlines.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2020/12/29/737-max-returns-to-the-us-after-deadly-crashes.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-12-29-1-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Petrinja earthquake.

**Archived source account.** A magnitude 6.4 earthquake strikes Petrinja, Croatia, destroying half of the town. Several other cities in the country are also affected. At least seven people are killed, five of whom were in Glina, one in Petrinja, and one in Žažina. Several others are also injured.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-55474230>).

<a id="event-2020-12-29-1-2"></a>

Context: 2020 Petrinja earthquake.

**Archived source account.** The Krško Nuclear Power Plant in neighboring Slovenia, which produces around 20 percent of the country's electricity, is shut down as a precaution. Preventive inspections at the plant are ongoing.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/slovenia-nuclear-plant-shut-after-6-2-magnitude-earthquake-in-neighbouring-croatia-2345189>); [IAEA](<https://www.iaea.org/newscenter/pressreleases/iaea-informed-by-slovenian-authority-that-krsko-nuclear-power-plant-in-safe-shutdown-following-earthquake>).

<a id="event-2020-12-29-5-2"></a>

<a id="event-2020-12-29-5-5"></a>

Context: Abortion in Argentina / Voluntary Interruption of Pregnancy Bill.

**Archived source account.** The Senate begins to debate the legalization of abortion up until the 14th week of pregnancy. If passed, Argentina will become the third Latin American country to allow abortion to be performed on demand, after Cuba and Uruguay. The Catholic Church opposes the move. The bill has already been approved by the lower house.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-argentina-abortion/argentinas-senate-poised-to-vote-on-legalizing-abortion-rare-in-region-idUSKBN293109?il=0>).

### 2020-12-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1273224851](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20December%2030&oldid=1273224851>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-12-30-0-2"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War / 2020 Aden attacks.

**Archived source account.** At least 25 people are killed and more than 110 others wounded in an attack at the Aden International Airport, shortly after a plane carrying the newly formed government arrived from Saudi Arabia. Prime Minister Maeen Abdulmalik Saeed is taken to safety along with the Saudi ambassador and all remaining government members. The Houthis are blamed for the attack, but the group has denied responsibility. Another blast was later reported at the presidential palace, where the cabinet was meeting.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/blast-at-yemens-aden-airport-as-new-cabinet-members-land/2020/12/30/f29d6a1e-4a91-11eb-97b6-4eb9f72ff46b_story.html>).

<a id="event-2020-12-30-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** Syrian state media reports that an ambush on a bus near Palmyra killed at least 37 people. A senior military defector in the region says that the bus was transporting Syrian Army troops and pro-government militia from Deir ez-Zor to the Tiyas Military Airbase.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-crisis-attack/syrian-state-media-says-28-killed-in-a-bus-ambush-in-deir-al-zor-idUSKBN2941ZI?il=0>); [SOHR](<https://www.syriahr.com/en/198297/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-12-30-1-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Gjerdrum landslide.

**Archived source account.** A landslide in the village of Gjerdrum, Viken, Norway, leaves at least ten people injured and buries several houses. Ten people are missing.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-55484627>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2020-12-30-3-1"></a>

Context: United States–European Union relations, Trump tariffs.

<a id="event-2020-12-30-4-2"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2020/12/30/world/americas/argentina-legalizes-abortion.html>).

<a id="event-2020-12-30-4-4"></a>

Context: Islam in Indonesia.

**Archived source account.** Indonesia bans any activities held by the Islamic Defenders Front, a hardline Islamic group led by the controversial cleric Muhammad Rizieq Shihab. The Coordinating Political, Legal, and Security Minister Mahfud MD says the ban is necessary because the group no longer has any legal standing as a mass organisation.

Source citations (as archived): [The Straits Times](<https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/indonesia-bans-hardline-islamic-defenders-front-group>).

<a id="event-2020-12-30-5-1"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/bobi-wine-ugandan-presidential-challenger-and-team-arrested/ar-BB1cmfov>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2020-12-30-6-1"></a>

Context: 2020 in paleontology.

**Archived source account.** Scientists at the Russian Academy of Sciences announce the discovery of a "well-preserved" woolly rhinoceros carcass in Abyysky District, Sakha, Russia, which was revealed by melting permafrost in August. The Russian Academy of Sciences says that the woolly rhinoceros was likely 3 or 4 years old when it died by drowning in the river, and could be anywhere from 20,000 to 50,000 years old.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/preserved-ice-age-woolly-rhino-found-siberia-74973072?cid=clicksource_4380645_2_heads_hero_live_headlines_hed>).

### 2020-12-31

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1219268851](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2020%20December%2031&oldid=1219268851>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2020-12-31-0-1"></a>

Context: Allied Democratic Forces insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Allied Democratic Forces militants kill at least 25 people in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo. Local officials say most of the victims were farmers working in the fields, and that some victims were decapitated.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/dr-congo-rebels-kill-dozens-of-farmers/a-56111863>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2020-12-31-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Australian Prime Minister Scott Morrison announces a change, effective January 1, to the wording of the country's national anthem, in which the word "young" in the second line "For we are young and free" is changed to "one", in an effort to reflect the country's long indigenous history.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-55494542>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2020-12-31-2-1"></a>

Context: Mining in Papua New Guinea.

**Archived source account.** Two people are confirmed dead and 15 others are feared dead after a landslide at an informal alluvial mining camp in Goilala District, Central Province, Papua New Guinea.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/433867/15-feared-dead-after-landslide-buries-png-village>).

<a id="event-2020-12-31-2-3"></a>

Context: Migrants' African routes.

**Archived source account.** The Algerian Civil Defence says that 20 people were killed and 11 others injured when a vehicle carrying illegal migrants overturned in Tamanrasset. Tamanrasset is a crossing point for illegal migrants from neighboring countries, specifically Mali and Niger.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.channelstv.com/2020/12/31/20-dead-in-algerian-road-accident/>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom / COVID-19 pandemic in England.

<a id="event-2020-12-31-5-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in Wisconsin, Grafton vaccine incident.

Context: 2020–2021 United States racial unrest, Dolal Idd protests.

**Archived source account.** The authorities arrested dozens of protesters in Minneapolis as they demanded answers into the fatal police shooting of 23-year-old Dolal Bayle Idd on December 30. The protests came after the body camera footage from a deadly traffic stop was released. At least 15 people were detained for allegedly rioting and 21 people were cited and released.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-12-31/hong-kong-s-top-court-orders-tycoon-jimmy-lai-returned-to-jail>).
